                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        name,
                        description,
                        price: retailPrice,
                        cost_price: costPrice,
                        category,
                        tier_prices: tierPrices,
                        preorder_deadline: new Date(deadlineValue).toISOString(),
                        ...(imageUrl ? { image_url: imageUrl } : {})
                    })
                });
                const result = await response.json();
                const productId = result && result.data && result.data.id;
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !productId) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `商品建立失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                sopCreatedProductId = String(productId);
                document.getElementById('sop-copy-button').disabled = false;
                status.className = 'chart-status success';
                status.textContent = `商品已上架（ID：${sopCreatedProductId}），可複製含專屬開單連結的廣播文案。`;
                updateSopPreview();
                showToast('商品已成功上架，WhatsApp 文案已準備好。');
                await loadProducts();
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('SOP 商品建立失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '商品建立失敗，請稍後再試。';
                showToast(error.message || '商品上架失敗，請稍後再試。');
            } finally {
                button.disabled = false;
                button.textContent = '確認上架';
            }
        }

        async function copySopPost() {
            if (!sopCreatedProductId) {
                showToast('請先確認上架，建立商品專屬開單連結。');
                return;
            }
            try {
                await navigator.clipboard.writeText(getSopPreviewText());
                showToast('WhatsApp 廣播文案已複製。');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('複製 SOP 廣播文案失敗：', error);
                showToast('複製失敗，請檢查瀏覽器剪貼簿權限。');
            }
        }

        async function addProductCategory() {
            const input = document.getElementById('new-product-category');
            const button = document.getElementById('add-category-button');
            const message = document.getElementById('category-form-message');
            const name = input.value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                message.className = 'error';
                message.textContent = '請輸入分類名稱。';
                input.focus();
                return;
            }
            if (name.length > 100) {
                message.className = 'error';
                message.textContent = '分類名稱不可超過 100 個字元。';
                input.focus();
                return;
            }
            const existing = productCategories.find(category =>
                category.name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() === name.toLocaleLowerCase()
            );
            if (existing) {
                populateProductCategoryOptions(existing.name);
                message.className = 'success';
                message.textContent = '此分類已存在，已選用現有分類。';
                input.value = '';
                return;
            }

            button.disabled = true;
            message.className = '';
            message.textContent = '正在儲存分類…';
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch('/api/products/categories', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ name })
                });
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data ||
                    !result.data.category) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `分類新增失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                await loadProductCategories(result.data.category.name);
                input.value = '';
                message.className = 'success';
                message.textContent = result.message || '分類已儲存並可使用。';
                showToast('新品分類新增成功！');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('新增產品分類失敗：', error);
                message.className = 'error';
                message.textContent = error.message || '分類新增失敗，請稍後再試。';
            } finally {
                button.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function saveProduct(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            const id = document.getElementById('product-id').value;
            const name = document.getElementById('product-name').value.trim();
            const price = document.getElementById('product-price').valueAsNumber;
            const costPriceInput = document.getElementById('product-cost-price');
            const costPrice = costPriceInput.value === '' ? null : costPriceInput.valueAsNumber;
            const category = document.getElementById('product-category').value.trim();
            const tierPricesRaw = document.getElementById('product-tier-prices').value.trim() || '[]';
            const preorderDeadlineRaw = document.getElementById('product-preorder-deadline').value;
            const message = document.getElementById('product-form-message');
            const button = document.getElementById('product-save-button');
            let tierPrices;
            try {
                tierPrices = JSON.parse(tierPricesRaw);
            } catch (error) {
                message.textContent = '階梯價 JSON 格式無效。';
                return;
            }
            if (!Array.isArray(tierPrices)) {
                message.textContent = '階梯價必須是 JSON 陣列。';
                return;
            }
            if (!category) {
                message.textContent = '請選擇產品分類；如未有合適分類，請先新增分類。';
                return;
            }
            if (
                name.length < 1 ||
                name.length > 255 ||
                !Number.isFinite(price) ||
                price < 0 ||
                price > 99999999.99 ||
                Math.abs(price * 100 - Math.round(price * 100)) > 1e-8 ||
                costPrice !== null && (
                    !Number.isFinite(costPrice) ||
                    costPrice < 0 ||
                    costPrice > 99999999.99 ||
                    Math.abs(costPrice * 100 - Math.round(costPrice * 100)) > 1e-8
                )
            ) {
                message.textContent = '請輸入有效商品名稱及最多兩位小數的非負價格。';
                return;
            }

            button.disabled = true;
            button.textContent = id ? '正在儲存…' : '正在新增…';
            message.textContent = id ? '正在更新商品資料…' : '正在建立商品…';
            message.style.color = '#64748b';
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(
                    id ? `/api/products/${encodeURIComponent(id)}` : '/api/products',
                    {
                        method: id ? 'PATCH' : 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            name,
                            price,
                            cost_price: costPrice,
                            category,
                            tier_prices: tierPrices,
                            preorder_deadline: preorderDeadlineRaw
                                ? new Date(preorderDeadlineRaw).toISOString()
                                : null
                        })
                    }
                );
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `商品儲存失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }

                document.getElementById('product-dialog').close();
                const status = document.getElementById('products-status');
                status.textContent = result.message || '商品已儲存，正在重新載入列表…';
                showToast('商品儲存成功！');
                try {
                    await loadProducts();
                } catch (refreshError) {
                    status.textContent = `商品已儲存，但重新載入列表失敗：${refreshError.message}`;
                    status.className = 'chart-status error';
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('儲存商品失敗：', error);
                message.style.color = '#b91c1c';
                message.textContent = error.message || '商品儲存失敗，請稍後再試。';
            } finally {
                button.disabled = false;
                button.textContent = id ? '儲存修改' : '新增商品';
            }
        }

        async function loadDashboard() {
            document.getElementById('status-badge').className = 'badge warning';
            document.getElementById('status-badge').textContent = '載入中';
            clearDashboardData();

            try {
                if (adminScopes.includes('products')) {
                    await Promise.all([
                        loadProductCategories(),
                        loadProducts(),
                        loadInventoryAlerts(),
                        loadInventoryAdjustments()
                    ]);
                }
                if (adminScopes.includes('inbound')) {
                    await Promise.all([loadInboundProducts(), loadExpiringStock()]);
                }
                const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
                    timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong',
                    year: 'numeric',
                    month: '2-digit',
                    day: '2-digit'
                });
                const today = dateFormatter.format(new Date());
                const pastDate = dateFormatter.format(new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86400000));
                const query = `start_date=${encodeURIComponent(pastDate)}&end_date=${encodeURIComponent(today)}`;
                if (adminScopes.includes('analytics')) {
                    await loadAnalyticsSummary();
                    await loadProfitAnalytics();
                    const resOverview = await adminFetch(`/api/analytics/overview?${query}`);
                    const jsonOverview = await resOverview.json();
                    if (!resOverview.ok || !jsonOverview || jsonOverview.success !== true || !jsonOverview.data) {
                        throw new Error(jsonOverview && jsonOverview.message
                            ? jsonOverview.message
                            : `營收報表載入失敗（HTTP ${resOverview.status}）。`);
                    }

                    const data = jsonOverview.data;
                    document.getElementById('m-revenue').textContent =
                        `$${Number(data.total_revenue || 0).toFixed(2)}`;
                    document.getElementById('m-orders').textContent =
                        String(data.total_orders || 0);
                    document.getElementById('m-paid').textContent =
                        `${Number(data.paid_order_percentage || 0)}%`;
                    const shippedPercentage = data.shipped_order_percentage === undefined
                        ? 100 - Number(data.unshipped_order_percentage || 0)
                        : Number(data.shipped_order_percentage || 0);
                    document.getElementById('m-shipped').textContent =
                        `${shippedPercentage}%`;

                    await loadSalesCharts(query);
                }
                if (adminScopes.includes('shipping')) {
                    await loadPickList();
                }
                if (adminScopes.includes('orders')) {
                    await loadAdminOrders(0);
                }
                if (adminScopes.includes('reviews')) {
                    await loadAdminReviews(0);
                }
                document.getElementById('status-badge').className = 'badge success';
                document.getElementById('status-badge').textContent = '已登入';
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                document.getElementById('status-badge').className = 'badge warning';
                document.getElementById('status-badge').textContent = '載入失敗';
                setSalesChartStatus(`圖表未載入：${err.message || '營收報表讀取失敗。'}`, true);
                showToast(err.message || '連接伺服器失敗');
            }
        }

        function setSalesChartStatus(message, isError) {
            const status = document.getElementById('sales-chart-status');
            status.textContent = message;
            status.className = isError ? 'chart-status error' : 'chart-status';
        }

        function renderSalesCharts(data) {
            if (
                !window.Chart ||
                !Array.isArray(data.labels) ||
                !Array.isArray(data.revenue) ||
                !Array.isArray(data.order_count) ||
                data.labels.length !== data.revenue.length ||
                data.labels.length !== data.order_count.length ||
                !data.revenue.every(Number.isFinite) ||
                !data.order_count.every(Number.isFinite)
            ) {
                throw new Error('圖表程式或趨勢資料格式無效。');
            }

            if (revenueChart) revenueChart.destroy();
            if (ordersChart) ordersChart.destroy();

            revenueChart = new Chart(document.getElementById('revenue-chart'), {
                type: 'line',
                data: {
                    labels: data.labels,
                    datasets: [{
                        label: '營業額 ($)',
                        data: data.revenue,
                        borderColor: '#2563eb',
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.14)',
                        fill: true,
                        tension: 0.25
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false },
                    scales: {
                        y: { beginAtZero: true, title: { display: true, text: '金額 ($)' } },
                        x: { ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 10 } }
                    }
                }
            });

            ordersChart = new Chart(document.getElementById('orders-chart'), {
                type: 'bar',
                data: {
                    labels: data.labels,
                    datasets: [{
                        label: '訂單數',
                        data: data.order_count,
                        backgroundColor: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.75)',
                        borderColor: '#059669',
                        borderWidth: 1
                    }]
                },
                options: {
                    responsive: true,
                    maintainAspectRatio: false,
                    scales: {
                        y: { beginAtZero: true, ticks: { precision: 0 }, title: { display: true, text: '訂單數' } },
                        x: { ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 10 } }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        async function loadSalesCharts(query) {
            setSalesChartStatus('正在載入最近 30 日銷售趨勢…', false);
            try {
                if (!window.Chart) {
                    throw new Error('Chart.js 未能載入，請檢查本機 vendor 檔案。');
                }

                const response = await adminFetch(`/api/analytics/sales-trend?${query}`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `銷售趨勢載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }

                renderSalesCharts(result.data);
                setSalesChartStatus(
                    `已載入 ${result.data.start_date} 至 ${result.data.end_date}：$${Number(result.data.total_revenue).toFixed(2)}，${result.data.total_orders} 張訂單。`,
                    false
                );
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('載入銷售趨勢圖表失敗：', error);
                if (revenueChart) {
                    revenueChart.destroy();
                    revenueChart = null;
                }
                if (ordersChart) {
                    ordersChart.destroy();
                    ordersChart = null;
                }
                setSalesChartStatus(error.message || '銷售趨勢載入失敗。', true);
            }
        }

        async function loadProducts() {
            const statusMessage = document.getElementById('products-status');
            const tbody = document.getElementById('products-tbody');
            
            tbody.replaceChildren();
            for(let i=0; i<4; i++){
                const skRow = document.createElement('tr');
                for(let j=0; j<4; j++){
                    const skCell = document.createElement('td');
                    skCell.innerHTML = '<div class="skeleton" style="height: 20px; width: 80%;"></div>';
                    skRow.appendChild(skCell);
                }
                tbody.appendChild(skRow);
            }

            statusMessage.textContent = '正在載入商品…';
            statusMessage.className = 'chart-status';
            try {
                const allProducts = [];
                let totalCount = 0;
                let offset = 0;
                do {
                    const query = new URLSearchParams({
                        limit: '100',
                        offset: String(offset),
                        sort: 'newest'
                    });
                    const response = await adminFetch(`/api/products?${query}`);
                    const result = await response.json();
                    if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data ||
                        !Array.isArray(result.data.products) ||
                        !Number.isSafeInteger(result.data.total_count)) {
                        throw new Error(result && result.message
                            ? result.message
                            : `商品列表載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                    }
                    allProducts.push(...result.data.products);
                    totalCount = result.data.total_count;
                    offset = result.data.offset + result.data.products.length;
                    if (result.data.products.length === 0) break;
                } while (offset < totalCount);

                const rowsData = allProducts;
                if (rowsData.length !== totalCount) {
                    throw new Error('商品列表分頁讀取不完整，請重新載入。');
                }

                if (rowsData.length === 0) {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const cell = document.createElement('td');
                    cell.colSpan = 4;
                    cell.style.textAlign = 'center';
                    cell.textContent = '目前沒有商品';
                    row.appendChild(cell);
                    tbody.replaceChildren(row);
                    statusMessage.textContent = '目前沒有商品。';
                    return true;
                }

                const rows = rowsData.map(product => {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const name = document.createElement('td');
                    name.textContent = product.product_name || product.name || `商品 #${product.id}`;
                    const price = document.createElement('td');
                    const productPrice = Number(product.price ?? product.retail_price);
                    price.textContent = Number.isFinite(productPrice)
                        ? `$${productPrice.toFixed(2)}`
                        : '—';
                    const stock = document.createElement('td');
                    const hasValidStock = Number.isSafeInteger(product.stock) &&
                        product.stock >= 0 &&
                        product.stock <= 2147483647;
                    if (hasValidStock) {
                        const stockCount = document.createElement('strong');
                        stockCount.textContent = `${product.stock} 件`;
                        const stockBadge = document.createElement('span');
                        stockBadge.className = `badge ${product.stock <= 5 ? 'low-stock' : 'stock-ok'}`;
                        stockBadge.textContent = product.stock <= 5 ? '低庫存' : '庫存正常';
                        stockBadge.setAttribute('aria-label', product.stock <= 5 ? '低庫存警示' : '庫存正常');
                        stock.append(stockCount, document.createElement('br'), stockBadge);
                    } else {
                        stock.textContent = '庫存資料無效，請檢查資料庫';
                    }
                    const update = document.createElement('td');
                    update.className = 'product-actions';
                    const editButton = document.createElement('button');
                    editButton.type = 'button';
                    editButton.className = 'secondary';
                    editButton.textContent = '編輯商品';
                    editButton.addEventListener('click', () => openProductDialog(product));
                    update.appendChild(editButton);
                    const input = document.createElement('input');
                    input.className = 'stock-input';
                    input.type = 'number';
                    input.min = '0';
                    input.max = '2147483647';
                    input.step = '1';
                    input.inputMode = 'numeric';
                    input.value = hasValidStock ? String(product.stock) : '';
                    input.placeholder = hasValidStock ? '新庫存' : '不可更新';
                    input.disabled = !hasValidStock;
                    input.setAttribute('aria-label', `設定${name.textContent}庫存`);
                    const reasonSelect = document.createElement('select');
                    reasonSelect.setAttribute('aria-label', `選擇${name.textContent}庫存設定原因`);
                    reasonSelect.add(new Option('選擇原因', ''));
                    for (const reason of ['損毀', '員工自用', '實體盤點差異', '其他']) {
                        reasonSelect.add(new Option(reason, reason));
                    }
                    const button = document.createElement('button');
                    button.className = 'stock-save';
                    button.type = 'button';
                    button.textContent = '更新';
                    button.disabled = !hasValidStock;
                    button.addEventListener('click', () =>
                        updateProductStock(product.id, input, reasonSelect, button, stock));
                    const feedback = document.createElement('small');
                    feedback.className = 'stock-feedback';
                    feedback.setAttribute('role', 'status');
                    feedback.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
                    const adjustmentButton = document.createElement('button');
                    adjustmentButton.type = 'button';
                    adjustmentButton.className = 'secondary';
                    adjustmentButton.textContent = '調整原因';
                    adjustmentButton.setAttribute('aria-label', `記錄${name.textContent}庫存調整`);
                    adjustmentButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        openInventoryAdjustment(product);
                    });
                    update.append(input, reasonSelect, button, feedback, adjustmentButton);
                    row.append(name, price, stock, update);
                    return row;
                });
                tbody.replaceChildren(...rows);
                statusMessage.textContent = `已載入 ${rowsData.length} 件商品。`;
                return true;
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(error);
                statusMessage.textContent = error.message || '商品列表載入失敗。';
                statusMessage.className = 'chart-status error';
                const tbody = document.getElementById('products-tbody');
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                const cell = document.createElement('td');
                cell.colSpan = 4;
                cell.style.textAlign = 'center';
                cell.style.color = '#b91c1c';
                cell.textContent = error.message || '商品列表載入失敗。';
                row.appendChild(cell);
                tbody.replaceChildren(row);
                throw error;
            }
        }

        async function loadInventoryAlerts() {
            const status = document.getElementById('inventory-alerts-status');
            const tbody = document.getElementById('inventory-alerts-tbody');
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在載入補貨及滯銷提醒…';
            setTableSkeleton(tbody, 5, 3);
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch('/api/products/inventory-alerts');
                const result = await response.json();
                if (
                    !response.ok ||
                    !result ||
                    result.success !== true ||
                    !result.data ||
                    !Array.isArray(result.data.alerts)
                ) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `庫存警示載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }

                currentInventoryAlerts = result.data.alerts.filter(alert =>
                    alert && alert.is_restock_needed === true
                );
                const rows = result.data.alerts.map(alert => {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const name = document.createElement('td');
                    name.textContent = String(alert.product_name || `商品 #${alert.product_id}`);
                    const stock = document.createElement('td');
                    stock.textContent = Number.isSafeInteger(alert.stock) ? `${alert.stock} 件` : '—';
                    const lastOrder = document.createElement('td');
                    lastOrder.textContent = alert.last_order_date
                        ? new Date(alert.last_order_date).toLocaleDateString('zh-HK', {
                            timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong'
                        })
                        : '沒有訂單紀錄';
                    const restock = document.createElement('td');
                    restock.textContent = alert.is_restock_needed === true &&
                        Number.isSafeInteger(alert.suggested_restock_quantity)
                        ? `建議補 ${alert.suggested_restock_quantity} 件`
                        : '—';
                    const labels = document.createElement('td');
                    if (alert.is_restock_needed === true) {
                        const lowStock = document.createElement('span');
                        lowStock.className = 'badge low-stock';
                        lowStock.textContent = '需補貨';
                        labels.append(lowStock, document.createTextNode(' '));
                    }
                    if (alert.is_slow_moving === true) {
                        const slowStock = document.createElement('span');
                        slowStock.className = 'badge warning';
                        slowStock.textContent = '滯銷／建議清倉';
                        labels.append(slowStock);
                    }
                    if (!labels.childNodes.length) labels.textContent = '庫存正常';
                    row.append(name, stock, lastOrder, restock, labels);
                    return row;
                });
                if (rows.length === 0) {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const cell = document.createElement('td');
                    cell.colSpan = 5;
                    cell.className = 'crm-empty';
                    cell.textContent = '目前沒有低庫存或滯銷商品。';
                    row.append(cell);
                    rows.push(row);
                }
                tbody.replaceChildren(...rows);
                status.textContent =
                    `已載入 ${result.data.alerts.length} 件提醒商品（安全線 ${result.data.safety_stock} 件、滯銷 ${result.data.slow_days} 日）。`;
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('載入補貨及滯銷提醒失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '庫存提醒載入失敗。';
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                const cell = document.createElement('td');
                cell.colSpan = 5;
                cell.className = 'crm-empty';
                cell.textContent = '暫時無法載入庫存提醒。';
                row.append(cell);
                tbody.replaceChildren(row);
            }
        }

        function getRestockDraft() {
            const lines = currentInventoryAlerts.map((alert, index) =>
                `${index + 1}. ${alert.product_name || `商品 #${alert.product_id}`}：現有 ${alert.stock} 件，建議補貨 ${alert.suggested_restock_quantity} 件`
            );
            return lines.length
                ? `LittlePlanet 補貨查詢\n你好，想查詢以下商品的補貨及批發價：\n${lines.join('\n')}\n麻煩回覆最新價格及到貨時間，謝謝。`
                : '目前沒有低庫存商品需要補貨。';
        }

        function copyRestockDraft() {
            const draft = getRestockDraft();
            if (currentInventoryAlerts.length === 0) {
                showToast(draft);
                return;
            }
            copyToClipboard(draft);
            document.getElementById('restock-draft-status').textContent =
                `已整理 ${currentInventoryAlerts.length} 件低庫存商品；草稿不含顧客資料。`;
        }

        function openRestockWhatsApp() {
            if (currentInventoryAlerts.length === 0) {
                showToast('目前沒有低庫存商品需要補貨。');
                return;
            }
            const rawPhone = document.getElementById('supplier-whatsapp-phone').value.trim();
            const phone = rawPhone.replace(/[\s()+-]/g, '');
            if (rawPhone && !/^\d{8,15}$/.test(phone)) {
                showToast('批發商 WhatsApp 電話必須是 8 至 15 位數字。');
                return;
            }
            const destination = phone
                ? `https://wa.me/${phone}?text=${encodeURIComponent(getRestockDraft())}`
                : `https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(getRestockDraft())}`;
            window.open(destination, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
        }

        async function loadInventoryAdjustments() {
            const status = document.getElementById('inventory-adjustments-status');
            const tbody = document.getElementById('inventory-adjustments-tbody');
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在載入庫存調整記錄…';
            setTableSkeleton(tbody, 6, 3);
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch('/api/products/adjustments?limit=50');
                const result = await response.json();
                if (
                    !response.ok ||
                    !result ||
                    result.success !== true ||
                    !result.data ||
                    !Array.isArray(result.data.adjustments)
                ) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `庫存調整記錄載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                const rows = result.data.adjustments.map(adjustment => {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const values = [
                        adjustment.created_at
                            ? new Date(adjustment.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-HK', {
                                timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong'
                            })
                            : '—',
                        adjustment.product_name || `商品 #${adjustment.product_id}`,
                        adjustment.quantity_before,
                        Number(adjustment.quantity_delta) > 0
                            ? `+${adjustment.quantity_delta}`
                            : adjustment.quantity_delta,
                        adjustment.quantity_after,
                        [adjustment.reason, adjustment.note].filter(Boolean).join('：')
                    ];
                    for (const value of values) {
                        const cell = document.createElement('td');
                        cell.textContent = String(value ?? '—');
                        row.append(cell);
                    }
                    return row;
                });
                if (rows.length === 0) {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const cell = document.createElement('td');
                    cell.colSpan = 6;
                    cell.className = 'crm-empty';
                    cell.textContent = '目前沒有手動庫存調整記錄。';
                    row.append(cell);
                    rows.push(row);
                }
                tbody.replaceChildren(...rows);
                status.textContent = `已載入 ${result.data.adjustments.length} 筆調整記錄。`;
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('載入庫存調整記錄失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '庫存調整記錄載入失敗。';
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                const cell = document.createElement('td');
                cell.colSpan = 6;
                cell.className = 'crm-empty';
                cell.textContent = '暫時無法載入調整記錄。';
                row.append(cell);
                tbody.replaceChildren(row);
            }
        }

        function openInventoryAdjustment(product) {
            inventoryAdjustmentProductId = String(product.id);
            document.getElementById('inventory-adjustment-form').reset();
            document.getElementById('inventory-adjustment-product-name').textContent =
                `${product.product_name || product.name || `商品 #${product.id}`}（目前 ${product.stock} 件）`;
            document.getElementById('inventory-adjustment-message').textContent = '';
            document.getElementById('inventory-adjustment-dialog').showModal();
        }

        async function submitInventoryAdjustment(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            const button = document.getElementById('inventory-adjustment-submit');
            const status = document.getElementById('inventory-adjustment-message');
            const delta = Number(document.getElementById('inventory-adjustment-delta').value);
            const reason = document.getElementById('inventory-adjustment-reason').value;
            const note = document.getElementById('inventory-adjustment-note').value.trim();
            if (!inventoryAdjustmentProductId || !Number.isSafeInteger(delta) || delta === 0) {
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = '請輸入不等於零的整數增減數量。';
                return;
            }
            button.disabled = true;
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在記錄庫存調整…';
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(
                    `/api/products/${encodeURIComponent(inventoryAdjustmentProductId)}/adjustments`,
                    {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({
                            quantity_delta: delta,
                            reason,
                            note: note || null
                        })
                    }
                );
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `庫存調整失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                document.getElementById('inventory-adjustment-dialog').close();
                showToast(result.message || '庫存調整已記錄。');
                await Promise.all([
                    loadProducts(),
                    loadInventoryAlerts(),
                    loadInventoryAdjustments()
                ]);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('提交庫存調整失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '庫存調整失敗，請稍後再試。';
            } finally {
                button.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function importBulkTracking(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            const form = document.getElementById('bulk-tracking-form');
            const fileInput = document.getElementById('bulk-tracking-file');
            const button = document.getElementById('bulk-tracking-submit');
            const status = document.getElementById('bulk-tracking-status');
            const tbody = document.getElementById('bulk-tracking-results');
            const file = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
            if (!file) {
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = '請先選擇 CSV 或 Excel 物流檔案。';
                return;
            }
            if (file.size < 1 || file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = '物流檔案不可為空，且大小不可超過 2MB。';
                return;
            }

            button.disabled = true;
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在驗證並匯入物流單號；如有錯誤，整批不會出貨…';
            try {
                const extension = file.name.toLocaleLowerCase().split('.').pop();
                const contentType = extension === 'csv'
                    ? 'text/csv'
                    : extension === 'xls'
                        ? 'application/vnd.ms-excel'
                        : 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet';
                const response = await adminFetch('/api/shipping/bulk-tracking', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': contentType,
                        'X-Upload-Filename': encodeURIComponent(file.name),
                        'X-Shipping-Method': encodeURIComponent(
                            document.getElementById('bulk-tracking-method').value
                        )
                    },
                    body: await file.arrayBuffer()
                });
                const result = await response.json();
                if (
                    !response.ok ||
                    !result ||
                    result.success !== true ||
                    !result.data ||
                    !Array.isArray(result.data.results)
                ) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `物流匯入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                const rows = result.data.results.map(item => {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const orderNumber = document.createElement('td');
                    orderNumber.textContent = String(item.order_number || '—');
                    const tracking = document.createElement('td');
                    tracking.textContent = String(item.tracking_number || '—');
                    const notification = document.createElement('td');
                    notification.textContent = item.notification && item.notification.success
                        ? '已發送'
                        : '未能確認（可重試）';
                    row.append(orderNumber, tracking, notification);
                    return row;
                });
                tbody.replaceChildren(...rows);
                status.className = result.data.failed_notifications > 0
                    ? 'chart-status error'
                    : 'chart-status';
                status.textContent = result.message || '批量物流資料已匯入。';
                showToast(result.message || '批量物流資料已匯入。');
                try {
                    await loadPickList();
                } catch (refreshError) {
                    console.error('批量出貨後重新載入執貨清單失敗：', refreshError);
                }
                form.reset();
                document.getElementById('bulk-tracking-method').value = '順豐';
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('批量匯入物流單號失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '物流匯入失敗，請檢查檔案後重試。';
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                const cell = document.createElement('td');
                cell.colSpan = 3;
                cell.className = 'crm-empty';
                cell.textContent = '匯入未成功；交易已回滾，沒有部分出貨。';
                row.replaceChildren(cell);
                tbody.replaceChildren(row);
            } finally {
                button.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function loadExpiringStock() {
            const status = document.getElementById('expiring-status');
            const tbody = document.getElementById('expiring-stock-tbody');
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在載入近效期庫存…';
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch('/api/inbound/expiring');
                const result = await response.json();
                if (
                    !response.ok ||
                    !result ||
                    result.success !== true ||
                    !result.data ||
                    !Array.isArray(result.data.alerts)
                ) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `近效期庫存載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }

                const rows = result.data.alerts.map(alert => {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    for (const value of [
                        alert.product_name || '未命名商品',
                        alert.batch_id,
                        alert.best_before_date || '—',
                        Number.isSafeInteger(alert.quantity_remaining)
                            ? `${alert.quantity_remaining} 件`
                            : '—'
                    ]) {
                        const cell = document.createElement('td');
                        cell.textContent = String(value ?? '—');
                        row.append(cell);
                    }
                    const alertCell = document.createElement('td');
                    const badge = document.createElement('span');
                    badge.className = alert.is_expired
                        ? 'expiring-badge expired'
                        : 'expiring-badge';
                    badge.textContent = alert.is_expired ? '已過期' : '30 日內到期';
                    alertCell.append(badge);
                    row.append(alertCell);
                    return row;
                });

                if (rows.length === 0) {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const cell = document.createElement('td');
                    cell.colSpan = 5;
                    cell.className = 'crm-empty';
                    cell.textContent = '目前沒有已過期或 30 日內到期的有效庫存批次。';
                    row.append(cell);
                    rows.push(row);
                }
                tbody.replaceChildren(...rows);
                status.textContent =
                    `共 ${result.data.alerts.length} 個批次需留意（截至 ${result.data.through_date}）。`;
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('載入近效期庫存失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '近效期庫存載入失敗，請稍後再試。';
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                const cell = document.createElement('td');
                cell.colSpan = 5;
                cell.className = 'crm-empty';
                cell.textContent = '暫時無法載入近效期庫存。';
                row.replaceChildren(cell);
                tbody.replaceChildren(row);
            }
        }

        async function loadInboundProducts() {
            const select = document.getElementById('inbound-product');
            const previousValue = select.value;
            const status = document.getElementById('inbound-form-message');
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在載入商品…';
            try {
                const products = [];
                let offset = 0;
                let totalCount = 0;
                do {
                    const query = new URLSearchParams({
                        limit: '100',
                        offset: String(offset),
                        sort: 'newest'
                    });
                    const response = await adminFetch(`/api/products?${query}`);
                    const result = await response.json();
                    if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data ||
                        !Array.isArray(result.data.products) ||
                        !Number.isSafeInteger(result.data.total_count)) {
                        throw new Error(result && result.message
                            ? result.message
                            : `入庫商品載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                    }
                    products.push(...result.data.products);
                    totalCount = result.data.total_count;
                    offset = result.data.offset + result.data.products.length;
                    if (result.data.products.length === 0) break;
                } while (offset < totalCount);

                const options = [new Option('-- 選擇商品 --', '')];
                for (const product of products) {
                    const name = product.product_name || product.name || `商品 #${product.id}`;
                    options.push(new Option(name, String(product.id)));
                }
                select.replaceChildren(...options);
                if (products.some(product => String(product.id) === previousValue)) {
                    select.value = previousValue;
                } else if (products.length > 0) {
                    select.value = String(products[0].id);
                }
                status.textContent = products.length
                    ? `已載入 ${products.length} 件商品。`
                    : '目前沒有可收貨商品。';
                if (select.value) {
                    await loadInboundBatches();
                } else {
                    renderInboundEmptyState('目前沒有商品');
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('載入入庫商品失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '入庫商品載入失敗。';
                renderInboundEmptyState(status.textContent);
            }
        }

        function renderInboundEmptyState(message) {
            const row = document.createElement('tr');
            const cell = document.createElement('td');
            cell.colSpan = 5;
            cell.style.textAlign = 'center';
            cell.textContent = message;
            row.appendChild(cell);
            document.getElementById('inbound-batches-tbody').replaceChildren(row);
        }

        async function loadInboundBatches() {
            const productId = document.getElementById('inbound-product').value;
            const status = document.getElementById('inbound-batches-status');
            const tbody = document.getElementById('inbound-batches-tbody');
            if (!productId) {
                status.textContent = '選擇商品後載入批次';
                renderInboundEmptyState('選擇商品後載入批次');
                return;
            }

            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在載入批次…';
            try {
                const query = new URLSearchParams({ product_id: productId });
                const response = await adminFetch(`/api/inbound/batches?${query}`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data ||
                    !Array.isArray(result.data.batches)) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `收貨批次載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }

                if (result.data.batches.length === 0) {
                    renderInboundEmptyState('沒有批次紀錄；目前庫存可能是 migration 前的舊庫存。');
                } else {
                    const rows = result.data.batches.map(batch => {
                        const row = document.createElement('tr');
                        const id = document.createElement('td');
                        id.textContent = batch.is_legacy_stock
                            ? '舊庫存（未分批）'
                            : `#${batch.batch_id}`;
                        const bestBefore = document.createElement('td');
                        const bestBeforeLabel = document.createElement('span');
                        bestBeforeLabel.textContent = batch.is_legacy_stock
                            ? '未知（舊庫存）'
                            : batch.best_before_date || '無最佳使用期限';
                        bestBefore.appendChild(bestBeforeLabel);
                        if (batch.is_legacy_stock) {
                            const legacyNote = document.createElement('small');
                            legacyNote.className = 'stock-feedback';
                            legacyNote.textContent = '舊庫存為日期未知的開倉快照，不可直接指定日期。';
                            bestBefore.appendChild(legacyNote);
                        } else {
                            const editDateButton = document.createElement('button');
                            editDateButton.type = 'button';
                            editDateButton.className = 'secondary batch-date-edit-button';
                            editDateButton.textContent = '編輯日期';
                            editDateButton.setAttribute(
                                'aria-label',
                                `編輯批次 ${batch.batch_id} 最佳使用日期`
                            );
                            editDateButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                                openBatchDateEditor(batch, bestBefore, bestBeforeLabel);
                            });
                            bestBefore.appendChild(editDateButton);
                        }
                        const received = document.createElement('td');
                        received.textContent = `${batch.quantity_received} 件`;
                        const remaining = document.createElement('td');
                        remaining.textContent = `${batch.quantity_remaining} 件`;
                        const receivedAt = document.createElement('td');
                        receivedAt.textContent = batch.received_at
                            ? new Date(batch.received_at).toLocaleString('zh-HK')
                            : '未知（既有庫存）';
                        row.append(id, bestBefore, received, remaining, receivedAt);
                        return row;
                    });
                    tbody.replaceChildren(...rows);
                }
                status.textContent = `目前商品總庫存：${result.data.current_stock} 件；登記批次：${result.data.batches.length} 批。`;
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('載入收貨批次失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '收貨批次載入失敗。';
                renderInboundEmptyState(status.textContent);
            }
        }

        function openBatchDateEditor(batch, cell, label) {
            const editor = document.createElement('div');
            editor.className = 'inbound-controls';
            const input = document.createElement('input');
            input.type = 'date';
            input.value = batch.best_before_date || '';
            input.setAttribute(
                'aria-label',
                `批次 ${batch.batch_id} 最佳使用日期`
            );

            const saveButton = document.createElement('button');
            saveButton.type = 'button';
            saveButton.textContent = '儲存';
            saveButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                saveBatchBestBeforeDate(batch.batch_id, input.value || null, saveButton);
            });

            const clearButton = document.createElement('button');
            clearButton.type = 'button';
            clearButton.className = 'secondary';
            clearButton.textContent = '清除日期';
            clearButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                saveBatchBestBeforeDate(batch.batch_id, null, clearButton);
            });

            const cancelButton = document.createElement('button');
            cancelButton.type = 'button';
            cancelButton.className = 'secondary';
            cancelButton.textContent = '取消';
            cancelButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
                editor.remove();
                label.hidden = false;
                cell.querySelector('.batch-date-edit-button').hidden = false;
            });

            editor.append(input, saveButton, clearButton, cancelButton);
            label.hidden = true;
            cell.querySelector('.batch-date-edit-button').hidden = true;
            cell.appendChild(editor);
            input.focus();
        }

        async function saveBatchBestBeforeDate(batchId, bestBeforeDate, button) {
            const status = document.getElementById('inbound-batches-status');
            button.disabled = true;
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在更新批次最佳使用日期…';
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(
                    `/api/inbound/batches/${encodeURIComponent(String(batchId))}`,
                    {
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ best_before_date: bestBeforeDate })
                    }
                );
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `更新批次日期失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }

                await loadInboundBatches();
                status.className = 'chart-status';
                status.textContent = result.message || '批次最佳使用日期更新成功。';
                showToast('批次效期更新成功！');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('更新批次最佳使用日期失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '更新批次最佳使用日期失敗，請稍後再試。';
                button.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function recordInboundReceipt(event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            const productId = document.getElementById('inbound-product').value;
            const quantity = document.getElementById('inbound-quantity').valueAsNumber;
            const bestBeforeDate = document.getElementById('inbound-best-before-date').value || null;
            const button = document.getElementById('inbound-submit-button');
            const message = document.getElementById('inbound-form-message');
            if (!productId || !Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) || quantity < 1 || quantity > 100000) {
                message.className = 'chart-status error';
                message.textContent = '請選擇商品，並輸入 1 至 100000 的整數收貨數量。';
                return;
            }

            button.disabled = true;
            message.className = 'chart-status';
            message.textContent = '正在記錄收貨…';
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch('/api/inbound/receipt', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        product_id: productId,
                        quantity,
                        best_before_date: bestBeforeDate
                    })
                });
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `收貨記錄失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                document.getElementById('inbound-quantity').value = '';
                document.getElementById('inbound-best-before-date').value = '';
                message.className = 'chart-status';
                showToast('收貨入庫登記成功！');
                try {
                    await Promise.all([
                        adminScopes.includes('products') ? loadProducts() : Promise.resolve(),
                        adminScopes.includes('products') ? loadInventoryAlerts() : Promise.resolve(),
                        loadInboundProducts()
                    ]);
                    message.textContent = result.message || '收貨批次已記錄，商品總庫存已更新。';
                } catch (refreshError) {
                    message.className = 'chart-status error';
                    message.textContent =
                        `收貨已記錄，但重新載入庫存清單失敗：${refreshError.message}`;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('記錄收貨失敗：', error);
                message.className = 'chart-status error';
                message.textContent = error.message || '收貨記錄失敗，請稍後再試。';
            } finally {
                button.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function updateProductStock(productId, input, reasonSelect, button, stockCell) {
            const stock = input.valueAsNumber;
            const feedback = button.parentElement.querySelector('.stock-feedback');
            if (!Number.isSafeInteger(stock) || stock < 0 || stock > 2147483647) {
                feedback.className = 'stock-feedback error';
                feedback.textContent = '請輸入 0 至 2147483647 的整數庫存。';
                input.focus();
                return;
            }
            if (!reasonSelect.value) {
                feedback.className = 'stock-feedback error';
                feedback.textContent = '請先選擇庫存調整原因。';
                reasonSelect.focus();
                return;
            }

            button.disabled = true;
            button.textContent = '更新中…';
            feedback.className = 'stock-feedback';
            feedback.textContent = '正在儲存庫存…';
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(`/api/products/${encodeURIComponent(productId)}/stock`, {
                    method: 'PATCH',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ stock, reason: reasonSelect.value })
                });
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `庫存更新失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                input.value = String(result.data.stock);
                const stockCount = document.createElement('strong');
                stockCount.textContent = `${result.data.stock} 件`;
                const stockBadge = document.createElement('span');
                stockBadge.className = `badge ${result.data.stock <= 5 ? 'low-stock' : 'stock-ok'}`;
                stockBadge.textContent = result.data.stock <= 5 ? '低庫存' : '庫存正常';
                stockBadge.setAttribute('aria-label', result.data.stock <= 5 ? '低庫存警示' : '庫存正常');
                stockCell.replaceChildren(stockCount, document.createElement('br'), stockBadge);
                feedback.className = 'stock-feedback success';
                feedback.textContent = `已更新至 ${result.data.stock} 件。`;
                showToast(`商品庫存已更新為 ${result.data.stock} 件`);
                await Promise.all([loadInventoryAlerts(), loadInventoryAdjustments()]);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(error);
                feedback.className = 'stock-feedback error';
                feedback.textContent = error.message || '庫存更新失敗，原庫存資料未作變更。';
            } finally {
                button.disabled = false;
                button.textContent = '更新';
            }
        }

        async function loadAnalyticsSummary() {
            const status = document.getElementById('analytics-summary-status');
            const topProducts = document.getElementById('summary-top-products');
            const orderTrend = document.getElementById('summary-order-trend');
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在載入營運分析…';
            document.getElementById('summary-total-revenue').textContent = '載入中…';
            document.getElementById('summary-total-orders').textContent = '載入中…';
            topProducts.textContent = '載入中…';
            orderTrend.textContent = '載入中…';
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch('/api/admin/analytics/summary');
                const result = await response.json();
                const data = result && result.data;
                if (
                    !response.ok ||
                    !result ||
                    result.success !== true ||
                    !data ||
                    !Number.isFinite(data.total_revenue) ||
                    !Number.isSafeInteger(data.total_orders) ||
                    !Array.isArray(data.top_products) ||
                    !Array.isArray(data.order_trend)
                ) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `營運分析載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }

                document.getElementById('summary-total-revenue').textContent =
                    HKD_FORMATTER.format(data.total_revenue);
                document.getElementById('summary-total-orders').textContent =
                    String(data.total_orders);

                const productRows = data.top_products.map((product, index) => {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    for (const value of [
                        Number.isSafeInteger(product.rank) ? product.rank : index + 1,
                        product.product_name || '未命名商品',
                        Number.isSafeInteger(product.quantity_sold) ? product.quantity_sold : 0,
                        Number.isFinite(product.sales_amount)
                            ? HKD_FORMATTER.format(product.sales_amount)
                            : '—'
                    ]) {
                        const cell = document.createElement('td');
                        cell.textContent = String(value);
                        row.append(cell);
                    }
                    return row;
                });
                if (productRows.length === 0) {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const cell = document.createElement('td');
                    cell.colSpan = 4;
                    cell.style.textAlign = 'center';
                    cell.textContent = '目前沒有銷售資料。';
                    row.append(cell);
                    productRows.push(row);
                }
                topProducts.replaceChildren(...productRows);

                const trendRows = data.order_trend.map(day => {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const date = document.createElement('td');
                    date.textContent = typeof day.date === 'string' ? day.date : '—';
                    const count = document.createElement('td');
                    count.textContent = Number.isSafeInteger(day.order_count)
                        ? String(day.order_count)
                        : '—';
                    const revenue = document.createElement('td');
                    revenue.textContent = Number.isFinite(day.revenue)
                        ? HKD_FORMATTER.format(day.revenue)
                        : '—';
                    row.append(date, count, revenue);
                    return row;
                });
                if (trendRows.length === 0) {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const cell = document.createElement('td');
                    cell.colSpan = 3;
                    cell.style.textAlign = 'center';
                    cell.textContent = '目前沒有趨勢資料。';
                    row.append(cell);
                    trendRows.push(row);
                }
                orderTrend.replaceChildren(...trendRows);
                const generatedAt = data.generated_at
                    ? new Date(data.generated_at)
                    : null;
                status.textContent = generatedAt && !Number.isNaN(generatedAt.getTime())
                    ? `已更新（${generatedAt.toLocaleString('zh-HK', { timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong' })}）`
                    : '分析資料已更新。';
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('載入營運分析摘要失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '營運分析載入失敗，請稍後重試。';
                document.getElementById('summary-total-revenue').textContent = '—';
                document.getElementById('summary-total-orders').textContent = '—';
                const productError = document.createElement('tr');
                const productMessage = document.createElement('td');
                productMessage.colSpan = 4;
                productMessage.style.textAlign = 'center';
                productMessage.textContent = error.message || '熱銷商品載入失敗。';
                productError.append(productMessage);
                topProducts.replaceChildren(productError);
                const trendError = document.createElement('tr');
                const trendMessage = document.createElement('td');
                trendMessage.colSpan = 3;
                trendMessage.style.textAlign = 'center';
                trendMessage.textContent = error.message || '訂單趨勢載入失敗。';
                trendError.append(trendMessage);
                orderTrend.replaceChildren(trendError);
            }
        }

        async function loadAdminReviews(offset = 0) {
            const status = document.getElementById('reviews-status');
            const tbody = document.getElementById('reviews-tbody');
            const previous = document.getElementById('reviews-previous-button');
            const next = document.getElementById('reviews-next-button');
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在載入顧客評價…';
            previous.disabled = true;
            next.disabled = true;
            const loadingRow = document.createElement('tr');
            const loadingCell = document.createElement('td');
            loadingCell.colSpan = 8;
            loadingCell.textContent = '正在載入評價…';
            loadingRow.append(loadingCell);
            tbody.replaceChildren(loadingRow);

            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(
                    `/api/admin/reviews?limit=${REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE}&offset=${offset}`
                );
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data ||
                    !Array.isArray(result.data.reviews)) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `評價清單載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                reviewOffset = offset;
                reviewTotalCount = Number.isSafeInteger(result.data.total_count)
                    ? result.data.total_count
                    : result.data.reviews.length;
                tbody.replaceChildren();
                if (result.data.reviews.length === 0) {
                    const emptyRow = document.createElement('tr');
                    const emptyCell = document.createElement('td');
                    emptyCell.colSpan = 8;
                    emptyCell.textContent = '目前沒有顧客評價。';
                    emptyRow.append(emptyCell);
                    tbody.append(emptyRow);
                }
                result.data.reviews.forEach(review => {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const values = [
                        review.product_id,
                        review.customer_name || '已驗證買家',
                        review.customer_phone,
                        `${review.rating} / 5`,
                        review.comment
                    ];
                    values.forEach(value => {
                        const cell = document.createElement('td');
                        cell.textContent = String(value ?? '');
                        row.append(cell);
                    });
                    const statusCell = document.createElement('td');
                    const reviewStatus = document.createElement('select');
                    reviewStatus.dataset.reviewStatusId = String(review.review_id);
                    reviewStatus.dataset.savedStatus = review.status || 'pending';
                    reviewStatus.setAttribute('aria-label', `評價 ${review.review_id} 審核狀態`);
                    for (const [value, label] of [
                        ['pending', '待審核'],
                        ['approved', '公開'],
                        ['rejected', '拒絕']
                    ]) {
                        reviewStatus.add(new Option(label, value));
                    }
                    reviewStatus.value = ['pending', 'approved', 'rejected'].includes(review.status)
                        ? review.status
                        : 'pending';
                    reviewStatus.dataset.savedStatus = reviewStatus.value;
                    statusCell.append(reviewStatus);
                    row.append(statusCell);
                    const createdCell = document.createElement('td');
                    createdCell.textContent = review.created_at
                        ? new Date(review.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-HK')
                        : '';
                    row.append(createdCell);
                    const actionCell = document.createElement('td');
                    const deleteButton = document.createElement('button');
                    deleteButton.type = 'button';
                    deleteButton.textContent = '刪除';
                    deleteButton.style.background = '#b91c1c';
                    deleteButton.dataset.reviewId = String(review.review_id);
                    deleteButton.setAttribute('aria-label', `刪除評價 ${review.review_id}`);
                    actionCell.append(deleteButton);
                    row.append(actionCell);
                    tbody.append(row);
                });
                const first = result.data.reviews.length ? offset + 1 : 0;
                const last = offset + result.data.reviews.length;
                document.getElementById('reviews-page-label').textContent =
                    `第 ${first}–${last} 筆，共 ${reviewTotalCount} 筆`;
                previous.disabled = offset === 0;
                next.disabled = offset + result.data.reviews.length >= reviewTotalCount;
                status.textContent = `已載入 ${result.data.reviews.length} 則評價。`;
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('載入評價清單失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '評價清單載入失敗，請稍後再試。';
                tbody.replaceChildren();
                const errorRow = document.createElement('tr');
                const errorCell = document.createElement('td');
                errorCell.colSpan = 8;
                errorCell.textContent = '評價清單暫時無法載入。';
                errorRow.append(errorCell);
                tbody.append(errorRow);
                document.getElementById('reviews-page-label').textContent = '無法載入評價';
            }
        }

        async function updateAdminReviewStatus(event) {
            const select = event.target.closest('select[data-review-status-id]');
            if (!select) return;
            const previousStatus = select.dataset.savedStatus;
            if (!['pending', 'approved', 'rejected'].includes(select.value)) {
                select.value = previousStatus;
                return;
            }
            if (select.value === previousStatus) return;
            select.disabled = true;
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(
                    `/api/admin/reviews/${encodeURIComponent(select.dataset.reviewStatusId)}/status`,
                    {
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ status: select.value })
                    }
                );
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `評價狀態更新失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                select.dataset.savedStatus = result.data.status;
                showToast(result.message || '評價審核狀態已更新。');
                document.getElementById('reviews-status').textContent = result.message || '評價審核狀態已更新。';
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('更新評價審核狀態失敗：', error);
                select.value = previousStatus;
                document.getElementById('reviews-status').className = 'chart-status error';
                document.getElementById('reviews-status').textContent =
                    error.message || '更新評價審核狀態失敗，請稍後再試。';
            } finally {
                select.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function deleteAdminReview(event) {
            const button = event.target.closest('button[data-review-id]');
            if (!button) return;
            const reviewId = button.dataset.reviewId;
            if (!reviewId) return;

            const confirmDialog = document.getElementById('confirm-dialog');
            document.getElementById('confirm-message').textContent = '確定刪除此顧客評價？此操作無法復原。';
            confirmDialog.showModal();

            const okBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-ok-btn');
            const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-cancel-btn');

            const cleanup = () => {
                confirmDialog.close();
                okBtn.replaceWith(okBtn.cloneNode(true));
                cancelBtn.replaceWith(cancelBtn.cloneNode(true));
            };

            document.getElementById('confirm-cancel-btn').addEventListener('click', cleanup, { once: true });
            document.getElementById('confirm-ok-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
                cleanup();
                button.disabled = true;
                try {
                    const response = await adminFetch(
                        `/api/admin/reviews/${encodeURIComponent(reviewId)}`,
                        { method: 'DELETE' }
                    );
                    const result = await response.json();
                    if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true) {
                        throw new Error(result && result.message
                            ? result.message
                            : `刪除評價失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                    }
                    document.getElementById('reviews-status').textContent =
                        result.message || '評價已刪除。';
                    showToast('評價已成功刪除');
                    await loadAdminReviews(reviewOffset);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('刪除商品評價失敗：', error);
                    document.getElementById('reviews-status').className = 'chart-status error';
                    document.getElementById('reviews-status').textContent =
                        error.message || '刪除評價失敗，請稍後再試。';
                    button.disabled = false;
                }
            }, { once: true });
        }

        async function loadAdminCustomers(offset = 0) {
            const status = document.getElementById('customers-status');
            const tbody = document.getElementById('customers-tbody');
            const previous = document.getElementById('customers-previous-button');
            const next = document.getElementById('customers-next-button');
            if (!adminScopes.includes('customers')) {
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = '此管理員帳戶沒有熟客管理權限。';
                return;
            }

            const requestId = ++customerRequestId;
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在載入客戶資料…';
            previous.disabled = true;
            next.disabled = true;
            setTableSkeleton(tbody, 7);

            let response;
            try {
