                const query = new URLSearchParams({
                    limit: String(CUSTOMER_PAGE_SIZE),
                    offset: String(offset)
                });
                if (customerSearchQuery) {
                    query.set('search', customerSearchQuery);
                }
                response = await adminFetch(`/api/admin/customers?${query}`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (
                    !response.ok ||
                    !result ||
                    result.success !== true ||
                    !result.data ||
                    !Array.isArray(result.data.customers)
                ) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `客戶列表載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                if (requestId !== customerRequestId) {
                    return;
                }

                const customers = result.data.customers;
                const creditStatuses = new Set(['normal', 'require_deposit', 'blacklisted']);
                if (customers.some(customer =>
                    !customer ||
                    typeof customer !== 'object' ||
                    !creditStatuses.has(customer.credit_status)
                )) {
                    throw new Error('客戶列表資料格式無效，請稍後再試。');
                }

                customerOffset = offset;
                customerHasNextPage = customers.length === CUSTOMER_PAGE_SIZE;
                tbody.replaceChildren();
                if (customers.length === 0) {
                    const emptyRow = document.createElement('tr');
                    const emptyCell = document.createElement('td');
                    emptyCell.colSpan = 7;
                    emptyCell.className = 'crm-empty';
                    emptyCell.textContent = customerSearchQuery
                        ? '找不到符合搜尋條件的客戶。'
                        : '目前沒有客戶資料。';
                    emptyRow.append(emptyCell);
                    tbody.append(emptyRow);
                }

                for (const customer of customers) {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const phoneCell = document.createElement('td');
                    const customerPhone = String(customer.customer_phone ?? '');
                    phoneCell.textContent = customerPhone || '—';
                    if (customerPhone) {
                        const bindGoogleButton = document.createElement('button');
                        bindGoogleButton.type = 'button';
                        bindGoogleButton.className = 'crm-bind-google-button';
                        bindGoogleButton.textContent = '綁 Google';
                        bindGoogleButton.addEventListener('click', () =>
                            bindCustomerGoogleAccount(customerPhone, bindGoogleButton)
                        );
                        phoneCell.append(bindGoogleButton);
                    }
                    const nameCell = document.createElement('td');
                    nameCell.textContent = String(customer.customer_name || '—');
                    const ordersCell = document.createElement('td');
                    const totalOrders = Number(customer.total_orders);
                    ordersCell.textContent = Number.isSafeInteger(totalOrders)
                        ? String(totalOrders)
                        : '—';
                    const spentCell = document.createElement('td');
                    const totalSpent = customer.total_spent === null ||
                        customer.total_spent === undefined
                        ? Number.NaN
                        : Number(customer.total_spent);
                    spentCell.textContent = Number.isFinite(totalSpent)
                        ? HKD_FORMATTER.format(totalSpent)
                        : '—';

                    const tagsCell = document.createElement('td');
                    const customerTags = Array.isArray(customer.tags)
                        ? customer.tags.filter(tag => typeof tag === 'string').slice(0, 5)
                        : [];
                    tagsCell.textContent = customerTags.length ? customerTags.join(' ') : '—';

                    const creditCell = document.createElement('td');
                    const creditSelect = document.createElement('select');
                    creditSelect.className = 'crm-status-select';
                    creditSelect.dataset.customerId = String(customer.id);
                    creditSelect.dataset.creditStatus = customer.credit_status;
                    creditSelect.setAttribute('aria-label', `更改 ${customer.customer_name || customer.customer_phone} 的信用評級`);
                    for (const [value, label] of [
                        ['normal', '🟢 正常'],
                        ['require_deposit', '🟡 需付訂金'],
                        ['blacklisted', '🔴 黑名單 / 高風險']
                    ]) {
                        const option = document.createElement('option');
                        option.value = value;
                        option.textContent = label;
                        creditSelect.append(option);
                    }
                    creditSelect.value = customer.credit_status;
                    creditCell.append(creditSelect);

                    const createdCell = document.createElement('td');
                    const createdAt = customer.created_at
                        ? new Date(customer.created_at)
                        : null;
                    createdCell.textContent = createdAt && !Number.isNaN(createdAt.getTime())
                        ? createdAt.toLocaleString('zh-HK', { timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong' })
                        : '—';
                    row.append(phoneCell, nameCell, ordersCell, spentCell, tagsCell, creditCell, createdCell);
                    tbody.append(row);
                }

                const first = customers.length > 0 ? offset + 1 : 0;
                const last = offset + customers.length;
                document.getElementById('customers-page-label').textContent =
                    `第 ${first}–${last} 筆`;
                previous.disabled = offset === 0;
                next.disabled = !customerHasNextPage;
                status.textContent = `已載入 ${customers.length} 位客戶。`;
            } catch (error) {
                if (requestId !== customerRequestId) {
                    return;
                }
                console.error('載入客戶列表失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '客戶列表載入失敗，請稍後再試。';
                tbody.replaceChildren();
                const errorRow = document.createElement('tr');
                const errorCell = document.createElement('td');
                errorCell.colSpan = 7;
                errorCell.className = 'crm-empty';
                errorCell.textContent = response && response.status === 401
                    ? '登入已逾期或沒有客戶管理權限，請重新登入。'
                    : '客戶資料暫時無法載入。';
                errorRow.append(errorCell);
                tbody.append(errorRow);
                document.getElementById('customers-page-label').textContent = '無法載入客戶';
                if (response && response.status === 401) {
                    showToast('請重新登入具備熟客管理權限的管理員帳戶。');
                }
            }
        }

        async function updateCustomerCreditStatus(event) {
            const select = event.target;
            if (!(select instanceof HTMLSelectElement) || !select.dataset.customerId) {
                return;
            }
            const customerId = select.dataset.customerId;
            const previousStatus = select.dataset.creditStatus;
            const creditStatus = select.value;
            if (creditStatus === previousStatus) {
                return;
            }

            select.disabled = true;
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(
                    `/api/admin/customers/${encodeURIComponent(customerId)}/credit-status`,
                    {
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ credit_status: creditStatus })
                    }
                );
                const result = await response.json();
                if (
                    !response.ok ||
                    !result ||
                    result.success !== true ||
                    !result.data ||
                    result.data.credit_status !== creditStatus
                ) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `信用評級更新失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                select.dataset.creditStatus = result.data.credit_status;
                showToast(result.message || '客戶信用評級已更新。');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('更新客戶信用評級失敗：', error);
                select.value = previousStatus;
                showToast(error.message || '更新信用評級失敗，請稍後再試。');
            } finally {
                select.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function bindCustomerGoogleAccount(customerPhone, button) {
            const submittedEmail = window.prompt('請輸入要綁定的 Gmail 地址：');
            if (submittedEmail === null) {
                return;
            }
            const googleEmail = submittedEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
            if (!/^[^\s@]+@gmail\.com$/.test(googleEmail)) {
                showToast('請輸入有效的 Gmail 地址。');
                return;
            }

            button.disabled = true;
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(
                    `/api/admin/customers/${encodeURIComponent(customerPhone)}/bind-google`,
                    {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ google_email: googleEmail })
                    }
                );
                const result = await response.json();
                const linkedOrders = result && (
                    result.linked_orders ?? (result.data && result.data.linked_orders)
                );
                if (
                    !response.ok ||
                    !result ||
                    result.success !== true ||
                    !Number.isSafeInteger(linkedOrders) ||
                    linkedOrders < 0
                ) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `Google 帳號綁定失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                showToast(`已綁 ${linkedOrders} 張單`);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('綁定客戶 Google 帳號失敗：', error);
                showToast(error.message || '綁定 Google 帳號失敗，請稍後再試。');
            } finally {
                button.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function loadAdminOrders(offset = 0) {
            const status = document.getElementById('orders-status');
            status.className = 'chart-status';
            status.textContent = '正在載入訂單…';
            setTableSkeleton(document.getElementById('orders-tbody'), 10);
            try {
                const query = new URLSearchParams({
                    limit: String(ORDER_PAGE_SIZE),
                    offset: String(offset)
                });
                const response = await adminFetch(`/api/orders/admin/orders?${query}`);
                const result = await response.json();
                if (
                    !response.ok ||
                    !result ||
                    result.success !== true ||
                    !result.data ||
                    !Array.isArray(result.data.orders) ||
                    !Number.isSafeInteger(result.data.total_count)
                ) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `訂單列表載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }

                orderOffset = result.data.offset;
                orderTotalCount = result.data.total_count;
                allCachedOrders = result.data.orders; 
                
                renderFilteredOrders();
                status.textContent = '訂單已載入。';
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('載入管理員訂單失敗：', error);
                status.className = 'chart-status error';
                status.textContent = error.message || '訂單列表載入失敗。';
                const tbody = document.getElementById('orders-tbody');
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                const cell = document.createElement('td');
                cell.colSpan = 10;
                cell.style.textAlign = 'center';
                cell.textContent = error.message || '訂單列表載入失敗。';
                row.replaceChildren(cell);
                tbody.replaceChildren(row);
                throw error;
            }
        }

        // 渲染過濾後的訂單（支援短單號、客戶名稱、全能搜尋）
        function renderFilteredOrders() {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('orders-tbody');
            const searchKeyword = document.getElementById('orders-search-input').value.trim().toLowerCase();

            const filtered = allCachedOrders.filter(order => {
                const matchesTab = (currentOrderTab === 'all') || (order.status === currentOrderTab);
                const displayOrderNo = (order.order_number || order.order_no || order.order_id || '').toLowerCase();
                const customerName = (order.customer_name || order.name || '').toLowerCase();
                const customerPhone = (order.customer_phone || order.phone || '').toLowerCase();

                const matchesSearch = !searchKeyword ||
                    displayOrderNo.includes(searchKeyword) ||
                    customerName.includes(searchKeyword) ||
                    customerPhone.includes(searchKeyword);

                return matchesTab && matchesSearch;
            });

            const rows = filtered.map(order => {
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                
                // 1. 訂單編號（優先顯示易讀單號，滑鼠移上去看完整 ID）
                const idCell = document.createElement('td');
                const rawOrderNo = order.order_number || order.order_no || order.order_id || '—';
                const displayText = rawOrderNo.length > 20 ? rawOrderNo.substring(0, 10) + '...' : rawOrderNo;
                
                const idText = document.createElement('span');
                idText.textContent = displayText;
                idText.title = rawOrderNo; 
                
                const copyBtn = document.createElement('button');
                copyBtn.type = 'button';
                copyBtn.className = 'secondary';
                copyBtn.style.cssText = 'padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; margin-left: 6px;';
                copyBtn.textContent = '複製';
                copyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => copyToClipboard(rawOrderNo));
                idCell.append(idText, copyBtn);
                idCell.style.overflowWrap = 'anywhere';

                // 2. 客戶名稱欄位
                const nameCell = document.createElement('td');
                nameCell.textContent = order.customer_name || order.name || '訪客 / 未填寫';
                nameCell.style.fontWeight = '600';
                nameCell.style.color = order.customer_name ? '#0f172a' : '#94a3b8';

                // 3. 聯絡電話
                const phoneCell = document.createElement('td');
                const phoneVal = order.customer_phone || order.phone || '—';
                const phoneText = document.createElement('span');
                phoneText.textContent = phoneVal;
                if(phoneVal !== '—') {
                    const phoneCopyBtn = document.createElement('button');
                    phoneCopyBtn.type = 'button';
                    phoneCopyBtn.className = 'secondary';
                    phoneCopyBtn.style.cssText = 'padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; margin-left: 6px;';
                    phoneCopyBtn.textContent = '複製';
                    phoneCopyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => copyToClipboard(phoneVal));
                    phoneCell.append(phoneText, phoneCopyBtn);
                } else {
                    phoneCell.append(phoneText);
                }
                if (order.shipping_address) {
                    const pickupDetails = document.createElement('small');
                    pickupDetails.style.cssText = 'display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: #64748b;';
                    pickupDetails.textContent = `取貨資料：${order.shipping_address}`;
                    phoneCell.append(pickupDetails);
                }

                // 4. 購買品項
                const itemsCell = document.createElement('td');
                const itemList = document.createElement('ul');
                itemList.className = 'order-items-list';
                for (const item of Array.isArray(order.items) ? order.items : []) {
                    const line = document.createElement('li');
                    const quantity = Number.isSafeInteger(Number(item.quantity))
                        ? Number(item.quantity)
                        : 0;
                    const unitPrice = Number.isFinite(Number(item.unit_price))
                        ? `（$${Number(item.unit_price).toFixed(2)}）`
                        : '';
                    line.textContent = `${item.product_name || item.name || '未命名商品'} × ${quantity} ${unitPrice}`;
                    itemList.append(line);
                }
                if (itemList.childElementCount === 0) {
                    const line = document.createElement('li');
                    line.textContent = '沒有商品明細';
                    itemList.append(line);
                }
                itemsCell.append(itemList);
                
                // 5. 總金額
                const amountCell = document.createElement('td');
                amountCell.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                amountCell.style.color = '#2563eb';
                amountCell.textContent = Number.isFinite(Number(order.total_amount))
                    ? `$${Number(order.total_amount).toFixed(2)}`
                    : '—';

                const proofCell = document.createElement('td');
                if (typeof order.payment_proof_signed_url === 'string' &&
                    order.payment_proof_signed_url) {
                    const proofLink = document.createElement('a');
                    proofLink.href = order.payment_proof_signed_url;
                    proofLink.target = '_blank';
                    proofLink.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
                    proofLink.setAttribute('aria-label', `開啟訂單 ${rawOrderNo} 的付款憑證`);
                    const proofImage = document.createElement('img');
                    proofImage.src = order.payment_proof_signed_url;
                    proofImage.alt = `訂單 ${rawOrderNo} 付款憑證縮圖`;
                    proofImage.className = 'payment-proof-thumb';
                    proofLink.append(proofImage);
                    proofCell.append(proofLink);
                } else {
                    proofCell.textContent = '未提交';
                }

                const proofStatusCell = document.createElement('td');
                const proofStatus = order.payment_proof_status || 'pending';
                const proofBadge = document.createElement('span');
                proofBadge.className = proofStatus === 'verified'
                    ? 'badge success'
                    : proofStatus === 'rejected'
                        ? 'badge low-stock'
                        : 'badge warning';
                proofBadge.textContent = proofStatus === 'verified'
                    ? '已核實'
                    : proofStatus === 'rejected'
                        ? '未通過'
                        : order.payment_proof_signed_url
                            ? '待審核'
                            : '待提交';
                proofStatusCell.append(proofBadge);
                if (order.payment_proof_signed_url && proofStatus !== 'verified') {
                    const actions = document.createElement('div');
                    actions.className = 'payment-proof-actions';
                    for (const [value, label] of [
                        ['verified', '核實'],
                        ['rejected', '拒絕']
                    ]) {
                        const button = document.createElement('button');
                        button.type = 'button';
                        button.dataset.paymentProofOrderId = String(order.order_id);
                        button.dataset.paymentProofStatus = value;
                        button.textContent = label;
                        if (value === 'rejected') {
                            button.style.background = '#b91c1c';
                        }
                        actions.append(button);
                    }
                    proofStatusCell.append(actions);
                }
                
                // 6. 下單時間
                const dateCell = document.createElement('td');
                const parsedDate = new Date(order.order_date || order.created_at);
                dateCell.textContent = Number.isNaN(parsedDate.getTime())
                    ? '—'
                    : parsedDate.toLocaleString('zh-HK', { timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong' });
                
                // 7. 目前狀態
                const stateCell = document.createElement('td');
                const select = document.createElement('select');
                select.className = 'order-status-select';
                select.dataset.orderId = String(order.order_id);
                select.dataset.savedStatus = order.status;
                select.setAttribute('aria-label', `訂單狀態`);
                for (const [value, label] of [
                    ['pending', '⏳ 待處理'],
                    ['shipping', '🚚 已出貨'],
                    ['completed', '✅ 已完成']
                ]) {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = value;
                    option.textContent = label;
                    select.append(option);
                }
                select.value = ['pending', 'shipping', 'completed'].includes(order.status)
                    ? order.status
                    : 'pending';
                select.dataset.savedStatus = select.value;
                stateCell.append(select);

                // 8. 更新提示
                const feedbackCell = document.createElement('td');
                feedbackCell.className = 'order-feedback';
                feedbackCell.setAttribute('role', 'status');
                feedbackCell.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');

                row.append(
                    idCell,
                    nameCell,
                    phoneCell,
                    itemsCell,
                    amountCell,
                    proofCell,
                    proofStatusCell,
                    dateCell,
                    stateCell,
                    feedbackCell
                );
                return row;
            });

            if (rows.length === 0) {
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                const cell = document.createElement('td');
                cell.colSpan = 10;
                cell.style.textAlign = 'center';
                cell.style.padding = '30px';
                cell.style.color = '#64748b';
                cell.textContent = '沒有符合條件的訂單紀錄。';
                row.append(cell);
                rows.push(row);
            }
            tbody.replaceChildren(...rows);

            const first = orderTotalCount === 0 ? 0 : orderOffset + 1;
            const last = Math.min(orderOffset + allCachedOrders.length, orderTotalCount);
            document.getElementById('orders-page-label').textContent =
                `第 ${first}–${last} 筆，共 ${orderTotalCount} 筆`;
            document.getElementById('orders-previous-button').disabled = orderOffset === 0;
            document.getElementById('orders-next-button').disabled =
                orderOffset + allCachedOrders.length >= orderTotalCount;
        }

        async function updateAdminOrderStatus(event) {
            const select = event.target.closest('.order-status-select');
            if (!select) return;
            const previousStatus = select.dataset.savedStatus;
            const feedback = select.closest('tr').querySelector('.order-feedback');
            if (!['pending', 'shipping', 'completed'].includes(select.value)) {
                select.value = previousStatus;
                return;
            }
            if (select.value === previousStatus) return;

            select.disabled = true;
            feedback.className = 'order-feedback';
            feedback.textContent = '正在更新…';
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(
                    `/api/orders/admin/orders/${encodeURIComponent(select.dataset.orderId)}/status`,
                    {
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ status: select.value })
                    }
                );
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `訂單狀態更新失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                select.dataset.savedStatus = result.data.status;
                
                const cached = allCachedOrders.find(o => String(o.order_id) === select.dataset.orderId);
                if (cached) cached.status = result.data.status;

                feedback.className = 'order-feedback success';
                feedback.textContent = result.message || '狀態已更新。';
                showToast('訂單狀態更新成功！');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('更新管理員訂單狀態失敗：', error);
                select.value = previousStatus;
                feedback.className = 'order-feedback error';
                feedback.textContent = error.message || '訂單狀態更新失敗。';
            } finally {
                select.disabled = false;
            }
        }

        async function updatePaymentProofStatus(event) {
            const button = event.target.closest('button[data-payment-proof-order-id]');
            if (!button) {
                return;
            }
            const orderId = button.dataset.paymentProofOrderId;
            const paymentProofStatus = button.dataset.paymentProofStatus;
            if (!orderId || !['verified', 'rejected'].includes(paymentProofStatus)) {
                return;
            }

            button.disabled = true;
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(
                    `/api/admin/orders/${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}/payment-status`,
                    {
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ payment_proof_status: paymentProofStatus })
                    }
                );
                const result = await response.json();
                if (
                    !response.ok ||
                    !result ||
                    result.success !== true ||
                    !result.data ||
                    result.data.payment_proof_status !== paymentProofStatus
                ) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `付款憑證審核失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                const cached = allCachedOrders.find(order => String(order.order_id) === orderId);
                if (cached) {
                    cached.payment_proof_status = paymentProofStatus;
                }
                renderFilteredOrders();
                showToast(result.message || '付款憑證狀態已更新。');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('審核付款憑證失敗：', error);
                button.disabled = false;
                showToast(error.message || '付款憑證審核失敗，請稍後再試。');
            }
        }

        async function loadPickList() {
            const groupBy = document.getElementById('groupby-select').value;

            try {
                const res = await adminFetch(`/api/shipping/pick-list?group_by=${groupBy}`);
                const json = await res.json();
                const tbody = document.getElementById('picklist-tbody');
                if (!res.ok || !json || json.success !== true || !Array.isArray(json.data)) {
                    throw new Error(json && json.message
                        ? json.message
                        : `執貨清單載入失敗（HTTP ${res.status}）。`);
                }

                if (json.data.length === 0) {
                    const row = document.createElement('tr');
                    const cell = document.createElement('td');
                    cell.colSpan = 5;
                    cell.style.textAlign = 'center';
                    cell.style.color = '#64748b';
                    cell.textContent = '目前沒有可出貨的項目';
                    row.appendChild(cell);
                    tbody.replaceChildren(row);
                    return true;
                }

                const rows = json.data.map(item => {
                    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                    const identity = document.createElement('td');
                    const title = document.createElement('strong');
                    const details = document.createElement('small');
                    if (groupBy === 'product') {
                        title.textContent = `貨品 #${item.product_id}`;
                        details.textContent = `${item.product_name || '未命名商品'} × ${item.total_quantity} 件`;
                    } else {
                        title.textContent = `訂單 #${item.order_id}`;
                        details.textContent = (Array.isArray(item.items) ? item.items : [])
                            .map(orderItem => `${orderItem.product_name || '未命名商品'} × ${orderItem.quantity}`)
                            .join('、');
                    }
                    identity.append(title, document.createElement('br'), details);

                    const phone = document.createElement('td');
                    phone.textContent = groupBy === 'order'
                        ? (item.customer_phone || '無電話')
                        : `${Array.isArray(item.orders) ? item.orders.length : 0} 張訂單`;
                    const shipping = document.createElement('td');
                    shipping.textContent = groupBy === 'order'
                        ? (item.shipping_method || '未安排')
                        : '按訂單分別出貨';

                    const statusCell = document.createElement('td');
                    const badge = document.createElement('span');
                    badge.className = 'badge success';
                    badge.textContent = groupBy === 'order'
                        ? (item.shipping_status || '可出貨')
                        : '已齊貨';
                    statusCell.appendChild(badge);

                    const action = document.createElement('td');
                    const orderIds = groupBy === 'order'
                        ? [item.order_id]
                        : [...new Set((Array.isArray(item.orders) ? item.orders : [])
                            .map(order => order.order_id))];
                    if (orderIds.length === 0) {
                        action.textContent = '無可出貨訂單';
                    } else {
                        for (const orderId of orderIds) {
                            const button = document.createElement('button');
                            button.type = 'button';
                            button.textContent = groupBy === 'order' ? '快速出貨' : `出貨 #${orderId}`;
                            button.addEventListener('click', () => shipOrder(orderId));
                            action.appendChild(button);
                        }
                    }
                    tr.append(identity, phone, shipping, statusCell, action);
                    return tr;
                });
                tbody.replaceChildren(...rows);
                return true;
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                const tbody = document.getElementById('picklist-tbody');
                const row = document.createElement('tr');
                const cell = document.createElement('td');
                cell.colSpan = 5;
                cell.style.textAlign = 'center';
                cell.style.color = '#b91c1c';
                cell.textContent = err.message || '執貨清單載入失敗。';
                row.appendChild(cell);
                tbody.replaceChildren(row);
                throw err;
            }
        }

        async function shipOrder(orderId) {
            const trackingNumber = prompt('請輸入順豐/京東運單號碼 (Tracking Number):', 'SF' + Date.now().toString().slice(-8));
            if (!trackingNumber) return;

            try {
                const res = await adminFetch(`/api/shipping/${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}/ship`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ shipping_method: '順豐', tracking_number: trackingNumber })
                });
                const json = await res.json();
                if (!res.ok || !json || json.success !== true) {
                    throw new Error(json && json.message
                        ? json.message
                        : `出貨失敗（HTTP ${res.status}）。`);
                }
                const notification = json.data && json.data.notification;
                const notificationStatus = notification && notification.status
                    ? notification.status
                    : 'unknown';
                const notificationMessage = notification && notification.message
                    ? notification.message
                    : '通知狀態未能確認。';
                showToast('訂單出貨成功，已發送 WhatsApp 通知！');
                try {
                    await Promise.all([loadPickList(), loadProducts(), loadInventoryAlerts()]);
                } catch (refreshError) {
                    showToast(`訂單已出貨，但清單重新讀取失敗：${refreshError.message}`);
                }
                if (
                    notification &&
                    notification.success !== true &&
                    ['failed', 'pending'].includes(notificationStatus) &&
                    confirm('要立即重試 WhatsApp 出貨通知嗎？')
                ) {
                    await retryShipmentNotification(orderId);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                showToast(err.message || '網路錯誤');
            }
        }

        async function retryShipmentNotification(orderId) {
            try {
                const response = await adminFetch(
                    `/api/shipping/${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}/notification/retry`,
                    {
                        method: 'POST',
                    }
                );
                const result = await response.json();
                if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true) {
                    throw new Error(result && result.message
                        ? result.message
                        : `通知重試失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
                }
                showToast(result.message || 'WhatsApp 出貨通知已重試發送。');
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('重試 WhatsApp 出貨通知失敗：', error);
                showToast(error.message || 'WhatsApp 通知重試失敗，請稍後再試。');
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.27 14.24c-.25-.72-.38-1.49-.38-2.24s.13-1.52.38-2.24V6.61H1.19C.43 8.15 0 9.89 0 11.75s.43 3.6 1.19 5.14l4.08-2.65z"/>
            <path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 4.75c1.77 0 3.35.61 4.6 1.8l3.42-3.42C17.95 1.19 15.24 0 12 0 7.26 0 3.17 2.64 1.19 6.61l4.08 3.15c.95-2.85 3.6-4.96 6.73-4.96z"/>
          </svg>
          使用 Google 帳號快速登入（系統初始化中...）

        <div class="relative flex py-2 items-center mb-6">

        <!-- 傳統手機 + 訂單號碼登入表單 -->

          <div>
            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">手提電話號碼</label>
            <input type="text" id="customerPhone" placeholder="例如：91234567 或 +85291234567" required
              class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-transparent text-sm transition">
          </div>
          <div>
            <label class="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">訂單編號 / 流水號</label>
            <input type="text" id="orderId" placeholder="例如：LP-20261017-0001" required
              class="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-transparent text-sm transition">
          </div>
          <button type="submit" id="loginBtn"
            class="w-full bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-semibold py-3 px-4 rounded-xl shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            驗證並查看我的訂單
          </button>
        </form>
        <p id="loginError" class="mt-3 text-center text-xs text-rose-500 hidden"></p>
      </div>

      <!-- 已登入會員資料區（初始隱藏） -->
      <div id="memberDashboard" class="hidden space-y-6">
        <div class="bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-100 p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <p class="text-xs text-indigo-500 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider">目前登入身份</p>
            <p id="memberIdentity" class="text-slate-900 font-bold mt-0.5 text-sm"></p>
          </div>
          <button id="logoutBtn" class="text-xs bg-white border border-indigo-200 text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-100 font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition">
            登出
          </button>
        </div>

        <div class="border-t border-slate-100 pt-4">
          <h2 class="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 mb-3">我的歷史訂單</h2>
          <div id="ordersContainer" class="space-y-3 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            <!-- 訂單列表將會動態載入此處 -->
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </main>

  <!-- JavaScript 邏輯：加入 credentials: 'include' 確保 Cookie 正常傳遞 -->
  <script>
    let supabaseClient = null;

    const loginSection = document.getElementById('loginSection');
    const memberDashboard = document.getElementById('memberDashboard');
    const memberIdentity = document.getElementById('memberIdentity');
    const phoneLoginForm = document.getElementById('phoneLoginForm');
    const loginError = document.getElementById('loginError');
    const logoutBtn = document.getElementById('logoutBtn');
    const ordersContainer = document.getElementById('ordersContainer');
    const googleLoginBtn = document.getElementById('googleLoginBtn');

    // 1. 初始化應用程式
    async function initApp() {
      try {
        const configRes = await fetch('/api/customer/config');
        const configResult = await configRes.json();

        if (!configResult.success || !configResult.data.supabaseAnonKey) {
          showError('無法載入系統安全配置。');
          return;
        }

        supabaseClient = window.supabase.createClient(
          configResult.data.supabaseUrl,
          configResult.data.supabaseAnonKey
        );

        googleLoginBtn.disabled = false;
        googleLoginBtn.className = "w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 font-semibold py-3 px-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm transition flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-6";
        googleLoginBtn.innerHTML = `
          <svg class="w-5 h-5" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path fill="#4285F4" d="M23.745 12.27c0-.7-.06-1.4-.19-2.07H12v4.51h6.6c-.29 1.52-1.14 2.82-2.4 3.68v3.05h3.88c2.27-2.09 3.66-5.17 3.66-9.17z"/>
            <path fill="#34A853" d="M12 24c3.24 0 5.95-1.08 7.93-2.91l-3.88-3.05c-1.08.72-2.45 1.16-4.05 1.16-3.13 0-5.78-2.11-6.73-4.96H1.19v3.15C3.17 21.36 7.26 24 12 24z"/>
            <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.27 14.24c-.25-.72-.38-1.49-.38-2.24s.13-1.52.38-2.24V6.61H1.19C.43 8.15 0 9.89 0 11.75s.43 3.6 1.19 5.14l4.08-2.65z"/>
            <path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 4.75c1.77 0 3.35.61 4.6 1.8l3.42-3.42C17.95 1.19 15.24 0 12 0 7.26 0 3.17 2.64 1.19 6.61l4.08 3.15c.95-2.85 3.6-4.96 6.73-4.96z"/>
          </svg>
          使用 Google 帳號快速登入
        `;

        checkSession();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('初始化失敗：', err);
        showError('系統初始化失敗，請重新整理頁面。');
      }
    }

    // 2. 檢查 Session 狀態 (全部加上 credentials: 'include')
    async function checkSession() {
      try {
        if (!supabaseClient) return;

        const { data: { session: googleSession } } = await supabaseClient.auth.getSession();
        if (googleSession && googleSession.access_token) {
          const res = await fetch('/api/customer/member/google-session', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + googleSession.access_token
            },
            credentials: 'include', // 關鍵修正
            body: JSON.stringify({})
          });
          const result = await res.json();
          if (result.success) {
            window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
            showDashboard(result.data.email || 'Google 會員');
            loadOrders();
            return;
          }
        }

        const res = await fetch('/api/customer/member/session', {
          credentials: 'include' // 關鍵修正
        });
        const result = await res.json();
        if (result.success && result.data.authenticated) {
          showDashboard(result.data.display_info || result.data.email || '已驗證會員');
          loadOrders();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('檢查登入狀態失敗：', err);
      }
    }

    // 3. Google 登入按鈕點擊事件
    googleLoginBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (!supabaseClient) {
        showError('系統尚未初始化完成，請稍候。');
        return;
      }
      const { error } = await supabaseClient.auth.signInWithOAuth({
        provider: 'google',
        options: {
          redirectTo: window.location.origin + '/customer.html'
        }
      });
      if (error) {
        showError('Google 登入失敗：' + error.message);
      }
    });

    // 4. 手機登入表單提交
    phoneLoginForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      loginError.classList.add('hidden');
      const phone = document.getElementById('customerPhone').value.trim();
      const orderId = document.getElementById('orderId').value.trim();

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/customer/member/session', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          credentials: 'include', // 關鍵修正
          body: JSON.stringify({ customer_phone: phone, order_id: orderId })
        });
        const result = await res.json();
        if (!result.success) {
          showError(result.message || '登入失敗，請檢查資料。');
          return;
        }
        showDashboard('••••' + phone.slice(-4));
        loadOrders();
      } catch (err) {
        showError('網絡連線錯誤，請稍後再試。');
      }
    });

    // 5. 登出按鈕
    logoutBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      if (supabaseClient) {
        await supabaseClient.auth.signOut();
      }
      await fetch('/api/customer/member/logout', { 
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'include' // 關鍵修正
      });
      loginSection.classList.remove('hidden');
      memberDashboard.classList.add('hidden');
      phoneLoginForm.reset();
    });

    function showError(msg) {
      loginError.textContent = msg;
      loginError.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function showDashboard(identityText) {
      loginSection.classList.add('hidden');
      memberDashboard.classList.remove('hidden');
      memberIdentity.textContent = identityText;
    }

    // 6. 載入歷史訂單與智能認領介面
    async function loadOrders() {
      ordersContainer.innerHTML = '<p class="text-xs text-slate-400 text-center py-4">正在載入您的歷史訂單...</p>';
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/customer/orders', {
          credentials: 'include' // 關鍵修正：確保帶上 Cookie
        });
        const result = await res.json();
        
        if (!result.success) {
          ordersContainer.innerHTML = `<p class="text-xs text-rose-500 text-center py-4">${result.message || '載入訂單失敗。'}</p>`;
          return;
        }

        const orders = result.data.orders || [];
        const needLinkPhone = result.data.need_link_phone;

        let html = '';

        if (needLinkPhone || orders.length === 0) {
          html += `
            <div id="linkPhoneCard" class="bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3 mb-4">
              <div class="flex items-start gap-2">
                <span class="text-amber-500 text-base">💡</span>
                <div>
                  <h3 class="text-xs font-bold text-amber-900">認領歷史手機訂單</h3>
                  <p class="text-xs text-amber-700 mt-0.5">如果您過往曾以手提電話號碼下單，請輸入該電話號碼與任意一張歷史訂單編號進行一次性認領與綁定。</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <form id="linkPhoneForm" class="space-y-2 pt-1">
                <input type="tel" id="linkPhone" placeholder="過往下單手機號碼 (如 91234567)" required
                  class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs rounded-lg border border-amber-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 bg-white">
                <input type="text" id="linkOrderNumber" placeholder="其中一張歷史訂單編號 (UUID 或 短碼)" required
                  class="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs rounded-lg border border-amber-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 bg-white">
                <button type="submit" id="linkPhoneBtn"
                  class="w-full bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-bold text-xs py-2 px-3 rounded-lg shadow-sm transition">
                  核對並一鍵認領歷史訂單
                </button>
              </form>
              <p id="linkPhoneMsg" class="text-xs font-medium hidden text-center"></p>
            </div>
          `;
        }

        if (orders.length === 0) {
          html += '<p class="text-xs text-slate-400 text-center py-4">目前暫無已綁定的歷史訂單記錄。</p>';
          ordersContainer.innerHTML = html;
        } else {
          html += orders.map(order => `
            <div class="border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 bg-white shadow-sm space-y-2">
              <div class="flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                <span class="font-bold text-slate-700">訂單編號: ${order.order_number || order.order_id}</span>
                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium ${order.status === 'completed' ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600' : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-600'}">${order.status || '處理中'}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="text-xs text-slate-500">
                日期：${new Date(order.order_date).toLocaleDateString()} | 金額：$${order.total_amount}
              </div>
              <div class="border-t border-slate-100 pt-2 text-xs space-y-1">
                ${(order.items || []).map(item => `
                  <div class="flex justify-between text-slate-600">
                    <span>${item.product_name} x ${item.quantity}</span> <span>$${item.unit_price * item.quantity}</span>
                  </div>
                `).join('')}
              </div>
            </div>
          `).join('');
          ordersContainer.innerHTML = html;
        }

        const linkPhoneForm = document.getElementById('linkPhoneForm');
        if (linkPhoneForm) {
          linkPhoneForm.addEventListener('submit', handleLinkPhoneSubmit);
        }

      } catch (err) {
        ordersContainer.innerHTML = '<p class="text-xs text-rose-500 text-center py-4">載入訂單失敗，請稍後再試。</p>';
      }
    }

    // 7. 處理認領表單提交
    async function handleLinkPhoneSubmit(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const phoneInput = document.getElementById('linkPhone').value.trim();
      const orderNumberInput = document.getElementById('linkOrderNumber').value.trim();
      const btn = document.getElementById('linkPhoneBtn');
      const msg = document.getElementById('linkPhoneMsg');

      msg.classList.add('hidden');
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.textContent = '核對中...';

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/customer/member/link-phone', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          credentials: 'include', // 關鍵修正
          body: JSON.stringify({ customer_phone: phoneInput, order_number: orderNumberInput })
        });
        const result = await res.json();

        if (result.success) {
          msg.textContent = result.message;
          msg.className = 'text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600 text-center block';
          setTimeout(() => loadOrders(), 1500);
        } else {
          msg.textContent = result.message || '核對失敗，請確認資料是否正確。';
          msg.className = 'text-xs font-semibold text-rose-500 text-center block';
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = '核對並一鍵認領歷史訂單';
        }
      } catch (err) {
        msg.textContent = '網絡錯誤，請稍後再試。';
        msg.className = 'text-xs font-semibold text-rose-500 text-center block';
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = '核對並一鍵認領歷史訂單';
      }
    }

    initApp();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```
