  <div id="toastNotification" class="pointer-events-none fixed bottom-20 left-1/2 z-[60] -translate-x-1/2 translate-y-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white opacity-0 shadow-xl transition sm:bottom-6" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>

  <script>
    'use strict';

    const CART_STORAGE_KEY = 'littleplanet_cart';
    const CHECKOUT_PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY = 'littleplanet_checkout_profiles';
    const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'littleplanet_theme';
    const storefrontUrlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    if (
      storefrontUrlParams.has('items') ||
      storefrontUrlParams.has('phone') ||
      storefrontUrlParams.has('name')
    ) {
      const cleanParams = new URLSearchParams(storefrontUrlParams);
      cleanParams.delete('items');
      cleanParams.delete('phone');
      cleanParams.delete('name');
      const remainingQuery = cleanParams.toString();
      window.history.replaceState(
        {},
        '',
        `${window.location.pathname}${remainingQuery ? `?${remainingQuery}` : ''}${window.location.hash}`
      );
    }
    const NEW_PRODUCT_DAYS = 30;
    const PRODUCT_PAGE_SIZE = 24;
    const currencyFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('zh-HK', { style: 'currency', currency: 'HKD' });
    const productGrid = document.querySelector('#productGrid');
    const cartDrawer = document.querySelector('#cartDrawer');
    const cartBackdrop = document.querySelector('#cartBackdrop');
    const cartItemsElement = document.querySelector('#cartItems');
    let products = [];
    let productsTotalCount = 0;
    let productsOffset = 0;
    let productRequestController = null;
    let productSearchTimer = null;
    let cart = loadCart();
    let activeCategory = 'all';
    let toastTimer;
    let lastFocusedElement;
    let memberSessionChecked = false;
    let memberAuthenticated = false;
    const wishlistProductIds = new Set();

    let currentQuickViewProduct = null;
    let currentQuickViewQuantity = 1;

    function loadCart() {
      try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CART_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
        if (!Array.isArray(saved)) return [];
        return saved.filter(item =>
          item && item.product && (typeof item.product.id === 'string' || typeof item.product.id === 'number') &&
          Number.isSafeInteger(item.quantity) && item.quantity > 0
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('讀取購物車失敗：', error);
        return [];
      }
    }

    function persistCart() {
      try {
        if (cart.length === 0) {
          localStorage.removeItem(CART_STORAGE_KEY);
        } else {
          localStorage.setItem(CART_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cart));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('儲存購物車失敗：', error);
        showToast('無法儲存購物車，請檢查瀏覽器儲存空間。');
      }
    }

    function normalizePhoneForProfile(value) {
      return String(value || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
    }

    function loadCheckoutProfiles() {
      try {
        const profiles = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CHECKOUT_PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY) || '[]');
        if (!Array.isArray(profiles)) {
          throw new Error('熟客資料格式無效。');
        }
        return profiles.filter(profile =>
          profile &&
          typeof profile.phone === 'string' &&
          typeof profile.customer_name === 'string' &&
          typeof profile.shipping_method === 'string' &&
          typeof profile.shipping_address === 'string'
        );
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('讀取本機熟客資料失敗：', error);
        showToast('無法讀取此裝置已記住的資料，請檢查瀏覽器儲存設定。');
        return [];
      }
    }

    function fillCheckoutProfile() {
      const phone = normalizePhoneForProfile(document.querySelector('#customerPhone').value);
      if (!/^\d{8,15}$/.test(phone)) return;
      const profile = loadCheckoutProfiles().find(item => item.phone === phone);
      if (!profile) return;
      document.querySelector('#customerName').value = profile.customer_name;
      document.querySelector('#shippingMethod').value = profile.shipping_method;
      document.querySelector('#shippingAddress').value = profile.shipping_address;
      updateShippingAddressRequirement();
      showToast('已從此裝置帶入上次收件資料。');
    }

    function saveCheckoutProfile(phone) {
      if (!document.querySelector('#rememberCheckoutDetails').checked) return;
      const profile = {
        phone: normalizePhoneForProfile(phone),
        customer_name: document.querySelector('#customerName').value.trim(),
        shipping_method: document.querySelector('#shippingMethod').value,
        shipping_address: document.querySelector('#shippingAddress').value.trim(),
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      };
      if (!profile.phone || (!profile.customer_name && !profile.shipping_method && !profile.shipping_address)) return;
      try {
        const profiles = loadCheckoutProfiles().filter(item => item.phone !== profile.phone);
        profiles.unshift(profile);
        localStorage.setItem(CHECKOUT_PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(profiles.slice(0, 10)));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('儲存本機熟客資料失敗：', error);
        showToast('訂單已建立，但無法記住資料；請檢查瀏覽器儲存空間。');
      }
    }

    function updateShippingAddressRequirement() {
      const method = document.querySelector('#shippingMethod').value;
      const requiresPickupPoint = method === 'sf_station' || method === 'sf_locker';
      const addressInput = document.querySelector('#shippingAddress');
      addressInput.required = requiresPickupPoint;
      addressInput.maxLength = requiresPickupPoint ? 190 : 200;
      document.querySelector('#shippingAddressOptional').textContent = requiresPickupPoint ? '（必填）' : '（選填）';
      document.querySelector('#shippingAddressHint').textContent = requiresPickupPoint
        ? '請輸入順豐站／智能櫃編號或地區；示例僅作提示，請核對地點。'
        : '順豐站／智能櫃編號例子只作輸入提示，請核對所選地點。';
    }

    function clearCart() {
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(CART_STORAGE_KEY);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('清除購物車失敗：', error);
      }
      cart = [];
    }

    function makeElement(tag, className, text) {
      const element = document.createElement(tag);
      if (className) element.className = className;
      if (text !== undefined) element.textContent = String(text);
      return element;
    }

    function getProductName(product) {
      return String(product.name || product.product_name || '未命名商品');
    }

    function getProductPrice(product) {
      const price = Number(product.price ?? product.retail_price);
      return Number.isFinite(price) && price >= 0 ? price : null;
    }

    function getProductStock(product) {
      const stock = Number(product.stock);
      return Number.isSafeInteger(stock) && stock >= 0 ? stock : null;
    }

    function getProductId(product) {
      return String(product.id ?? product.product_id ?? '');
    }

    function getProductById(productId) {
      if (!productId) return null;
      const id = String(productId);
      return products.find(p => getProductId(p) === id) || null;
    }

    function isNewProduct(product) {
      if (product.is_new === true) return true;
      const createdAt = Date.parse(product.created_at || '');
      if (!Number.isFinite(createdAt)) return false;
      const age = Date.now() - createdAt;
      return age >= 0 && age <= NEW_PRODUCT_DAYS * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    }

    function formatPrice(price) {
      return price === null ? '價格待確認' : currencyFormatter.format(price);
    }

    function getTierPrices(product) {
      return Array.isArray(product.tier_prices)
        ? product.tier_prices.filter(tier =>
          tier && Number.isSafeInteger(tier.min_qty) &&
          tier.min_qty > 1 && Number.isFinite(tier.price) && tier.price >= 0
        ).sort((left, right) => left.min_qty - right.min_qty)
        : [];
    }

    function getEffectiveUnitPrice(product, quantity) {
      const basePrice = getProductPrice(product);
      if (basePrice === null) return null;
      return getTierPrices(product).reduce(
        (price, tier) => quantity >= tier.min_qty ? tier.price : price,
        basePrice
      );
    }

    function tierPriceSummary(product) {
      return getTierPrices(product)
        .map(tier => `買滿 ${tier.min_qty} 件每件 ${formatPrice(tier.price)}`)
        .join(' · ');
    }

    function formatCountdown(deadline) {
      const remaining = Date.parse(deadline) - Date.now();
      if (!Number.isFinite(remaining) || remaining <= 0) return '已截單';
      const seconds = Math.floor(remaining / 1000);
      const days = Math.floor(seconds / 86400);
      const hours = Math.floor((seconds % 86400) / 3600);
      const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
      const secs = seconds % 60;
      return `截單倒數 ${days}日 ${String(hours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }

    function updateCountdownLabels() {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-countdown-deadline]').forEach(label => {
        label.textContent = formatCountdown(label.dataset.countdownDeadline);
      });
      const quickViewAddButton = document.querySelector('#quickViewAddToCartBtn');
      if (currentQuickViewProduct && currentQuickViewProduct.preorder_deadline) {
        quickViewAddButton.disabled =
          Date.parse(currentQuickViewProduct.preorder_deadline) <= Date.now();
      }
    }

    const reviewSummaries = new Map();

    function showToast(message) {
      const toast = document.querySelector('#toastNotification');
      toast.textContent = message;
      const isError = /失敗|無法|錯誤|不足|無效|超出|不能/.test(message);
      toast.classList.toggle('toast-error', isError);
      toast.classList.toggle('toast-success', !isError);
      toast.classList.remove('translate-y-3', 'opacity-0');
      toast.classList.add('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');
      clearTimeout(toastTimer);
      toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.add('translate-y-3', 'opacity-0');
        toast.classList.remove('translate-y-0', 'opacity-100');
      }, 2000);
    }

    function updateCartCount() {
      const count = cart.reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0);
      const countBadge = document.querySelector('#cartCount');
      const previousCount = Number(countBadge.textContent);
      countBadge.textContent = String(count);
      if (count !== previousCount) {
        countBadge.classList.remove('cart-count-pop');
        void countBadge.offsetWidth;
        countBadge.classList.add('cart-count-pop');
      }
      document.querySelector('#drawerCartCount').textContent = `(${count})`;
      persistCart();
      if (!cartDrawer.inert) renderCart();
    }

    function setLoadingProducts() {
      productGrid.replaceChildren();
      for (let index = 0; index < 8; index += 1) {
        const card = makeElement('div', 'overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3');
        card.append(makeElement('div', 'skeleton aspect-[4/3] rounded-xl'));
        card.append(makeElement('div', 'skeleton mt-4 h-4 w-3/4 rounded'));
        card.append(makeElement('div', 'skeleton mt-3 h-4 w-1/3 rounded'));
        card.append(makeElement('div', 'skeleton mt-5 h-10 rounded-xl'));
        productGrid.append(card);
      }
      document.querySelector('#resultCount').textContent = '正在載入商品…';
    }

    function showProductLoadError(message = '請檢查網絡連線後重試。') {
      productGrid.replaceChildren();
      const panel = makeElement('div', 'col-span-full rounded-3xl border border-rose-200 bg-white px-6 py-12 text-center');
      panel.append(makeElement('div', 'text-4xl', '⚠️'));
      panel.append(makeElement('h3', 'mt-3 text-lg font-extrabold', '暫時無法載入商品'));
      panel.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500', message));
      const retry = makeElement('button', 'mt-5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-indigo-700', '重新載入');
      retry.type = 'button';
      retry.addEventListener('click', () => loadProducts(0));
      panel.append(retry);
      productGrid.append(panel);
      document.querySelector('#resultCount').textContent = '';
    }

    function renderCategoryTabs() {
      const tabs = document.querySelector('#categoryTabs');
      const categoryFilter = document.querySelector('#categoryFilter');
      const existingCategories = [...new Set(products
        .map(product => typeof product.category === 'string' ? product.category.trim() : '')
        .filter(Boolean))];

      tabs.querySelectorAll('[data-dynamic-category]').forEach(button => button.remove());
      const selectedCategory = categoryFilter.value;
      categoryFilter.replaceChildren(makeElement('option', '', '所有分類'));
      categoryFilter.options[0].value = '';
      existingCategories.forEach(category => {
        const button = makeElement('button', 'category-button shrink-0 rounded-full border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:border-indigo-200 hover:text-indigo-700', category);
        button.type = 'button';
        button.dataset.category = `category:${category}`;
        button.dataset.dynamicCategory = 'true';
        tabs.append(button);
        const option = makeElement('option', '', category);
        option.value = category;
        categoryFilter.append(option);
      });
      if (selectedCategory && !existingCategories.includes(selectedCategory)) {
        const selectedOption = makeElement('option', '', selectedCategory);
        selectedOption.value = selectedCategory;
        categoryFilter.append(selectedOption);
      }
      categoryFilter.value = selectedCategory;
      updateCategoryTabStyles();
    }

    function updateCategoryTabStyles() {
      document.querySelectorAll('.category-button').forEach(button => {
        const selected = button.dataset.category === activeCategory ||
          button.dataset.category === `category:${document.querySelector('#categoryFilter').value}`;
        button.classList.toggle('bg-indigo-600', selected);
        button.classList.toggle('text-white', selected);
        button.classList.toggle('border-indigo-600', selected);
        button.classList.toggle('shadow-sm', selected);
        button.classList.toggle('border-slate-200', !selected);
        button.classList.toggle('bg-white', !selected);
        button.classList.toggle('text-slate-600', !selected);
      });
    }

    function productMatchesCategory(product) {
      const stock = getProductStock(product);
      if (activeCategory === 'hot') return stock !== null && stock > 0 && stock <= 5;
      if (activeCategory === 'new') return isNewProduct(product);
      if (activeCategory === 'in-stock') return stock !== null && stock > 0;
      return true;
    }

    function openQuickView(product) {
      currentQuickViewProduct = product;
      currentQuickViewQuantity = 1;
      
      const hasUploadedImage =
        (Array.isArray(product.images) && product.images.length > 0) ||
        (typeof product.image_url === 'string' && product.image_url.trim() !== '') ||
        (typeof product.imageUrl === 'string' && product.imageUrl.trim() !== '');

      let imgUrl = '';
      if (hasUploadedImage) {
        imgUrl = (Array.isArray(product.images) && product.images[0]) || product.image_url || product.imageUrl;
      } else {
        const randomSeed = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
        imgUrl = `https://picsum.photos/seed/${randomSeed}/400/300`;
      }

      const quickViewImg = document.querySelector('#quickViewImg');
      quickViewImg.src = imgUrl;
      if (!hasUploadedImage) {
        quickViewImg.addEventListener('error', function onQuickViewImgError() {
          quickViewImg.removeEventListener('error', onQuickViewImgError);
          quickViewImg.src = 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1523275335684-37898b6baf30?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60';
        }, { once: true });
      }

      document.querySelector('#quickViewCategory').textContent = product.category || '精選商品';
      document.querySelector('#quickViewTitle').textContent = getProductName(product);
      document.querySelector('#quickViewPrice').textContent = formatPrice(getProductPrice(product));
      const tierSummary = document.querySelector('#quickViewTierPrices');
      tierSummary.textContent = tierPriceSummary(product);
      tierSummary.hidden = !tierSummary.textContent;
      const countdown = document.querySelector('#quickViewCountdown');
      countdown.dataset.countdownDeadline = product.preorder_deadline || '';
      countdown.hidden = !product.preorder_deadline;
      if (product.preorder_deadline) countdown.textContent = formatCountdown(product.preorder_deadline);
      const reviewSummary = reviewSummaries.get(getProductId(product));
      document.querySelector('#quickViewReviewSummary').textContent = reviewSummary
        ? `${'★'.repeat(Math.round(reviewSummary.average_rating))}${'☆'.repeat(5 - Math.round(reviewSummary.average_rating))} ${reviewSummary.average_rating.toFixed(1)} · ${reviewSummary.review_count} 則評價`
        : '☆☆☆☆☆ 暫無評價';
      const stock = getProductStock(product);

      const isPreorder = (product.description && product.description.includes('截單')) || (product.name && product.name.includes('【預購】'));
document.querySelector('#quickViewStock').textContent = isPreorder ? '商品狀態：預購中（請參考下方截單日期）' : stock === null ? '庫存：待確認' : `庫存：${stock} 件`;
      // ✨ 關鍵修復：使用 textContent 或 innerText 讓帶有換行符號的描述文字完美顯示換行與排版 ✨
      const descEl = document.querySelector('#quickViewDescription');
      descEl.textContent = product.description || '暫無商品描述';

      document.querySelector('#quickViewQuantityValue').textContent = currentQuickViewQuantity;

      const modal = document.querySelector('#quickViewModal');
      modal.classList.remove('hidden');
      modal.classList.add('flex');
    }

    function closeQuickView() {
      const modal = document.querySelector('#quickViewModal');
      modal.classList.remove('flex');
      modal.classList.add('hidden');
      currentQuickViewProduct = null;
    }

    function makeProductCard(product) {
      const productId = getProductId(product);
      const stock = getProductStock(product);
      const price = getProductPrice(product);
      const soldOut = stock === 0 || product.status === '已下架' || product.is_active === false;
      const card = makeElement('article', 'product-card group flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-3.5 shadow-sm transition duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-indigo-100 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-indigo-100/60');

      const imageWrap = makeElement('div', 'relative grid aspect-[4/3] place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 via-violet-50 to-pink-50 cursor-pointer');
      imageWrap.addEventListener('click', () => openQuickView(product));
      
      const hasUploadedImage =
        (Array.isArray(product.images) && product.images.length > 0) ||
        (typeof product.image_url === 'string' && product.image_url.trim() !== '') ||
        (typeof product.imageUrl === 'string' && product.imageUrl.trim() !== '');

      let imagesList = [];
      if (Array.isArray(product.images) && product.images.length > 0) {
        imagesList = product.images;
      } else if (typeof product.image_url === 'string' && product.image_url.trim()) {
        imagesList = [product.image_url];
      } else if (typeof product.imageUrl === 'string' && product.imageUrl.trim()) {
        imagesList = [product.imageUrl];
      } else {
        imagesList = ['https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1523275335684-37898b6baf30?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60'];
      }

      const primaryImg = document.createElement('img');
      if (hasUploadedImage) {
        primaryImg.src = imagesList[0];
      } else {
        const primaryRandomSeed = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
        primaryImg.src = `https://picsum.photos/seed/${primaryRandomSeed}/400/300`;
        primaryImg.addEventListener('error', function onPrimaryImageError() {
          primaryImg.removeEventListener('error', onPrimaryImageError);
          primaryImg.src = imagesList[0];
        });
      }
      primaryImg.alt = getProductName(product);
      primaryImg.loading = 'lazy';
      primaryImg.className = 'product-image absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover transition-opacity duration-300';
      imageWrap.append(primaryImg);

      if (imagesList.length > 1) {
        const secondaryImg = document.createElement('img');
        secondaryImg.src = imagesList[1];
        secondaryImg.alt = `${getProductName(product)} - 另一角度`;
        secondaryImg.loading = 'lazy';
        secondaryImg.className = 'product-image absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-300 group-hover:opacity-100';
        imageWrap.append(secondaryImg);
      }

      if (soldOut) {
        imageWrap.append(makeElement('span', 'absolute left-3 top-3 rounded-full bg-slate-900/80 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-white', product.status === '已下架' ? '暫停供應' : '已售罄'));
      } else if (isNewProduct(product)) {
        imageWrap.append(makeElement('span', 'absolute left-3 top-3 rounded-full bg-fuchsia-600 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-white shadow', 'NEW 新品'));
      }
      const badges = makeElement('div', 'absolute left-3 top-3 flex flex-col items-start gap-1.5');
      if (!soldOut && stock !== null && stock > 0 && stock < 5) {
        badges.append(makeElement(
          'span',
          'rounded-full bg-rose-600 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-extrabold text-white shadow',
          `🔥 僅剩最後 ${stock} 件！`
        ));
      }
      if (!soldOut && getTierPrices(product).length > 0) {
        badges.append(makeElement(
          'span',
          'rounded-full bg-emerald-600 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-extrabold text-white shadow',
          '團購優惠中'
        ));
      }
      if (badges.childElementCount > 0) imageWrap.append(badges);

      const content = makeElement('div', 'flex flex-1 flex-col px-1 pb-1 pt-4');
      if (product.category) content.append(makeElement('p', 'text-xs font-bold tracking-wide text-indigo-600', product.category));
      
      const titleElem = makeElement('h3', 'mt-1 line-clamp-2 min-h-12 text-[15px] font-extrabold leading-6 text-slate-900 cursor-pointer hover:text-indigo-600 transition', getProductName(product));
      titleElem.addEventListener('click', () => openQuickView(product));
      content.append(titleElem);

      content.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-2 text-lg font-black tracking-tight text-indigo-700', formatPrice(price)));

      const tierSummary = tierPriceSummary(product);
      if (tierSummary) content.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-xs font-bold leading-5 text-emerald-700', tierSummary));
      if (product.preorder_deadline) {
        const countdown = makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-xs font-extrabold text-rose-600');
        countdown.dataset.countdownDeadline = product.preorder_deadline;
        countdown.textContent = formatCountdown(product.preorder_deadline);
        content.append(countdown);
      }
      const reviewSummary = reviewSummaries.get(productId);
      const reviewBadge = makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-600');
      reviewBadge.dataset.reviewSummaryFor = productId;
      reviewBadge.textContent = reviewSummary
        ? `${'★'.repeat(Math.round(reviewSummary.average_rating))}${'☆'.repeat(5 - Math.round(reviewSummary.average_rating))} ${reviewSummary.average_rating.toFixed(1)} · ${reviewSummary.review_count} 則評價`
        : '☆☆☆☆☆ 暫無評價';
      content.append(reviewBadge);

const isPreorder = (product.description && product.description.includes('截單')) || (product.name && product.name.includes('【預購】'));
const stockText = soldOut ? '暫無庫存' : isPreorder ? '⏳ 預購中（按公告日期到貨）' : stock === null ? '庫存資訊待確認' : stock > 0 && stock < 5 ? `庫存緊張 · 剩餘 ${stock} 件` : `現貨 · ${stock} 件`;
content.append(makeElement('p', `mt-1 text-xs font-semibold ${soldOut ? 'text-slate-400' : isPreorder ? 'text-indigo-600 font-bold' : stock !== null && stock > 0 && stock < 5 ? 'text-rose-600' : 'text-emerald-700'}`, stockText));

      content.append(createBestBeforeSummary(product.best_before_summary));

      const actions = makeElement('div', 'mt-auto pt-4');
      
      const quickViewBtn = makeElement('button', 'mb-2 w-full rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700 transition hover:bg-indigo-100', '快速查看 Quick View');
      quickViewBtn.type = 'button';
      quickViewBtn.addEventListener('click', () => openQuickView(product));
      actions.append(quickViewBtn);

      const favorite = makeElement('button', 'mb-2 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold transition', '');
      favorite.type = 'button';
      favorite.dataset.action = 'toggle-wishlist';
      favorite.dataset.productId = productId;
      updateWishlistButton(favorite, productId);
      actions.append(favorite);

      const reviewsButton = makeElement('button', 'mb-2 w-full rounded-lg border border-indigo-200 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700 transition hover:bg-indigo-50', '查看評價 / 寫評價');
      reviewsButton.type = 'button';
      reviewsButton.dataset.action = 'product-reviews';
      reviewsButton.dataset.productId = productId;
      actions.append(reviewsButton);

      if (!soldOut && stock !== 0) {
        const actionRow = makeElement('div', 'flex items-center justify-between gap-3');
        const quantity = makeElement('div', 'flex items-center rounded-lg border border-slate-200');
        const minus = makeElement('button', 'grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center text-lg font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50', '−');
        minus.type = 'button';
        minus.dataset.action = 'card-quantity';
        minus.dataset.delta = '-1';
        minus.dataset.productId = productId;
        minus.setAttribute('aria-label', `減少${getProductName(product)}數量`);
        const value = makeElement('span', 'min-w-7 text-center text-sm font-bold', '1');
        value.dataset.quantityFor = productId;
        const plus = makeElement('button', 'grid h-9 w-9 place-items-center text-lg font-semibold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50', '+');
        plus.type = 'button';
        plus.dataset.action = 'card-quantity';
        plus.dataset.delta = '1';
        plus.dataset.productId = productId;
        plus.setAttribute('aria-label', `增加${getProductName(product)}數量`);
        quantity.append(minus, value, plus);
        actionRow.append(quantity);
        const add = makeElement('button', 'flex-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-indigo-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-slate-300', '加入購物車');
        add.type = 'button';
        add.dataset.action = 'add-to-cart';
        add.dataset.productId = productId;
        actionRow.append(add);
        actions.append(actionRow);
      } else {
        const unavailable = makeElement('button', 'w-full cursor-not-allowed rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-400', '暫未供應');
        unavailable.type = 'button';
        unavailable.disabled = true;
        actions.append(unavailable);
      }
      content.append(actions);
      card.append(imageWrap, content);
      return card;
    }

    function createBestBeforeSummary(summary) {
      const section = makeElement('div', 'mt-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-100 bg-amber-50/70 p-2.5');
      section.append(makeElement('p', 'text-xs font-extrabold text-amber-900', '📅 收貨批次最佳使用日期'));

      if (!summary || (!Array.isArray(summary.best_before_dates) && !summary.has_undated_batch && !summary.has_legacy_unknown_date)) {
        section.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500', '效期資料暫未提供'));
        return section;
      }

      if (Array.isArray(summary.best_before_dates) && summary.best_before_dates.length > 0) {
        const datesText = summary.best_before_dates.join('、');
        section.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700', `有效日期：${datesText}`));
      }

      if (summary.has_undated_batch === true) {
        section.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-amber-800', '• 部分批次：無最佳使用日期設定'));
      }

      if (summary.has_legacy_unknown_date === true) {
        section.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600', '• 舊庫存批次：效期日期未知'));
      }

      return section;
    }

    function updateWishlistButton(button, productId) {
      const saved = wishlistProductIds.has(productId);
      button.textContent = saved ? '♥ 已收藏' : '♡ 加入收藏';
      button.className = `mb-2 flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-sm font-bold transition ${
        saved
          ? 'border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-100'
          : 'border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:border-rose-200 hover:text-rose-600'
      }`;
      button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', saved ? 'true' : 'false');
      button.setAttribute('aria-label', saved ? '從收藏清單移除' : '加入收藏清單');
    }

    function refreshWishlistButtons() {
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-action="toggle-wishlist"]').forEach(button => {
        updateWishlistButton(button, button.dataset.productId);
      });
    }

    async function loadMemberWishlist() {
      memberSessionChecked = false;
      try {
        const sessionResponse = await fetch('/api/customer/member/session', {
          headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
          credentials: 'same-origin',
          cache: 'no-store'
        });
        const sessionResult = await sessionResponse.json();
        if (!sessionResponse.ok || !sessionResult || sessionResult.success !== true) {
          throw new Error(sessionResult && sessionResult.message
            ? sessionResult.message
            : `會員登入狀態讀取失敗（HTTP ${sessionResponse.status}）。`);
        }
        memberAuthenticated = sessionResult.data && sessionResult.data.authenticated === true;
        if (!memberAuthenticated) {
          wishlistProductIds.clear();
          return;
        }

        wishlistProductIds.clear();
        let offset = 0;
        let totalCount = 0;
        try {
          do {
            const response = await fetch(`/api/customer/wishlist?limit=100&offset=${offset}`, {
              headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
              credentials: 'same-origin',
              cache: 'no-store'
            });
            const result = await response.json();
            if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true ||
                !result.data || !Array.isArray(result.data.wishlist) ||
                !Number.isSafeInteger(result.data.total_count)) {
              if (response.status === 401) memberAuthenticated = false;
              throw new Error(result && result.message
                ? result.message
                : `收藏清單載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
            }
            result.data.wishlist.forEach(item => wishlistProductIds.add(String(item.product_id)));
            totalCount = result.data.total_count;
            offset += result.data.wishlist.length;
            if (result.data.wishlist.length === 0) break;
          } while (offset < totalCount);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('載入會員收藏清單失敗：', error);
          showToast('收藏狀態暫時無法載入，請稍後重試。');
          if (!memberAuthenticated) wishlistProductIds.clear();
        }
      } catch (error) {
        memberAuthenticated = false;
        wishlistProductIds.clear();
        console.error('載入會員收藏狀態失敗：', error);
      } finally {
        memberSessionChecked = true;
        refreshWishlistButtons();
      }
    }

    async function toggleWishlist(productId, button) {
      if (!memberSessionChecked || !memberAuthenticated) {
        showToast('請先登入會員中心，登入後即可管理收藏。');
        window.location.assign('/customer.html?wishlist=1');
        return;
      }
      const wasSaved = wishlistProductIds.has(productId);
      button.disabled = true;
      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          wasSaved
            ? `/api/customer/wishlist/${encodeURIComponent(productId)}`
            : '/api/customer/wishlist',
          {
            method: wasSaved ? 'DELETE' : 'POST',
            headers: {
              Accept: 'application/json',
              ...(wasSaved ? {} : { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' })
            },
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            ...(wasSaved ? {} : { body: JSON.stringify({ product_id: productId }) })
          }
        );
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true) {
          if (response.status === 401) {
            memberAuthenticated = false;
            wishlistProductIds.clear();
            refreshWishlistButtons();
          }
          throw new Error(result && result.message
            ? result.message
            : `收藏操作失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
        }
        if (wasSaved) wishlistProductIds.delete(productId);
        else wishlistProductIds.add(productId);
        refreshWishlistButtons();
        showToast(result.message || (wasSaved ? '已移除收藏。' : '已加入收藏。'));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('更新會員收藏失敗：', error);
        showToast(error.message || '收藏操作失敗，請稍後再試。');
      } finally {
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    let activeReviewProductId = '';

    async function loadProductReviews() {
      const summary = document.querySelector('#reviewSummary');
      const status = document.querySelector('#reviewStatus');
      const list = document.querySelector('#reviewList');
      summary.textContent = '正在載入評價…';
      status.textContent = '';
      list.replaceChildren();
      try {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/products/${encodeURIComponent(activeReviewProductId)}/reviews?limit=50&offset=0`, {
          headers: { Accept: 'application/json' }
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data || !Array.isArray(result.data.reviews)) {
          throw new Error(result && result.message ? result.message : `評價載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
        }
        const rating = Number(result.data.average_rating);
        const count = Number(result.data.review_count);
        summary.textContent = `${Number.isFinite(rating) ? rating.toFixed(1) : '0.0'} ★ · ${Number.isSafeInteger(count) ? count : 0} 則評價`;
        if (result.data.reviews.length === 0) {
          status.textContent = '暫時未有評價，成為第一位分享使用感受的顧客吧。';
          return;
        }
        result.data.reviews.forEach(review => {
          const item = makeElement('li', 'rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4');
          item.append(makeElement('p', 'font-bold text-amber-600', `${'★'.repeat(review.rating)}${'☆'.repeat(5 - review.rating)}`));
          item.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-sm leading-6 text-slate-700', review.comment));
          item.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500', review.customer_name || '已驗證買家'));
          const date = new Date(review.created_at);
          item.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500', Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '' : date.toLocaleDateString('zh-HK')));
          list.append(item);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('載入商品評價失敗：', error);
        summary.textContent = '評價暫時無法載入';
        status.textContent = error.message || '請稍後重試。';
      }
    }

    async function refreshReviewMemberState() {
      const panel = document.querySelector('#reviewVerifyPanel');
      const form = document.querySelector('#reviewForm');
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/customer/member/session', {
          headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
          credentials: 'same-origin'
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        const authenticated = response.ok && result && result.success === true &&
          result.data && result.data.authenticated === true;
        panel.hidden = authenticated;
        form.hidden = !authenticated;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('檢查會員 Session 失敗：', error);
        panel.hidden = false;
        form.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    async function openProductReviews(productId) {
      const product = products.find(item => getProductId(item) === productId);
      if (!product) return;
      activeReviewProductId = productId;
      document.querySelector('#reviewDialogTitle').textContent = `${getProductName(product)} · 商品評價`;
      document.querySelector('#reviewDialog').showModal();
      document.querySelector('#reviewComment').value = '';
      await Promise.all([loadProductReviews(), refreshReviewMemberState()]);
    }

    async function loadReviewSummaries(productList) {
      const productIds = [...new Set(productList.map(getProductId).filter(Boolean))];
      if (productIds.length === 0) return;
      try {
        const query = new URLSearchParams({ product_ids: productIds.join(',') });
        const response = await fetch(`/api/reviews/summary?${query}`, {
          headers: { Accept: 'application/json' }
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data ||
            !result.data.summaries || typeof result.data.summaries !== 'object') {
          throw new Error(result && result.message
            ? result.message
            : `評價摘要載入失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
        }
        for (const [productId, summary] of Object.entries(result.data.summaries)) {
          if (
            productIds.includes(productId) &&
            summary &&
            Number.isFinite(summary.average_rating) &&
            Number.isSafeInteger(summary.review_count)
          ) {
            reviewSummaries.set(productId, summary);
          }
        }
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-review-summary-for]').forEach(label => {
          const summary = reviewSummaries.get(label.dataset.reviewSummaryFor);
          if (summary) {
            const stars = Math.round(summary.average_rating);
            label.textContent = `${'★'.repeat(stars)}${'☆'.repeat(5 - stars)} ${summary.average_rating.toFixed(1)} · ${summary.review_count} 則評價`;
          }
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('載入商品星級摘要失敗：', error);
      }
    }

    function renderProducts() {
      const visible = products.filter(productMatchesCategory);

      productGrid.replaceChildren();
      document.querySelector('#resultCount').textContent =
        activeCategory === 'all'
          ? `共 ${productsTotalCount} 件符合條件的商品`
          : `本頁 ${visible.length} 件符合快速篩選 · 共 ${productsTotalCount} 件搜尋結果`;
      if (visible.length === 0) {
        const empty = makeElement('div', 'col-span-full rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-6 py-14 text-center');
        empty.append(makeElement('div', 'text-4xl', '🔎'));
        empty.append(makeElement('h3', 'mt-3 text-lg font-extrabold', '暫時找不到符合的商品'));
        empty.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500', activeCategory === 'new' ? '目前沒有可確認上架日期的新品，試試其他分類。' : '試試其他關鍵字或切換分類。'));
        productGrid.append(empty);
      } else {
        visible.forEach(product => productGrid.append(makeProductCard(product)));
      }
      const pageStatus = document.querySelector('#productPageStatus');
      const first = productsTotalCount === 0 ? 0 : productsOffset + 1;
      const last = Math.min(productsOffset + products.length, productsTotalCount);
      pageStatus.textContent = productsTotalCount > 0
        ? `顯示第 ${first}–${last} 件，共 ${productsTotalCount} 件`
        : '沒有符合條件的商品';
      document.querySelector('#previousProductsButton').disabled = productsOffset === 0;
      document.querySelector('#nextProductsButton').disabled =
        productsOffset + products.length >= productsTotalCount;
    }

    function reconcileCartWithProducts() {
      cart = cart.map(item => {
        const latest = products.find(product => getProductId(product) === String(item.product.id ?? item.product.product_id));
        return latest ? { product: latest, quantity: item.quantity } : item;
      });
      persistCart();
      updateCartCount();
    }

    let deepLinkProcessed = false;

    async function applyDeepLinkOrder() {
      if (deepLinkProcessed) return;
      deepLinkProcessed = true;
      const params = storefrontUrlParams;
      const rawItems = params.get('items');
      if (!rawItems) return;

      const requested = new Map();
      const chunks = rawItems.split(',');
      if (chunks.length > 20) {
        showToast('開單連結商品數量超出上限，請聯絡店主。');
        return;
      }
      for (const chunk of chunks) {
        const match = chunk.match(/^([^:,]+):([1-9]\d{0,3})$/);
        if (!match || !/^(?:[1-9]\d{0,18}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$/i.test(match[1])) {
          showToast('開單連結商品格式無效，請向店主索取新連結。');
          return;
        }
        const productId = match[1].toLowerCase();
        const quantity = Number(match[2]);
        const totalQuantity = (requested.get(productId) || 0) + quantity;
        if (totalQuantity > 1000) {
          showToast('開單連結商品數量超出上限。');
          return;
        }
        requested.set(productId, totalQuantity);
      }

      try {
        const query = new URLSearchParams({ ids: [...requested.keys()].join(',') });
        const response = await fetch(`/api/products?${query}`, {
          headers: { Accept: 'application/json' }
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data ||
            !Array.isArray(result.data.products)) {
          throw new Error(result && result.message
            ? result.message
            : `開單商品讀取失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
        }
        const productsById = new Map(result.data.products.map(product => [
          getProductId(product).toLowerCase(),
          product
        ]));
        if (productsById.size !== requested.size) {
          throw new Error('開單連結包含不存在或已下架的商品，請聯絡店主。');
        }
        for (const [productId, quantity] of requested) {
          const product = productsById.get(productId);
          const existing = cart.find(item => getProductId(item.product).toLowerCase() === productId);
          const stock = getProductStock(product);
          if (
            !product ||
            stock === null ||
            stock < quantity + (existing ? existing.quantity : 0) ||
            quantity + (existing ? existing.quantity : 0) > 1000 ||
            product.preorder_deadline && Date.parse(product.preorder_deadline) <= Date.now() ||
            product.status === '已下架' ||
            product.is_active === false
          ) {
            throw new Error(`商品「${product ? getProductName(product) : productId}」目前無法按連結數量加入購物車。`);
          }
        }
        for (const [productId, quantity] of requested) {
          const product = productsById.get(productId);
          const existing = cart.find(item => getProductId(item.product).toLowerCase() === productId);
          if (existing) {
            existing.product = product;
            existing.quantity += quantity;
          } else {
            cart.push({ product, quantity });
          }
        }
        const phone = params.get('phone') || '';
        if (/^\+?\d{8,15}$/.test(phone)) {
          document.querySelector('#customerPhone').value = phone;
        }
        const name = params.get('name') || '';
        if (name.length <= 100 && !/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(name)) {
          document.querySelector('#customerName').value = name.trim();
        }
        persistCart();
        updateCartCount();
        renderProducts();
        renderCart();
        openCart();
        showToast('私訊開單商品已加入購物車，請核對資料後結帳。');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('套用私訊開單連結失敗：', error);
        showToast(error.message || '開單連結載入失敗，請稍後重試。');
      }
    }

    async function loadProducts(offset = 0) {
      if (productRequestController) {
        productRequestController.abort();
      }
      const controller = new AbortController();
      productRequestController = controller;
      setLoadingProducts();
      document.querySelector('#productPageStatus').textContent = '正在搜尋商品…';
      document.querySelector('#previousProductsButton').disabled = true;
      document.querySelector('#nextProductsButton').disabled = true;
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        limit: String(PRODUCT_PAGE_SIZE),
        offset: String(offset),
        sort: document.querySelector('#sortSelect').value,
        include_best_before_dates: 'true'
      });
      const search = document.querySelector('#searchInput').value.trim();
      const category = document.querySelector('#categoryFilter').value;
      if (search) query.set('search', search);
      if (category) query.set('category', category);
      try {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/products?${query}`, {
          headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
          signal: controller.signal
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data ||
            !Array.isArray(result.data.products) ||
            !Number.isSafeInteger(result.data.total_count)) {
          throw new Error(result && result.message ? result.message : '商品服務回應格式無效');
        }
        products = result.data.products.filter(product => product && typeof product === 'object' && getProductId(product));
        productsTotalCount = result.data.total_count;
        productsOffset = result.data.offset;
        renderCategoryTabs();
        reconcileCartWithProducts();
        renderProducts();
        void loadReviewSummaries(products);
        if (offset === 0) void applyDeepLinkOrder();
      } catch (error) {
        if (error.name === 'AbortError') return;
        console.error('載入商品失敗：', error);
        showProductLoadError(error.message || '請檢查網絡連線後重試。');
        document.querySelector('#productPageStatus').textContent = '';
      } finally {
        if (productRequestController === controller) {
          productRequestController = null;
        }
      }
    }

    function changeCardQuantity(productId, delta) {
      const product = products.find(item => getProductId(item) === productId);
      const value = document.querySelector(`[data-quantity-for="${CSS.escape(productId)}"]`);
      if (!product || !value) return;
      const stock = getProductStock(product);
      const current = Number(value.textContent) || 1;
      const next = current + delta;
      if (next < 1 || (stock !== null && next > stock)) return;
      value.textContent = String(next);
    }

    function addToCart(productId) {
      const product = products.find(item => getProductId(item) === productId);
      if (!product) return;
      const stock = getProductStock(product);
      const price = getProductPrice(product);
      if (stock === null || stock < 1 || price === null ||
          product.preorder_deadline && Date.parse(product.preorder_deadline) <= Date.now() ||
          product.status === '已下架' || product.is_active === false) {
        showToast('商品目前無法加入購物車。');
        return;
      }
      const quantityElement = document.querySelector(`[data-quantity-for="${CSS.escape(productId)}"]`);
      const quantity = Number(quantityElement ? quantityElement.textContent : 1);
      const existing = cart.find(item => String(item.product.id ?? item.product.product_id) === productId);
      if ((existing ? existing.quantity : 0) + quantity > stock) {
        showToast('購買數量已達庫存上限。');
        return;
      }
      if (existing) {
        existing.product = product;
        existing.quantity += quantity;
      } else {
        cart.push({ product, quantity });
      }
      updateCartCount();
      renderProducts();
      openCart();
      showToast(`已將 ${quantity} 件「${getProductName(product)}」加入購物車。`);
    }

    function createCartItem(item) {
      const product = item.product;
      const productId = getProductId(product);
      const name = getProductName(product);
      const price = getProductPrice(product);
      const stock = getProductStock(product);
      const row = makeElement('article', 'flex gap-3 border-b border-slate-100 py-4 last:border-0');
      const thumbnail = makeElement('div', 'grid h-16 w-16 shrink-0 place-items-center overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 text-2xl', '🪐');
      if (typeof product.image_url === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(product.image_url)) {
        const image = document.createElement('img');
        image.src = product.image_url;
        image.alt = '';
        image.loading = 'lazy';
        image.className = 'h-full w-full object-cover';
        image.addEventListener('error', () => image.remove(), { once: true });
        thumbnail.replaceChildren(image);
      }
      const details = makeElement('div', 'min-w-0 flex-1');
      const top = makeElement('div', 'flex items-start justify-between gap-2');
      top.append(makeElement('h3', 'line-clamp-2 text-sm font-extrabold leading-5', name));
      const remove = makeElement('button', 'shrink-0 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 transition hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600', '移除');
      remove.type = 'button';
      remove.dataset.action = 'remove-cart-item';
      remove.dataset.productId = productId;
      remove.setAttribute('aria-label', `移除${name}`);
      top.append(remove);
      details.append(top);
      const unitPrice = getEffectiveUnitPrice(product, item.quantity);
      const priceText = unitPrice !== price
        ? `${formatPrice(unitPrice)} / 件（階梯優惠） × ${item.quantity}`
        : `${formatPrice(price)} × ${item.quantity}`;
      details.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500', priceText));
      if (stock === null || item.quantity > stock) details.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600', stock === null ? '庫存待確認，暫不能結帳' : '目前庫存不足，請調整數量'));

      const controls = makeElement('div', 'mt-2 flex items-center gap-2');
      const minus = makeElement('button', 'grid h-7 w-7 place-items-center rounded-md border border-slate-200 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-40', '−');
      minus.type = 'button';
      minus.dataset.action = 'cart-quantity';
      minus.dataset.delta = '-1';
      minus.dataset.productId = productId;
      minus.disabled = item.quantity <= 1;
      minus.setAttribute('aria-label', `減少${name}數量`);
      const count = makeElement('span', 'min-w-5 text-center text-sm font-bold', String(item.quantity));
      const plus = makeElement('button', 'grid h-7 w-7 place-items-center rounded-md border border-slate-200 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-40', '+');
      plus.type = 'button';
      plus.dataset.action = 'cart-quantity';
      plus.dataset.delta = '1';
      plus.dataset.productId = productId;
      plus.disabled = stock === null || item.quantity >= stock;
      plus.setAttribute('aria-label', `增加${name}數量`);
      controls.append(minus, count, plus);
      details.append(controls);
      row.append(thumbnail, details);
      return row;
    }

    function canCheckout() {
      return cart.length > 0 && cart.every(item => {
        const stock = getProductStock(item.product);
        return stock !== null && stock > 0 && item.quantity <= stock && getProductPrice(item.product) !== null &&
          (!item.product.preorder_deadline || Date.parse(item.product.preorder_deadline) > Date.now()) &&
          item.product.status !== '已下架' && item.product.is_active !== false;
      });
    }

    function renderCart() {
      cartItemsElement.replaceChildren();
      if (cart.length === 0) {
        const empty = makeElement('div', 'flex h-full min-h-48 flex-col items-center justify-center text-center');
        empty.append(makeElement('div', 'text-5xl', '🛍️'));
        empty.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-3 font-extrabold', '購物車還未有商品'));
        empty.append(makeElement('p', 'mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500', '逛逛商品，挑選喜歡的好物吧。'));
        cartItemsElement.append(empty);
      } else {
        cart.forEach(item => cartItemsElement.append(createCartItem(item)));
      }
      const subtotal = cart.reduce((total, item) => {
        const price = getEffectiveUnitPrice(item.product, item.quantity);
        return total + (price === null ? 0 : price * item.quantity);
      }, 0);
      document.querySelector('#cartSubtotal').textContent = currencyFormatter.format(subtotal);
      const shippingHint = document.querySelector('#cartShippingHint');
      shippingHint.textContent = document.querySelector('#shippingMethod').value
        ? '運費按所選取貨方式確認。'
        : '先選擇取貨方式，即可確認適用運費；目前沒有設定固定免運門檻。';
      document.querySelector('#checkoutButton').disabled = !canCheckout();
      document.querySelector('#checkoutStatus').textContent = cart.length > 0 && !canCheckout()
        ? '請移除已下架／已截單商品，或調整庫存不足的數量後再結帳。'
        : '';
    }

    function openCart() {
      lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
      renderCart();
      cartDrawer.inert = false;
      cartDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      document.querySelectorAll('#cartButton, #mobileCartBtn').forEach(button =>
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true')
      );
      cartBackdrop.classList.remove('hidden');
      document.body.classList.add('overflow-hidden');
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        cartBackdrop.classList.remove('opacity-0');
        cartBackdrop.classList.add('opacity-100');
        cartDrawer.classList.remove('translate-x-full');
        document.querySelector('#closeCartButton').focus();
      });
    }

    function closeCart() {
      cartBackdrop.classList.add('opacity-0');
      cartBackdrop.classList.remove('opacity-100');
      cartDrawer.classList.add('translate-x-full');
      cartDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      cartDrawer.inert = true;
      document.querySelectorAll('#cartButton, #mobileCartBtn').forEach(button =>
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false')
      );
      document.body.classList.remove('overflow-hidden');
      setTimeout(() => cartBackdrop.classList.add('hidden'), 230);
      if (lastFocusedElement && typeof lastFocusedElement.focus === 'function') lastFocusedElement.focus();
    }

    function removeCartItem(productId) {
      cart = cart.filter(item => String(item.product.id ?? item.product.product_id) !== productId);
      updateCartCount();
      showToast('商品已從購物車移除。');
    }

    function changeCartQuantity(productId, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(entry => String(entry.product.id ?? entry.product.product_id) === productId);
      if (!item) return;
      const stock = getProductStock(item.product);
      const next = item.quantity + delta;
      if (next < 1 || (stock !== null && next > stock)) return;
      item.quantity = next;
      updateCartCount();
    }

    function initializeTheme() {
      try {
        const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);
        const dark = savedTheme ? savedTheme === 'dark' : true; 

        document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', dark);
        if (dark) {
          document.body.classList.replace('bg-slate-50', 'bg-slate-950');
          document.body.classList.replace('text-slate-900', 'text-slate-100');
          document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn').textContent = '☀️';
          document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn').setAttribute('aria-label', '切換淺色模式');
        } else {
          document.body.classList.replace('bg-slate-950', 'bg-slate-50');
          document.body.classList.replace('text-slate-100', 'text-slate-900');
          document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn').textContent = '🌙';
          document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn').setAttribute('aria-label', '切換深色模式');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('讀取主題設定失敗：', error);
      }
    }

    document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const dark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
      document.body.classList.toggle('bg-slate-950', dark);
      document.body.classList.toggle('bg-slate-50', !dark);
      document.body.classList.toggle('text-slate-100', dark);
      document.body.classList.toggle('text-slate-900', !dark);
      document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn').textContent = dark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
      document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn').setAttribute('aria-label', dark ? '切換淺色模式' : '切換深色模式');
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, dark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('儲存主題設定失敗：', error);
      }
    });

    document.querySelector('#searchInput').addEventListener('input', () => {
      clearTimeout(productSearchTimer);
      productSearchTimer = setTimeout(() => loadProducts(0), 140);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-search-keyword]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const input = document.querySelector('#searchInput');
        input.value = button.dataset.searchKeyword;
        input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
        input.focus();
      });
    });
    document.querySelector('#categoryFilter').addEventListener('change', () => {
      activeCategory = 'all';
      updateCategoryTabStyles();
      loadProducts(0);
    });
    document.querySelector('#sortSelect').addEventListener('change', () => loadProducts(0));
    document.querySelector('#previousProductsButton').addEventListener('click', () => {
      loadProducts(Math.max(0, productsOffset - PRODUCT_PAGE_SIZE));
    });
    document.querySelector('#nextProductsButton').addEventListener('click', () => {
      loadProducts(productsOffset + PRODUCT_PAGE_SIZE);
    });
    document.querySelector('#categoryTabs').addEventListener('click', event => {
      const button = event.target.closest('[data-category]');
      if (!button) return;
      activeCategory = button.dataset.category;
      if (activeCategory.startsWith('category:')) {
        document.querySelector('#categoryFilter').value = activeCategory.slice(9);
        activeCategory = 'all';
        loadProducts(0);
      } else if (activeCategory === 'all') {
        document.querySelector('#categoryFilter').value = '';
        loadProducts(0);
      } else {
        renderProducts();
      }
      updateCategoryTabStyles();
    });

    document.querySelector('#quickViewCloseBtn').addEventListener('click', closeQuickView);
    document.querySelector('#quickViewModal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target.id === 'quickViewModal') closeQuickView();
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') closeQuickView();
    });

    document.querySelector('#quickViewQuantityMinus').addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (currentQuickViewQuantity > 1) {
        currentQuickViewQuantity--;
        document.querySelector('#quickViewQuantityValue').textContent = currentQuickViewQuantity;
      }
    });

    document.querySelector('#quickViewQuantityPlus').addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!currentQuickViewProduct) return;
      const stock = getProductStock(currentQuickViewProduct);
      if (stock === null || currentQuickViewQuantity < stock) {
        currentQuickViewQuantity++;
        document.querySelector('#quickViewQuantityValue').textContent = currentQuickViewQuantity;
      } else {
        showToast('已達庫存上限。');
      }
    });

    document.querySelector('#quickViewAddToCartBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!currentQuickViewProduct) return;
      const productId = getProductId(currentQuickViewProduct);
      const stock = getProductStock(currentQuickViewProduct);
      const price = getProductPrice(currentQuickViewProduct);
      if (stock === null || stock < 1 || price === null ||
          currentQuickViewProduct.preorder_deadline &&
            Date.parse(currentQuickViewProduct.preorder_deadline) <= Date.now() ||
          currentQuickViewProduct.status === '已下架' ||
          currentQuickViewProduct.is_active === false) {
        showToast('商品目前無法加入購物車。');
        return;
      }
      const existing = cart.find(item => String(item.product.id ?? item.product.product_id) === productId);
      if ((existing ? existing.quantity : 0) + currentQuickViewQuantity > stock) {
        showToast('購買數量已達庫存上限。');
        return;
      }
      if (existing) {
        existing.product = currentQuickViewProduct;
        existing.quantity += currentQuickViewQuantity;
      } else {
        cart.push({ product: currentQuickViewProduct, quantity: currentQuickViewQuantity });
      }
      updateCartCount();
      renderProducts();
      openCart();
      closeQuickView();
      showToast(`已將 ${currentQuickViewQuantity} 件「${getProductName(currentQuickViewProduct)}」加入購物車。`);
    });

    productGrid.addEventListener('click', event => {
      const button = event.target.closest('[data-action]');
      if (!button) return;
      if (button.dataset.action === 'add-to-cart') addToCart(button.dataset.productId);
      if (button.dataset.action === 'card-quantity') changeCardQuantity(button.dataset.productId, Number(button.dataset.delta));
      if (button.dataset.action === 'product-reviews') openProductReviews(button.dataset.productId);
      if (button.dataset.action === 'toggle-wishlist') toggleWishlist(button.dataset.productId, button);
    });

    document.querySelector('#closeReviewDialog').addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelector('#reviewDialog').close();
    });

    document.querySelector('#reviewVerifyButton').addEventListener('click', async event => {
      const button = event.currentTarget;
      const status = document.querySelector('#reviewStatus');
      const phone = document.querySelector('#reviewCustomerPhone').value.trim();
      const orderId = document.querySelector('#reviewOrderId').value.trim();
      
      const isValidPhone = /^\+?\d{8,15}$/.test(phone);
      const isValidOrderId = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(orderId);

      if (!isValidPhone || !isValidOrderId) {
        status.textContent = '請輸入有效電話號碼及訂單 UUID。';
        return;
      }

      button.disabled = true;
      status.textContent = '正在驗證會員身份…';
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/customer/member/session', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
          credentials: 'same-origin',
          body: JSON.stringify({ customer_phone: phone, order_id: orderId })
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true) {
          throw new Error(result && result.message ? result.message : `會員驗證失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
        }
        status.textContent = '會員驗證成功，現在可以提交評價。';
        await refreshReviewMemberState();
      } catch (error) {
        status.textContent = error.message || '會員驗證失敗，請稍後再試。';
      } finally {
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    });

    document.querySelector('#reviewForm').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const button = document.querySelector('#submitReviewButton');
      const status = document.querySelector('#reviewStatus');
      const comment = document.querySelector('#reviewComment').value.trim();
      const rating = Number(document.querySelector('#reviewRating').value);
      if (!Number.isInteger(rating) || rating < 1 || rating > 5 || comment.length < 1 || comment.length > 1000) {
        status.textContent = '請選擇 1 至 5 分，並輸入 1 至 1000 字的評價。';
        return;
      }
      button.disabled = true;
      button.textContent = '正在提交…';
      status.textContent = '正在提交評價…';
      try {
        const response = await fetch(`/api/products/${encodeURIComponent(activeReviewProductId)}/reviews`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
          credentials: 'same-origin',
          body: JSON.stringify({ rating, comment })
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true) {
          throw new Error(result && result.message ? result.message : `評價提交失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
        }
        document.querySelector('#reviewComment').value = '';
        status.textContent = result.message || '評價已提交。';
        await loadProductReviews();
      } catch (error) {
        status.textContent = error.message || '評價提交失敗，請稍後再試。';
      } finally {
        button.disabled = false;
        button.textContent = '提交評價';
      }
    });

    cartItemsElement.addEventListener('click', event => {
      const button = event.target.closest('[data-action]');
      if (!button) return;
      if (button.dataset.action === 'remove-cart-item') removeCartItem(button.dataset.productId);
      if (button.dataset.action === 'cart-quantity') changeCartQuantity(button.dataset.productId, Number(button.dataset.delta));
    });

    document.querySelector('#cartButton').addEventListener('click', openCart);
    document.querySelector('#mobileCartBtn').addEventListener('click', openCart);
    document.querySelector('#closeCartButton').addEventListener('click', closeCart);
    cartBackdrop.addEventListener('click', closeCart);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && !cartDrawer.inert) closeCart();
    });

    document.querySelector('#clearCartButton').addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (cart.length === 0) return;
      if (!window.confirm('確定清空購物車？')) return;
      cart = [];
      updateCartCount();
      showToast('已清空購物車。');
    });

    document.querySelector('#customerPhone').addEventListener('change', fillCheckoutProfile);
    document.querySelector('#customerPhone').addEventListener('blur', fillCheckoutProfile);
    document.querySelector('#shippingMethod').addEventListener('change', () => {
      updateShippingAddressRequirement();
      renderCart();
    });
    updateShippingAddressRequirement();

    document.querySelector('#checkoutButton').addEventListener('click', async event => {
      const button = event.currentTarget;
      const status = document.querySelector('#checkoutStatus');
      const phone = document.querySelector('#customerPhone').value.trim();
      const customerName = document.querySelector('#customerName').value.trim();
      const shippingMethod = document.querySelector('#shippingMethod').value;
      const shippingAddress = document.querySelector('#shippingAddress').value.trim();
      if (cart.length === 0) {
        status.textContent = '購物車目前沒有商品。';
        return;
      }
      if (!/^\+?\d{8,15}$/.test(phone)) {
        status.textContent = '請輸入有效的 WhatsApp 電話號碼。';
        document.querySelector('#customerPhone').focus();
        return;
      }
      if (customerName.length > 100 || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(customerName)) {
        status.textContent = '收件人姓名不可超過 100 字或包含特殊控制字元。';
        document.querySelector('#customerName').focus();
        return;
      }
      const maxShippingAddressLength = shippingMethod === 'sf_station' || shippingMethod === 'sf_locker' ? 190 : 200;
      if (shippingAddress.length > maxShippingAddressLength || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(shippingAddress)) {
        status.textContent = `取貨地點或地址不可超過 ${maxShippingAddressLength} 字。`;
        document.querySelector('#shippingAddress').focus();
        return;
      }
      if ((shippingMethod === 'sf_station' || shippingMethod === 'sf_locker') && !shippingAddress) {
        status.textContent = '請輸入順豐站／智能櫃編號或地區。';
        document.querySelector('#shippingAddress').focus();
        return;
      }
      if (!canCheckout()) {
        status.textContent = '商品庫存或價格資料已變更，請更新購物車後再試。';
        return;
      }

      button.disabled = true;
      button.textContent = '正在建立訂單…';
      status.textContent = '正在安全地提交訂單，請稍候…';
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/orders', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            customer_phone: phone,
            customer_name: customerName,
            shipping_method: shippingMethod,
            shipping_address: shippingAddress,
            items: cart.map(item => ({
              product_id: getProductId(item.product),
              quantity: item.quantity
            }))
          })
        });
        let result;
        try {
          result = await response.json();
        } catch {
          // 伺服器回傳非 JSON（例如代理錯誤頁），當作伺服器錯誤處理
          result = { success: false, message: '伺服器回應異常，請稍後再試。', code: 'SERVER_ERROR' };
        }

        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data) {
          const code = result && result.code;
          if (code === 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE') {
            clearCart();
            updateCartCount();
            closeCart();
            status.textContent = '';
            showToast('購物車包含已失效商品，已自動為您清空');
            return;
          }
          if (code === 'STOCK_UNAVAILABLE') {
            // 移除庫存不足的商品項目，保留其他有效商品
            const stockDetails = result && result.data ? result.data : null;
            if (stockDetails && stockDetails.product_id) {
              const staleId = String(stockDetails.product_id);
              cart = cart.filter(item => String(getProductId(item.product)) !== staleId);
              updateCartCount();
            }
            status.textContent = stockDetails && stockDetails.product_name
              ? `商品「${stockDetails.product_name}」庫存不足（需 ${stockDetails.requested}，剩 ${stockDetails.available}），請調整數量後重試。`
              : '部分商品庫存不足，請更新購物車後重試。';
            showToast('部分商品庫存不足，已為您移除，請重新選購或調整數量。');
            return;
          }
          throw new Error((result && result.message) || '建立訂單失敗，請稍後再試。');
        }

        const orderData = result.data;
        const rawOrderNo = orderData.order_number || orderData.orderNo || '';
        const orderNo = typeof rawOrderNo === 'string' ? rawOrderNo.trim() : '';
        if (
          !orderNo ||
          orderNo.length > 100 ||
          /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(orderNo) ||
          /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(orderNo)
        ) {
          throw new Error('訂單已建立，但未收到正式訂單編號，請聯絡管理員。');
        }

        try {
          localStorage.setItem('littleplanet_last_order_no', orderNo);
          localStorage.setItem('littleplanet_last_phone', phone);
        } catch {}

        saveCheckoutProfile(phone);

        // 結帳成功：清空購物車（LocalStorage 與頁面狀態）
        clearCart();
        updateCartCount();
        closeCart();

        window.location.assign(`/track.html?phone=${encodeURIComponent(phone)}&order_no=${encodeURIComponent(orderNo)}`);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('結帳失敗：', error);
        const isNetworkError = error instanceof TypeError || /^Failed to fetch/i.test(error.message);
        if (isNetworkError) {
          // 網路錯誤：清空購物車，提示重試
          clearCart();
          updateCartCount();
          closeCart();
          status.textContent = '';
          showToast('無法連線伺服器，購物車已自動清空，請重新加入商品後重試。');
        } else {
          // 其他伺服器錯誤（500 等）：保留購物車，僅顯示錯誤訊息，不誤判為過期商品
          status.textContent = error.message || '結帳發生錯誤，請稍後再試。';
          showToast(error.message || '結帳發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
        }
      } finally {
        button.disabled = !canCheckout();
        button.innerHTML = '前往結帳 <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>';
      }
    });

    initializeTheme();
    updateCartCount();
    loadProducts();
    loadMemberWishlist();
    updateCountdownLabels();
    window.setInterval(() => {
      updateCountdownLabels();
      if (cart.length > 0) {
        document.querySelector('#checkoutButton').disabled = !canCheckout();
      }
    }, 1000);
  </script>
  <script>
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
      window.addEventListener('load', () => {
        navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js')
          .catch(error => console.error('註冊離線快取服務失敗：', error));
      });
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
