<body class="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 antialiased flex flex-col justify-between">
  <div>
    <!-- 頂部宣傳 Banner -->
    <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-600 via-violet-600 to-fuchsia-600 px-4 py-2 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-white">
      ✨ 管理員後台工作階段 · 產品管理與庫存系統
    </div>

    <!-- 導覽列 -->
    <header class="sticky top-0 z-30 border-b border-slate-200/80 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl dark:bg-slate-900/90 dark:border-slate-800">
      <div class="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
        <a href="/" class="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5 text-slate-900 no-underline dark:text-white" aria-label="LittlePlanet 小行星首頁">
          <span class="grid h-10 w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600 text-xl text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-200">🪐</span>
          <span>
            <span class="block text-lg font-black leading-tight tracking-tight sm:text-xl">LittlePlanet 小行星</span>
            <span class="hidden text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 sm:block dark:text-slate-400">把喜歡的生活好物帶回家</span>
          </span>
        </a>
        <nav class="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3" aria-label="主要導覽">
          <a href="/" class="rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800">返回前台</a>
          <button id="themeToggleBtn" type="button" class="grid h-10 w-10 place-items-center rounded-xl border border-slate-200 text-lg transition hover:bg-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-800" aria-label="切換深色模式">🌙</button>
        </nav>
      </div>
    </header>

    <!-- 主要內容區 -->
    <main class="mx-auto w-full max-w-5xl flex-1 px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
      <div class="mb-8 flex items-center justify-between">
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 sm:text-3xl">LittlePlanet 產品管理</h1>
      </div>

      <!-- 登入驗證列 -->
      <form class="mb-8 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900" id="adminLoginForm">
        <label for="adminToken" class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">管理員密鑰：</label>
        <input type="password" id="adminToken" autocomplete="current-password" required placeholder="請輸入管理員 Token" class="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white">
        <button id="loginButton" type="submit" class="rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow hover:bg-indigo-700 transition">登入</button>
        <button id="logoutButton" type="button" class="rounded-xl bg-rose-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow hover:bg-rose-600 transition" hidden>登出</button>
        <div id="authStatus" class="w-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400" role="status" aria-live="polite">正在檢查登入狀態…</div>
      </form>

      <!-- 新增/編輯商品表單 -->
      <div class="mb-8 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
        <h2 id="formTitle" class="mb-4 text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">新增商品</h2>
        <form id="productForm" class="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label for="name" class="block mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">產品名稱 <span class="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
            <input type="text" id="name" required placeholder="例如：太空宇宙杯" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white">
          </div>

          <div class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div>
              <label for="price" class="block mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">價格 (HKD) <span class="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
              <input type="number" id="price" min="0" step="0.5" oninput="if (this.value < 0) this.value = 0;" required placeholder="100" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white">
            </div>
            <div>
              <label for="stock" class="block mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">存貨數量 <span class="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
              <input type="number" id="stock" min="0" oninput="if (this.value < 0) this.value = 0;" required placeholder="0" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white">
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- 分類選擇與手動新增/管理 -->
          <div>
            <label for="category" class="block mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">分類 <span class="text-rose-500">*</span></label>
            <div class="flex gap-2">
              <select id="category" required class="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white">
                <option value="">-- 請選擇分類 --</option>
              </select>
              <button type="button" id="addCategoryBtn" class="rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-indigo-400 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 transition" title="手動新增分類">+ 新增分類</button>
            </div>
            <div id="categoryList" class="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5"></div>
          </div>

          <!-- 狀態欄位 -->
          <div>
            <label for="status" class="block mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">商品狀態</label>
            <select id="status" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white">
               <option value="預購中">預購中</option>
               <option value="正常上架">正常上架</option>
               <option value="暫停供應">暫停供應</option>
               <option value="已下架">已下架</option>
               <option value="旅購中">旅購中</option>
              <option value="已到貨">已到貨</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <!-- 產品有效期限 / 批次日期欄位 -->
          <div>
            <label for="bestBeforeDate" class="block mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">產品有效期限 / 批次日期 (選填)</label>
            <input type="date" id="bestBeforeDate" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white">
          </div>

          <!-- 圖片網址 -->
          <div>
            <label for="imageUrl" class="block mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">圖片網址 (選填)</label>
            <input type="url" id="imageUrl" placeholder="https://... 留空將自動生成隨機預設圖片" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white">
          </div>

          <!-- 商品描述 -->
          <div>
            <label for="description" class="block mb-1 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">商品詳細描述 (選填)</label>
            <textarea id="description" rows="3" placeholder="輸入商品的特色、規格或注意事項..." class="w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white"></textarea>
          </div>

          <div class="flex gap-3 pt-2">
            <button type="submit" id="productSubmitButton" class="rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow hover:bg-indigo-700 transition disabled:opacity-50" disabled>確認新增</button>
            <button type="button" id="cancelEditButton" class="rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 transition dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800" hidden>取消編輯</button>
          </div>
          <div id="message" class="text-sm font-semibold"></div>
        </form>
      </div>

      <!-- 商品列表 -->
      <div class="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900">
        <h2 class="mb-6 text-lg font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">商品列表</h2>
        <div id="productGrid" class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <!-- 動態載入商品 -->
        </div>
        
        <!-- 分頁控制 -->
        <div class="mt-8 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-slate-100 pt-4 dark:border-slate-800">
          <button id="prevBtn" onclick="changePage(-1)" class="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">上一頁</button>
          <span id="pageIndicator" class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">第 1 頁</span>
          <button id="nextBtn" onclick="changePage(1)" class="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-40 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">下一頁</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>

  <!-- 頁尾 -->
  <footer class="border-t border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-6 text-center text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-400">
    <p>© 2026 LittlePlanet 小行星 · 產品管理後台</p>
  </footer>

  <script>
    'use strict';
    const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'littleplanet_theme';
    let adminScopes = [];
    let editingProductId = null;
    let currentPage = 1;
    const limit = 10;
    let totalCount = 0;
    let allCategories = new Set(['熱賣推薦', '新品上市', '日用品', '零食茶飲', '美妝保養', '旅購限定']);

    // 深色模式初始化
    function initializeTheme() {
      try {
        const dark = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY) === 'dark';
        document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', dark);
        document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn').textContent = dark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const dark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
      document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn').textContent = dark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
      try { localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, dark ? 'dark' : 'light'); } catch (e) {}
    });

    function setAdminScopes(authenticated, scopes = []) {
      adminScopes = authenticated && Array.isArray(scopes) ? [...new Set(scopes)] : [];
      const canManageProducts = adminScopes.includes('products');
      document.getElementById('adminToken').hidden = authenticated;
      const authLabel = document.querySelector('#adminLoginForm label');
      if (authLabel) authLabel.hidden = authenticated;
      document.getElementById('loginButton').hidden = authenticated;
      document.getElementById('logoutButton').hidden = !authenticated;
      document.getElementById('productSubmitButton').disabled = !canManageProducts;
      
      const status = document.getElementById('authStatus');
      status.className = authenticated
        ? canManageProducts ? 'w-full text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600' : 'w-full text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600'
        : 'w-full text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500';
      status.textContent = canManageProducts
        ? '已登入產品管理工作階段。'
        : authenticated
          ? '已登入管理員工作階段，但此 Session 沒有產品管理權限。'
          : '請登入管理員以執行新增、編輯與刪除商品。';
      
      fetchProducts();
    }

    function adminFetch(url, options = {}) {
      return fetch(url, { ...options, credentials: 'same-origin' }).then((response) => {
        if (response.status === 401 && !url.startsWith('/api/admin-auth/session')) {
          setAdminScopes(false);
        }
        return response;
      }).catch((error) => {
        console.error('API 請求失敗：', error);
        throw error;
      });
    }

    async function readApiResponse(response, operation) {
      const body = await response.text();
      const result = body.trim() ? JSON.parse(body) : null;
      if (!response.ok || !result || typeof result !== 'object') {
        throw new Error(result?.message || `${operation}失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
      }
      return result;
    }

    async function checkAdminSession() {
      try {
        const response = await adminFetch('/api/admin-auth/session');
        const result = await readApiResponse(response, '登入狀態檢查');
        if (result.success === true && result.data) {
          setAdminScopes(result.data.authenticated === true, result.data.scopes);
          return;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('檢查 Session 失敗：', err);
      }
      setAdminScopes(false);
    }

    async function loginAdmin(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const token = document.getElementById('adminToken').value.trim();
      const status = document.getElementById('authStatus');
      try {
        const response = await adminFetch('/api/admin-auth/login', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ token })
        });
        const result = await readApiResponse(response, '管理員登入');
        if (result.success === true && result.data) {
          document.getElementById('adminToken').value = '';
          setAdminScopes(true, result.data.scopes);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        status.className = 'w-full text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600';
        status.textContent = err.message || '登入失敗';
      }
    }

    async function logoutAdmin() {
      try {
        await adminFetch('/api/admin-auth/logout', { method: 'POST' });
        setAdminScopes(false);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('登出失敗：', err);
      }
    }

    // 更新分類選單與快速標籤
    function updateCategoryDropdowns(products) {
      products.forEach(p => {
        const cat = p.category || p.product_category;
        if (cat && typeof cat === 'string' && cat.trim()) {
          allCategories.add(cat.trim());
        }
      });

      const selectEl = document.getElementById('category');
      const currentSelected = selectEl.value;
      
      selectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- 請選擇分類 --</option>';
      Array.from(allCategories).sort().forEach(cat => {
        const opt = document.createElement('option');
        opt.value = cat;
        opt.textContent = cat;
        selectEl.appendChild(opt);
      });
      if (allCategories.has(currentSelected)) {
        selectEl.value = currentSelected;
      }

      // 渲染分類標籤捷徑
      const listEl = document.getElementById('categoryList');
      listEl.innerHTML = Array.from(allCategories).map(cat => `
        <span onclick="document.getElementById('category').value='${cat}'" class="cursor-pointer rounded-lg bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 hover:bg-indigo-100 hover:text-indigo-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition">📁 ${cat}</span>
      `).join('');
    }

    // 手動新增分類按鈕事件
    document.getElementById('addCategoryBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
      const newCat = prompt('請輸入新的商品分類名稱：');
      if (newCat && newCat.trim()) {
        const trimmed = newCat.trim();
        allCategories.add(trimmed);
        updateCategoryDropdowns([]);
        document.getElementById('category').value = trimmed;
      }
    });

    async function fetchProducts() {
      const offset = (currentPage - 1) * limit;
      const grid = document.getElementById('productGrid');
      grid.innerHTML = '<p class="col-span-full text-center text-slate-500">正在載入產品...</p>';
      
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/products?limit=${limit}&offset=${offset}&include_best_before_dates=true`);
        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(`網路請求失敗：狀態碼 ${res.status}`);
        }
        const result = await res.json();
        if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.message || '讀取失敗');

        const rawData = result.data;
        const products = Array.isArray(rawData) ? rawData : (rawData.products || []);
        totalCount = rawData.total_count || products.length;

        updateCategoryDropdowns(products);
        renderProducts(products);
        updatePaginationControls();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('取得產品失敗：', err);
        grid.innerHTML = '<p class="col-span-full text-center text-rose-500">無法載入產品清單</p>';
      }
    }

    function renderProducts(products) {
      const grid = document.getElementById('productGrid');
      if (products.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = '<p class="col-span-full text-center text-slate-500">暫無商品記錄</p>';
        return;
      }

      grid.innerHTML = products.map(p => {
        const pId = p.id ?? p.product_id;
        const pCategory = p.category || p.product_category || '-';
        const pStock = p.stock ?? p.stock_quantity ?? 0;
        const fallbackImg = `https://picsum.photos/seed/product_${pId || Math.random()}/300/200`;
        const imgSrc = (p.image_url && p.image_url.trim() !== '') ? p.image_url : fallbackImg;
        const pName = p.name || p.product_name || '未命名';
        const pPrice = p.price ?? p.retail_price ?? 0;
        const pStatus = p.status || '上架';
        const pDesc = p.description || '';

        let actionsHtml = '';
        if (adminScopes.includes('products')) {
          actionsHtml = `
            <div class="mt-4 flex gap-2">
              <button type="button" class="flex-1 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-indigo-700 transition" onclick='editProduct(${JSON.stringify(p)})'>編輯</button>
              <button type="button" class="flex-1 rounded-lg bg-rose-500 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-rose-600 transition" onclick='deleteProduct(${JSON.stringify(p)})'>刪除</button>
            </div>
          `;
        }

        return `
          <div class="flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-sm">
            <div class="relative h-40 w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800">
              <img src="${imgSrc}" alt="${pName}" class="h-full w-full object-cover" onerror="this.src='${fallbackImg}'">
              <span class="absolute top-2 right-2 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${pStatus === '上架' ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-white' : 'bg-slate-500 text-white'}">${pStatus}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex flex-1 flex-col justify-between p-4">
              <div>
                <h3 class="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">${pName}</h3>
                <div class="mt-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span class="rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">分類：${pCategory}</span>
                  <span class="rounded-md bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-300">存貨：${pStock}</span>
                </div>
                <p class="mt-2 font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">HK$ ${pPrice}</p>
                ${pDesc ? `<p class="mt-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 line-clamp-2">${pDesc}</p>` : ''}
                <div class="mt-2">
                  ${renderBatchSummary(p.best_before_summary)}
                </div>
              </div>
              ${actionsHtml}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function updatePaginationControls() {
      const maxPage = Math.ceil(totalCount / limit) || 1;
      document.getElementById('pageIndicator').textContent = `第 ${currentPage} 頁 / 共 ${maxPage} 頁`;
      document.getElementById('prevBtn').disabled = currentPage <= 1;
      document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = currentPage >= maxPage;
    }

    function changePage(direction) {
      currentPage += direction;
      fetchProducts();
    }

    function editProduct(product) {
      editingProductId = product.id ?? product.product_id;
      document.getElementById('name').value = product.name || product.product_name || '';
      document.getElementById('price').value = product.price ?? product.retail_price ?? '';
      
      const cat = product.category || product.product_category || '';
      if (cat) {
        allCategories.add(cat);
        updateCategoryDropdowns([]);
      }
      document.getElementById('category').value = cat;
      document.getElementById('stock').value = product.stock ?? product.stock_quantity ?? 0;
      document.getElementById('status').value = product.status || '上架';
      document.getElementById('imageUrl').value = product.image_url || '';
      document.getElementById('description').value = product.description || '';
      
      // 自動填入有效期限（若有資料）
      const bestBeforeInput = document.getElementById('bestBeforeDate');
      if (product.best_before_summary && product.best_before_summary.best_before_dates && product.best_before_summary.best_before_dates.length > 0) {
        bestBeforeInput.value = product.best_before_summary.best_before_dates[0];
      } else {
        bestBeforeInput.value = '';
      }

      document.getElementById('formTitle').textContent = '編輯商品';
      document.getElementById('productSubmitButton').textContent = '儲存修改';
      document.getElementById('cancelEditButton').hidden = false;
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    function resetProductForm() {
      editingProductId = null;
      document.getElementById('productForm').reset();
      document.getElementById('formTitle').textContent = '新增商品';
      document.getElementById('productSubmitButton').textContent = '確認新增';
      document.getElementById('cancelEditButton').hidden = true;
      document.getElementById('message').textContent = '';
    }

    function renderBatchSummary(summary) {
      if (!summary || typeof summary !== 'object') {
        return '<span class="text-xs text-slate-400">暫無效期資料</span>';
      }
      if (summary.has_legacy_unknown_date) {
        return '<span class="text-xs text-slate-500">舊庫存（日期未知）</span>';
      }
      if (summary.has_undated_batch) {
        return '<span class="text-xs text-slate-500">無最佳使用期限</span>';
      }
      if (summary.best_before_dates && Array.isArray(summary.best_before_dates) && summary.best_before_dates.length > 0) {
        const dates = [...summary.best_before_dates].sort();
        return `<span class="text-xs text-indigo-600">有效期限：${dates.join('、')}</span>`;
      }
      return '<span class="text-xs text-slate-400">暫無效期資料</span>';
    }

    async function deleteProduct(product) {
      const pId = product.id ?? product.product_id;
      const pName = product.name || product.product_name || '此商品';
      if (!confirm(`確定刪除「${pName}」嗎？`)) return;

      try {
        const res = await adminFetch(`/api/products/${encodeURIComponent(pId)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
        const result = await readApiResponse(res, '刪除產品');
        if (result.success) {
          document.getElementById('message').className = 'text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-600';
          document.getElementById('message').textContent = '產品刪除成功';
          fetchProducts();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        document.getElementById('message').className = 'text-sm font-semibold text-rose-600';
        document.getElementById('message').textContent = '刪除失敗：' + err.message;
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('productForm').addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const name = document.getElementById('name').value.trim();
      const price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('price').value);
      const stock = parseInt(document.getElementById('stock').value, 10);
      const category = document.getElementById('category').value;
      const status = document.getElementById('status').value;
      const image_url = document.getElementById('imageUrl').value.trim();
      const description = document.getElementById('description').value.trim();
      const best_before_date = document.getElementById('bestBeforeDate').value;
      const msgEl = document.getElementById('message');

      if (!category) {
        msgEl.className = 'text-sm font-semibold text-rose-600';
        msgEl.textContent = '請選擇或新增商品分類';
        return;
      }

      try {
        const isEditing = editingProductId !== null;
        const url = isEditing ? `/api/products/${encodeURIComponent(editingProductId)}` : '/api/products';
        const method = isEditing ? 'PATCH' : 'POST';
        
        const payload = { name, price, stock, category, status, image_url, description };
        if (best_before_date) {
          payload.best_before_date = best_before_date;
        }

        const res = await adminFetch(url, {
          method,
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(payload)
        });
        const result = await readApiResponse(res, isEditing ? '更新產品' : '新增產品');

        if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.message);

        msgEl.className = 'text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-600';
        msgEl.textContent = isEditing ? '產品修改成功！' : '產品新增成功！';
        resetProductForm();
        fetchProducts();
      } catch (err) {
        msgEl.className = 'text-sm font-semibold text-rose-600';
        msgEl.textContent = err.message || '操作失敗';
      }
    });

    document.getElementById('cancelEditButton').addEventListener('click', resetProductForm);
    document.getElementById('adminLoginForm').addEventListener('submit', loginAdmin);
    document.getElementById('logoutButton').addEventListener('click', logoutAdmin);

    initializeTheme();
    checkAdminSession();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

### File: `public\sw.js`

```
'use strict';

const CACHE_NAME = 'littleplanet-shell-v1';
const APP_SHELL = [
  '/',
  '/index.html',
  '/manifest.json',
  '/image/pwa-icon.svg',
  '/image/pwa-icon-192.png',
  '/image/pwa-icon-512.png'
];

self.addEventListener('install', event => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME)
      .then(cache => cache.addAll(APP_SHELL))
      .then(() => self.skipWaiting())
  );
});

self.addEventListener('activate', event => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys()
      .then(keys => Promise.all(
        keys.filter(key => key.startsWith('littleplanet-shell-') && key !== CACHE_NAME)
          .map(key => caches.delete(key))
      ))
      .then(() => self.clients.claim())
  );
});

self.addEventListener('fetch', event => {
  const request = event.request;
  const url = new URL(request.url);
  if (
    request.method !== 'GET' ||
    url.origin !== self.location.origin ||
    url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')
  ) {
    return;
  }

  if (request.mode === 'navigate') {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(request)
        .then(response => {
          if (response.ok && !url.search) {
            const copy = response.clone();
            event.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => cache.put(request, copy)));
          }
          return response;
        })
        .catch(async () => (
          await caches.match(request) ||
          await caches.match('/') ||
          Response.error()
        ))
    );
    return;
  }

  if (['style', 'script', 'image', 'font'].includes(request.destination)) {
    event.respondWith(
      caches.match(request).then(cached => {
        if (cached) return cached;
        return fetch(request).then(response => {
          if (response.ok && !url.search) {
            const copy = response.clone();
            event.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then(cache => cache.put(request, copy)));
          }
          return response;
        });
      })
    );
  }
});

        <button id="forgotOrdersButton" type="button" class="w-full rounded-xl border border-indigo-200 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700 transition hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:border-indigo-800 dark:text-indigo-300 dark:hover:bg-slate-800">唔記得單號？只用電話搵返</button>
        <p id="forgotOrdersMessage" class="text-center text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <div id="forgotOrdersResults" class="hidden space-y-2" aria-live="polite"></div>
      </form>
      <p id="lookupMessage" class="mt-3 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-rose-600" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </section>
  </main>

  <script>
    'use strict';

    const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'littleplanet_theme';
    const themeToggleBtn = document.querySelector('#themeToggleBtn');

    function updateThemeButton(isDark) {
      themeToggleBtn.textContent = isDark ? '☀️' : '🌙';
      themeToggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', isDark ? '切換淺色模式' : '切換深色模式');
    }

    const isCurrentlyDark = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark');
    updateThemeButton(isCurrentlyDark);

    themeToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const dark = document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
      updateThemeButton(dark);
      try { localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, dark ? 'dark' : 'light'); } catch (e) {}
    });

    const searchPanel = document.querySelector('#searchPanel');
    const resultCard = document.querySelector('#resultCard');
    const toggleSearchModeBtn = document.querySelector('#toggleSearchModeBtn');
    const form = document.querySelector('#lookupForm');
    const phoneInput = document.querySelector('#phoneInput');
    const orderNoInput = document.querySelector('#orderNoInput');
    const lookupButton = document.querySelector('#lookupButton');
    const lookupMessage = document.querySelector('#lookupMessage');
    const lastOrderHint = document.querySelector('#lastOrderHint');
    const forgotOrdersButton = document.querySelector('#forgotOrdersButton');
    const forgotOrdersMessage = document.querySelector('#forgotOrdersMessage');
    const forgotOrdersResults = document.querySelector('#forgotOrdersResults');
    const editPhoneBtn = document.querySelector('#editPhoneBtn');
    const editShippingBtn = document.querySelector('#editShippingBtn');

    let isEditingPhone = false;
    let isEditingShipping = false;
    let currentOrderData = null;

    // 修改聯絡電話邏輯
    editPhoneBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const phoneEl = document.querySelector('#resPhone');
      const currentPhone = phoneEl.dataset.rawPhone || phoneEl.textContent.trim();
      const orderNo = document.querySelector('#resOrderNo').textContent.trim();

      if (!isEditingPhone) {
        phoneEl.innerHTML = `<input id="newPhoneInput" type="tel" value="${currentPhone}" class="w-full px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-indigo-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white">`;
        editPhoneBtn.textContent = '儲存';
        isEditingPhone = true;
      } else {
        const newPhone = document.querySelector('#newPhoneInput').value.trim();
        if (!/^[0-9]{8,15}$/.test(newPhone)) {
          alert('請輸入有效的 8 至 15 位電話號碼');
          return;
        }

        editPhoneBtn.disabled = true;
        editPhoneBtn.textContent = '儲存中...';

        try {
          const res = await fetch('/api/orders/update-info', {
            method: 'PATCH',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              phone: currentPhone,
              orderNo: orderNo,
              customer_phone: newPhone
            })
          });
          const result = await res.json();
          if (!res.ok || !result.success) throw new Error(result.message || '更新失敗');

          phoneEl.textContent = result.data.customer_phone;
          phoneEl.dataset.rawPhone = result.data.customer_phone;
          editPhoneBtn.textContent = '修改';
          isEditingPhone = false;
          alert('聯絡電話已成功更新！');
        } catch (err) {
          alert(err.message);
          editPhoneBtn.textContent = '儲存';
        } finally {
          editPhoneBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      }
    });

    // 修改出貨方式邏輯
    editShippingBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const shippingEl = document.querySelector('#resShippingMethod');
      const currentShipping = shippingEl.textContent.trim();
      const currentPhone = document.querySelector('#resPhone').dataset.rawPhone || document.querySelector('#resPhone').textContent.trim();
      const orderNo = document.querySelector('#resOrderNo').textContent.trim();

      if (!isEditingShipping) {
        const methods = ['面交', '自取', '順豐', '京東'];
        let optionsHtml = methods.map(m => `<option value="${m}" ${m === currentShipping ? 'selected' : ''}>${m}</option>`).join('');
        shippingEl.innerHTML = `<select id="newShippingSelect" class="w-full px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded border border-indigo-300 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-white">${optionsHtml}</select>`;
        editShippingBtn.textContent = '儲存';
        isEditingShipping = true;
      } else {
        const newShipping = document.querySelector('#newShippingSelect').value;

        editShippingBtn.disabled = true;
        editShippingBtn.textContent = '儲存中...';

        try {
          const res = await fetch('/api/orders/update-info', {
            method: 'PATCH',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              phone: currentPhone,
              orderNo: orderNo,
              shipping_method: newShipping
            })
          });
          const result = await res.json();
          if (!res.ok || !result.success) throw new Error(result.message || '更新失敗');

          shippingEl.textContent = result.data.shipping_method;
          editShippingBtn.textContent = '修改';
          isEditingShipping = false;
          alert('出貨方式已成功更新！');
        } catch (err) {
          alert(err.message);
          editShippingBtn.textContent = '儲存';
        } finally {
          editShippingBtn.disabled = false;
        }
      }
    });

    function renderOrderData(order) {
      currentOrderData = order;
      document.querySelector('#resOrderNo').textContent = order.order_number || order.order_no || '未知單號';
      
      const phoneEl = document.querySelector('#resPhone');
      const phoneVal = order.customer_phone || order.phone || '未提供';
      phoneEl.textContent = phoneVal;
      phoneEl.dataset.rawPhone = phoneVal;

      document.querySelector('#resCustomerName').textContent = order.customer_name || '未提供';
      document.querySelector('#resShippingMethod').textContent = order.shipping_method || '待後台安排';
      document.querySelector('#resShippingAddress').textContent = order.shipping_address || '未提供';

      const trackingNumber = typeof order.tracking_number === 'string'
        ? order.tracking_number.trim()
        : '';
      const carrier = order.shipping_carrier ||
        (order.shipping_method === '順豐' ? 'SF Express' :
          order.shipping_method === '京東' ? 'Jump Point' : '');
      const trackingPanel = document.querySelector('#resTrackingPanel');
      const trackingLink = document.querySelector('#resTrackingLink');
      const trackingUrls = {
        'SF Express': 'https://www.sf-express.com/hk/tc/dynamic_function/waybill/',
        'Jump Point': 'https://www.jumppoint.io/'
      };
      if (trackingNumber && trackingUrls[carrier]) {
        document.querySelector('#resTrackingCarrier').textContent = `物流商：${carrier}`;
        document.querySelector('#resTrackingNumber').textContent = trackingNumber;
        trackingLink.href = trackingUrls[carrier];
        trackingLink.setAttribute('aria-label', `前往 ${carrier} 網站查詢運單 ${trackingNumber}`);
        trackingPanel.classList.remove('hidden');
      } else {
        trackingPanel.classList.add('hidden');
      }

      const proofStatus = order.payment_proof_status || 'pending';
      const proofStatusText = proofStatus === 'verified'
        ? '✅ 付款憑證已核實。'
        : proofStatus === 'rejected'
          ? '⚠️ 付款憑證未能核實，請確認圖片清晰及付款資料正確後重新提交。'
          : order.payment_proof_submitted
            ? '⏳ 已收到付款憑證，管理員核對中。'
            : '尚未提交付款憑證';
      document.querySelector('#paymentProofStatus').textContent = proofStatusText;
      document.querySelector('#paymentProofForm').hidden = proofStatus === 'verified';
      
      const total = order.total_amount != null ? `HK$${order.total_amount}` : '計算中';
      document.querySelector('#resTotalAmount').textContent = total;
      document.querySelector('#resSubtotal').textContent = total;
      document.querySelector('#resGrandTotal').textContent = total;

      document.querySelector('#resStatusBadge').textContent = order.status === 'completed' ? '已完成' : order.status === 'shipping' ? '已出貨' : '處理中';
      document.querySelector('#resPaymentBadge').textContent = order.payment_status || '待付款 / 處理中';

      const itemsList = document.querySelector('#resItemsList');
      itemsList.replaceChildren();

      const items = Array.isArray(order.items) ? order.items : [];
      const reviewPanel = document.querySelector('#orderReviewPanel');
      const reviewProductSelect = document.querySelector('#orderReviewProduct');
      const orderNumber = order.order_number || order.order_no || '';
      const reviewableItems = [...new Map(items
        .filter(item => item && (typeof item.product_id === 'string' || typeof item.product_id === 'number'))
        .map(item => [String(item.product_id), item])).values()];
      if (orderNumber && !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(orderNumber) && reviewableItems.length > 0) {
        reviewProductSelect.replaceChildren(...reviewableItems.map(item => {
          const option = document.createElement('option');
          option.value = String(item.product_id);
          option.textContent = item.product_name || item.name || `商品 ${item.product_id}`;
          return option;
        }));
        reviewPanel.classList.remove('hidden');
        document.querySelector('#orderReviewStatus').textContent = '';
        document.querySelector('#orderReviewForm').reset();
      } else {
        reviewPanel.classList.add('hidden');
      }
      if (items.length === 0) {
        const empty = document.createElement('div');
        empty.className = 'py-4 text-center text-sm text-slate-400';
        empty.textContent = '（此訂單暫未包含商品細節記錄）';
        itemsList.append(empty);
      } else {
        items.forEach(item => {
          const row = document.createElement('div');
          row.className = 'py-4 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 last:border-0 space-y-3';

          // 上半部：縮圖、名稱、數量與單價
          const topPart = document.createElement('div');
          topPart.className = 'flex items-center justify-between gap-4';

          const left = document.createElement('div');
          left.className = 'flex items-center gap-3.5';

          // 商品縮圖
          const img = document.createElement('img');
          img.src = item.image_url || item.imageUrl || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1523275335684-37898b6baf30?w=150&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80';
          img.alt = item.product_name || item.name || '精選商品';
          img.className = 'w-14 h-14 object-cover rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 flex-shrink-0';

          const nameDiv = document.createElement('div');
          const nameSpan = document.createElement('h4');
          nameSpan.className = 'font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 text-sm sm:text-base';
          nameSpan.textContent = item.product_name || item.name || '精選商品';
          nameDiv.append(nameSpan);

          if (item.product_code) {
            const codeP = document.createElement('p');
            codeP.className = 'text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5';
            codeP.textContent = `代號: ${item.product_code}`;
            nameDiv.append(codeP);
          }

          left.append(img, nameDiv);

          // 右側：數量與價格
          const right = document.createElement('div');
          right.className = 'text-right flex-shrink-0';
          const qty = item.quantity || 1;
          const unitPrice = item.unit_price || item.price;
          
          const qtyDiv = document.createElement('div');
          qtyDiv.className = 'font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-sm';
          qtyDiv.textContent = `數量：${qty}`;
          right.append(qtyDiv);

          if (unitPrice != null) {
            const priceDiv = document.createElement('div');
            priceDiv.className = 'text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 mt-0.5';
            priceDiv.textContent = `單價：HK$${unitPrice}`;
            right.append(priceDiv);
          }

          topPart.append(left, right);
          row.append(topPart);

          // 下半部：詳細描述文字（加上 formatted-desc 類別，完美保留段落與換行）
          const descText = item.description || item.desc || '';
          if (descText) {
            const descP = document.createElement('p');
            descP.className = 'text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-relaxed bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 formatted-desc';
            descP.textContent = descText;
            row.append(descP);
          }

          itemsList.append(row);
        });
      }

      searchPanel.style.display = 'none';
      resultCard.style.display = 'block';
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    async function fetchAndShowOrder(phone, orderNo) {
      lookupMessage.textContent = '正在載入訂單資料…';
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/orders/query-order', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ phone, orderNo })
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true) {
          throw new Error(result && result.message ? result.message : '找不到對應的訂單資料。');
        }

        const order = result.data;
        if (!order) throw new Error('查無訂單');
        renderOrderData(order);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        lookupMessage.textContent = error.message || '查詢失敗，請檢查資料。';
        searchPanel.style.display = 'block';
        resultCard.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }

    forgotOrdersButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const phone = phoneInput.value.trim();
      forgotOrdersMessage.textContent = '';
      forgotOrdersResults.replaceChildren();
      forgotOrdersResults.classList.add('hidden');
      if (!phone) {
        forgotOrdersMessage.textContent = '請先輸入手提電話號碼。';
        phoneInput.focus();
        return;
      }

      forgotOrdersButton.disabled = true;
      forgotOrdersMessage.textContent = '正在尋找最近訂單…';
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/customer/orders/forgot', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
          credentials: 'same-origin',
          body: JSON.stringify({ customer_phone: phone })
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !Array.isArray(result.data)) {
          throw new Error(result && result.message
            ? result.message
            : `找回訂單編號失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
        }
        if (result.data.length === 0) {
          forgotOrdersMessage.textContent = '找不到相關訂單，請確認電話號碼是否正確。';
          return;
        }

        forgotOrdersMessage.textContent = '請選擇一張訂單以繼續安全查詢：';
        result.data.slice(0, 10).forEach(order => {
          if (!order || typeof order.order_number !== 'string' || !order.order_number.trim()) return;
          const button = document.createElement('button');
          button.type = 'button';
          button.className = 'w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3 text-left text-sm transition hover:border-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:border-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-800';
          const orderNumber = document.createElement('span');
          orderNumber.className = 'block font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100';
          orderNumber.textContent = order.order_number;
          const summary = document.createElement('span');
          summary.className = 'mt-1 block text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400';
          const orderDate = order.order_date ? new Date(order.order_date).toLocaleDateString('zh-HK') : '日期不詳';
          const amount = Number(order.total_amount);
          const formattedAmount = Number.isFinite(amount) ? `HK$${amount.toFixed(2)}` : '金額不詳';
          summary.textContent = `${orderDate} · ${formattedAmount} · ${order.payment_status || '付款狀態不詳'}`;
          button.append(orderNumber, summary);
          button.addEventListener('click', () => {
            orderNoInput.value = order.order_number;
            phoneInput.value = phone;
            forgotOrdersResults.classList.add('hidden');
            forgotOrdersMessage.textContent = '';
            fetchAndShowOrder(phone, order.order_number);
          });
          forgotOrdersResults.append(button);
        });
        if (forgotOrdersResults.childElementCount > 0) {
          forgotOrdersResults.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          forgotOrdersMessage.textContent = '找不到可用的訂單編號。';
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('找回訂單編號失敗：', error);
        forgotOrdersMessage.textContent = error.message || '找回訂單編號失敗，請稍後再試。';
      } finally {
        forgotOrdersButton.disabled = false;
      }
    });

    document.querySelector('#paymentProofForm').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const fileInput = document.querySelector('#paymentProofFile');
      const submitButton = document.querySelector('#paymentProofSubmit');
      const status = document.querySelector('#paymentProofStatus');
      const file = fileInput.files && fileInput.files[0];
      const orderNumber = currentOrderData &&
        (currentOrderData.order_number || currentOrderData.order_no);
      const phone = currentOrderData && currentOrderData.customer_phone;

      if (!file || !orderNumber || !phone) {
        status.textContent = '請先查詢訂單，並選擇付款截圖。';
        return;
      }
      if (
        file.size < 1 ||
        file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024 ||
        !['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)
      ) {
        status.textContent = '請選擇 JPG、PNG 或 WEBP 圖片，檔案大小不可超過 5 MB。';
        return;
      }

      submitButton.disabled = true;
      status.textContent = '正在安全上傳付款憑證…';
      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `/api/orders/${encodeURIComponent(orderNumber)}/payment-proof`,
          {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': file.type,
              'X-Customer-Phone': phone
            },
            body: file
          }
        );
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true || !result.data) {
          throw new Error(result && result.message
            ? result.message
            : `付款憑證上傳失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
        }
        currentOrderData.payment_proof_status = result.data.payment_proof_status;
        currentOrderData.payment_proof_submitted = true;
        status.textContent = result.message || '付款憑證已收到，管理員核對後會更新付款狀態。';
        fileInput.value = '';
        if (result.data.payment_proof_status === 'verified') {
          document.querySelector('#paymentProofForm').hidden = true;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('上傳付款憑證失敗：', error);
        status.textContent = error.message || '付款憑證上傳失敗，請稍後再試。';
      } finally {
        submitButton.disabled = false;
      }
    });

    document.querySelector('#orderReviewForm').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const submitButton = document.querySelector('#orderReviewSubmit');
      const status = document.querySelector('#orderReviewStatus');
      const phone = currentOrderData && currentOrderData.customer_phone;
      const orderNumber = currentOrderData && (currentOrderData.order_number || currentOrderData.order_no);
      const productId = document.querySelector('#orderReviewProduct').value;
      const customerName = document.querySelector('#orderReviewName').value.trim();
      const rating = Number(document.querySelector('#orderReviewRating').value);
      const comment = document.querySelector('#orderReviewComment').value.trim();
      if (!phone || !orderNumber || !productId) {
        status.textContent = '請先完成電話及訂單編號驗證。';
        return;
      }
      submitButton.disabled = true;
      status.textContent = '正在提交評價…';
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/reviews', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
          credentials: 'same-origin',
          body: JSON.stringify({
            product_id: productId,
            customer_phone: phone,
            order_number: orderNumber,
            customer_name: customerName,
            rating,
            comment
          })
        });
        const result = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok || !result || result.success !== true) {
          throw new Error(result && result.message
            ? result.message
            : `評價提交失敗（HTTP ${response.status}）。`);
        }
        status.textContent = result.message || '評價已提交，待管理員審核。';
        document.querySelector('#orderReviewForm').reset();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('提交訂單評價失敗：', error);
        status.textContent = error.message || '評價提交失敗，請稍後再試。';
      } finally {
        submitButton.disabled = false;
      }
    });

    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const paramOrderNo = urlParams.get('order_no') || urlParams.get('order_id');
    const paramPhone = urlParams.get('phone');

    if (paramPhone && paramOrderNo) {
      phoneInput.value = paramPhone;
      orderNoInput.value = paramOrderNo;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('littleplanet_last_order_no', paramOrderNo);
        localStorage.setItem('littleplanet_last_phone', paramPhone);
      } catch {}
      fetchAndShowOrder(paramPhone, paramOrderNo);
    } else if (!paramPhone && !paramOrderNo) {
      try {
        const lastOrderNo = localStorage.getItem('littleplanet_last_order_no');
        const lastPhone = localStorage.getItem('littleplanet_last_phone');
        if (lastPhone && lastOrderNo) {
          phoneInput.value = lastPhone;
          orderNoInput.value = lastOrderNo;
          lastOrderHint.classList.remove('hidden');
          fetchAndShowOrder(lastPhone, lastOrderNo);
        }
      } catch {}
    } else {
      if (paramPhone) phoneInput.value = paramPhone;
      if (paramOrderNo) orderNoInput.value = paramOrderNo;
    }

    toggleSearchModeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      resultCard.style.display = 'none';
      searchPanel.style.display = 'block';
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', window.location.pathname);
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      lookupMessage.textContent = '';
      const phone = phoneInput.value.trim();
      const orderNo = orderNoInput.value.trim();
      if (!phone || !orderNo) {
        lookupMessage.textContent = '請填寫完整的電話與訂單編號。';
        return;
      }
      lookupButton.disabled = true;
      lookupButton.textContent = '查詢中…';
      await fetchAndShowOrder(phone, orderNo);
      lookupButton.disabled = false;
      lookupButton.textContent = '立即查詢訂單';
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

const crypto = require('crypto');
const express = require('express');
const NodeCache = require('node-cache');

const MISSING_RPC_CODES = new Set(['42883', 'PGRST202']);
const MISSING_TABLE_CODES = new Set(['42P01', 'PGRST205']);
const MISSING_COLUMN_CODES = new Set(['42703', 'PGRST204']);
const PAYMENT_STATUSES = new Set(['未付款', '已付訂金', '已付清']);
const SHIPPING_STATUSES = new Set(['待到貨', '部分到貨', '可出貨', '已出貨']);
const MAX_DATE_RANGE_DAYS = 3660;
const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100;
const MAX_TOP_PRODUCTS = 50;
const MAX_FALLBACK_ORDERS = 5000;
const MAX_FALLBACK_ITEMS = 20000;
const ORDER_ITEM_COLUMNS = 'order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price';

function sendError(res, status, message) {
  return res.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    data: null,
    message
  });
}

function parseDate(value) {
  if (
    typeof value !== 'string' ||
    !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ||
    value.startsWith('0000-')
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) || date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value) {
    return null;
  }

  return date;
}

function parseInteger(value, minimum, maximum, defaultValue) {
  if (value === undefined) {
    return defaultValue;
  }
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(value)) {
    return null;
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) && parsed >= minimum && parsed <= maximum
    ? parsed
    : null;
}

function validateDateRange(query) {
  const startDate = parseDate(query.start_date);
  const endDate = parseDate(query.end_date);
  if (!startDate || !endDate || startDate > endDate) {
    return null;
  }

  const days = (endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / 86400000 + 1;
  if (days > MAX_DATE_RANGE_DAYS) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    startDate: query.start_date,
    endDate: query.end_date,
    startAt: `${query.start_date}T00:00:00+08:00`,
    endAt: `${new Date(endDate.getTime() + 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00+08:00`
  };
}

function normalizeOrderAmount(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'number' && typeof value !== 'string') {
    return 0;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() === '') {
    return 0;
  }

  const amount = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(amount) && amount >= 0 ? amount : 0;
}

function calculateOverview(orders, dateRange) {
  const totalOrders = orders.length;
  const totalRevenue = orders.reduce(
    (sum, order) => sum + normalizeOrderAmount(order && order.total_amount),
    0
  );
  const paidOrders = orders.filter(order => (
    order.payment_status === '已付訂金' || order.payment_status === '已付清'
  )).length;
  const unpaidOrders = orders.filter(order => order.payment_status === '未付款').length;
  const shippedOrders = orders.filter(order => order.shipping_status === '已出貨').length;
  const unshippedOrders = orders.filter(order => order.shipping_status !== '已出貨').length;

  return {
    start_date: dateRange.startDate,
    end_date: dateRange.endDate,
    total_revenue: Math.round((totalRevenue + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100,
    total_orders: totalOrders,
    paid_orders: paidOrders,
    unpaid_orders: unpaidOrders,
    paid_order_percentage: totalOrders ? Math.round(paidOrders * 10000 / totalOrders) / 100 : 0,
    unpaid_order_percentage: totalOrders ? Math.round(unpaidOrders * 10000 / totalOrders) / 100 : 0,
    shipped_orders: shippedOrders,
    unshipped_orders: unshippedOrders,
    shipped_order_percentage: totalOrders ? Math.round(shippedOrders * 10000 / totalOrders) / 100 : 0,
    unshipped_order_percentage: totalOrders ? Math.round(unshippedOrders * 10000 / totalOrders) / 100 : 0
  };
}

function hongKongDate(value) {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit'
  }).formatToParts(new Date(value));
  const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part => [part.type, part.value]));
  return `${dateParts.year}-${dateParts.month}-${dateParts.day}`;
}

function createDailySalesTrend(orders, dateRange) {
  const start = parseDate(dateRange.startDate);
  const end = parseDate(dateRange.endDate);
  const dailyTotals = new Map();
  for (
    let day = start.getTime();
    day <= end.getTime();
    day += 86400000
  ) {
    const date = new Date(day).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    dailyTotals.set(date, { revenue: 0, order_count: 0 });
  }

  for (const order of orders) {
    const date = hongKongDate(order.order_date);
    const total = dailyTotals.get(date);
    if (!total) {
      continue;
    }
    total.revenue += Number(order.total_amount || 0);
    total.order_count += 1;
  }

  const labels = [...dailyTotals.keys()];
  const revenue = labels.map(date => (
    Math.round((dailyTotals.get(date).revenue + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
  ));
  const orderCount = labels.map(date => dailyTotals.get(date).order_count);

  return {
    start_date: dateRange.startDate,
    end_date: dateRange.endDate,
    labels,
    revenue,
    order_count: orderCount,
    total_revenue: Math.round(
      (revenue.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) + Number.EPSILON) * 100
    ) / 100,
    total_orders: orderCount.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0)
  };
}

function createAnalyticsRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  const router = express.Router();
  const adminToken = options.adminToken || '';
  const readEnabled = options.readEnabled === true;
  const useTableFallback = options.useTableFallback === true;
  const profitDetailsEnabled = options.profitDetailsEnabled === true;
  const cacheTtlSeconds = Number.isSafeInteger(options.cacheTtlSeconds) &&
      options.cacheTtlSeconds > 0
    ? options.cacheTtlSeconds
    : 60;
  const reportCache = options.cache || new NodeCache({
    stdTTL: cacheTtlSeconds,
    checkperiod: cacheTtlSeconds * 2,
    maxKeys: 1000,
    useClones: false
  });

  function createCacheKey(report, parameters) {
    return `analytics:${report}:${JSON.stringify(parameters)}`;
  }

  function sendCachedResponse(res, cacheKey, message) {
    const data = reportCache.get(cacheKey);
    if (data === undefined) {
      res.set('X-Analytics-Cache', 'MISS');
      return null;
    }

    res.set('X-Analytics-Cache', 'HIT');
    return res.json({
      success: true,
      data,
      message
    });
  }

  function storeCachedResponse(cacheKey, data) {
    try {
      reportCache.set(cacheKey, data, cacheTtlSeconds);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('儲存 Analytics 快取時發生錯誤：', error);
    }
  }

  router.use((req, res, next) => {
    if (adminToken.length < 32 || adminToken.startsWith('replace-with-')) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '報表服務尚未設定 ANALYTICS_ADMIN_TOKEN。');
    }

    const authorized = options.requireSession === true
      ? (
        typeof options.isSessionAuthorized === 'function' &&
        options.isSessionAuthorized(req, 'analytics')
      )
      : typeof options.isSessionAuthorized === 'function'
        ? options.isSessionAuthorized(req, adminToken, 'analytics')
        : (() => {
        const authorization = req.get('authorization') || '';
        const suppliedToken = authorization.startsWith('Bearer ')
          ? authorization.slice('Bearer '.length)
          : '';
        const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(adminToken);
        const suppliedBuffer = Buffer.from(suppliedToken);
        return expectedBuffer.length === suppliedBuffer.length &&
          crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuffer, suppliedBuffer);
      })();

    if (!authorized) {
      return sendError(res, 401, '沒有權限使用管理報表。');
    }

    if (!readEnabled) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '報表服務需要設定 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY 才可查詢。');
    }

    return next();
  });

  function handleRpcError(res, error, operation) {
    logSupabaseError(`${operation} Supabase RPC 失敗`, error);
    if (error && MISSING_RPC_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '報表資料庫 migration 尚未執行。');
    }
    if (error && MISSING_TABLE_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '報表資料表尚未同步，請確認相關資料庫 migration 已執行。');
    }
    if (error && MISSING_COLUMN_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '資料庫報表欄位尚未同步，請確認相關資料表的 schema。');
    }
    if (error && error.code === '22023') {
      return sendError(res, 400, error.message || '報表查詢條件無效。');
    }
    return sendError(res, 500, `${operation}失敗，請稍後再試。`);
  }

  async function fetchOrdersInRange(dateRange, columns) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .select(columns)
      .gte('order_date', dateRange.startAt)
      .lt('order_date', dateRange.endAt)
      .order('order_date', { ascending: false })
      .limit(MAX_FALLBACK_ORDERS + 1);

    if (error) {
      throw createSupabaseQueryError(error, `orders.select(${columns})`);
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
      throw new Error('Supabase 訂單報表查詢回傳格式無效。');
    }
    if (data.length > MAX_FALLBACK_ORDERS) {
      const error = new Error('查詢範圍內訂單超過報表讀取上限，請縮短日期區間。');
      error.statusCode = 413;
      throw error;
    }
    return data;
  }

  async function fetchItemsForOrders(orderIds) {
    if (orderIds.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('order_items')
        .select(ORDER_ITEM_COLUMNS)
        .in('order_id', orderIds);
      if (error || !Array.isArray(data)) {
        return [];
      }
      return data.map(item => {
        const quantity = Number(item && item.quantity);
        return {
          order_id: item && item.order_id,
          product_id: item && item.product_id,
          quantity: Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) && quantity > 0 ? quantity : 0,
          unit_price: normalizeOrderAmount(item && (item.unit_price ?? item.price_at_purchase)),
          item_id: null,
          item_status: null
        };
      });
    } catch (_error) {
      return [];
    }
  }

  async function fetchProductNames(productIds, queryContext = 'products.select(id,name)') {
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
      return new Map();
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('products')
      .select('id, name')
      .in('id', productIds);

    if (error) {
      throw createSupabaseQueryError(error, queryContext);
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
      throw new Error('Supabase 商品報表查詢回傳格式無效。');
    }
    return new Map(data.map(product => [
      String(product.id),
      String(product.product_name || product.name || '未命名商品')
    ]));
  }

  function handleFallbackError(res, error, operation) {
    logSupabaseError(`${operation} Supabase 查詢失敗`, error);
    if (isJwtClockSkewError(error)) {
      console.warn('系統時間與雲端伺服器未同步，請校正電腦時間。', {
        code: error.code,
        message: error.message,
        details: error.details
      });
      return sendError(res, 503, '資料庫連線時間同步異常，請校正電腦時間後重試。');
    }
    if (error && error.statusCode === 413) {
      return sendError(res, 413, error.message);
    }
    if (error && MISSING_TABLE_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '報表資料表尚未同步，請確認相關資料庫 migration 已執行。');
    }
    if (error && MISSING_COLUMN_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '資料庫報表欄位尚未同步，請確認相關資料表的 schema。');
    }
    return sendError(res, 500, `${operation}失敗，請稍後再試。`);
  }

  function isJwtClockSkewError(error) {
    if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') {
      return false;
    }
    const originalError = error.originalError &&
        typeof error.originalError === 'object'
      ? error.originalError
      : error;
    const errorText = [error.message, originalError.message]
      .filter(value => typeof value === 'string')
      .join(' ');

      originalError.code === 'PGRST303' ||

  }

  function createSupabaseQueryError(error, queryContext) {
    const queryError = new Error(
      error && error.message
        ? error.message
        : `Supabase 查詢失敗：${queryContext}`
    );
    queryError.code = error && error.code;
    queryError.details = error && error.details;
    queryError.hint = error && error.hint;
    queryError.status = error && error.status;
    queryError.queryContext = queryContext;
    queryError.originalError = error;
    return queryError;
  }

  function logSupabaseError(operation, error) {
    console.error(`${operation}：`, {
      query: error && error.queryContext,
      code: error && error.code,
      message: error && error.message,
      details: error && error.details,
      hint: error && error.hint,
      status: error && error.status,
      originalError: error && error.originalError ? error.originalError : error
    });
  }

  async function fetchSummaryRows(createQuery, maximumRows, operation) {
    const pageSize = 500;
    const rows = [];
    for (let offset = 0; offset <= maximumRows; offset += pageSize) {
      const { data, error } = await createQuery()
        .range(offset, offset + pageSize - 1);
      if (error) {
        throw createSupabaseQueryError(error, operation);
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
        throw new Error(`Supabase ${operation}回傳格式無效。`);
      }
      rows.push(...data);
      if (rows.length > maximumRows) {
        const error = new Error(`${operation}超過安全讀取上限。`);
        error.statusCode = 413;
        throw error;
      }
      if (data.length < pageSize) {
        return rows;
      }
    }
    return rows;
  }

  router.get('/summary', async (req, res) => {
    if (
      options.requireSession !== true ||
      typeof options.isSessionAuthorized !== 'function' ||
      !options.isSessionAuthorized(req, 'analytics')
    ) {
      return sendError(res, 401, '營運分析摘要只允許具備 Analytics 權限的管理員 Session 存取。');
    }
    const cacheKey = createCacheKey('summary', {});
    const cachedResponse = sendCachedResponse(res, cacheKey, '營運分析摘要查詢完成。');
    if (cachedResponse) {
      return cachedResponse;
    }

    try {
      const orders = await fetchSummaryRows(
        () => supabase
          .from('orders')
          .select('order_id,order_date,total_amount')
          .order('order_date', { ascending: false }),
        MAX_FALLBACK_ORDERS,
        'orders.select(order_id,order_date,total_amount)'
      );
      const items = [];

      const totalsByProduct = new Map();
      for (const item of items) {
        const key = String(item.product_id);
        const quantity = Number(item.quantity);
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) || quantity < 0) {
          console.error('營運摘要遇到無效訂單商品數量。');
          return sendError(res, 500, '訂單商品資料格式無效。');
        }
        const total = totalsByProduct.get(key) || {
          product_id: item.product_id,
          quantity_sold: 0,
          sales_amount: null
        };
        total.quantity_sold += quantity;
        totalsByProduct.set(key, total);
      }

      const rankedProducts = [...totalsByProduct.values()]
        .sort((left, right) => (
          right.quantity_sold - left.quantity_sold ||
          (right.sales_amount ?? 0) - (left.sales_amount ?? 0) ||
          String(left.product_id).localeCompare(String(right.product_id))
        ))
        .slice(0, 10);
      const productNames = rankedProducts.length === 0
        ? new Map()
        : await fetchProductNames(
          rankedProducts.map(product => product.product_id),
          'products.select(id,name)（營運分析商品名稱）'
        );

      const today = hongKongDate(new Date());
      const todayDate = parseDate(today);
      const startDate = new Date(todayDate.getTime() - 6 * 86400000)
        .toISOString()
        .slice(0, 10);
      const trendDates = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, index) => (
        new Date(Date.parse(`${startDate}T00:00:00.000Z`) + index * 86400000)
          .toISOString()
          .slice(0, 10)
      ));
      const trend = new Map(trendDates.map(date => [date, {
        date,
        order_count: 0,
        revenue: 0
      }]));
      let totalRevenue = 0;
      for (const order of orders) {
        const amount = normalizeOrderAmount(order && order.total_amount);
        totalRevenue += amount;
        const daily = trend.get(hongKongDate(order.order_date));
        if (daily) {
          daily.order_count += 1;
          daily.revenue += amount;
        }
      }
      const data = {
        generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        total_revenue: Math.round((totalRevenue + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100,
        total_orders: orders.length,
        top_products: rankedProducts.map((product, index) => ({
          ...product,
          product_name: productNames.get(String(product.product_id)) || '未命名商品',
          rank: index + 1,
          sales_amount: product.sales_amount === null
            ? null
            : Math.round((product.sales_amount + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
        })),
        order_trend: trendDates.map(date => {
          const daily = trend.get(date);
          return {
            ...daily,
            revenue: Math.round((daily.revenue + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
          };
        })
      };
      storeCachedResponse(cacheKey, data);
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: '營運分析摘要查詢完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return handleFallbackError(res, error, '取得營運分析摘要');
    }
  });

  router.get('/profit', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const dateRange = validateDateRange(req.query);
      if (!dateRange) {
        return sendError(
          res,
          400,
          `start_date 和 end_date 必須是有效 YYYY-MM-DD 日期，且區間不可超過 ${MAX_DATE_RANGE_DAYS} 日。`
        );
      }
      const limit = parseInteger(req.query.limit, 1, MAX_TOP_PRODUCTS, 10);
      if (limit === null) {
        return sendError(res, 400, `limit 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_TOP_PRODUCTS} 的整數。`);
      }

      const cacheKey = createCacheKey('profit', {
        startDate: dateRange.startDate,
        endDate: dateRange.endDate,
        limit
      });
      const cachedResponse = sendCachedResponse(res, cacheKey, '商品成本與利潤分析查詢完成。');
      if (cachedResponse) {
        return cachedResponse;
      }

      const orders = await fetchOrdersInRange(
        dateRange,
        'order_id,total_amount'
      );
      const items = profitDetailsEnabled
        ? await fetchItemsForOrders(orders.map(order => order.order_id))
        : [];
      const detailsAvailable = true;
      const detailsMessage = null;
      const productIds = [...new Set(items.map(item => String(item.product_id)))];
      const productInfo = new Map();
      for (let offset = 0; offset < productIds.length; offset += 100) {
        const ids = productIds.slice(offset, offset + 100);
        const products = await fetchSummaryRows(
          () => supabase
            .from('products')
            .select('id,name,cost_price,price')
            .in('id', ids),
          100,
          '商品成本報表查詢'
        );
        for (const product of products) {
          const costPrice = normalizeOrderAmount(product && product.cost_price);
          const unitPrice = normalizeOrderAmount(product && product.price);
          if (
            !product ||
            (typeof product.id !== 'string' && typeof product.id !== 'number') ||
            typeof product.name !== 'string'
          ) {
            console.error('商品成本報表遇到無效商品資料。');
            return sendError(res, 500, '商品成本資料格式無效。');
          }
          productInfo.set(String(product.id), {
            product_name: product.name,
            cost_price: costPrice,
            unit_price: unitPrice
          });
        }
      }

      const totalsByProduct = new Map();
      let totalRevenue = 0;
      let totalCost = 0;
      let unitsSold = 0;
      let unitsWithKnownCost = 0;
      let unknownCostItems = 0;
      for (const order of orders) {
        totalRevenue += normalizeOrderAmount(order && order.total_amount);
      }

      for (const item of items) {
        const quantity = Number(item.quantity);
        const key = String(item.product_id);
        const product = productInfo.get(key);
        if (
          !Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) ||
          quantity < 0
        ) {
          console.error('商品利潤報表遇到無效訂單商品資料。');
          return sendError(res, 500, '訂單商品資料格式無效。');
        }
        const itemUnitPrice = Number(item.unit_price) || (product ? product.unit_price : 0);
        const salesAmount = quantity * itemUnitPrice;
        const knownCost = Boolean(product);
        const costAmount = knownCost ? quantity * product.cost_price : null;
        const total = totalsByProduct.get(key) || {
          product_id: item.product_id,
          product_name: product ? product.product_name : '商品資料已不存在',
          quantity_sold: 0,
          sales_amount: 0,
          cost_amount: 0,
          net_profit: 0,
          cost_known: true
        };
        total.quantity_sold += quantity;
        total.sales_amount += salesAmount;
        if (knownCost) {
          total.cost_amount += costAmount;
          total.net_profit += salesAmount - costAmount;
          unitsWithKnownCost += quantity;
          totalCost += costAmount;
        } else {
          total.cost_known = false;
          unknownCostItems += 1;
        }
        unitsSold += quantity;
        totalsByProduct.set(key, total);
      }

      const completeCostCoverage = unknownCostItems === 0;
      const rankedProducts = [...totalsByProduct.values()]
        .sort((left, right) => (
          (right.cost_known ? right.net_profit : Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY) -
            (left.cost_known ? left.net_profit : Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY) ||
          right.sales_amount - left.sales_amount ||
          String(left.product_id).localeCompare(String(right.product_id))
        ))
        .slice(0, limit)
        .map((product, index) => ({
          product_id: product.product_id,
          product_name: product.product_name,
          quantity_sold: product.quantity_sold,
          sales_amount: Math.round((product.sales_amount + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100,
          cost_amount: product.cost_known
            ? Math.round((product.cost_amount + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
            : null,
          net_profit: product.cost_known
            ? Math.round((product.net_profit + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
            : null,
          rank: index + 1
        }));
      const roundedRevenue = Math.round((totalRevenue + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
      const roundedCost = Math.round((totalCost + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
      const grossProfit = completeCostCoverage ? roundedRevenue - roundedCost : null;
      const data = {
        start_date: dateRange.startDate,
        end_date: dateRange.endDate,
        total_revenue: roundedRevenue,
        total_cost: roundedCost,
        gross_profit: grossProfit === null
          ? null
          : Math.round((grossProfit + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100,
        gross_margin_percentage: completeCostCoverage && roundedRevenue > 0
          ? Math.round((grossProfit / roundedRevenue) * 10000) / 100
          : null,
        cost_coverage_percentage: unitsSold > 0
          ? Math.round((unitsWithKnownCost / unitsSold) * 10000) / 100
          : 100,
        cost_data_complete: completeCostCoverage,
        unknown_cost_items: unknownCostItems,
        details_available: detailsAvailable,
        details_message: detailsMessage,
        top_products: rankedProducts
      };
      if (detailsAvailable) {
        storeCachedResponse(cacheKey, data);
      }
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: detailsMessage || '商品成本與利潤分析查詢完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return handleFallbackError(res, error, '取得商品成本與利潤分析');
    }
  });

  router.get('/overview', async (req, res) => {

  router.get('/top-products', async (req, res) => {

          `start_date 和 end_date 必須是有效 YYYY-MM-DD 日期，且區間不可超過 ${MAX_DATE_RANGE_DAYS} 日。`
        );
      }

      if (limit === null) {
        return sendError(res, 400, `limit 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_TOP_PRODUCTS} 的整數。`);
      }

      const cacheKey = createCacheKey('top-products', {
        startDate: dateRange.startDate,
        endDate: dateRange.endDate,
        limit
      });

      if (cachedResponse) {
        return cachedResponse;

        const productIds = [...new Set(items.map(item => item.product_id))];
        const productNames = await fetchProductNames(productIds);
        const totals = new Map();

            : Number(item.quantity || 0) * item.unit_price;

            product_name: productNames.get(key) || '未命名商品',
            quantity_sold: 0,

          };
          current.quantity_sold += Number(item.quantity || 0);
          if (current.sales_amount !== null && itemSalesAmount !== null) {
            current.sales_amount += itemSalesAmount;
          } else {
            current.sales_amount = null;
          }
          totals.set(key, current);
        }

        data = [...totals.values()]
          .sort((left, right) => (
            right.quantity_sold - left.quantity_sold ||
            right.sales_amount - left.sales_amount ||
            String(left.product_id).localeCompare(String(right.product_id))
          ))
          .slice(0, limit)
          .map((product, index) => ({
            ...product,
            rank: index + 1,
            sales_amount: product.sales_amount === null
              ? null
              : Math.round((product.sales_amount + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
          }));
      } else {
        const result = await supabase.rpc('get_top_selling_products', {
          p_start_date: dateRange.startDate,
          p_end_date: dateRange.endDate,
          p_limit: limit
        });
        data = result.data;
        if (result.error) {
          return handleRpcError(res, result.error, '取得熱銷商品排行榜');
        }
