      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
        console.error('熱銷商品 RPC 回傳格式無效：', data);
        return sendError(res, 500, '熱銷商品排行榜回傳格式無效。');

      }
      console.error('取得熱銷商品排行榜時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '取得熱銷商品排行榜時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  router.get('/reconciliation', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const dateRange = validateDateRange(req.query);
      if (!dateRange) {
        return sendError(
          res,
          400,
          `start_date 和 end_date 必須是有效 YYYY-MM-DD 日期，且區間不可超過 ${MAX_DATE_RANGE_DAYS} 日。`
        );
      }

      const paymentStatus = req.query.payment_status || null;
      if (paymentStatus !== null && !PAYMENT_STATUSES.has(paymentStatus)) {
        return sendError(res, 400, 'payment_status 必須是未付款、已付訂金或已付清。');
      }

      const shippingStatus = req.query.shipping_status || null;
      if (shippingStatus !== null && !SHIPPING_STATUSES.has(shippingStatus)) {
        return sendError(res, 400, 'shipping_status 必須是待到貨、部分到貨、可出貨或已出貨。');
      }

      const limit = parseInteger(req.query.limit, 1, MAX_PAGE_SIZE, 50);
      const offset = parseInteger(req.query.offset, 0, 2147483647, 0);
      if (limit === null || offset === null) {
        return sendError(res, 400, `limit 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_PAGE_SIZE} 的整數，offset 必須是 0 至 2147483647 的整數。`);
      }

      const cacheKey = createCacheKey('reconciliation', {
        startDate: dateRange.startDate,
        endDate: dateRange.endDate,
        paymentStatus,
        shippingStatus,
        limit,
        offset
      });
      const cachedResponse = sendCachedResponse(res, cacheKey, '財務對賬明細查詢完成。');
      if (cachedResponse) {
        return cachedResponse;
      }

      let data;
      if (useTableFallback) {
        let query = supabase
          .from('orders')
          .select(
            'order_id,order_date,total_amount,payment_status,shipping_status,shipping_method,tracking_number',
            { count: 'exact' }
          )
          .gte('order_date', dateRange.startAt)
          .lt('order_date', dateRange.endAt)
          .order('order_date', { ascending: false });
        if (paymentStatus !== null) {
          query = query.eq('payment_status', paymentStatus);
        }
        if (shippingStatus !== null) {
          query = query.eq('shipping_status', shippingStatus);
        }
        const { data: orders, error, count } = await query.range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
        if (error) {
          throw error;
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(orders)) {
          throw new Error('Supabase 財務對賬訂單查詢回傳格式無效。');
        }

        const items = await fetchItemsForOrders(orders.map(order => order.order_id));
        const productIds = [...new Set(items.map(item => item.product_id))];
        const productNames = await fetchProductNames(productIds);
        const itemsByOrderId = new Map();
        for (const item of items) {
          const key = String(item.order_id);
          const orderItems = itemsByOrderId.get(key) || [];
          orderItems.push({
            ...item,
            product_name: productNames.get(String(item.product_id)) || '未命名商品',
            line_total: item.unit_price === null
              ? null
              : Number(item.quantity || 0) * item.unit_price,
            received_quantity: item.item_status === null
              ? null
              : item.item_status === '已到貨倉' || item.item_status === '已出貨'
                ? Number(item.quantity || 0)
                : 0
          });
          itemsByOrderId.set(key, orderItems);
        }
        data = {
          total_count: count === null ? orders.length : count,
          rows: orders.map(order => ({
            ...order,
            items: itemsByOrderId.get(String(order.order_id)) || []
          }))
        };
      } else {
        const result = await supabase.rpc('get_financial_reconciliation', {
          p_start_date: dateRange.startDate,
          p_end_date: dateRange.endDate,
          p_payment_status: paymentStatus,
          p_shipping_status: shippingStatus,
          p_limit: limit,
          p_offset: offset
        });
        data = result.data;
        if (result.error) {
          return handleRpcError(res, result.error, '查詢財務對賬明細');
        }
      }
      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data) || !Array.isArray(data.rows)) {
        console.error('財務對賬 RPC 回傳格式無效：', data);
        return sendError(res, 500, '財務對賬明細回傳格式無效。');
      }

      storeCachedResponse(cacheKey, data);
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: '財務對賬明細查詢完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (useTableFallback) {
        return handleFallbackError(res, error, '查詢財務對賬明細');
      }
      console.error('查詢財務對賬明細時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '查詢財務對賬明細時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = createAnalyticsRouter;

const crypto = require('crypto');
const express = require('express');
const {
  SESSION_TTL_SECONDS,
  createCustomerSession,
  getCustomerSession,
  setCustomerCookie
} = require('../middleware/customer-session');

const MISSING_RPC_CODES = new Set(['42883', 'PGRST202']);
const MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES = new Set(['42P01', '42703', 'PGRST204', 'PGRST205']);
const MAX_CUSTOMER_PAGE_SIZE = 100;
const MAX_CUSTOMER_ORDER_ITEMS = 5000;
const PRODUCT_ID_PATTERN = /^(?:[1-9]\d{0,18}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$/i;
const WISHLIST_PRODUCT_FIELDS = new Set([
  'id',
  'product_id',
  'product_code',
  'name',
  'product_name',
  'description',
  'price',
  'retail_price',
  'stock',
  'image_url',
  'category',
  'is_active',
  'status',
  'discount_rule',
  'cutoff_datetime',
  'created_at'
]);

function sendError(res, status, message) {
  return res.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    data: null,
    message
  });
}

function normalizePhone(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    return null;
  }
  const normalized = value.trim().replace(/^\+/, '');
  return /^\d{8,15}$/.test(normalized) ? normalized : null;
}

function getPhoneVariants(value) {
  const normalized = normalizePhone(value);
  if (!normalized) {
    return [];
  }
  const rawPhone = normalized.replace(/^852/, '');
  return [...new Set([
    normalized,
    rawPhone,
    `852${rawPhone}`,
    `+${normalized}`,
    `+852${rawPhone}`
  ])];
}

function parseInteger(value, minimum, maximum, defaultValue) {
  if (value === undefined) {
    return defaultValue;
  }
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(value)) {
    return null;
  }
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) && parsed >= minimum && parsed <= maximum
    ? parsed
    : null;
}

function normalizeProductId(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    return null;
  }
  const normalized = value.trim();
  return PRODUCT_ID_PATTERN.test(normalized) ? normalized : null;
}

function filterWishlistProductFields(product) {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(product).filter(([field]) => WISHLIST_PRODUCT_FIELDS.has(field))
  );
}

function getRateLimitKey(remoteAddress, secret) {
  if (typeof remoteAddress !== 'string' || remoteAddress.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', secret)
    .update(remoteAddress)
    .digest('hex');
}

function isSameOriginRequest(req) {
  const origin = req.get('origin');
  if (!origin) {
    return false;
  }
  try {
    return new URL(origin).origin === `${req.protocol}://${req.get('host')}`;
  } catch (error) {
    return false;
  }
}

function createCustomerRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  const router = express.Router();
  const rateLimitSecret = options.rateLimitSecret || '';
  const sessionSecret = options.sessionSecret || '';
  const readEnabled = options.readEnabled === true;
  const secureCookie = options.secureCookie === true;

  function validateMemberService(res) {
    if (!readEnabled || !supabase) {
      sendError(res, 503, '會員服務尚未設定資料庫服務權限。');
      return false;
    }
    if (Buffer.byteLength(sessionSecret) < 32 || sessionSecret.startsWith('replace-with-')) {
      sendError(res, 503, '會員服務尚未設定 CUSTOMER_SESSION_SECRET。');
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function getWishlistMember(req, res) {
    if (!validateMemberService(res)) {
      return null;
    }
    const session = getCustomerSession(req, sessionSecret);
    if (!session) {
      sendError(res, 401, '會員工作階段已失效，請重新驗證。');
      return null;
    }
    return session;
  }

  // ==========================================
  // 0. 提供前端安全的公開配置 API (/config)
  // ==========================================
  router.get('/config', (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    res.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        supabaseUrl: process.env.SUPABASE_URL || 'https://wteditztyndkfvnzkpvn.supabase.co',
        supabaseAnonKey: process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || ''
      },
      message: '取得前端配置成功。'
    });
  });

  // ==========================================
  // 1. 收藏清單 API (Wishlist)
  // ==========================================
  router.get('/wishlist', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    const session = getWishlistMember(req, res);
    if (!session) return;

    const limit = parseInteger(req.query.limit, 1, MAX_CUSTOMER_PAGE_SIZE, MAX_CUSTOMER_PAGE_SIZE);
    const offset = parseInteger(req.query.offset, 0, 2147483647, 0);
    if (limit === null || offset === null) {
      return sendError(res, 400, `limit 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_CUSTOMER_PAGE_SIZE} 的整數，offset 必須是非負整數。`);
    }

    try {
      let query = supabase.from('customer_wishlists').select('id,product_id,created_at', { count: 'exact' });
      if (session.phone && session.phone.includes('|google|')) {
        const [email] = session.phone.split('|google|');
        query = query.eq('customer_email', email);
      } else {
        query = query.eq('customer_phone', session.phone);
      }

      const { data: savedItems, error, count } = await query
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);

      if (error) {
        console.error('讀取會員收藏清單失敗：', error);
        if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(error.code)) {
          return sendError(res, 503, '會員收藏資料庫 migration 尚未完成。');
        }
        return sendError(res, 500, '讀取會員收藏清單失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }

      const productIds = (savedItems || []).map(item => String(item.product_id));
      let products = [];
      if (productIds.length > 0) {
        const { data, error: productsError } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .select('*')
          .in('id', productIds);
        if (!productsError && Array.isArray(data)) {
          products = data;
        }
      }

      const productsById = new Map(products.map(p => [String(p.id ?? p.product_id), filterWishlistProductFields(p)]));
      const wishlist = (savedItems || []).map(item => ({
        id: item.id,
        product_id: String(item.product_id),
        created_at: item.created_at,
        product: productsById.get(String(item.product_id)) || null
      }));

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          wishlist,
          total_count: Number.isSafeInteger(count) ? count : wishlist.length,
          limit,
          offset
        },
        message: '會員收藏清單載入完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('處理會員收藏清單時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '讀取會員收藏清單時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  router.post('/wishlist', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    if (!isSameOriginRequest(req)) return sendError(res, 403, '收藏操作要求必須來自同一網站。');
    const session = getWishlistMember(req, res);
    if (!session) return;

    const body = req.body;
    if (!body || typeof body !== 'object') return sendError(res, 400, '收藏資料格式無效。');
    const productId = normalizeProductId(body.product_id);
    if (!productId) return sendError(res, 400, 'product_id 必須是有效的商品 ID。');

    try {
      const { data: product, error: productError } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('id')
        .eq('id', productId)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (productError || !product) {
        return sendError(res, 404, '找不到要收藏的商品。');
      }

      const insertPayload = { product_id: product.id };
      if (session.phone && session.phone.includes('|google|')) {
        const [email] = session.phone.split('|google|');
        insertPayload.customer_email = email;
      } else {
        insertPayload.customer_phone = session.phone;
      }

      const { data: savedItem, error: insertError } = await supabase
        .from('customer_wishlists')
        .insert(insertPayload)
        .select('id,product_id,created_at')
        .single();

      if (insertError) {
        if (insertError.code === '23505') return sendError(res, 409, '此商品已在你的收藏清單中。');
        return sendError(res, 500, '加入收藏失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }

      return res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: { id: savedItem.id, product_id: String(savedItem.product_id), created_at: savedItem.created_at },
        message: '商品已加入收藏。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('加入會員收藏失敗：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '加入收藏時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  router.delete('/wishlist/:productId', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    if (!isSameOriginRequest(req)) return sendError(res, 403, '收藏操作要求必須來自同一網站。');
    const session = getWishlistMember(req, res);
    if (!session) return;

    const productId = normalizeProductId(req.params.productId);
    if (!productId) return sendError(res, 400, 'product_id 格式無效。');

    try {
      let query = supabase.from('customer_wishlists').delete().eq('product_id', productId);
      if (session.phone && session.phone.includes('|google|')) {
        const [email] = session.phone.split('|google|');
        query = query.eq('customer_email', email);
      } else {
        query = query.eq('customer_phone', session.phone);
      }

      const { data, error } = await query.select('id,product_id').maybeSingle();
      if (error || !data) return sendError(res, 404, '此商品不在你的收藏清單中。');

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: { product_id: String(data.product_id) },
        message: '商品已從收藏清單移除。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return sendError(res, 500, '移除收藏時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  // ==========================================
  // 2. 會員 Auth & Session 處理 (Google Auth & 認領 & 舊登入)
  // ==========================================

  // 2.1 歷史訂單認領 API (/member/link-phone)
  router.post('/member/link-phone', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    if (!isSameOriginRequest(req)) return sendError(res, 403, '認領要求必須來自同一網站。');
    if (!validateMemberService(res)) return;

    const session = getCustomerSession(req, sessionSecret);
    if (!session || !session.phone || !session.phone.includes('|google|')) {
      return sendError(res, 401, '請先透過 Google 帳號登入會員中心後再進行訂單認領。');
    }

    const [email] = session.phone.split('|google|');
    const body = req.body || {};
    const phone = normalizePhone(body.customer_phone);
    const orderNumber = typeof body.order_number === 'string' ? body.order_number.trim() : '';

    if (!phone || !orderNumber) {
      return sendError(res, 400, '請提供過往訂單登記的手提電話號碼及其中一張訂單編號。');
    }

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('link_customer_phone_orders', {
        p_google_email: email,
        p_phone: phone,
        p_sample_order_number: orderNumber
      });

      if (error) {
        console.error('認領歷史訂單 RPC 失敗：', error);
        return sendError(res, 400, error.message || '核對失敗，請確認電話號碼與訂單編號是否匹配。');
      }

      const updatedCount = Array.isArray(data) && data[0] ? (data[0].updated_count || data[0]) : data;

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: { updated_count: updatedCount },
        message: `成功核對並認領 ${updatedCount || 0} 筆歷史訂單！過往訂單已永久綁定至您的 Google 帳號。`
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('認領歷史訂單發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '認領訂單時發生系統錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  // Google OAuth 驗證登入
  router.post('/member/google-session', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    if (!isSameOriginRequest(req)) return sendError(res, 403, '會員驗證要求必須來自同一網站。');
    if (!validateMemberService(res)) return;

    const authHeader = req.headers.authorization;
    if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
      return sendError(res, 401, '缺少 Google 授權憑證 Token。');
    }

    const token = authHeader.split(' ')[1];
    try {
      const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser(token);
      if (error || !user || !user.email) {
        return sendError(res, 401, '無效的 Google 身份證明文件或存取權限。');
      }

      const sessionPayload = `${user.email}|google|${user.id}`;
      const customerSession = createCustomerSession(sessionPayload, sessionSecret);
      setCustomerCookie(res, customerSession, {
        maxAge: SESSION_TTL_SECONDS,
        secure: secureCookie && req.protocol === 'https'
      });

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          authenticated: true,
          auth_provider: 'google',
          email: user.email,
          user_metadata: user.user_metadata,
          expires_at: new Date((Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + SESSION_TTL_SECONDS) * 1000).toISOString()
        },
        message: 'Google 驗證成功，順利登入會員中心。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Google Session 驗證失敗：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, 'Google 登入驗證時發生錯誤。');
    }
  });

  // 手機 + 訂單號碼登入
  router.post('/member/session', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    if (!isSameOriginRequest(req)) return sendError(res, 403, '會員驗證要求必須來自同一網站。');
    if (!validateMemberService(res)) return;

    const body = req.body;
    if (!body || typeof body !== 'object') return sendError(res, 400, '會員驗證資料格式無效。');

    const phone = normalizePhone(body.customer_phone);
    const orderInput = typeof body.order_id === 'string' ? body.order_id.trim() : '';

    if (!phone || !orderInput) {
      return sendError(res, 400, '請提供有效的手機號碼及訂單編號作身份驗證。');
    }

    try {
      const isUuid = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(orderInput);
      let query = supabase.from('orders').select('order_id, order_number, customer_phone');

      if (isUuid) {
        query = query.eq('order_id', orderInput);
      } else {
        query = query.eq('order_number', orderInput.toUpperCase());
      }

      const { data: order, error } = await query.maybeSingle();
      if (error) return sendError(res, 500, '會員身份驗證暫時無法完成，請稍後再試。');

      const storedPhone = order ? normalizePhone(order.customer_phone) : null;
      const isPhoneMatch = storedPhone && phone && (storedPhone === phone || storedPhone.slice(-8) === phone.slice(-8));

      if (!order || !isPhoneMatch) {
        return sendError(res, 401, '手機號碼或訂單編號不正確。');
      }

      const customerSession = createCustomerSession(phone, sessionSecret);
      setCustomerCookie(res, customerSession, {
        maxAge: SESSION_TTL_SECONDS,
        secure: secureCookie && req.protocol === 'https'
      });

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          authenticated: true,
          expires_at: new Date((Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + SESSION_TTL_SECONDS) * 1000).toISOString()
        },
        message: '會員驗證成功。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('會員身份驗證錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '會員身份驗證時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  // 取得目前 Session 狀態
  router.get('/member/session', (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    if (!validateMemberService(res)) return;

    const session = getCustomerSession(req, sessionSecret);
    if (!session) {
      return res.json({ success: true, data: { authenticated: false }, message: '尚未驗證會員身份。' });
    }

    const isGoogle = session.phone && session.phone.includes('|google|');
    if (isGoogle) {
      const [email] = session.phone.split('|google|');
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          authenticated: true,
          auth_provider: 'google',
          email,
          display_info: email
        },
        message: '會員工作階段有效。'
      });
    }

    return res.json({
      success: true,
      data: {
        authenticated: true,
        auth_provider: 'phone',
        phone: `••••${session.phone.slice(-4)}`,
        display_info: `••••${session.phone.slice(-4)}`
      },
      message: '會員工作階段有效。'
    });
  });

  // 登出 API
  router.post('/member/logout', (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    if (!isSameOriginRequest(req)) return sendError(res, 403, '登出要求必須來自同一網站。');
    setCustomerCookie(res, '', { 
      maxAge: 0, 
      secure: secureCookie && req.protocol === 'https' 
    });
    return res.json({
      success: true,
      data: { authenticated: false },
      message: '已安全登出會員中心。'
    });
  });

  // ==========================================
  // 3. 歷史訂單讀取 API (/orders)
  // ==========================================
  router.get('/orders', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    if (!validateMemberService(res)) return;

    const session = getCustomerSession(req, sessionSecret);
    if (!session) return sendError(res, 401, '會員工作階段已失效，請重新驗證。');

    const limit = parseInteger(req.query.limit, 1, MAX_CUSTOMER_PAGE_SIZE, 50);
    const offset = parseInteger(req.query.offset, 0, 2147483647, 0);

    try {
      let ordersQuery = supabase
        .from('orders')
        .select('order_id, order_number, order_date, total_amount, status, payment_status, shipping_status', { count: 'exact' });

      const isGoogle = session.phone && session.phone.includes('|google|');
      let googleEmail = null;
      if (isGoogle) {
        const [email] = session.phone.split('|google|');
        googleEmail = email.toLowerCase();
        ordersQuery = ordersQuery.eq('customer_email', googleEmail);
      } else {
        ordersQuery = ordersQuery.in('customer_phone', getPhoneVariants(session.phone));
      }

      let { data: orders, error, count } = await ordersQuery
        .order('order_date', { ascending: false })
        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);

      if (error) {
        console.error('讀取會員歷史訂單失敗：', error);
        if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(error.code)) {
          return sendError(res, 503, '會員訂單資料表或欄位尚未完成設定。');
        }
        return sendError(res, 500, '讀取會員歷史訂單失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }

      if (isGoogle && (!Array.isArray(orders) || orders.length === 0)) {
        const { data: customer, error: customerError } = await supabase
          .from('customers')
          .select('customer_phone')
          .eq('google_email', googleEmail)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (customerError) {
          console.error('透過 Google 電郵尋找會員電話失敗：', customerError);
          if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(customerError.code)) {
            return sendError(res, 503, 'Google 帳號綁定資料尚未完成設定。');
          }
          return sendError(res, 500, '讀取 Google 帳號綁定資料失敗，請稍後再試。');
        }

        if (customer && customer.customer_phone) {
          const phoneVariants = getPhoneVariants(customer.customer_phone);
          if (phoneVariants.length === 0) {
            console.error('Google 綁定資料中的客戶電話格式無效。');
            return sendError(res, 500, 'Google 帳號綁定資料格式無效。');
          }

          const phoneOrdersResult = await supabase
            .from('orders')
            .select('order_id, order_number, order_date, total_amount, status, payment_status, shipping_status', { count: 'exact' })
            .in('customer_phone', phoneVariants)
            .order('order_date', { ascending: false })
            .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);

          if (phoneOrdersResult.error) {
            console.error('透過 Google 綁定電話讀取會員訂單失敗：', phoneOrdersResult.error);
            if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(phoneOrdersResult.error.code)) {
              return sendError(res, 503, '會員訂單資料表或欄位尚未完成設定。');
            }
            return sendError(res, 500, '讀取會員訂單失敗，請稍後再試。');
          }

          orders = phoneOrdersResult.data;
          count = phoneOrdersResult.count;
        }
      }

      const orderIds = (orders || []).map(o => o.order_id);
      let items = [];
      if (orderIds.length > 0) {
        const { data: itemsData, error: itemsErr } = await supabase
          .from('order_items')
          .select('*')
          .in('order_id', orderIds);
        
        if (itemsErr) {
          console.error('撈取訂單明細失敗：', itemsErr);
        }
        if (Array.isArray(itemsData)) {
          items = itemsData;
        }
      }

      const productIds = [...new Set(items.map(item => String(item.product_id)).filter(Boolean))];
      let products = [];
      if (productIds.length > 0) {
        const { data: prodData } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .select('id, name, product_name')
          .in('id', productIds);
        if (Array.isArray(prodData)) products = prodData;
      }

      const productNames = new Map();
      products.forEach(p => {
        const pId = String(p.id);
        const pName = p.product_name || p.name || '商品';
        productNames.set(pId, pName);
      });

      const itemsByOrder = new Map();
      for (const item of items) {
        const key = String(item.order_id);
        const orderItems = itemsByOrder.get(key) || [];
        const prodName = productNames.get(String(item.product_id)) || item.product_name || '精選商品';
        orderItems.push({
          ...item,
          product_name: prodName
        });
        itemsByOrder.set(key, orderItems);
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          orders: (orders || []).map(order => ({
            ...order,
            items: itemsByOrder.get(String(order.order_id)) || []
          })),
          total_count: Number.isSafeInteger(count) ? count : (orders || []).length,
          need_link_phone: isGoogle && (!orders || orders.length === 0),
          limit,
          offset
        },
        message: '會員歷史訂單載入完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('處理會員歷史訂單時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '讀取會員歷史訂單時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  router.post('/orders/forgot', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    if (!readEnabled || !supabase) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '訂單查詢服務尚未設定權限。');
    }

    const body = req.body;
    if (!body || typeof body !== 'object') {
      return sendError(res, 400, '查詢資料格式無效。');
    }

    const customerPhone = normalizePhone(body.customer_phone);
    if (!customerPhone || body.order_id !== undefined) {
      return sendError(res, 400, '請提供有效的 customer_phone。');
    }

    const rawPhone = customerPhone.replace(/^852/, '');
    const phoneVariants = [...new Set([
      customerPhone,
      rawPhone,
      `852${rawPhone}`,
      `+${customerPhone}`,
      `+852${rawPhone}`
    ])];

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('orders')
        .select('order_number, order_date, total_amount, payment_status')
        .in('customer_phone', phoneVariants)
        .order('order_date', { ascending: false })
        .limit(10);

      if (error) {
        console.error('找回訂單編號查詢失敗：', error);
        if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(error.code)) {
          return sendError(res, 503, '訂單查詢資料庫尚未完成設定。');
        }
        return sendError(res, 500, '找回訂單編號失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {

        return sendError(res, 500, '訂單查詢結果格式無效。');
      }

        success: true,

  router.post('/orders/lookup', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      if (!readEnabled) return sendError(res, 503, '訂單查詢服務尚未設定權限。');
      const body = req.body;

      if (!customerPhone || !orderNumber || orderNumber.length > 100 || body.order_id !== undefined) {

        .maybeSingle();
      if (error) {

      }

      if (!order) {

          success: true,
          data: [],
          message: '若資料相符，訂單資料將會顯示。'

      );
      if (!rateLimitKey) return sendError(res, 503, '無法安全驗證請求，請稍後再試。');

        p_customer_phone: null,
        p_order_id: order.order_id,

        if (MISSING_RPC_CODES.has(lookupError.code) || MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(lookupError.code)) {

      if (!lookupResult || typeof lookupResult !== 'object') {
        console.error('訂單查詢 RPC 回傳格式無效：', lookupResult);
        return sendError(res, 500, '訂單查詢結果格式無效。');
      }
      if (lookupResult.rate_limited) {
        res.set('Retry-After', '900');
        return sendError(res, 429, '訂單查詢次數過多，請 15 分鐘後再試。');

      if (!Array.isArray(lookupResult.orders)) {
        console.error('訂單查詢 RPC 缺少 orders 清單：', lookupResult);
        return sendError(res, 500, '訂單查詢結果格式無效。');
      }

      const formattedOrders = lookupResult.orders
        .filter(item => item && String(item.order_id) === String(order.order_id))
        .map(item => ({
          ...item,
          order_number: order.order_number,
          customer_phone: order.customer_phone,
          shipping_status: order.shipping_status,
          shipping_method: order.shipping_method,
          shipping_carrier: order.shipping_carrier,
          tracking_number: order.tracking_number,
          payment_proof_submitted: Boolean(order.payment_proof_url),
          payment_proof_status: order.payment_proof_status
        }));

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: formattedOrders,
        message: '查詢完成。'
      });

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('查詢訂單未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '查詢訂單時發生未預期錯誤。');
    }
  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = createCustomerRouter;

'use strict';

const express = require('express');

const CREDIT_STATUSES = new Set(['normal', 'require_deposit', 'blacklisted']);
const CUSTOMER_ID_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES = new Set(['42P01', '42703', 'PGRST204', 'PGRST205']);
const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 50;
const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100;

function sendError(res, status, message) {
  return res.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    data: null,
    message
  });
}

function parsePageValue(value, fallback, maximum) {
  if (value === undefined) {
    return fallback;
  }
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(value)) {
    return null;
  }
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) && parsed <= maximum ? parsed : null;
}

function normalizePhone(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    return null;
  }
  const normalized = value.trim().replace(/^\+/, '');
  return /^\d{8,15}$/.test(normalized) ? normalized : null;
}

function getPhoneVariants(phone) {
  const normalized = normalizePhone(phone);
  if (!normalized) {
    return [];
  }
  const rawPhone = normalized.replace(/^852/, '');
  return [...new Set([
    normalized,
    rawPhone,
    `852${rawPhone}`,
    `+${normalized}`,
    `+852${rawPhone}`
  ])];
}

function createCustomersRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  const router = express.Router();

  function authorizeCustomers(req, res) {
    if (
      typeof options.isSessionAuthorized !== 'function' ||
      !options.isSessionAuthorized(req, 'customers')
    ) {
      sendError(res, 401, '請先以具備客戶管理權限的管理員 Session 登入。');
      return false;
    }
    if (!supabase || options.serviceRoleAvailable === false) {
      sendError(res, 503, '客戶管理服務尚未設定資料庫服務權限。');
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  router.get('/', async (req, res) => {
    if (!authorizeCustomers(req, res)) {
      return;
    }

    const limit = parsePageValue(req.query.limit, DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, MAX_PAGE_SIZE);
    const offset = parsePageValue(req.query.offset, 0, 2147483647);
    const search = typeof req.query.search === 'string' ? req.query.search.trim() : '';
    if (
      limit === null ||
      limit < 1 ||
      offset === null ||
      search.length > 100
    ) {
      return sendError(res, 400, '客戶搜尋或分頁參數無效。');
    }

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('list_admin_customers', {
        p_search: search || null,
        p_limit: limit,
        p_offset: offset
      });

      if (error) {
        console.error('管理員客戶列表查詢失敗：', error);
        return sendError(res, 500, '讀取客戶列表失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
        console.error('管理員客戶列表查詢回傳格式無效：', data);
        return sendError(res, 500, '客戶列表回傳格式無效。');
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          customers: data,
          limit,
          offset
        },
        message: '客戶列表載入完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('讀取管理員客戶列表時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '讀取客戶列表時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  router.post('/:customerPhone/bind-google', async (req, res) => {
    if (!authorizeCustomers(req, res)) {
      return;
    }

    const customerPhone = normalizePhone(req.params.customerPhone);
    const submittedEmail = req.body && req.body.google_email;
    const googleEmail = typeof submittedEmail === 'string'
      ? submittedEmail.trim().toLowerCase()
      : '';
    if (!customerPhone || googleEmail.length > 254 || !/^[^\s@]+@gmail\.com$/.test(googleEmail)) {
      return sendError(res, 400, '請提供有效電話號碼及 Gmail 地址。');
    }

    try {
      const phoneVariants = getPhoneVariants(customerPhone);
      const { count, error: ordersError } = await supabase
        .from('orders')
        .select('order_id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
        .in('customer_phone', phoneVariants);

      if (ordersError) {
        console.error('綁定 Google 帳號時查詢訂單失敗：', ordersError);
        if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(ordersError.code)) {
          return sendError(res, 503, '訂單資料表或欄位尚未完成設定。');
        }
        return sendError(res, 500, '查詢客戶訂單失敗，未能綁定 Google 帳號。');
      }
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(count) || count < 0) {
        console.error('綁定 Google 帳號時收到無效訂單數量：', count);
        return sendError(res, 500, '訂單數量回傳格式無效，未能綁定 Google 帳號。');
      }

      const { error: customerError } = await supabase
        .from('customers')
        .upsert({
          customer_phone: customerPhone,
          google_email: googleEmail,
          customer_name: googleEmail
        }, { onConflict: 'customer_phone' });

      if (customerError) {
        console.error('綁定客戶 Google 帳號失敗：', customerError);
        if (customerError.code === '23505') {
          return sendError(res, 409, '此 Google 帳號已綁定其他客戶。');
        }
        if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(customerError.code)) {
          return sendError(res, 503, '客戶 Google 綁定欄位尚未完成設定。');
        }
        return sendError(res, 500, '綁定 Google 帳號失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: { linked_orders: count },
        linked_orders: count,
        message: `已綁定 Google 帳號及 ${count} 張訂單。`
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('綁定客戶 Google 帳號時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '綁定 Google 帳號失敗，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  router.patch('/:id/credit-status', async (req, res) => {
    if (!authorizeCustomers(req, res)) {
      return;
    }

    const { id } = req.params;
    const creditStatus = req.body && req.body.credit_status;
    if (!CUSTOMER_ID_PATTERN.test(id)) {
      return sendError(res, 400, '客戶 ID 格式無效。');
    }
    if (typeof creditStatus !== 'string' || !CREDIT_STATUSES.has(creditStatus)) {
      return sendError(res, 400, '信用評級必須是 normal、require_deposit 或 blacklisted。');
    }

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('customers')
        .update({ credit_status: creditStatus })
        .eq('id', id)
        .select('id, customer_phone, customer_name, credit_status')
        .maybeSingle();

      if (error) {
        console.error('更新客戶信用評級失敗：', error);
        return sendError(res, 500, '更新客戶信用評級失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }
      if (!data) {
        return sendError(res, 404, '找不到指定客戶。');
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: '客戶信用評級已更新。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('更新客戶信用評級時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '更新客戶信用評級時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = createCustomersRouter;

const crypto = require('crypto');
const express = require('express');

const MAX_INBOUND_QUANTITY = 100000;
const MAX_EXPIRING_BATCHES = 500;
const MISSING_RPC_CODES = new Set(['42883', 'PGRST202']);
const BATCH_SELECT_COLUMNS =
  'batch_id, product_id, quantity_received, quantity_remaining, best_before_date, received_at, is_legacy_stock';

function sendError(res, status, message) {
  return res.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    data: null,
    message
  });
}

function parsePositiveInteger(value) {
  if (typeof value === 'number') {
    return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value > 0 ? value : null;
  }

  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(value)) {
    return null;
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function parseBatchId(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(value)) {
    return null;
  }
  try {
    const batchId = BigInt(value);
    return batchId <= 9223372036854775807n ? value : null;
  } catch (error) {
    return null;
  }
}

function parseOrderUuid(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    return null;
  }
  const normalized = value.trim();
  return /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(normalized)
    ? normalized
    : null;
}

function getHongKongDate(date = new Date()) {
  const dateParts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit'
  }).formatToParts(date);
  const parts = Object.fromEntries(dateParts.map(part => [part.type, part.value]));
  return `${parts.year}-${parts.month}-${parts.day}`;
}

function parseBestBeforeDate(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') {
    return { value: null };
  }
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
    return { error: 'best_before_date 必須是有效的 YYYY-MM-DD 日期，或留空表示無最佳使用期限。' };
  }
  if (Number(value.slice(0, 4)) < 1) {
    return { error: 'best_before_date 必須是有效的 YYYY-MM-DD 日期，或留空表示無最佳使用期限。' };
  }
  const parsedDate = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  if (
    Number.isNaN(parsedDate.getTime()) ||
    parsedDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value
  ) {
    return { error: 'best_before_date 必須是有效的 YYYY-MM-DD 日期，或留空表示無最佳使用期限。' };
  }
  if (value < getHongKongDate()) {
    return { error: '最佳使用日期不可早於香港收貨日期。' };
  }
  return { value };
}

function createInboundRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  const router = express.Router();
  const adminToken = options.adminToken || '';
  const writeEnabled = options.writeEnabled === true;

  router.use((req, res, next) => {
    if (adminToken.length < 32 || adminToken === 'replace-with-a-long-random-secret') {
      return sendError(res, 503, '入庫服務尚未設定 INBOUND_ADMIN_TOKEN。');
    }

    const authorized = typeof options.isSessionAuthorized === 'function'
      ? options.isSessionAuthorized(req, adminToken, 'inbound')
      : (() => {
        const authorization = req.get('authorization') || '';
        const suppliedToken = authorization.startsWith('Bearer ')
          ? authorization.slice('Bearer '.length)
          : '';
        const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(adminToken);
        const suppliedBuffer = Buffer.from(suppliedToken);
        return expectedBuffer.length === suppliedBuffer.length &&
          crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuffer, suppliedBuffer);
      })();

    if (!authorized) {
      return sendError(res, 401, '沒有權限使用入庫服務。');
    }

    if (!writeEnabled) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '入庫服務需要設定 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY 才可安全寫入。');
    }

    return next();
  });

  function handleRpcError(res, error, operation) {
    console.error(`${operation} Supabase RPC 失敗：`, error);

    if (error && MISSING_RPC_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '入庫資料庫遷移尚未執行，請先套用入庫對賬及商品效期批次 migration。');
    }

    if (error && error.code === 'P0002') {
      return sendError(res, 404, '找不到指定商品或訂單。');
    }

    if (error && (error.code === '22023' || error.code === '23514')) {
      return sendError(res, 400, error.message || '入庫資料不符合資料庫規則。');
    }

    return sendError(res, 500, `${operation}失敗，資料庫交易已回滾，請稍後再試。`);
  }

  router.post('/receipt', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const body = req.body;
      if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) {
        return sendError(res, 400, '入庫資料格式無效。');
      }

      const productId = parsePositiveInteger(body.product_id);
      const quantity = parsePositiveInteger(body.quantity);

      if (productId === null) {
        return sendError(res, 400, 'product_id 必須是正整數。');
      }
      if (quantity === null || quantity > MAX_INBOUND_QUANTITY) {
        return sendError(res, 400, `quantity 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_INBOUND_QUANTITY} 的整數。`);
      }

      const bestBeforeDate = parseBestBeforeDate(body.best_before_date);
      if (bestBeforeDate.error) {
        return sendError(res, 400, bestBeforeDate.error);
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('record_product_receipt', {
        p_product_id: productId,
        p_quantity: quantity,
        p_best_before_date: bestBeforeDate.value
      });

      if (error) {
        return handleRpcError(res, error, '記錄入庫');
      }

      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || data.success !== true) {
        console.error('入庫 RPC 回傳格式無效：', data);
        return sendError(res, 500, '入庫結果格式無效，請檢查資料庫 RPC。');
      }

      return res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: '入庫已記錄，庫存及相關訂單明細已在資料庫交易中更新。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('處理入庫時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '處理入庫時發生錯誤，資料庫交易未確認，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  router.get('/expiring', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    try {
      const now = typeof options.now === 'function' ? options.now() : new Date();
      const today = getHongKongDate(now);
      const alertEnd = new Date(`${today}T00:00:00.000Z`);
      alertEnd.setUTCDate(alertEnd.getUTCDate() + 30);
      const endDate = alertEnd.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

      const { data: batches, error: batchError } = await supabase
        .from('product_stock_batches')
        .select(BATCH_SELECT_COLUMNS)
        .gt('quantity_remaining', 0)
        .not('best_before_date', 'is', null)
        .lte('best_before_date', endDate)
        .order('best_before_date', { ascending: true })
        .limit(MAX_EXPIRING_BATCHES + 1);
      if (batchError) {
        console.error('讀取近效期庫存批次時發生 Supabase 錯誤：', batchError);
        if (batchError.code === '42P01' || batchError.code === 'PGRST205') {
          return sendError(res, 503, '商品效期批次 migration 尚未執行。');
        }
        return sendError(res, 500, '讀取近效期庫存失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(batches)) {
        console.error('近效期庫存批次查詢回傳格式無效：', batches);
        return sendError(res, 500, '近效期庫存資料格式無效。');
      }
      if (batches.length > MAX_EXPIRING_BATCHES) {
        return sendError(res, 413, '近效期庫存警示超過安全顯示上限，請先分批查看。');
      }

      const productIds = [...new Set(batches.map(batch => batch.product_id))];
      let products = [];
      if (productIds.length > 0) {
        const { data, error: productError } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .select('id,name,product_name')
          .in('id', productIds);
        if (productError) {
          console.error('讀取近效期批次商品名稱時發生 Supabase 錯誤：', productError);
          return sendError(res, 500, '讀取近效期商品名稱失敗，請稍後再試。');
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
          console.error('近效期商品查詢回傳格式無效：', data);
          return sendError(res, 500, '近效期商品資料格式無效。');
        }
        products = data;
      }

      const namesById = new Map(products.map(product => [
        String(product.id),
        String(product.product_name || product.name || '未命名商品')
      ]));
      const alerts = batches
        .filter(batch => (
          Number.isSafeInteger(batch.quantity_remaining) &&
          batch.quantity_remaining > 0 &&
          typeof batch.best_before_date === 'string' &&
          batch.best_before_date <= endDate
        ))
        .map(batch => ({
          ...batch,
          product_name: namesById.get(String(batch.product_id)) || '未命名商品',
          is_expired: batch.best_before_date < today
        }));

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          alerts,
          today,
          through_date: endDate
        },
        message: '近效期庫存警示已載入。'

      });
    } catch (error) {

      return sendError(res, 500, '執行齊貨對賬時發生錯誤，資料庫交易未確認，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = createInboundRouter;

function getHongKongDatePart(date = new Date()) {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit'
  }).formatToParts(date);
  const values = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part => [part.type, part.value]));
  return `${values.year}${values.month}${values.day}`;
}

        }
        if (error.message === 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE') {

      const result = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : data;
      if (!result || typeof result !== 'object' || !UUID_PATTERN.test(String(result.order_id || ''))) {
        console.error('結帳 RPC 回傳無效結果：', data);

        if (orderLookupError) {
          console.error('讀取正式訂單編號失敗：', orderLookupError);

      if (!orderNumber) {

  router.post('/query-order', async (req, res) => {

      const trimmedOrderNo = typeof orderNo === 'string' ? orderNo.trim() : '';

      const rawPhone = trimmedPhone.replace(/^852/, '');
      const phoneVariants = [...new Set([
        trimmedPhone,
        rawPhone,
        `852${rawPhone}`,
        `+${trimmedPhone}`,
        `+852${rawPhone}`
      ])];
      const { data: order, error } = await supabase
        .from('orders')
        .select('order_id, order_number, customer_phone, customer_name, shipping_address, total_amount, order_date, status, payment_status, payment_proof_url, payment_proof_status, shipping_status, shipping_method, shipping_carrier, tracking_number')
        .in('customer_phone', phoneVariants)

      }

      const { data: rawItems, error: itemsError } = await supabase
        .from('order_items')
        .select('*')

      if (itemsError) {
        console.error('查詢訂單明細失敗：', itemsError);
      }

      const productIds = [...new Set(items.map(item => String(item.product_id)).filter(Boolean))];
      let products = [];
      if (productIds.length > 0) {
        const { data: prodData } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .select('*')
          .in('id', productIds);

      }

      const productsMap = new Map(products.map(p => [String(p.id), p]));

      const formattedItems = items.map(item => {

          ...item,

          description: prod.description || item.description || '',

      const { phone, orderNo, customer_phone, shipping_method } = req.body || {};

      const trimmedOrderNo = typeof orderNo === 'string' ? orderNo.trim() : '';

      if (!trimmedPhone || !trimmedOrderNo) {
        return sendError(res, 400, '驗證失敗：必須提供原本的手提電話與訂單編號。');
      }

      const updateFields = {};
      if (typeof customer_phone === 'string' && /^[0-9]{8,15}$/.test(customer_phone.trim())) {
        updateFields.customer_phone = customer_phone.trim();
      }
      if (typeof shipping_method === 'string' && SHIPPING_METHODS.has(shipping_method.trim())) {

      }

      if (!data) {
        return sendError(res, 404, '找不到對應的訂單，或驗證資料不符。');
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: '訂單資料已成功更新。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('處理更新訂單時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '更新訂單時發生系統錯誤。');
    }
  });

  router.get('/admin/orders', async (req, res) => {
    if (!authorizeOrderManagement(req, res)) {
      return;
    }
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    const limit = parseQueryInteger(req.query.limit, 50);
    const offset = parseQueryInteger(req.query.offset, 0);
    if (
      !Number.isSafeInteger(limit) ||
      limit < 1 ||
      limit > MAX_ADMIN_PAGE_SIZE ||
      !Number.isSafeInteger(offset) ||
      offset < 0
    ) {
      return sendError(res, 400, `limit 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_ADMIN_PAGE_SIZE} 的整數，offset 必須是非負整數。`);
    }

    try {
      const { data: orders, error, count } = await supabase
        .from('orders')
        .select('order_id,customer_phone,customer_name,shipping_address,total_amount,order_date,status,order_number', { count: 'exact' })
        .order('order_date', { ascending: false })
        .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);

      if (error) {
        console.error('管理員訂單列表查詢失敗：', error);
        if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(error.code)) {
          return sendError(res, 503, '訂單狀態資料庫 migration 尚未執行。');
        }
        return sendError(res, 500, '讀取訂單列表失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(orders)) {
        console.error('管理員訂單列表查詢回傳格式無效：', orders);
        return sendError(res, 500, '訂單列表回傳格式無效。');
      }

      const orderIds = orders.map(order => order.order_id);
      let items = [];
      if (orderIds.length > 0) {
        const { data, error: itemsError } = await supabase
          .from('order_items')
          .select('item_id,order_id,product_id,quantity,unit_price')
          .in('order_id', orderIds)
          .limit(MAX_ORDER_ITEMS + 1);
        if (itemsError) {
          console.error('管理員訂單明細查詢失敗：', itemsError);
          return sendError(res, 500, '讀取訂單商品明細失敗，請稍後再試。');
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length > MAX_ORDER_ITEMS) {
          console.error('管理員訂單明細超出安全讀取上限或格式無效。');
          return sendError(res, 413, '本頁訂單明細超過安全讀取上限，請縮小每頁筆數。');
        }
        items = data;
      }

      const productIds = [...new Set(items.map(item => item.product_id))];
      let products = [];
      if (productIds.length > 0) {
        const { data, error: productsError } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .select('*')
          .in('id', productIds);
        if (productsError) {
          console.error('管理員訂單商品資訊查詢失敗：', productsError);
          return sendError(res, 500, '讀取商品資訊失敗，請稍後再試。');
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
          console.error('管理員訂單商品資訊查詢回傳格式無效：', data);
          return sendError(res, 500, '商品資訊資料回傳格式無效。');
        }
        products = data;
      }

      const productsMap = new Map(products.map(p => [String(p.id), p]));
      const itemsByOrder = new Map();
      for (const item of items) {
        const key = String(item.order_id);
        const orderItems = itemsByOrder.get(key) || [];
        const prod = productsMap.get(String(item.product_id)) || {};
        orderItems.push({
          product_id: item.product_id,
          product_name: prod.product_name || prod.name || '未命名商品',
          description: prod.description || '',
          product_code: prod.product_code || '',
          image_url: prod.image_url || prod.image || '',
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unit_price: item.unit_price
        });
        itemsByOrder.set(key, orderItems);
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          orders: orders.map(order => ({
            ...order,
            items: itemsByOrder.get(String(order.order_id)) || []
          })),
          total_count: Number.isSafeInteger(count) ? count : orders.length,
          limit,
          offset
        },
        message: '訂單列表載入完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('讀取管理員訂單時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '讀取訂單列表時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = createOrdersRouter;

'use strict';

const crypto = require('node:crypto');
const express = require('express');

const PAYMENT_PROOF_BUCKET = 'payment-proofs';
const MAX_PROOF_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const UUID_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const ORDER_NUMBER_PATTERN = /^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{0,99}$/;
const PROOF_STATUSES = new Set(['verified', 'rejected']);

function sendError(res, status, message) {
  return res.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    data: null,
    message
  });
}

function getImageType(buffer) {
  if (
    buffer.length >= 3 &&
    buffer[0] === 0xff &&
    buffer[1] === 0xd8 &&
    buffer[2] === 0xff
  ) {
    return { mimeType: 'image/jpeg', extension: 'jpg' };
  }
  if (
    buffer.length >= 8 &&
    buffer.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]))
  ) {
    return { mimeType: 'image/png', extension: 'png' };
  }
  if (
    buffer.length >= 12 &&
    buffer.toString('ascii', 0, 4) === 'RIFF' &&
    buffer.toString('ascii', 8, 12) === 'WEBP'
  ) {
    return { mimeType: 'image/webp', extension: 'webp' };
  }
  return null;
}

function getPhoneVariants(phone) {
  const normalized = phone.trim().replace(/^\+/, '');
  if (!/^\d{8,15}$/.test(normalized)) {
    return null;
  }
  const rawPhone = normalized.replace(/^852/, '');
  return [...new Set([
    normalized,
    rawPhone,
    `852${rawPhone}`,
    `+${normalized}`,
    `+852${rawPhone}`
  ])];
}

      typeof options.isSessionAuthorized !== 'function' ||

          }

        }
        if (!data) {
          return sendError(res, 404, '找不到指定訂單。');
        }

        return res.json({
          success: true,
          data,
          message: paymentProofStatus === 'verified'
            ? '付款憑證已核實。'
            : '付款憑證已標記為不通過。'
        });
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('審核付款憑證時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
        return sendError(res, 500, '審核付款憑證時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
      }
    });
  }

  return router;
}

function createProductsRouter(supabase, options = {}) {

      !PRODUCT_SORTS.has(sort) ||
      (req.query.search !== undefined && (
        typeof req.query.search !== 'string' ||
        search.length < 1 ||
        search.length > MAX_PRODUCT_SEARCH_LENGTH ||
        /[,%_*\\()]/.test(search)
      )) ||
      (category !== undefined && typeof category !== 'string') ||
      (status !== undefined && typeof status !== 'string') ||
      (req.query.ids !== undefined && (
        requestedIds === null ||
        requestedIds.length < 1 ||
        requestedIds.length > MAX_PUBLIC_PRODUCT_IDS ||
        requestedIds.some(id => !isValidProductId(id)) ||
        new Set(requestedIds).size !== requestedIds.length ||
        search !== undefined ||
        category !== undefined ||
        status !== undefined
      )) ||
      (req.query.include_best_before_dates !== undefined &&
        !['true', 'false'].includes(req.query.include_best_before_dates))
    ) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        data: null,
        message: '商品搜尋、排序或分頁參數無效。'
      });
    }

    try {
      let query = supabase
        .from('products')
        .select('*', { count: 'exact' });

      if (requestedIds) {
        query = query.in('id', requestedIds);
      } else if (search !== undefined) {
        query = query.or(`name.ilike.*${search}*,description.ilike.*${search}*`);
      }
      if (category) {
        query = query.eq('category', category.trim());
      }
      if (status) {
        query = query.eq('status', status.trim());
      }

      if (req.query.sort !== undefined) {
        const [sortColumn, ascending] = PRODUCT_SORTS.get(sort);
        query = query.order(sortColumn, { ascending });
      }

      const { data, count, error } = await query.range(
        parsedOffset,
        parsedOffset + parsedLimit - 1
      );
      if (error) throw error;

      let batchSummaries = new Map();
      if (includeBestBeforeDates && data.length > 0) {
        const productIds = data.map(product => String(product.id));
        const { data: batches, error: batchError } = await supabase
          .from('product_stock_batches')
          .select('product_id, best_before_date, is_legacy_stock')
          .in('product_id', productIds);

        if (batchError) {
          console.error('讀取公開商品批次效期摘要時發生 Supabase 錯誤：', batchError);
          const missingBatchSchema = MISSING_STOCK_BATCH_TABLE_ERROR_CODES.has(batchError.code) ||
            MISSING_COLUMN_ERROR_CODES.has(batchError.code);
          return res.status(
            missingBatchSchema ? 503 : 500
          ).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: missingBatchSchema
              ? '商品批次資料尚未就緒，請確認效期批次 migration 已部署。'
              : '無法讀取商品批次效期摘要。'
          });
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(batches)) {
          console.error('商品批次效期摘要回傳格式無效：', batches);
          return res.status(500).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: '商品批次效期摘要格式無效。'
          });
        }

        batchSummaries = new Map(productIds.map(id => [id, {
          best_before_dates: new Set(),
          has_undated_batch: false,
          has_legacy_unknown_date: false
        }]));
        for (const batch of batches) {
          if (
            !batch ||
            typeof batch.product_id !== 'string' && typeof batch.product_id !== 'number' ||
            typeof batch.is_legacy_stock !== 'boolean' ||
            batch.best_before_date !== null &&
              (typeof batch.best_before_date !== 'string' ||
                !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(batch.best_before_date))
          ) {
            console.error('商品批次效期摘要資料列格式無效：', batch);
            return res.status(500).json({
              success: false,
              data: null,
              message: '商品批次效期摘要資料格式無效。'
            });
          }
          const summary = batchSummaries.get(String(batch.product_id));
          if (!summary) continue;
          if (batch.is_legacy_stock) {
            summary.has_legacy_unknown_date = true;
          } else if (batch.best_before_date === null) {
            summary.has_undated_batch = true;
          } else {
            summary.best_before_dates.add(batch.best_before_date);
          }
        }
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          products: data.map(product => {
            const publicProduct = hasAdminAccess(req, options, adminToken)
              ? filterAdminProductFields(product)
              : filterPublicProductFields(product);
            if (includeBestBeforeDates) {
              const summary = batchSummaries.get(String(product.id));
              publicProduct.best_before_summary = {
                best_before_dates: summary
                  ? [...summary.best_before_dates].sort()
                  : [],
                has_undated_batch: summary ? summary.has_undated_batch : false,
                has_legacy_unknown_date: summary
                  ? summary.has_legacy_unknown_date
                  : false
              };
            }
            return publicProduct;
          }),
          total_count: count !== null ? count : data.length,
          limit: parsedLimit,
          offset: parsedOffset
        },
        message: '產品列表讀取成功'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('讀取產品列表時發生 Supabase 錯誤：', error);
      return res.status(isMissingSchemaError(error) ? 503 : 500).json({
        success: false,
        data: null,
        message: isMissingSchemaError(error)
          ? '商品資料表或欄位尚未同步，請確認相關資料庫 migration 已執行。'
          : '無法讀取產品列表'
      });
    }
  });

  router.get('/inventory-alerts', async (req, res) => {

      if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) {

      if (!stockWriteEnabled) {
        return res.status(503).json({
          success: false,

          message: '庫存警示需要設定 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY。'
        });
      }

      const safetyStock = parseQueryInteger(req.query.safety_stock, 0, 100000, 3);
      const targetStock = parseQueryInteger(req.query.target_stock, 1, 100000, 10);
      const slowDays = parseQueryInteger(req.query.slow_days, 1, 3650, 30);
      if (
        safetyStock === null ||
        targetStock === null ||
        targetStock < safetyStock ||
        slowDays === null
      ) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存安全線、目標庫存或滯銷天數參數無效。'
        });
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_product_inventory_alerts', {
        p_safety_stock: safetyStock,
        p_target_stock: targetStock,
        p_slow_days: slowDays
      });
      if (error) {
        console.error('讀取商品庫存警示時發生 Supabase RPC 錯誤：', error);
        if (
          error.code === '42883' ||
          error.code === 'PGRST202' ||
          isMissingSchemaError(error)
        ) {
          return res.status(503).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: '庫存警示資料庫 migration 尚未執行。'

        return res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '讀取商品庫存警示失敗，請稍後再試。'
        });
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
        console.error('商品庫存警示 RPC 回傳格式無效：', data);
        return res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '商品庫存警示回傳格式無效。'
        });
      }
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          alerts: data,
          safety_stock: safetyStock,
          target_stock: targetStock,
          slow_days: slowDays
        },
        message: '商品補貨與滯銷警示已載入。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('讀取商品庫存警示時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        data: null,
        message: '讀取商品庫存警示時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。'
      });
    }

  router.get('/adjustments', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) {
        return;
      }
      if (!stockWriteEnabled) {
        return res.status(503).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存調整記錄需要設定 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY。'
        });
      }

      const limit = parseQueryInteger(req.query.limit, 1, 100, 50);
      if (limit === null) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存調整記錄 limit 必須是 1 至 100 的整數。'
        });
      }

      const { data: adjustments, error } = await supabase
        .from('inventory_adjustments')
        .select('adjustment_id,product_id,quantity_before,quantity_delta,quantity_after,reason,note,actor,created_at')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .order('adjustment_id', { ascending: false })
        .limit(limit);
      if (error) {
        console.error('讀取庫存調整記錄時發生 Supabase 錯誤：', error);
        if (isMissingSchemaError(error)) {
          return res.status(503).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: '庫存調整資料庫 migration 尚未執行。'
          });
        }
        return res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '讀取庫存調整記錄失敗，請稍後再試。'
        });
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(adjustments)) {
        console.error('庫存調整記錄查詢回傳格式無效：', adjustments);
        return res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存調整記錄回傳格式無效。'
        });
      }

      const productIds = [...new Set(adjustments.map(row => String(row.product_id)))];
      let productNames = new Map();
      if (productIds.length > 0) {
        const { data: products, error: productsError } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .select('id,name,product_name')
          .in('id', productIds);
        if (productsError) {
          console.error('讀取庫存調整商品名稱時發生 Supabase 錯誤：', productsError);
          return res.status(isMissingSchemaError(productsError) ? 503 : 500).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: isMissingSchemaError(productsError)
              ? '商品資料表或欄位尚未同步，請確認相關資料庫 migration 已執行。'
              : '讀取庫存調整商品名稱失敗，請稍後再試。'
          });
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(products)) {
          console.error('庫存調整商品名稱查詢回傳格式無效：', products);
          return res.status(500).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: '庫存調整商品名稱回傳格式無效。'
          });
        }
        productNames = new Map(products.map(product => [
          String(product.id),
          product.product_name || product.name || `商品 #${product.id}`
        ]));
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          adjustments: adjustments.map(adjustment => ({
            ...adjustment,
            product_name: productNames.get(String(adjustment.product_id)) ||
              `商品 #${adjustment.product_id}`
          }))
        },
        message: '庫存調整記錄已載入。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('讀取庫存調整記錄時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        data: null,
        message: '讀取庫存調整記錄時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。'
      });
    }
  });

  router.post('/:productId/adjustments', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) {
        return;
      }
      if (!stockWriteEnabled) {
        return res.status(503).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存調整需要設定 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY 才可安全寫入。'
        });
      }
      if (
        !isValidProductRecordId(req.params.productId)
      ) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '產品編號格式無效。'
        });
      }

      const body = req.body;
      const allowedFields = new Set(['quantity_delta', 'reason', 'note']);
      if (
        !body ||
        typeof body !== 'object' ||
        Array.isArray(body) ||
        Object.keys(body).some(key => !allowedFields.has(key))
      ) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存調整資料格式無效。'
        });
      }
      if (
        !Number.isSafeInteger(body.quantity_delta) ||
        body.quantity_delta === 0 ||
        Math.abs(body.quantity_delta) > 100000
      ) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: 'quantity_delta 必須是 -100000 至 100000 之間且不等於零的整數。'
        });
      }
      if (typeof body.reason !== 'string' || !INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT_REASONS.has(body.reason)) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '請選擇有效的庫存調整原因。'
        });
      }
      const note = body.note === undefined || body.note === null ? null : body.note;
      if (
        note !== null &&
        (typeof note !== 'string' || note.trim().length > 500 || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(note))
      ) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存調整備註不可超過 500 個字元或包含控制字元。'
        });
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('adjust_product_inventory', {
        p_product_id: req.params.productId,
        p_quantity_delta: body.quantity_delta,
        p_reason: body.reason,
        p_note: note ? note.trim() : null,
        p_actor: 'admin'
      });
      if (error) {
        console.error('調整產品庫存時發生 Supabase RPC 錯誤：', error);
        if (error.code === '42883' || error.code === 'PGRST202') {
          return res.status(503).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: '庫存調整資料庫 migration 尚未執行。'
          });
        }
        if (error.code === 'P0002') {
          return res.status(404).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: '找不到指定商品。'
          });
        }
        if (error.code === '22023' || error.code === '23514') {
          return res.status(400).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: error.message || '庫存調整資料不符合資料庫規則。'
          });
        }
        return res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '調整產品庫存失敗，請稍後再試。'
        });
      }
      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || !Number.isSafeInteger(data.adjustment_id)) {
        console.error('庫存調整 RPC 回傳格式無效：', data);
        return res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存調整結果格式無效。'
        });
      }
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: '庫存調整已記錄。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('調整產品庫存時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        data: null,
        message: '調整產品庫存時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。'
      });
    }
  });

  router.patch('/:productId/stock', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) {
        return;
      }

      if (!stockWriteEnabled) {
        return res.status(503).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存更新需要設定 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY 才可安全寫入。'
        });
      }

      if (
        !isValidProductRecordId(req.params.productId)
      ) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '產品編號格式無效。'
        });
      }

      const body = req.body;
      if (
        !body ||
        typeof body !== 'object' ||
        Array.isArray(body) ||
        Object.keys(body).some(key => !['stock', 'reason', 'note'].includes(key))
      ) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存更新需提交 stock、reason 及可選 note 欄位。'
        });
      }

      const stock = parseStock(body.stock);
      if (stock === null) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: `stock 必須是 0 至 ${MAX_STOCK} 的整數。`
        });
      }
      if (typeof body.reason !== 'string' || !INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT_REASONS.has(body.reason)) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '請選擇有效的庫存調整原因。'
        });
      }
      const note = body.note === undefined || body.note === null ? null : body.note;
      if (
        note !== null &&
        (typeof note !== 'string' || note.trim().length > 500 || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(note))
      ) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '庫存調整備註不可超過 500 個字元或包含控制字元。'
        });
      }

      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('set_product_inventory', {
        p_product_id: req.params.productId,
        p_stock: stock,
        p_reason: body.reason,
        p_note: note ? note.trim() : null,
        p_actor: 'admin'
      });

      if (error) {
        console.error('更新產品庫存時發生 Supabase RPC 錯誤：', error);
        if (
          error.code === '42883' ||
          error.code === 'PGRST202' ||
          isMissingSchemaError(error)
        ) {
          return res.status(503).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: '庫存調整資料庫 migration 尚未執行。'
          });
        }
        if (error.code === 'P0002') {
          return res.status(404).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: '找不到指定產品。'
          });
        }
        if (error.code === '22023' || error.code === '23514') {
          return res.status(400).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: error.message || '庫存數量不符合資料庫規則。'
          });
        }
        return res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '更新產品庫存失敗，請稍後再試。'
        });
      }

      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || data.stock !== stock) {
        console.error('產品庫存更新回傳格式無效：', data);
        return res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '資料庫未回傳預期的庫存更新結果。'
        });
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: { ...data, id: req.params.productId },
        message: data.quantity_delta === 0
          ? '庫存數量沒有變更，未新增調整記錄。'
          : '產品庫存更新成功並已記錄調整原因。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('更新產品庫存時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        data: null,
        message: '更新產品庫存時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。'
      });
    }
  });

  router.post('/', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      if (!requireAdmin(req, res)) {
        return;
      }
      if (!stockWriteEnabled) {
        return res.status(503).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '商品新增需要設定 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY 才可安全寫入。'
        });
      }
      const validated = validateProductFields(req.body);
      if (validated.error) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: validated.error
        });
      }
      if (validated.values.category &&
          !(await validateCategoryExists(validated.values.category, res))) {
        return;
      }

      const bestBeforeDate = validated.values.best_before_date;
      delete validated.values.best_before_date;

      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('products')
        .insert({
          status: '預購中',
          stock: 0,
          ...validated.values
        })
        .select('*')
        .single();

      if (error) {
        console.error('新增產品時發生 Supabase 錯誤：', error);
        if (isMissingSchemaError(error)) {
          return res.status(503).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: '商品資料庫欄位尚未完成 migration。'
          });
        }
        return res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '新增產品失敗，請稍後再試。'
        });
      }

      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) {
        console.error('新增產品 Supabase 回傳格式無效。');
        return res.status(500).json({
          success: false,
          data: null,
          message: '新增產品結果格式無效。'
        });
      }

      // 儲存批次效期
      if (bestBeforeDate && data.id) {
        const { error: batchInsertError } = await supabase.from('product_stock_batches').insert({
          product_id: data.id,
          best_before_date: bestBeforeDate,
          is_legacy_stock: false
        });
        if (batchInsertError) {
          console.error('新增產品批次效期時發生 Supabase 錯誤：', batchInsertError);
          return res.status(isMissingSchemaError(batchInsertError) ? 503 : 500).json({
            success: false,
            data: null,
            message: isMissingSchemaError(batchInsertError)
              ? '商品批次資料尚未就緒，請確認效期批次 migration 已部署。'
              : '新增產品效期失敗，請稍後再試。'
          });
        }
      }

      return res.status(201).json({
        success: true,
        data: filterAdminProductFields(data),
        message: '產品新增成功。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('新增產品時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return res.status(500).json({
        success: false,
        data: null,
        message: '新增產品時發生錯誤。'
      });
    }
