const crypto = require('crypto');
const express = require('express');

const REMINDER_STATUS_PENDING = '未提示';
const REMINDER_STATUS_SENT = '已發送提醒';
const MAX_WINDOW_HOURS = 168;
const CLAIM_LEASE_MINUTES = 30;
const PUBLIC_REMINDER_FIELDS = [
  'id',
  'product_id',
  'product_code',
  'name',
  'product_name',
  'supplier_name',
  'price',
  'retail_price',
  'cutoff_datetime',
  'remind_status',
  'status'
];

function sendError(res, status, message) {
  return res.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    data: null,
    message
  });
}

function getProductIdColumn(product) {
  if (product.product_id !== undefined) {
    return 'product_id';
  }
  return 'id';
}

function getProductId(product) {
  return product[getProductIdColumn(product)];
}

function getProductName(product) {
  return String(product.product_name || product.name || '未命名商品');
}

function filterReminderFields(product) {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(product).filter(([field]) => PUBLIC_REMINDER_FIELDS.includes(field))
  );
}

function parseWindowHours(value) {
  if (value === undefined) {
    return 24;
  }

  const hours = typeof value === 'number'
    ? value
    : typeof value === 'string' && /^\d+$/.test(value)
      ? Number(value)
      : null;
  return Number.isSafeInteger(hours) && hours >= 1 && hours <= MAX_WINDOW_HOURS
    ? hours
    : null;
}

function createReminderRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  const router = express.Router();
  const cronToken = options.cronToken || '';
  const recipients = Array.isArray(options.recipients) ? options.recipients : [];
  const sendWhatsApp = options.sendWhatsApp;

  router.use((req, res, next) => {
    if (cronToken.length < 32 || cronToken === 'replace-with-a-long-random-secret') {
      return sendError(res, 503, '截單提醒服務尚未設定 REMINDER_CRON_TOKEN。');
    }

    const authorization = req.get('authorization') || '';
    const suppliedToken = authorization.startsWith('Bearer ')
      ? authorization.slice('Bearer '.length)
      : '';
    const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(cronToken);
    const suppliedBuffer = Buffer.from(suppliedToken);

    if (
      expectedBuffer.length !== suppliedBuffer.length ||
      !crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuffer, suppliedBuffer)
    ) {
      return sendError(res, 401, '沒有權限使用截單提醒服務。');
    }

    return next();
  });

  async function findUpcomingProducts(hours) {
    const now = new Date();
    const until = new Date(now.getTime() + hours * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('products')
      .select('*')
      .eq('remind_status', REMINDER_STATUS_PENDING)
      .gte('cutoff_datetime', now.toISOString())
      .lte('cutoff_datetime', until.toISOString())
      .order('cutoff_datetime', { ascending: true });

    if (error) {
      throw error;
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
      throw new Error('Supabase 截單商品查詢回傳格式無效。');
    }

    return data.filter(product => (
      product.is_active !== false &&
      product.status !== '已下架'
    ));
  }

  async function releaseClaim(productIdColumn, productId, claimedAt) {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('products')
      .update({ remind_claimed_at: null })
      .eq(productIdColumn, productId)
      .eq('remind_status', REMINDER_STATUS_PENDING)
      .eq('remind_claimed_at', claimedAt);

    if (error) {
      throw error;
    }
  }

  router.get('/upcoming', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const hours = parseWindowHours(req.query.hours);
      if (hours === null) {
        return sendError(res, 400, `hours 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_WINDOW_HOURS} 的整數。`);
      }

      const products = await findUpcomingProducts(hours);
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: products.map(filterReminderFields),
        message: `未來 ${hours} 小時內有 ${products.length} 件商品即將截單。`
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('查詢即將截單商品失敗：', error);
      if (error && ['42703', 'PGRST204'].includes(error.code)) {
        return sendError(res, 503, 'products.cutoff_datetime、products.remind_status 或提醒鎖定欄位尚未建立，請先執行資料庫遷移。');
      }
      return sendError(res, 500, '查詢即將截單商品時發生錯誤。');
    }
  });

  router.post('/run', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const hours = parseWindowHours(req.body && req.body.hours);
      if (hours === null) {
        return sendError(res, 400, `hours 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_WINDOW_HOURS} 的整數。`);
      }

      if (recipients.length === 0) {
        return sendError(res, 503, '尚未設定 WHATSAPP_REMINDER_RECIPIENTS。');
      }
      if (typeof sendWhatsApp !== 'function') {
        return sendError(res, 503, 'WhatsApp 提醒發送器尚未設定。');
      }

      const products = await findUpcomingProducts(hours);
      const results = [];

      for (const product of products) {
        const productIdColumn = getProductIdColumn(product);
        const productId = getProductId(product);
        const claimNow = new Date();
        const claimedAt = claimNow.toISOString();
        const staleClaimBefore = new Date(
          claimNow.getTime() - CLAIM_LEASE_MINUTES * 60 * 1000
        ).toISOString().replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, 'Z');

        const { data: claimedRows, error: claimError } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .update({ remind_claimed_at: claimedAt })
          .eq(productIdColumn, productId)
          .eq('remind_status', REMINDER_STATUS_PENDING)
          .or(`remind_claimed_at.is.null,remind_claimed_at.lt.${staleClaimBefore}`)
          .select(productIdColumn);

        if (claimError) {
          console.error('截單提醒商品鎖定失敗：', { productId, error: claimError });
          results.push({ product_id: productId, success: false, message: '無法鎖定提醒工作。' });
          continue;
        }

        if (!Array.isArray(claimedRows) || claimedRows.length !== 1) {
          results.push({ product_id: productId, success: false, skipped: true, message: '商品提醒已由其他工作程序處理。' });
          continue;
        }

        const cutoff = new Date(product.cutoff_datetime);
        const message = [
          `截單提醒：${getProductName(product)}`,
          `截單時間：${cutoff.toLocaleString('zh-HK', { timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong' })}`,
          product.product_code ? `產品代號：${product.product_code}` : ''
        ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
        const sentRecipients = [];
        const failedRecipients = [];

        for (const recipient of recipients) {
          try {
            await sendWhatsApp({ to: recipient, text: message });
            sentRecipients.push(recipient);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('WhatsApp 截單提醒發送失敗：', {
              productId,
              recipient,
              error
            });
            failedRecipients.push(recipient);
          }
        }

        if (failedRecipients.length > 0) {
          let claimReleased = true;
          try {
            await releaseClaim(productIdColumn, productId, claimedAt);
          } catch (error) {
            claimReleased = false;
            console.error('釋放失敗提醒鎖定時發生錯誤：', {
              productId,
              error
            });
          }

          results.push({
            product_id: productId,
            success: false,
            sent_recipients: sentRecipients,
            failed_recipients: failedRecipients,
            message: claimReleased
              ? '部分或全部 WhatsApp 提醒發送失敗；提醒狀態未標記為已發送，重試時已送達對象可能收到重複提醒。'
              : '部分或全部 WhatsApp 提醒發送失敗；提醒鎖定暫未釋放，請檢查資料庫及發送紀錄。'
          });
          continue;
        }

        const sentAt = new Date().toISOString();
        const { data: updatedRows, error: updateError } = await supabase
          .from('products')
          .update({
            remind_status: REMINDER_STATUS_SENT,
            remind_claimed_at: null,
            remind_sent_at: sentAt
          })
          .eq(productIdColumn, productId)
          .eq('remind_status', REMINDER_STATUS_PENDING)
          .eq('remind_claimed_at', claimedAt)
          .select(productIdColumn);

        if (updateError || !Array.isArray(updatedRows) || updatedRows.length !== 1) {
          console.error('提醒已發送但更新 remind_status 失敗：', {
            productId,
            error: updateError || new Error('資料庫沒有更新到預期商品。')
          });
          results.push({
            product_id: productId,
            success: false,
            sent: true,
            message: '提醒已發送，但提醒狀態更新失敗；請檢查資料庫以免重複發送。'
          });
          continue;
        }

        results.push({
          product_id: productId,
          success: true,
          sent_recipients: recipients.length,
          remind_status: REMINDER_STATUS_SENT
        });
      }

      const failedCount = results.filter(result => !result.success).length;
      const responseStatus = failedCount > 0 ? 207 : 200;
      return res.status(responseStatus).json({
        success: failedCount === 0,
        data: results,
        message: `截單提醒處理完成：成功 ${results.length - failedCount} 件，失敗或略過 ${failedCount} 件。`
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('執行截單提醒失敗：', error);
      if (error && ['42703', 'PGRST204'].includes(error.code)) {
        return sendError(res, 503, 'products.cutoff_datetime、products.remind_status 或提醒鎖定欄位尚未建立，請先執行資料庫遷移。');
      }
      return sendError(res, 500, '執行截單提醒時發生錯誤。');
    }
  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = createReminderRouter;

'use strict';

const express = require('express');
const { getCustomerSession } = require('../middleware/customer-session');

const UUID_PATTERN = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const PRODUCT_ID_PATTERN = /^(?:[1-9]\d{0,18}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$/i;
const MAX_REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE = 100;
const MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH = 1000;
const MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES = new Set(['42P01', '42703', 'PGRST202', 'PGRST204']);

function sendError(res, status, message) {
  return res.status(status).json({ success: false, data: null, message });
}

function parseInteger(value, minimum, maximum, defaultValue) {
  if (value === undefined) return defaultValue;
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(value)) return null;
  const number = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(number) && number >= minimum && number <= maximum
    ? number
    : null;
}

function isSameOriginRequest(req) {
  const origin = req.get('origin');
  if (!origin) return false;
  try {
    return new URL(origin).origin === `${req.protocol}://${req.get('host')}`;
  } catch (error) {
    return false;
  }
}

function createReviewsRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  const router = express.Router();
  const readEnabled = options.readEnabled === true;
  const writeEnabled = options.writeEnabled === true;
  const customerSessionSecret = options.customerSessionSecret || '';

  function checkService(res, enabled, description) {
    if (!enabled || !supabase) {
      sendError(res, 503, `${description}尚未設定 Supabase 服務權限。`);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  function authorizeReviewAdmin(req, res) {
    if (typeof options.isSessionAuthorized !== 'function' ||
        !options.isSessionAuthorized(req, 'reviews')) {
      sendError(res, 401, '沒有評價管理權限，請使用具評價管理權限的管理員 Session 登入。');
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  router.get('/products/:productId/reviews', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=30, stale-while-revalidate=30');
    if (!checkService(res, readEnabled, '商品評價服務')) return;
    const productId = req.params.productId;
    const limit = parseInteger(req.query.limit, 1, MAX_REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE, 20);
    const offset = parseInteger(req.query.offset, 0, 2147483647, 0);
    if (!PRODUCT_ID_PATTERN.test(productId) || limit === null || offset === null) {
      return sendError(res, 400, `商品 ID 無效；limit 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE} 的整數，offset 必須是非負整數。`);
    }

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_product_reviews', {
        p_product_id: productId,
        p_limit: limit,
        p_offset: offset
      });
      if (error) {
        console.error('讀取商品評價失敗：', error);
        if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(error.code)) {
          return sendError(res, 503, '商品評價資料庫 migration 尚未完成。');
        }
        return sendError(res, 500, '讀取商品評價失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }
      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data) ||
          !Array.isArray(data.reviews) ||
          !Number.isSafeInteger(data.review_count) ||
          typeof data.average_rating !== 'number') {
        console.error('商品評價 RPC 回傳格式無效：', data);
        return sendError(res, 500, '商品評價資料格式無效。');
      }
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          product_id: productId,
          average_rating: data.average_rating,
          review_count: data.review_count,
          reviews: data.reviews,
          limit,
          offset
        },
        message: '商品評價載入完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('處理商品評價查詢時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '讀取商品評價時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  router.get('/reviews/summary', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'public, max-age=30, stale-while-revalidate=30');
    if (!checkService(res, readEnabled, '商品評價服務')) return;
    const productIds = typeof req.query.product_ids === 'string'
      ? [...new Set(req.query.product_ids.split(',').map(value => value.trim()))]
      : [];
    if (
      productIds.length < 1 ||
      productIds.length > MAX_REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE ||
      productIds.some(productId => !PRODUCT_ID_PATTERN.test(productId))
    ) {
      return sendError(res, 400, '商品評價摘要的商品 ID 清單無效。');
    }
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_product_review_summaries', {
        p_product_ids: productIds
      });
      if (error) {
        console.error('讀取商品評價摘要失敗：', error);
        if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(error.code)) {

        }
        return sendError(res, 500, '讀取商品評價摘要失敗，請稍後再試。');
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.some(item =>

      return sendError(res, 500, '讀取商品評價摘要時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  router.post('/reviews', async (req, res) => {
    res.set('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
    if (!checkService(res, writeEnabled, '提交商品評價')) return;
    if (!isSameOriginRequest(req)) {

    const productId = typeof body.product_id === 'string' || typeof body.product_id === 'number'

  router.post('/products/:productId/reviews', async (req, res) => {

      const { data, error } = await supabase

        if (MISSING_SCHEMA_CODES.has(error.code)) {
          return sendError(res, 503, '商品評價資料庫 migration 尚未完成。');

      return res.json({

        data: { review_id: data.review_id },

      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('處理商品評價刪除時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '刪除商品評價時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');

  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = createReviewsRouter;

const crypto = require('crypto');
const express = require('express');
const NodeCache = require('node-cache');

const MISSING_RPC_CODES = new Set(['42883', 'PGRST202']);
const MISSING_TABLE_CODES = new Set(['42P01', 'PGRST205']);
const MISSING_COLUMN_CODES = new Set(['42703', 'PGRST204']);
const PAYMENT_STATUSES = new Set(['未付款', '已付訂金', '已付清']);
const SHIPPING_STATUSES = new Set(['待到貨', '部分到貨', '可出貨', '已出貨']);
const MAX_DATE_RANGE_DAYS = 3660;
const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 100;
const MAX_TOP_PRODUCTS = 50;
const MAX_FALLBACK_ORDERS = 5000;
const MAX_FALLBACK_ITEMS = 20000;
const ORDER_ITEM_COLUMNS = 'order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price';

function sendError(res, status, message) {
  return res.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    data: null,
    message
  });
}

function parseDate(value) {
  if (
    typeof value !== 'string' ||
    !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ||
    value.startsWith('0000-')
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) || date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value) {
    return null;
  }

  return date;
}

function parseInteger(value, minimum, maximum, defaultValue) {
  if (value === undefined) {
    return defaultValue;
  }
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(value)) {
    return null;
  }

  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) && parsed >= minimum && parsed <= maximum
    ? parsed
    : null;
}

function validateDateRange(query) {
  const startDate = parseDate(query.start_date);
  const endDate = parseDate(query.end_date);
  if (!startDate || !endDate || startDate > endDate) {
    return null;
  }

  const days = (endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / 86400000 + 1;
  if (days > MAX_DATE_RANGE_DAYS) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    startDate: query.start_date,
    endDate: query.end_date,
    startAt: `${query.start_date}T00:00:00+08:00`,
    endAt: `${new Date(endDate.getTime() + 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00+08:00`
  };
}

function normalizeOrderAmount(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'number' && typeof value !== 'string') {
    return 0;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() === '') {
    return 0;
  }

  const amount = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(amount) && amount >= 0 ? amount : 0;
}

function calculateOverview(orders, dateRange) {
  const totalOrders = orders.length;
  const totalRevenue = orders.reduce(
    (sum, order) => sum + normalizeOrderAmount(order && order.total_amount),
    0
  );
  const paidOrders = orders.filter(order => (
    order.payment_status === '已付訂金' || order.payment_status === '已付清'
  )).length;
  const unpaidOrders = orders.filter(order => order.payment_status === '未付款').length;
  const shippedOrders = orders.filter(order => order.shipping_status === '已出貨').length;
  const unshippedOrders = orders.filter(order => order.shipping_status !== '已出貨').length;

  return {
    start_date: dateRange.startDate,
    end_date: dateRange.endDate,
    total_revenue: Math.round((totalRevenue + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100,
    total_orders: totalOrders,
    paid_orders: paidOrders,
    unpaid_orders: unpaidOrders,
    paid_order_percentage: totalOrders ? Math.round(paidOrders * 10000 / totalOrders) / 100 : 0,
    unpaid_order_percentage: totalOrders ? Math.round(unpaidOrders * 10000 / totalOrders) / 100 : 0,
    shipped_orders: shippedOrders,
    unshipped_orders: unshippedOrders,
    shipped_order_percentage: totalOrders ? Math.round(shippedOrders * 10000 / totalOrders) / 100 : 0,
    unshipped_order_percentage: totalOrders ? Math.round(unshippedOrders * 10000 / totalOrders) / 100 : 0
  };
}

function hongKongDate(value) {
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit'
  }).formatToParts(new Date(value));
  const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part => [part.type, part.value]));
  return `${dateParts.year}-${dateParts.month}-${dateParts.day}`;
}

function createDailySalesTrend(orders, dateRange) {
  const start = parseDate(dateRange.startDate);
  const end = parseDate(dateRange.endDate);
  const dailyTotals = new Map();
  for (
    let day = start.getTime();
    day <= end.getTime();
    day += 86400000
  ) {
    const date = new Date(day).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    dailyTotals.set(date, { revenue: 0, order_count: 0 });
  }

  for (const order of orders) {
    const date = hongKongDate(order.order_date);
    const total = dailyTotals.get(date);
    if (!total) {
      continue;
    }
    total.revenue += Number(order.total_amount || 0);
    total.order_count += 1;
  }

  const labels = [...dailyTotals.keys()];
  const revenue = labels.map(date => (
    Math.round((dailyTotals.get(date).revenue + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
  ));
  const orderCount = labels.map(date => dailyTotals.get(date).order_count);

  return {
    start_date: dateRange.startDate,
    end_date: dateRange.endDate,
    labels,
    revenue,
    order_count: orderCount,
    total_revenue: Math.round(
      (revenue.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) + Number.EPSILON) * 100
    ) / 100,
    total_orders: orderCount.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0)
  };
}

function createAnalyticsRouter(supabase, options = {}) {

  }

  async function fetchOrdersInRange(dateRange, columns) {

      .from('orders')

      .gte('order_date', dateRange.startAt)
      .lt('order_date', dateRange.endAt)

    if (data.length > MAX_FALLBACK_ORDERS) {
      const error = new Error('查詢範圍內訂單超過報表讀取上限，請縮短日期區間。');
      error.statusCode = 413;
      throw error;
    }
    return data;
  }

  async function fetchItemsForOrders(orderIds) {
    if (orderIds.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from('order_items')
        .select(ORDER_ITEM_COLUMNS)
        .in('order_id', orderIds);
      if (error || !Array.isArray(data)) {
        return [];
      }
      return data.map(item => {
        const quantity = Number(item && item.quantity);
        return {
          order_id: item && item.order_id,
          product_id: item && item.product_id,
          quantity: Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) && quantity > 0 ? quantity : 0,
          unit_price: normalizeOrderAmount(item && (item.unit_price ?? item.price_at_purchase)),
          item_id: null,
          item_status: null
        };
      });
    } catch (_error) {
      return [];
    }
  }

  async function fetchProductNames(productIds, queryContext = 'products.select(id,name)') {
    if (productIds.length === 0) {
      return new Map();
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('products')
      .select('id, name')
      .in('id', productIds);

    if (error) {
      throw createSupabaseQueryError(error, queryContext);
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
      throw new Error('Supabase 商品報表查詢回傳格式無效。');
    }
    return new Map(data.map(product => [
      String(product.id),
      String(product.product_name || product.name || '未命名商品')
    ]));
  }

  function handleFallbackError(res, error, operation) {
    logSupabaseError(`${operation} Supabase 查詢失敗`, error);
    if (isJwtClockSkewError(error)) {
      console.warn('系統時間與雲端伺服器未同步，請校正電腦時間。', {
        code: error.code,
        message: error.message,
        details: error.details
      });
      return sendError(res, 503, '資料庫連線時間同步異常，請校正電腦時間後重試。');
    }
    if (error && error.statusCode === 413) {
      return sendError(res, 413, error.message);
    }
    if (error && MISSING_TABLE_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '報表資料表尚未同步，請確認相關資料庫 migration 已執行。');
    }
    if (error && MISSING_COLUMN_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '資料庫報表欄位尚未同步，請確認相關資料表的 schema。');
    }
    return sendError(res, 500, `${operation}失敗，請稍後再試。`);
  }

  function isJwtClockSkewError(error) {
    if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') {
      return false;
    }
    const originalError = error.originalError &&
        typeof error.originalError === 'object'
      ? error.originalError
      : error;
    const errorText = [error.message, originalError.message]
      .filter(value => typeof value === 'string')
      .join(' ');
    return error.code === 'PGRST303' ||
      originalError.code === 'PGRST303' ||
      /JWT issued at future/i.test(errorText);
  }

  function createSupabaseQueryError(error, queryContext) {
    const queryError = new Error(
      error && error.message
        ? error.message
        : `Supabase 查詢失敗：${queryContext}`
    );
    queryError.code = error && error.code;
    queryError.details = error && error.details;
    queryError.hint = error && error.hint;
    queryError.status = error && error.status;
    queryError.queryContext = queryContext;
    queryError.originalError = error;
    return queryError;
  }

  function logSupabaseError(operation, error) {
    console.error(`${operation}：`, {
      query: error && error.queryContext,
      code: error && error.code,
      message: error && error.message,
      details: error && error.details,
      hint: error && error.hint,
      status: error && error.status,
      originalError: error && error.originalError ? error.originalError : error
    });
  }

  async function fetchSummaryRows(createQuery, maximumRows, operation) {
    const pageSize = 500;
    const rows = [];
    for (let offset = 0; offset <= maximumRows; offset += pageSize) {
      const { data, error } = await createQuery()
        .range(offset, offset + pageSize - 1);
      if (error) {
        throw createSupabaseQueryError(error, operation);
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
        throw new Error(`Supabase ${operation}回傳格式無效。`);
      }
      rows.push(...data);
      if (rows.length > maximumRows) {
        const error = new Error(`${operation}超過安全讀取上限。`);
        error.statusCode = 413;
        throw error;
      }
      if (data.length < pageSize) {
        return rows;
      }
    }
    return rows;
  }

  router.get('/summary', async (req, res) => {
    if (
      options.requireSession !== true ||
      typeof options.isSessionAuthorized !== 'function' ||
      !options.isSessionAuthorized(req, 'analytics')
    ) {
      return sendError(res, 401, '營運分析摘要只允許具備 Analytics 權限的管理員 Session 存取。');
    }
    const cacheKey = createCacheKey('summary', {});
    const cachedResponse = sendCachedResponse(res, cacheKey, '營運分析摘要查詢完成。');
    if (cachedResponse) {
      return cachedResponse;
    }

    try {
      const orders = await fetchSummaryRows(
        () => supabase
          .from('orders')
          .select('order_id,order_date,total_amount')
          .order('order_date', { ascending: false }),
        MAX_FALLBACK_ORDERS,
        'orders.select(order_id,order_date,total_amount)'
      );
      const items = [];

      const totalsByProduct = new Map();
      for (const item of items) {
        const key = String(item.product_id);
        const quantity = Number(item.quantity);
        if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) || quantity < 0) {
          console.error('營運摘要遇到無效訂單商品數量。');
          return sendError(res, 500, '訂單商品資料格式無效。');
        }
        const total = totalsByProduct.get(key) || {
          product_id: item.product_id,
          quantity_sold: 0,
          sales_amount: null
        };
        total.quantity_sold += quantity;
        totalsByProduct.set(key, total);
      }

      const rankedProducts = [...totalsByProduct.values()]
        .sort((left, right) => (
          right.quantity_sold - left.quantity_sold ||
          (right.sales_amount ?? 0) - (left.sales_amount ?? 0) ||
          String(left.product_id).localeCompare(String(right.product_id))
        ))
        .slice(0, 10);
      const productNames = rankedProducts.length === 0
        ? new Map()
        : await fetchProductNames(
          rankedProducts.map(product => product.product_id),
          'products.select(id,name)（營運分析商品名稱）'
        );

      const today = hongKongDate(new Date());
      const todayDate = parseDate(today);
      const startDate = new Date(todayDate.getTime() - 6 * 86400000)
        .toISOString()
        .slice(0, 10);
      const trendDates = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, index) => (
        new Date(Date.parse(`${startDate}T00:00:00.000Z`) + index * 86400000)
          .toISOString()
          .slice(0, 10)
      ));
      const trend = new Map(trendDates.map(date => [date, {
        date,
        order_count: 0,
        revenue: 0
      }]));
      let totalRevenue = 0;
      for (const order of orders) {
        const amount = normalizeOrderAmount(order && order.total_amount);
        totalRevenue += amount;
        const daily = trend.get(hongKongDate(order.order_date));
        if (daily) {
          daily.order_count += 1;
          daily.revenue += amount;
        }
      }
      const data = {
        generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        total_revenue: Math.round((totalRevenue + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100,
        total_orders: orders.length,
        top_products: rankedProducts.map((product, index) => ({
          ...product,
          product_name: productNames.get(String(product.product_id)) || '未命名商品',
          rank: index + 1,
          sales_amount: product.sales_amount === null
            ? null
            : Math.round((product.sales_amount + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
        })),
        order_trend: trendDates.map(date => {
          const daily = trend.get(date);
          return {
            ...daily,
            revenue: Math.round((daily.revenue + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
          };
        })
      };
      storeCachedResponse(cacheKey, data);
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: '營運分析摘要查詢完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return handleFallbackError(res, error, '取得營運分析摘要');
    }
  });

  router.get('/profit', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const dateRange = validateDateRange(req.query);
      if (!dateRange) {
        return sendError(
          res,
          400,
          `start_date 和 end_date 必須是有效 YYYY-MM-DD 日期，且區間不可超過 ${MAX_DATE_RANGE_DAYS} 日。`
        );
      }
      const limit = parseInteger(req.query.limit, 1, MAX_TOP_PRODUCTS, 10);
      if (limit === null) {
        return sendError(res, 400, `limit 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_TOP_PRODUCTS} 的整數。`);
      }

      const cacheKey = createCacheKey('profit', {
        startDate: dateRange.startDate,
        endDate: dateRange.endDate,
        limit
      });
      const cachedResponse = sendCachedResponse(res, cacheKey, '商品成本與利潤分析查詢完成。');
      if (cachedResponse) {
        return cachedResponse;
      }

      const orders = await fetchOrdersInRange(
        dateRange,
        'order_id,total_amount'
      );
      const items = profitDetailsEnabled
        ? await fetchItemsForOrders(orders.map(order => order.order_id))
        : [];
      const detailsAvailable = true;
      const detailsMessage = null;
      const productIds = [...new Set(items.map(item => String(item.product_id)))];
      const productInfo = new Map();
      for (let offset = 0; offset < productIds.length; offset += 100) {
        const ids = productIds.slice(offset, offset + 100);
        const products = await fetchSummaryRows(
          () => supabase
            .from('products')
            .select('id,name,cost_price,price')
            .in('id', ids),
          100,
          '商品成本報表查詢'
        );
        for (const product of products) {
          const costPrice = normalizeOrderAmount(product && product.cost_price);
          const unitPrice = normalizeOrderAmount(product && product.price);
          if (
            !product ||
            (typeof product.id !== 'string' && typeof product.id !== 'number') ||
            typeof product.name !== 'string'
          ) {
            console.error('商品成本報表遇到無效商品資料。');
            return sendError(res, 500, '商品成本資料格式無效。');
          }
          productInfo.set(String(product.id), {
            product_name: product.name,
            cost_price: costPrice,
            unit_price: unitPrice
          });
        }
      }

      const totalsByProduct = new Map();
      let totalRevenue = 0;
      let totalCost = 0;
      let unitsSold = 0;
      let unitsWithKnownCost = 0;
      let unknownCostItems = 0;
      for (const order of orders) {
        totalRevenue += normalizeOrderAmount(order && order.total_amount);
      }

      for (const item of items) {
        const quantity = Number(item.quantity);
        const key = String(item.product_id);
        const product = productInfo.get(key);
        if (
          !Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) ||
          quantity < 0
        ) {
          console.error('商品利潤報表遇到無效訂單商品資料。');
          return sendError(res, 500, '訂單商品資料格式無效。');
        }
        const itemUnitPrice = Number(item.unit_price) || (product ? product.unit_price : 0);
        const salesAmount = quantity * itemUnitPrice;
        const knownCost = Boolean(product);
        const costAmount = knownCost ? quantity * product.cost_price : null;
        const total = totalsByProduct.get(key) || {
          product_id: item.product_id,
          product_name: product ? product.product_name : '商品資料已不存在',
          quantity_sold: 0,
          sales_amount: 0,
          cost_amount: 0,
          net_profit: 0,
          cost_known: true
        };
        total.quantity_sold += quantity;
        total.sales_amount += salesAmount;
        if (knownCost) {
          total.cost_amount += costAmount;
          total.net_profit += salesAmount - costAmount;
          unitsWithKnownCost += quantity;
          totalCost += costAmount;
        } else {
          total.cost_known = false;
          unknownCostItems += 1;
        }
        unitsSold += quantity;
        totalsByProduct.set(key, total);
      }

      const completeCostCoverage = unknownCostItems === 0;
      const rankedProducts = [...totalsByProduct.values()]
        .sort((left, right) => (
          (right.cost_known ? right.net_profit : Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY) -
            (left.cost_known ? left.net_profit : Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY) ||
          right.sales_amount - left.sales_amount ||
          String(left.product_id).localeCompare(String(right.product_id))
        ))
        .slice(0, limit)
        .map((product, index) => ({
          product_id: product.product_id,
          product_name: product.product_name,
          quantity_sold: product.quantity_sold,
          sales_amount: Math.round((product.sales_amount + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100,
          cost_amount: product.cost_known
            ? Math.round((product.cost_amount + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
            : null,
          net_profit: product.cost_known
            ? Math.round((product.net_profit + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
            : null,
          rank: index + 1
        }));
      const roundedRevenue = Math.round((totalRevenue + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
      const roundedCost = Math.round((totalCost + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
      const grossProfit = completeCostCoverage ? roundedRevenue - roundedCost : null;
      const data = {
        start_date: dateRange.startDate,
        end_date: dateRange.endDate,
        total_revenue: roundedRevenue,
        total_cost: roundedCost,
        gross_profit: grossProfit === null
          ? null
          : Math.round((grossProfit + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100,
        gross_margin_percentage: completeCostCoverage && roundedRevenue > 0
          ? Math.round((grossProfit / roundedRevenue) * 10000) / 100
          : null,
        cost_coverage_percentage: unitsSold > 0
          ? Math.round((unitsWithKnownCost / unitsSold) * 10000) / 100
          : 100,
        cost_data_complete: completeCostCoverage,
        unknown_cost_items: unknownCostItems,
        details_available: detailsAvailable,
        details_message: detailsMessage,
        top_products: rankedProducts
      };
      if (detailsAvailable) {
        storeCachedResponse(cacheKey, data);
      }
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: detailsMessage || '商品成本與利潤分析查詢完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      return handleFallbackError(res, error, '取得商品成本與利潤分析');
    }
  });

  router.get('/reconciliation', async (req, res) => {

          `start_date 和 end_date 必須是有效 YYYY-MM-DD 日期，且區間不可超過 ${MAX_DATE_RANGE_DAYS} 日。`
        );
      }

      const paymentStatus = req.query.payment_status || null;

        return sendError(res, 400, 'payment_status 必須是未付款、已付訂金或已付清。');
      }

      const shippingStatus = req.query.shipping_status || null;
      if (shippingStatus !== null && !SHIPPING_STATUSES.has(shippingStatus)) {
        return sendError(res, 400, 'shipping_status 必須是待到貨、部分到貨、可出貨或已出貨。');
      }

      const limit = parseInteger(req.query.limit, 1, MAX_PAGE_SIZE, 50);
      const offset = parseInteger(req.query.offset, 0, 2147483647, 0);
      if (limit === null || offset === null) {
        return sendError(res, 400, `limit 必須是 1 至 ${MAX_PAGE_SIZE} 的整數，offset 必須是 0 至 2147483647 的整數。`);
      }

      const cacheKey = createCacheKey('reconciliation', {
        startDate: dateRange.startDate,
        endDate: dateRange.endDate,
        paymentStatus,
        shippingStatus,
        limit,
        offset
      });
      const cachedResponse = sendCachedResponse(res, cacheKey, '財務對賬明細查詢完成。');
      if (cachedResponse) {
        return cachedResponse;
      }

      let data;
      if (useTableFallback) {
        let query = supabase
          .from('orders')
          .select(
            'order_id,order_date,total_amount,payment_status,shipping_status,shipping_method,tracking_number',
            { count: 'exact' }
          )
          .gte('order_date', dateRange.startAt)
          .lt('order_date', dateRange.endAt)
          .order('order_date', { ascending: false });
        if (paymentStatus !== null) {
          query = query.eq('payment_status', paymentStatus);
        }
        if (shippingStatus !== null) {
          query = query.eq('shipping_status', shippingStatus);
        }
        const { data: orders, error, count } = await query.range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
        if (error) {
          throw error;
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(orders)) {
          throw new Error('Supabase 財務對賬訂單查詢回傳格式無效。');
        }

        const items = await fetchItemsForOrders(orders.map(order => order.order_id));
        const productIds = [...new Set(items.map(item => item.product_id))];
        const productNames = await fetchProductNames(productIds);
        const itemsByOrderId = new Map();
        for (const item of items) {
          const key = String(item.order_id);
          const orderItems = itemsByOrderId.get(key) || [];
          orderItems.push({
            ...item,
            product_name: productNames.get(String(item.product_id)) || '未命名商品',
            line_total: item.unit_price === null
              ? null
              : Number(item.quantity || 0) * item.unit_price,
            received_quantity: item.item_status === null
              ? null
              : item.item_status === '已到貨倉' || item.item_status === '已出貨'
                ? Number(item.quantity || 0)
                : 0
          });
          itemsByOrderId.set(key, orderItems);
        }
        data = {
          total_count: count === null ? orders.length : count,
          rows: orders.map(order => ({
            ...order,
            items: itemsByOrderId.get(String(order.order_id)) || []
          }))
        };
      } else {
        const result = await supabase.rpc('get_financial_reconciliation', {
          p_start_date: dateRange.startDate,
          p_end_date: dateRange.endDate,
          p_payment_status: paymentStatus,
          p_shipping_status: shippingStatus,
          p_limit: limit,
          p_offset: offset
        });
        data = result.data;
        if (result.error) {
          return handleRpcError(res, result.error, '查詢財務對賬明細');
        }
      }
      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data) || !Array.isArray(data.rows)) {
        console.error('財務對賬 RPC 回傳格式無效：', data);
        return sendError(res, 500, '財務對賬明細回傳格式無效。');
      }

      storeCachedResponse(cacheKey, data);
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: '財務對賬明細查詢完成。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (useTableFallback) {
        return handleFallbackError(res, error, '查詢財務對賬明細');
      }
      console.error('查詢財務對賬明細時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '查詢財務對賬明細時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = createAnalyticsRouter;

const crypto = require('crypto');
const express = require('express');
const XLSX = require('xlsx');

const MISSING_RPC_CODES = new Set(['42883', 'PGRST202']);
const SHIPPING_METHODS = new Set(['面交', '自取', '順豐', '京東']);
const MAX_PICK_LIST_ORDERS = 5000;
const MAX_PICK_LIST_ITEMS = 20000;
const MAX_BULK_TRACKING_FILE_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_BULK_TRACKING_ROWS = 100;

function normalizeTrackingHeader(value) {
  return String(value ?? '')
    .trim()
    .toLocaleLowerCase()
    .replace(/[\s_-]+/g, '');
}

function parseBulkTrackingFile(buffer, fileName, defaultShippingMethod) {
  const extension = fileName.toLocaleLowerCase().split('.').pop();
  if (!['csv', 'xlsx', 'xls'].includes(extension)) {
    return { error: '只接受 CSV、XLSX 或 XLS 格式的物流檔案。' };
  }
  if (!SHIPPING_METHODS.has(defaultShippingMethod)) {
    return { error: '請選擇有效的運送方式。' };
  }

  let workbook;
  try {
    workbook = XLSX.read(buffer, {
      type: 'buffer',
      cellDates: false,
      sheetRows: MAX_BULK_TRACKING_ROWS + 2
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('解析批量物流檔案失敗：', error);
    return { error: '物流檔案內容無法讀取，請確認檔案格式正確。' };
  }
  const firstSheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
  const sheet = firstSheetName && workbook.Sheets[firstSheetName];
  if (!sheet) {
    return { error: '物流檔案內沒有可讀取的工作表。' };
  }

  const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(sheet, {
    header: 1,
    raw: false,
    defval: '',
    blankrows: false
  });
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length < 2 || rows.length > MAX_BULK_TRACKING_ROWS + 1) {
    return { error: `物流檔案必須包含標題列及 1 至 ${MAX_BULK_TRACKING_ROWS} 筆資料。` };
  }

  const headers = rows[0].map(normalizeTrackingHeader);
  const orderNumberIndex = headers.findIndex(header =>
    ['ordernumber', 'orderno.', '訂單編號', '訂單號碼'].includes(header)
  );
  const trackingNumberIndex = headers.findIndex(header =>
    ['trackingnumber', '運單號', '物流單號', '快遞單號'].includes(header)
  );
  const shippingMethodIndex = headers.findIndex(header =>
    ['shippingmethod', '出貨方式', '物流方式', '運送方式'].includes(header)
  );
  if (orderNumberIndex < 0 || trackingNumberIndex < 0) {
    return { error: '標題列必須包含 order_number / 訂單編號及 tracking_number / 運單號欄位。' };
  }

  const shipments = [];
  for (let index = 1; index < rows.length; index += 1) {
    const row = rows[index];
    const orderNumber = String(row[orderNumberIndex] ?? '').trim();
    const trackingNumber = String(row[trackingNumberIndex] ?? '').trim();
    const shippingMethod = shippingMethodIndex >= 0 && String(row[shippingMethodIndex] ?? '').trim()
      ? String(row[shippingMethodIndex]).trim()
      : defaultShippingMethod;
    if (
      !orderNumber ||
      orderNumber.length > 100 ||
      !trackingNumber ||
      trackingNumber.length > 100 ||
      !SHIPPING_METHODS.has(shippingMethod)
    ) {
      return { error: `第 ${index + 1} 列的訂單編號、運單號或出貨方式無效。` };
    }
    shipments.push({
      order_number: orderNumber,
      tracking_number: trackingNumber,
      shipping_method: shippingMethod
    });
  }
  if (new Set(shipments.map(row => row.order_number.toLocaleUpperCase())).size !== shipments.length) {
    return { error: '物流檔案包含重複訂單編號，請先整理後再匯入。' };
  }
  return { shipments };
}

function sendError(res, status, message, data = null) {
  return res.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    data,
    message
  });
}

function parseOrderId(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    return null;
  }
  if (/^[1-9]\d*$/.test(value)) {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isSafeInteger(parsed) ? String(parsed) : null;
  }
  return /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(value)
    ? value.toLowerCase()
    : null;
}

function normalizePhone(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') {
    return null;
  }

  const normalized = value.trim().replace(/^\+/, '');
  return /^\d{8,15}$/.test(normalized) ? normalized : null;
}

function createShippingRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  const router = express.Router();
  const adminToken = options.adminToken || '';
  const writeEnabled = options.writeEnabled === true;
  const readEnabled = options.readEnabled === true;
  const sendWhatsApp = options.sendWhatsApp;

  router.use((req, res, next) => {
    if (adminToken.length < 32 || adminToken.startsWith('replace-with-')) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '出貨服務尚未設定 SHIPPING_ADMIN_TOKEN。');
    }

    const authorized = typeof options.isSessionAuthorized === 'function'
      ? options.isSessionAuthorized(req, adminToken, 'shipping')
      : (() => {
        const authorization = req.get('authorization') || '';
        const suppliedToken = authorization.startsWith('Bearer ')
          ? authorization.slice('Bearer '.length)
          : '';
        const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(adminToken);
        const suppliedBuffer = Buffer.from(suppliedToken);
        return expectedBuffer.length === suppliedBuffer.length &&
          crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuffer, suppliedBuffer);
      })();

    if (!authorized) {
      return sendError(res, 401, '沒有權限使用出貨服務。');
    }

    if (req.method !== 'GET' && !writeEnabled) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '出貨服務需要設定 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY 才可安全運作。');
    }

    if (req.method === 'GET' && !readEnabled && !writeEnabled) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '執貨清單讀取服務尚未設定 Supabase 資料庫連線。');
    }

    return next();
  });

  function handleRpcError(res, error, operation) {
    console.error(`${operation} Supabase RPC 失敗：`, error);

    if (error && MISSING_RPC_CODES.has(error.code)) {
      return sendError(res, 503, '出貨資料庫遷移尚未執行，請先套用出貨管理 migration。');
    }
    if (error && error.code === 'P0002') {
      return sendError(res, 404, '找不到指定訂單。');
    }
    if (error && error.code === '55000') {
      return sendError(res, 409, error.message || '訂單目前不可出貨。');
    }
    if (error && (error.code === '22023' || error.code === '23514')) {
      return sendError(res, 400, error.message || '出貨資料不符合資料庫規則。');
    }

    return sendError(res, 500, `${operation}失敗，資料庫交易已回滾，請稍後再試。`);
  }

  async function getTablePickList(groupBy) {
    const { data: orders, error: ordersError } = await supabase
      .from('orders')
      .select('order_id,order_date,customer_phone,shipping_method,tracking_number,shipping_status')
      .eq('shipping_status', '可出貨')
      .order('order_date', { ascending: true })
      .limit(MAX_PICK_LIST_ORDERS + 1);

    if (ordersError) {
      throw ordersError;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(orders)) {
      throw new Error('Supabase 執貨清單訂單查詢回傳格式無效。');
    }
    if (orders.length > MAX_PICK_LIST_ORDERS) {
      const error = new Error('可出貨訂單超過清單讀取上限，請縮短查詢範圍。');
      error.statusCode = 413;
      throw error;
    }
    if (orders.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    const orderIds = orders.map(order => order.order_id);
    const { data: items, error: itemsError } = await supabase
      .from('order_items')
      .select('item_id,order_id,product_id,quantity,item_status')
      .in('order_id', orderIds)
      .eq('item_status', '已到貨倉')
      .limit(MAX_PICK_LIST_ITEMS + 1);

    if (itemsError) {
      throw itemsError;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(items)) {
      throw new Error('Supabase 執貨清單明細查詢回傳格式無效。');
    }
    if (items.length > MAX_PICK_LIST_ITEMS) {
      const error = new Error('執貨清單明細超過讀取上限，請縮短查詢範圍。');
      error.statusCode = 413;
      throw error;
    }

    const readyOrders = orders.filter(order => (
      items.some(item => String(item.order_id) === String(order.order_id))
    ));
    if (items.length === 0) {
      return [];
    }

    const productIds = [...new Set(items.map(item => item.product_id))];
    const { data: products, error: productsError } = await supabase
      .from('products')
      .select('id,name,product_name')
      .in('id', productIds);

    if (productsError) {
      throw productsError;
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(products)) {
      throw new Error('Supabase 執貨清單商品查詢回傳格式無效。');
    }

    const ordersById = new Map(readyOrders.map(order => [String(order.order_id), order]));
    const productsById = new Map(products.map(product => [
      String(product.id),
      String(product.product_name || product.name || '未命名商品')
    ]));
    const rows = items.map(item => {
      const order = ordersById.get(String(item.order_id));
      if (!order) {
        return null;
      }
      return {
        order_id: order.order_id,
        order_date: order.order_date,
        customer_phone: order.customer_phone,
        shipping_method: order.shipping_method,
        tracking_number: order.tracking_number,
        shipping_status: order.shipping_status,
        item_id: item.item_id,
        product_id: item.product_id,
        product_name: productsById.get(String(item.product_id)) || '未命名商品',
        quantity: item.quantity
      };
    }).filter(Boolean);

    if (groupBy === 'product') {
      const productsGrouped = new Map();
      for (const row of rows) {
        const key = String(row.product_id);
        const group = productsGrouped.get(key) || {
          product_id: row.product_id,
          product_name: row.product_name,
          total_quantity: 0,
          orders: []
        };
        group.total_quantity += Number(row.quantity);
        group.orders.push({
          order_id: row.order_id,
          item_id: row.item_id,
          quantity: row.quantity
        });
        productsGrouped.set(key, group);
      }
      return [...productsGrouped.values()];
    }

    const ordersGrouped = new Map();
    for (const row of rows) {
      const key = String(row.order_id);
      const group = ordersGrouped.get(key) || {
        order_id: row.order_id,
        order_date: row.order_date,
        customer_phone: row.customer_phone,
        shipping_method: row.shipping_method,
        tracking_number: row.tracking_number,
        shipping_status: row.shipping_status,
        items: []
      };
      group.items.push({
        item_id: row.item_id,
        product_id: row.product_id,
        product_name: row.product_name,
        quantity: row.quantity,
        item_status: '已到貨倉'
      });
      ordersGrouped.set(key, group);
    }
    return [...ordersGrouped.values()];
  }

  async function sendShipmentNotification(orderId) {
    let notification;
    try {
      const result = await supabase.rpc(
        'claim_shipping_notification',
        { p_order_id: orderId }
      );
      notification = result.data;

      if (result.error) {
        console.error('取得出貨通知工作失敗：', { orderId, error: result.error });
        return {
          success: false,
          status: 'pending',
          message: '出貨已完成，但無法取得通知工作；請稍後重試通知。'
        };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('呼叫出貨通知 claim RPC 時發生錯誤：', { orderId, error });
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'pending',
        message: '出貨已完成，但無法取得通知工作；請稍後重試通知。'
      };
    }

    if (!notification || typeof notification !== 'object') {
      console.error('出貨通知 claim RPC 回傳格式無效：', notification);
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'unknown',
        message: '出貨已完成，但通知工作狀態無效；請檢查資料庫通知佇列。'
      };
    }

    if (notification.claimed !== true) {
      if (!['pending', 'sending', 'sent', 'failed'].includes(notification.status)) {
        console.error('出貨通知 claim RPC 回傳未知狀態：', notification);
        return {
          success: false,
          status: 'unknown',
          message: '出貨已完成，但通知工作狀態無效；請檢查資料庫通知佇列。'
        };
      }

      return {
        success: notification.status === 'sent',
        status: notification.status,
        message: '通知已由其他工作程序處理或目前仍在處理中。'
      };
    }

    let failureMessage = '';
    try {
      if (
        typeof notification.customer_phone !== 'string' ||
        normalizePhone(notification.customer_phone) === null ||
        typeof notification.shipping_method !== 'string' ||
        typeof notification.tracking_number !== 'string'
      ) {
        throw new Error('出貨通知資料格式無效。');
      }
      if (typeof sendWhatsApp !== 'function') {
        throw new Error('WhatsApp Cloud API 尚未設定。');
      }

      const text = [
        `LittlePlanet 出貨通知：訂單 #${orderId} 已出貨。`,
        `快遞公司／方式：${notification.shipping_method}`,
        `運單號碼：${notification.tracking_number}`
      ].join('\n');

      await sendWhatsApp({
        to: notification.customer_phone,
        text
      });
    } catch (error) {
      failureMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'WhatsApp 訊息發送失敗。';
      console.error('WhatsApp 出貨通知發送失敗：', { orderId, error });
    }

    let result;
    try {
      const finishResult = await supabase.rpc(
        'finish_shipping_notification',
        {
          p_order_id: orderId,
          p_success: failureMessage.length === 0,
          p_error_message: failureMessage ? failureMessage.slice(0, 500) : null
        }
      );
      result = finishResult.data;
      if (finishResult.error) {
        console.error('更新出貨通知結果失敗：', { orderId, error: finishResult.error });
        return {
          success: false,
          status: 'sending',
          message: '出貨已完成，但通知發送結果未能記錄；請檢查 WhatsApp 及通知狀態。'
        };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('呼叫出貨通知 finish RPC 時發生錯誤：', { orderId, error });
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'sending',
        message: '出貨已完成，但通知發送結果未能記錄；請檢查 WhatsApp 及通知狀態。'
      };
    }

    const expectedStatus = failureMessage ? 'failed' : 'sent';
    if (!result || result.status !== expectedStatus) {
      console.error('更新出貨通知 RPC 回傳格式無效：', { orderId, result });
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'unknown',
        message: '出貨已完成，但通知結果未能確認；請檢查通知佇列。'
      };
    }

    if (failureMessage) {
      return {
        success: false,
        status: result.status,
        message: '出貨已完成，但 WhatsApp 通知發送失敗；可呼叫通知重試 API。',
        error: failureMessage
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      status: result.status,
      message: 'WhatsApp 出貨通知已發送。'
    };
  }

  router.get('/pick-list', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const groupBy = req.query.group_by || 'order';
      if (!['order', 'product'].includes(groupBy)) {
        return sendError(res, 400, 'group_by 只接受 order 或 product。');
      }

      let data;
      if (readEnabled && !writeEnabled) {
        data = await getTablePickList(groupBy);
      } else {
        const { data: rpcData, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_shipping_pick_list', {
          p_group_by: groupBy
        });
        if (error) {
          return handleRpcError(res, error, '取得執貨清單');
        }
        data = rpcData;
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
        console.error('執貨清單 RPC 回傳格式無效：', data);
        return sendError(res, 500, '執貨清單格式無效，請檢查資料庫 RPC。');
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data,
        message: `已產生按${groupBy === 'order' ? '訂單' : '貨品'}分組的執貨清單。`
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('取得執貨清單時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      if (error && error.statusCode === 413) {
        return sendError(res, 413, error.message);
      }
      if (error && (error.code === '42703' || error.code === 'PGRST204')) {
        return sendError(res, 503, '資料庫出貨／明細欄位尚未同步，請先執行相關 migrations。');
      }
      return sendError(res, 500, '取得執貨清單時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  router.post(
    '/bulk-tracking',
    express.raw({
      type: [
        'text/csv',
        'application/csv',
        'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet',
        'application/vnd.ms-excel',
        'application/octet-stream'
      ],
      limit: MAX_BULK_TRACKING_FILE_BYTES
    }),
    async (req, res) => {
      try {
        const fileNameHeader = req.get('x-upload-filename') || '';
        let fileName;
        try {
          fileName = decodeURIComponent(fileNameHeader);
        } catch (error) {
          return sendError(res, 400, '物流檔案名稱格式無效。');
        }
        if (
          !fileName ||
          fileName.length > 255 ||
          /[\\/\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(fileName)
        ) {
          return sendError(res, 400, '請提供有效的 CSV 或 Excel 物流檔案名稱。');
        }
        let defaultShippingMethod;
        try {
          defaultShippingMethod = decodeURIComponent(req.get('x-shipping-method') || '');
        } catch (error) {
          return sendError(res, 400, '預設運送方式格式無效。');
        }
        const file = req.body;
        if (
          !Buffer.isBuffer(file) ||
          file.length < 1 ||
          file.length > MAX_BULK_TRACKING_FILE_BYTES
        ) {
          return sendError(res, 400, '物流檔案不可為空，且大小不可超過 2MB。');
        }

        const parsed = parseBulkTrackingFile(file, fileName, defaultShippingMethod);
        if (parsed.error) {
          return sendError(res, 400, parsed.error);
        }
        const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('bulk_ship_orders', {
          p_shipments: parsed.shipments
        });
        if (error) {
          return handleRpcError(res, error, '批量匯入物流單號');
        }
        if (
          !data ||
          typeof data !== 'object' ||
          !Array.isArray(data.shipments) ||
          !Array.isArray(data.order_ids) ||
          data.shipments.length !== parsed.shipments.length ||
          data.order_ids.length !== parsed.shipments.length
        ) {
          console.error('批量出貨 RPC 回傳格式無效：', data);
          return sendError(res, 500, '批量出貨結果格式無效，請檢查資料庫 RPC。');

            notification = await sendShipmentNotification(orderId);

            console.error('批量出貨後發送 WhatsApp 通知時發生錯誤：', { orderId, error });
            notification = {

            };
          }
          results.push({
            order_number: data.shipments[index].order_number,
            tracking_number: parsed.shipments[index].tracking_number,
            notification
          });
        }

        const failedNotifications = results.filter(result => !result.notification.success).length;
        return res.json({
          success: true,
          data: {
            imported_count: results.length,
            failed_notifications: failedNotifications,
            results
          },
          message: failedNotifications === 0
            ? `已成功匯入 ${results.length} 筆物流單號並發送通知。`

      const orderId = parseOrderId(req.params.orderId);
      if (orderId === null) {
        return sendError(res, 400, '訂單編號格式無效。');
      }

      const body = req.body;
      if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(body)) {
        return sendError(res, 400, '出貨資料格式無效。');
      }

      const shippingMethod = typeof body.shipping_method === 'string'
        ? body.shipping_method.trim()
        : '';
      if (!SHIPPING_METHODS.has(shippingMethod)) {
        return sendError(res, 400, 'shipping_method 必須是面交、自取、順豐或京東。');
      }

      const trackingNumber = typeof body.tracking_number === 'string'
        ? body.tracking_number.trim()
        : '';
      if (!trackingNumber || trackingNumber.length > 100) {
        return sendError(res, 400, 'tracking_number 必須是 1 至 100 個字元。');
      }

      if (body.customer_phone !== undefined && body.customer_phone !== null) {

        if (customerPhone === null) {

        }

        p_tracking_number: trackingNumber,
        p_customer_phone: customerPhone
      });

      if (error) {
        return handleRpcError(res, error, '更新出貨資料');
      }
      if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || data.success !== true) {
        console.error('出貨 RPC 回傳格式無效：', data);
        return sendError(res, 500, '出貨結果格式無效，請檢查資料庫 RPC。');
      }

      const notification = await sendShipmentNotification(orderId);
      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          ...data,
          notification
        },
        message: notification.success
          ? '訂單已標記為已出貨，WhatsApp 通知已發送。'
          : '訂單已標記為已出貨；WhatsApp 通知未能確認送達，可稍後重試。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('更新出貨資料時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '更新出貨資料時發生錯誤，請檢查訂單及通知狀態。');
    }
  });

  router.post('/:orderId/notification/retry', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      const orderId = parseOrderId(req.params.orderId);
      if (orderId === null) {
        return sendError(res, 400, '訂單編號格式無效。');
      }

      const notification = await sendShipmentNotification(orderId);
      if (!notification.success) {
        return res.status(502).json({
          success: false,
          data: { order_id: orderId, notification },
          message: notification.message
        });
      }

      return res.json({
        success: true,
        data: { order_id: orderId, notification },
        message: notification.message
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('重試 WhatsApp 出貨通知時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '重試出貨通知時發生錯誤，請稍後再試。');
    }
  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = createShippingRouter;

    expected.length < 32 ||
    expected.startsWith('replace-with-') ||
    typeof supplied !== 'string'

    return false;
  }

  const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(expected);
  const suppliedBuffer = Buffer.from(supplied);
  return expectedBuffer.length === suppliedBuffer.length &&
    crypto.timingSafeEqual(expectedBuffer, suppliedBuffer);
}

}

        processed: true,
        action: 'order_intent',
        success: false,
        reason: parsed.error && parsed.error.code
      };
    }

    const normalizedCatalog = new Map(
      catalog.map(product => [
        product.product_code.normalize('NFKC').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('en'),
        product
      ])
    );
    const intentItems = parsed.data.items.map(item => {
      const product = normalizedCatalog.get(
        item.product_code.normalize('NFKC').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('en')
      );
      if (!product || typeof product.id !== 'string' && typeof product.id !== 'number') {
        throw new Error('WhatsApp 解析商品缺少有效資料庫識別碼。');
      }
      return {
        product_id: String(product.id),
        product_code: product.product_code,
        quantity: item.quantity
      };
    });

    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('create_whatsapp_order_intent', {
      p_customer_phone: phone,
      p_source_message_id: message.id,
      p_items: intentItems
    });
    if (error) {
      if (error.message === 'STOCK_UNAVAILABLE' || error.message === 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE') {
        await sendWhatsApp({
          to: phone,
          text: error.message === 'STOCK_UNAVAILABLE'
            ? '商品庫存不足，暫時未能建立訂單預覽，請調整數量後再試。'
            : '商品已下架或截單，未能建立訂單預覽。'
        });
        return { processed: true, action: 'order_intent', success: false };
      }
      if (MISSING_RPC_CODES.has(error.code)) {
        throw new Error('WhatsApp 訂單意圖 migration 尚未執行。');
      }
      throw new Error('建立 WhatsApp 訂單意圖失敗。');
    }

    if (
      !data ||
      typeof data !== 'object' ||
      typeof data.success !== 'boolean' ||
      (data.success && (!data.data || typeof data.data !== 'object'))
    ) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 訂單意圖回傳格式無效。');
    }

    if (!data.success) {
      await sendWhatsApp({ to: phone, text: data.message || '未能建立訂單預覽。' });
      return {
        processed: true,
        action: 'order_intent',
        success: false,
        reason: data.code || 'intent_rejected'
      };
    }

    const intent = data.data;
    if (intent.status !== 'pending' || typeof intent.intent_token !== 'string') {
      return {
        processed: true,
        action: 'order_intent',
        duplicate: intent.duplicate === true,
        success: intent.status === 'confirmed'
      };
    }

    if (!Array.isArray(intent.items) || !Number.isFinite(Number(intent.total_amount))) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 訂單意圖預覽資料無效。');
    }

    const expiry = new Date(intent.expires_at);
    if (Number.isNaN(expiry.getTime())) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 訂單意圖過期時間無效。');
    }
    if (expiry.getTime() <= Date.now()) {
      await sendWhatsApp({
        to: phone,
        text: '此訂單預覽已過期，請重新發送商品代號及數量。'
      });
      return {
        processed: true,
        action: 'order_intent',
        duplicate: intent.duplicate === true,
        success: false,
        reason: 'INTENT_EXPIRED'
      };
    }

    const lines = intent.items.map(item =>
      `${item.product_name}（${item.product_code}）× ${item.quantity}：HK$${Number(item.subtotal).toFixed(2)}`
    );

    await sendWhatsApp({
      to: phone,
      text: [
        'LittlePlanet 訂單預覽（尚未落實，暫未扣庫存）：',
        ...lines,
        `合計：HK$${Number(intent.total_amount).toFixed(2)}`,
        `如確認，請於 ${expiry.toLocaleString('zh-HK', { timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong' })} 前回覆：確認 ${intent.intent_token}`,
        '確認後訂單付款狀態為未付款；貨到後付款，出貨前需付清。'
      ].join('\n')
    });
    return {
      processed: true,
      action: 'order_intent',
      duplicate: intent.duplicate === true,
      success: true,
      intent_token: intent.intent_token
    };
  }

  async function handleIncomingMessage(message) {
    const phone = normalizePhone(message && message.from);
    if (!phone || typeof message.id !== 'string' || message.id.length === 0) {
      return { processed: false, reason: 'invalid_sender_or_message_id' };
    }

    if (message.type === 'image') {
      return handlePaymentProofImage(message, phone);
    }

    const text = getMessageText(message);
    if (!text) {
      return { processed: false, reason: 'unsupported_message_type' };
    }

    const confirmationMatch = text.match(
      /^(?:確認|confirm)\s+([0-9a-f-]{36})$/i
    );
    if (confirmationMatch) {
      const intentToken = parseIntentToken(confirmationMatch[1]);
      if (!intentToken) {
        await sendWhatsApp({ to: phone, text: '確認碼格式無效，請使用訂單預覽中的完整確認碼。' });
        return { processed: true, action: 'order_confirmation', success: false };
      }
      return handleOrderConfirmation(phone, intentToken, message);
    }

    const queryMatch = text.match(/^(?:查詢訂單|訂單查詢|查單|訂單)\s+([0-9a-f-]{36})$/i);
    if (queryMatch) {
      const orderId = parseOrderId(queryMatch[1]);
      if (orderId === null) {
        return { processed: false, reason: 'invalid_order_id' };
      }

      const order = await getOrderStatus(phone, orderId);
      const reply = order.found
        ? [
          `訂單 #${order.order_id}`,
          `付款狀態：${order.payment_status}`,
          `出貨狀態：${order.shipping_status}`,
          `出貨方式：${order.shipping_method || '未安排'}`,
          `運單號碼：${order.tracking_number || '未提供'}`,
          ...(Array.isArray(order.items)
            ? order.items.map(item => `${item.product_name} × ${item.quantity}：${item.reconciliation_status}`)
            : [])
        ].join('\n')
        : '未找到與此 WhatsApp 號碼相符的訂單。';

      await sendWhatsApp({ to: phone, text: reply });
      return { processed: true, action: 'order_lookup', order_id: order.found ? order.order_id : null };
    }

    const paymentMatch = text.match(/^(?:付款回報|付款)\s+([0-9a-f-]{36})\s+(.+)$/i);
    if (paymentMatch) {
      const orderId = parseOrderId(paymentMatch[1]);
      const reference = paymentMatch[2].trim();
      if (orderId === null || reference.length === 0 || reference.length > 100) {
        return { processed: false, reason: 'invalid_payment_report' };
      }

      const result = await reportPayment(phone, orderId, reference, message.id);
      const reply = result.found
        ? '已收到付款回報，訂單仍待管理員核實；核實前付款狀態不會變更。'
        : '未找到與此 WhatsApp 號碼相符的訂單，付款回報未建立。';

      await sendWhatsApp({ to: phone, text: reply });
      return {
        processed: true,
        action: 'payment_report',
        order_id: result.found ? orderId : null,
        duplicate: result.duplicate === true
      };
    }

    const orderIntent = await handleOrderIntent(phone, text, message);
    if (orderIntent) {
      return orderIntent;
    }

    await sendWhatsApp({
      to: phone,
      text: 'LittlePlanet 指令：查詢訂單 <UUID訂單編號>、付款回報 <UUID訂單編號> <交易參考編號>，或以「商品代號 x 數量」格式落單。'
    });
    return { processed: true, action: 'help' };
  }

  router.post('/whatsapp', async (req, res) => {
    try {
      if (!writeEnabled) {
        return sendError(res, 503, 'Webhook 尚未設定 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY。');
      }
      if (!hasValidSignature(req)) {
        return sendError(res, 401, 'Webhook 簽名驗證失敗。');
      }

      if (
        !req.body ||
        typeof req.body !== 'object' ||
        Array.isArray(req.body) ||
        req.body.object !== 'whatsapp_business_account' ||
        !Array.isArray(req.body.entry)
      ) {
        return sendError(res, 400, 'Webhook payload 格式無效。');
      }

      const incomingMessages = [];
      for (const entry of req.body.entry) {
        if (!entry || !Array.isArray(entry.changes)) {
          continue;
        }
        for (const change of entry.changes) {
          const value = change && change.value;
          const changeMessages = value && Array.isArray(value.messages)
            ? value.messages
            : [];
          incomingMessages.push(...changeMessages);
        }
      }

      if (incomingMessages.length > 0 && typeof sendWhatsApp !== 'function') {
        return sendError(res, 503, 'WhatsApp 回覆發送器尚未設定。');
      }
      if (
        incomingMessages.some(message => message && message.type === 'image') &&
        (typeof downloadWhatsAppMedia !== 'function' || typeof sendWhatsAppImage !== 'function')
      ) {
        return sendError(res, 503, 'WhatsApp 付款憑證媒體服務尚未設定。');
      }

      const results = [];
      for (const message of incomingMessages) {
        results.push(await handleIncomingMessage(message));
      }

      return res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          processed_count: results.filter(result => result.processed).length,
          ignored_count: results.filter(result => !result.processed).length,
          results
        },
        message: 'WhatsApp webhook 已處理。'
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('處理 WhatsApp webhook 時發生錯誤：', error);
      return sendError(res, 500, '處理 WhatsApp webhook 時發生錯誤，Meta 可安全重試。');
    }
  });

  return router;
}

module.exports = createWebhookRouter;

### File: `supabase\diagnostics\performance_review.sql`

```
SELECT
  schemaname,
  tablename,
  indexname,
  indexdef,
  pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(indexrelid)) AS index_size,
  idx_scan,
  idx_tup_read,
  idx_tup_fetch
FROM pg_stat_user_indexes
WHERE schemaname = 'public'
  AND tablename IN (
    'orders',
    'order_items',
    'products',
    'customers',
    'shipping_notifications',
    'whatsapp_payment_reports'
  )
ORDER BY tablename, indexname;

SELECT
  schemaname,
  relname AS table_name,
  seq_scan,
  seq_tup_read,
  idx_scan,
  n_live_tup AS estimated_live_rows,
  pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) AS total_size
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
WHERE schemaname = 'public'
  AND relname IN (
    'orders',
    'order_items',
    'products',
    'customers',
    'shipping_notifications',
    'whatsapp_payment_reports'
  )
ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC;

```

BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE public.products
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status text;

ALTER TABLE public.products
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS products_status_check;

ALTER TABLE public.products
  ALTER COLUMN status DROP DEFAULT;

ALTER TABLE public.products
  ALTER COLUMN status TYPE text
  USING status::text;

DO $migration$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'products'
      AND column_name = 'is_active'
  ) THEN
    EXECUTE $backfill$
      UPDATE public.products
      SET status = CASE
        WHEN is_active IS FALSE THEN '已下架'
        ELSE '預購中'
      END
      WHERE status IS NULL
         OR status NOT IN ('預購中', '旅購中', '已到貨', '已下架')
    $backfill$;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.products
    SET status = '預購中'
    WHERE status IS NULL
       OR status NOT IN ('預購中', '旅購中', '已到貨', '已下架');
  END IF;
END
$migration$;

ALTER TABLE public.products
  ALTER COLUMN status SET DEFAULT '預購中',
  ALTER COLUMN status SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.products
  ADD CONSTRAINT products_status_check
  CHECK (status IN ('預購中', '旅購中', '已到貨', '已下架'));

COMMIT;

```

BEGIN;

DO $migration$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'orders'
      AND column_name = 'id'
  ) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'orders'
      AND column_name = 'order_id'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.orders RENAME COLUMN id TO order_id;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'order_items'
      AND column_name = 'id'
  ) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'order_items'
      AND column_name = 'item_id'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.order_items RENAME COLUMN id TO item_id;
  END IF;
END
$migration$;

ALTER TABLE public.orders
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customer_id integer,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS order_date timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS payment_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT '未付款',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shipping_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT '待到貨',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shipping_method text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tracking_number varchar(100);

ALTER TABLE public.orders
  ALTER COLUMN order_date SET DEFAULT now(),
  ALTER COLUMN payment_status SET DEFAULT '未付款',
  ALTER COLUMN shipping_status SET DEFAULT '待到貨';

DO $migration$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
      AND table_name = 'orders'
      AND column_name = 'status'
  ) THEN
    EXECUTE $backfill$
      UPDATE public.orders
      SET status = 'pending'
      WHERE status IS NULL
    $backfill$;
    ALTER TABLE public.orders
      ALTER COLUMN status SET DEFAULT 'pending';
  END IF;
END
$migration$;

UPDATE public.orders
SET payment_status = '未付款'
WHERE payment_status IS NULL
   OR payment_status NOT IN ('未付款', '已付訂金', '已付清');

UPDATE public.orders
SET shipping_status = '待到貨'
WHERE shipping_status IS NULL
   OR shipping_status NOT IN ('待到貨', '部分到貨', '可出貨', '已出貨');

ALTER TABLE public.orders
  ALTER COLUMN payment_status SET NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN shipping_status SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.orders
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS orders_payment_status_check,
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS orders_shipping_status_check,
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS orders_shipping_method_check;

ALTER TABLE public.orders
  ADD CONSTRAINT orders_payment_status_check
    CHECK (payment_status IN ('未付款', '已付訂金', '已付清')),
  ADD CONSTRAINT orders_shipping_status_check
    CHECK (shipping_status IN ('待到貨', '部分到貨', '可出貨', '已出貨')),
  ADD CONSTRAINT orders_shipping_method_check
    CHECK (shipping_method IS NULL OR shipping_method IN ('面交', '自取', '順豐', '京東'));

ALTER TABLE public.order_items
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS item_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT '待進貨',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_travel_buy boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

UPDATE public.order_items
SET item_status = '待進貨'
WHERE item_status IS NULL
   OR item_status NOT IN ('待進貨', '已到貨倉', '已出貨');

ALTER TABLE public.order_items
  ALTER COLUMN item_status SET NOT NULL,
  ALTER COLUMN is_travel_buy SET NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE public.order_items
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS order_items_item_status_check;

ALTER TABLE public.order_items
  ADD CONSTRAINT order_items_item_status_check
  CHECK (item_status IN ('待進貨', '已到貨倉', '已出貨'));

DO $migration$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conname = 'order_items_order_id_fkey'
      AND conrelid = 'public.order_items'::regclass
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.order_items
      ADD CONSTRAINT order_items_order_id_fkey
      FOREIGN KEY (order_id)
      REFERENCES public.orders(order_id)
      ON DELETE CASCADE;
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.customers') IS NOT NULL
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM information_schema.columns
       WHERE table_schema = 'public'
         AND table_name = 'customers'
         AND column_name = 'customer_id'
     )
     AND NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM pg_constraint
       WHERE conname = 'orders_customer_id_fkey'
         AND conrelid = 'public.orders'::regclass
     ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.orders
      ADD CONSTRAINT orders_customer_id_fkey
      FOREIGN KEY (customer_id)
      REFERENCES public.customers(customer_id)
      ON DELETE SET NULL;
  END IF;
END
$migration$;

NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

COMMIT;
