BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE public.orders
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS payment_proof_url text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS payment_proof_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shipping_carrier text;

COMMENT ON COLUMN public.orders.payment_proof_url IS
  'Private payment-proofs bucket object path; issue short-lived signed URLs for admin previews.';

UPDATE public.orders
SET payment_proof_status = 'pending'
WHERE payment_proof_status IS NULL
   OR payment_proof_status NOT IN ('pending', 'verified', 'rejected');

UPDATE public.orders
SET shipping_carrier = CASE shipping_method
  WHEN '順豐' THEN 'SF Express'
  WHEN '京東' THEN 'Jump Point'
  ELSE shipping_carrier
END
WHERE tracking_number IS NOT NULL
  AND shipping_method IN ('順豐', '京東');

ALTER TABLE public.orders
  ALTER COLUMN payment_proof_status SET DEFAULT 'pending',
  ALTER COLUMN payment_proof_status SET NOT NULL,
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS orders_payment_proof_status_check,
  ADD CONSTRAINT orders_payment_proof_status_check
    CHECK (payment_proof_status IN ('pending', 'verified', 'rejected'));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_order_shipping_carrier()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = public
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.tracking_number IS NULL OR btrim(NEW.tracking_number) = '' THEN
    NEW.shipping_carrier := NULL;
  ELSIF NEW.shipping_method = '順豐' THEN
    NEW.shipping_carrier := 'SF Express';
  ELSIF NEW.shipping_method = '京東' THEN
    NEW.shipping_carrier := 'Jump Point';
  ELSE
    NEW.shipping_carrier := NULL;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS orders_set_shipping_carrier ON public.orders;
CREATE TRIGGER orders_set_shipping_carrier
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF shipping_method, tracking_number
ON public.orders
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION public.set_order_shipping_carrier();

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.set_order_shipping_carrier() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

INSERT INTO storage.buckets (
  id,
  name,
  public,
  file_size_limit,
  allowed_mime_types
)
VALUES (
  'payment-proofs',
  'payment-proofs',
  false,
  5242880,
  ARRAY['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp']::text[]
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
SET public = false,
    file_size_limit = EXCLUDED.file_size_limit,
    allowed_mime_types = EXCLUDED.allowed_mime_types;

NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

COMMIT;

### File: `supabase\migrations\20261022000300_checkout_contact_and_pickup_memory.sql`

```
BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE public.orders
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customer_name text,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shipping_address text;

ALTER TABLE public.customers
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS default_shipping_address text;

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.create_customer_order(text, jsonb);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_customer_order(
  p_customer_phone text,
  p_items jsonb,
  p_customer_name text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_shipping_method text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_shipping_address text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_item jsonb;
  v_product_id text;
  v_quantity integer;
  v_product record;
  v_order_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_order_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_total numeric(14, 2) := 0;
  v_order_date timestamptz := now();
BEGIN
  IF p_customer_phone IS NULL
     OR p_customer_phone !~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$'
     OR p_items IS NULL
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array'
     OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '結帳資料無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_customer_name IS NOT NULL
     AND (length(p_customer_name) > 100 OR p_customer_name ~ '[[:cntrl:]]') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '收件人姓名無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_shipping_method IS NOT NULL
     AND p_shipping_method NOT IN ('順豐', '自取', '面交', '京東') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '取貨方式無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_shipping_address IS NOT NULL
     AND (length(p_shipping_address) > 200 OR p_shipping_address ~ '[[:cntrl:]]') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '取貨地點或地址無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_shipping_method = '順豐'
     AND p_shipping_address IS NOT NULL
     AND p_shipping_address !~ '^(順豐站|順豐智能櫃)：.+' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '順豐站或智能櫃取貨資料無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS entry(value)
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(entry.value) <> 'object'
       OR COALESCE(entry.value->>'product_id', '') = ''
       OR COALESCE(entry.value->>'quantity', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
       OR CASE
         WHEN COALESCE(entry.value->>'quantity', '') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
           THEN (entry.value->>'quantity')::numeric > 1000
         ELSE false
       END
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '商品編號或數量無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS entry(value)
    GROUP BY lower(entry.value->>'product_id')
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        OR SUM((entry.value->>'quantity')::numeric) > 1000
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '重複商品或商品數量超出限制' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  FOR v_item IN
    SELECT value
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
    ORDER BY value->>'product_id'
  LOOP
    v_product_id := v_item->>'product_id';
    v_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::integer;

    SELECT
      p.id::text AS id,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(p)->>'product_name', ''), NULLIF(to_jsonb(p)->>'name', ''), '未命名商品') AS product_name,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(p)->>'price', '')::numeric, 0)::numeric(14, 2) AS unit_price,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(p)->>'stock', '')::integer, 0) AS stock,
      COALESCE(to_jsonb(p)->>'status', 'active') AS product_status,
      COALESCE(to_jsonb(p)->>'is_active', 'true') AS is_active
    INTO v_product
    FROM public.products AS p
    WHERE lower(p.id::text) = lower(v_product_id)
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND
       OR v_product.product_status IN ('inactive', 'archived', '停用', '下架', '已下架')
       OR v_product.is_active = 'false' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
    IF v_product.stock < v_quantity THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'STOCK_UNAVAILABLE'
        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',
              DETAIL = jsonb_build_object(
                'product_id', v_product_id,
                'product_name', v_product.product_name,
                'requested', v_quantity,
                'available', v_product.stock
              )::text;
    END IF;
    IF v_product.unit_price < 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '商品售價無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;

    v_total := v_total + (v_product.unit_price * v_quantity);
    v_order_items := v_order_items || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'product_id', v_product.id,
      'product_name', v_product.product_name,
      'quantity', v_quantity,
      'unit_price', v_product.unit_price,
      'item_status', '待進貨',
      'is_travel_buy', false
    ));
  END LOOP;

  INSERT INTO public.orders (
    order_id,
    customer_phone,
    customer_name,
    order_date,
    payment_status,
    shipping_status,
    shipping_method,
    shipping_address,
    total_amount
  )
  VALUES (
    v_order_id,
    p_customer_phone,
    NULLIF(btrim(p_customer_name), ''),
    v_order_date,
    '未付款',
    '待到貨',
    p_shipping_method,
    NULLIF(btrim(p_shipping_address), ''),
    v_total
  );

  INSERT INTO public.order_items (
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    item_status,
    is_travel_buy,
    received_quantity
  )
  SELECT
    v_order_id,
    p.id,
    (entry.value->>'quantity')::integer,
    (entry.value->>'unit_price')::numeric,
    entry.value->>'item_status',
    false,
    0
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_order_items) AS entry(value)
  JOIN public.products AS p
    ON lower(p.id::text) = lower(entry.value->>'product_id');

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '訂單明細建立失敗' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  FOR v_item IN
    SELECT value
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
    ORDER BY value->>'product_id'
  LOOP
    v_product_id := v_item->>'product_id';
    v_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::integer;

    UPDATE public.products AS p
    SET stock = p.stock - v_quantity
    WHERE lower(p.id::text) = lower(v_product_id);

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF NULLIF(btrim(p_customer_name), '') IS NOT NULL
     OR p_shipping_method IS NOT NULL
     OR NULLIF(btrim(p_shipping_address), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.customers (
      customer_phone,
      customer_name,
      default_shipping_method,
      default_shipping_address
    )
    VALUES (
      p_customer_phone,
      NULLIF(btrim(p_customer_name), ''),
      p_shipping_method,
      NULLIF(btrim(p_shipping_address), '')
    )
    ON CONFLICT (customer_phone) DO UPDATE
    SET customer_name = COALESCE(
          EXCLUDED.customer_name,
          public.customers.customer_name
        ),
        default_shipping_method = COALESCE(
          EXCLUDED.default_shipping_method,
          public.customers.default_shipping_method
        ),
        default_shipping_address = COALESCE(
          EXCLUDED.default_shipping_address,
          public.customers.default_shipping_address
        );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'order_id', v_order_id,
    'order_date', v_order_date,
    'customer_name', NULLIF(btrim(p_customer_name), ''),
    'shipping_method', p_shipping_method,
    'shipping_address', NULLIF(btrim(p_shipping_address), ''),
    'payment_status', '未付款',
    'shipping_status', '待到貨',
    'total_amount', v_total,
    'items', v_order_items
  );
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.create_customer_order(text, jsonb, text, text, text)
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.create_customer_order(text, jsonb, text, text, text)
  TO service_role;

NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

COMMIT;

```

### File: `supabase\migrations\20261022000400_tiered_pricing_and_review_moderation.sql`

```
BEGIN;

ALTER TABLE public.products
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tier_prices jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS preorder_deadline timestamptz;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.valid_product_tier_prices(
  p_tier_prices jsonb,
  p_base_price numeric
)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
IMMUTABLE
SET search_path = pg_catalog
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_tier jsonb;
  v_min_qty integer;
  v_previous_min_qty integer := 1;
  v_tier_price numeric;
  v_previous_price numeric := p_base_price;
  v_min_text text;
  v_price_text text;
BEGIN
  IF p_tier_prices IS NULL
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_tier_prices) <> 'array'
     OR jsonb_array_length(p_tier_prices) > 20 THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  FOR v_tier IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_tier_prices)
  LOOP
    IF jsonb_typeof(v_tier) <> 'object' THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;
    v_min_text := v_tier->>'min_qty';
    v_price_text := v_tier->>'price';
    IF v_min_text IS NULL
       OR v_min_text !~ '^[2-9][0-9]*$'
       OR v_price_text IS NULL
       OR v_price_text !~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]{1,2})?$' THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;
    v_min_qty := v_min_text::integer;
    v_tier_price := v_price_text::numeric;
    IF v_min_qty > 1000
       OR v_min_qty <= v_previous_min_qty
       OR v_tier_price > v_previous_price THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;
    v_previous_min_qty := v_min_qty;
    v_previous_price := v_tier_price;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN true;
END;
$function$;

ALTER TABLE public.products
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS products_tier_prices_valid_check;
ALTER TABLE public.products
  ADD CONSTRAINT products_tier_prices_valid_check
    CHECK (public.valid_product_tier_prices(tier_prices, price));

ALTER TABLE public.product_reviews
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS order_id uuid REFERENCES public.orders(order_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customer_name text NOT NULL DEFAULT '已驗證買家',
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending';

UPDATE public.product_reviews
SET status = 'approved'
WHERE status = 'pending';

ALTER TABLE public.product_reviews
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS product_reviews_status_check;
ALTER TABLE public.product_reviews
  ADD CONSTRAINT product_reviews_status_check
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')),
  ADD CONSTRAINT product_reviews_customer_name_check
    CHECK (char_length(btrim(customer_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 50);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS product_reviews_status_created_idx
  ON public.product_reviews (status, created_at DESC, review_id DESC);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_product_reviews(
  p_product_id text,
  p_limit integer DEFAULT 20,
  p_offset integer DEFAULT 0
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'average_rating',
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT round(avg(review.rating)::numeric, 2)::double precision
       FROM public.product_reviews AS review
       WHERE review.product_id::text = p_product_id
         AND review.status = 'approved'),
      0
    ),
    'review_count',
    (SELECT count(*)::integer
     FROM public.product_reviews AS review
     WHERE review.product_id::text = p_product_id
       AND review.status = 'approved'),
    'reviews',
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'review_id', page.review_id,
          'product_id', page.product_id::text,
          'rating', page.rating,
          'comment', page.comment,
          'customer_name', page.customer_name,
          'created_at', page.created_at
        )
        ORDER BY page.created_at DESC, page.review_id DESC
      )
       FROM (
         SELECT review.review_id, review.product_id, review.rating,
                review.comment, review.customer_name, review.created_at
         FROM public.product_reviews AS review
         WHERE review.product_id::text = p_product_id
           AND review.status = 'approved'
         ORDER BY review.created_at DESC, review.review_id DESC
         LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 1), 100)
         OFFSET GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, 0), 0)
       ) AS page),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  );
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_product_review_summaries(p_product_ids text[])
RETURNS TABLE (
  product_id text,
  average_rating double precision,
  review_count bigint
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $function$
  SELECT
    review.product_id::text,
    round(avg(review.rating)::numeric, 2)::double precision,
    count(*)::bigint
  FROM public.product_reviews AS review
  WHERE review.status = 'approved'
    AND review.product_id::text = ANY(p_product_ids)
  GROUP BY review.product_id;
$function$;

     OR p_customer_phone !~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$'
     OR p_items IS NULL
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array'
     OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '結帳資料無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_customer_name IS NOT NULL
     AND (length(p_customer_name) > 100 OR p_customer_name ~ '[[:cntrl:]]') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '收件人姓名無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_shipping_method IS NOT NULL
     AND p_shipping_method NOT IN ('順豐', '自取', '面交', '京東') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '取貨方式無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_shipping_address IS NOT NULL
     AND (length(p_shipping_address) > 200 OR p_shipping_address ~ '[[:cntrl:]]') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '取貨地點或地址無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_shipping_method = '順豐'
     AND p_shipping_address IS NOT NULL
     AND p_shipping_address !~ '^(順豐站|順豐智能櫃)：.+' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '順豐站或智能櫃取貨資料無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS entry(value)
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(entry.value) <> 'object'
       OR COALESCE(entry.value->>'product_id', '') = ''
       OR COALESCE(entry.value->>'quantity', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
       OR CASE
         WHEN COALESCE(entry.value->>'quantity', '') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
           THEN (entry.value->>'quantity')::numeric > 1000
         ELSE false
       END
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '商品編號或數量無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS entry(value)
    GROUP BY lower(entry.value->>'product_id')
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        OR SUM((entry.value->>'quantity')::numeric) > 1000
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '重複商品或商品數量超出限制' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  FOR v_item IN
    SELECT value

    v_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::integer;

    SELECT
      p.id::text AS id,

      COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(p)->>'price', '')::numeric, 0)::numeric(14, 2) AS unit_price,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(p)->>'stock', '')::integer, 0) AS stock,

              )::text;
    END IF;
    IF v_product.unit_price < 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '商品售價無效' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;

    v_unit_price := v_product.unit_price;
    FOR v_tier IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_product.tier_prices)
    LOOP
      IF (v_tier->>'min_qty')::integer <= v_quantity THEN
        v_unit_price := (v_tier->>'price')::numeric(14, 2);
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    v_total := v_total + (v_unit_price * v_quantity);
    v_order_items := v_order_items || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'product_id', v_product.id,
      'product_name', v_product.product_name,
      'quantity', v_quantity,
      'unit_price', v_unit_price,
      'item_status', '待進貨',
      'is_travel_buy', false
    ));
  END LOOP;

  INSERT INTO public.orders (
    order_id,
    customer_phone,
    customer_name,
    order_date,
    payment_status,
    shipping_status,
    shipping_method,
    shipping_address,
    total_amount
  )
  VALUES (
    v_order_id,
    p_customer_phone,
    NULLIF(btrim(p_customer_name), ''),
    v_order_date,
    '未付款',
    '待到貨',
    p_shipping_method,
    NULLIF(btrim(p_shipping_address), ''),
    v_total
  );

  INSERT INTO public.order_items (
    order_id,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    item_status,
    is_travel_buy,
    received_quantity
  )
  SELECT
    v_order_id,
    p.id,
    (entry.value->>'quantity')::integer,
    (entry.value->>'unit_price')::numeric,
    entry.value->>'item_status',
    false,
    0
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_order_items) AS entry(value)
  JOIN public.products AS p
    ON lower(p.id::text) = lower(entry.value->>'product_id');

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '訂單明細建立失敗' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  FOR v_item IN
    SELECT value
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
    ORDER BY value->>'product_id'
  LOOP
    UPDATE public.products AS p
    SET stock = p.stock - (v_item->>'quantity')::integer
    WHERE lower(p.id::text) = lower(v_item->>'product_id');

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF NULLIF(btrim(p_customer_name), '') IS NOT NULL
     OR p_shipping_method IS NOT NULL
     OR NULLIF(btrim(p_shipping_address), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.customers (
      customer_phone,
      customer_name,
      default_shipping_method,
      default_shipping_address
    )
    VALUES (
      p_customer_phone,
      NULLIF(btrim(p_customer_name), ''),
      p_shipping_method,
      NULLIF(btrim(p_shipping_address), '')
    )
    ON CONFLICT (customer_phone) DO UPDATE
    SET customer_name = COALESCE(
          EXCLUDED.customer_name,
          public.customers.customer_name
        ),
        default_shipping_method = COALESCE(
          EXCLUDED.default_shipping_method,
          public.customers.default_shipping_method
        ),
        default_shipping_address = COALESCE(
          EXCLUDED.default_shipping_address,
          public.customers.default_shipping_address
        );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'order_id', v_order_id,
    'order_date', v_order_date,
    'customer_name', NULLIF(btrim(p_customer_name), ''),
    'shipping_method', p_shipping_method,
    'shipping_address', NULLIF(btrim(p_shipping_address), ''),
    'payment_status', '未付款',
    'shipping_status', '待到貨',
    'total_amount', v_total,
    'items', v_order_items
  );
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.adjust_product_inventory(
  p_product_id bigint,
  p_quantity_delta integer,
  p_reason text,
  p_note text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_actor text DEFAULT 'admin'
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_product public.products%ROWTYPE;
  v_after integer;
  v_adjustment public.inventory_adjustments%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_product_id IS NULL OR p_product_id <= 0
     OR p_quantity_delta IS NULL
     OR p_quantity_delta = 0
     OR abs(p_quantity_delta::bigint) > 100000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '商品編號或庫存調整數量無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_reason IS NULL OR p_reason NOT IN ('損毀', '員工自用', '實體盤點差異', '其他') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '庫存調整原因無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_note IS NOT NULL AND (
    length(p_note) > 500 OR p_note ~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '庫存調整備註格式無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_product
  FROM public.products
  WHERE id = p_product_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '找不到指定商品'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0) + p_quantity_delta < 0
     OR COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0) + p_quantity_delta > 2147483647 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '調整後庫存不可小於零或超出可儲存範圍'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  v_after := COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0) + p_quantity_delta;

  UPDATE public.products
  SET stock = v_after
  WHERE id = p_product_id;

  INSERT INTO public.inventory_adjustments (
    product_id,
    quantity_before,
    quantity_delta,
    quantity_after,
    reason,
    note,
    actor
  )
  VALUES (
    p_product_id,
    COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0),
    p_quantity_delta,
    v_after,
    p_reason,
    NULLIF(btrim(p_note), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_actor), ''), 'admin')
  )
  RETURNING * INTO v_adjustment;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'adjustment_id', v_adjustment.adjustment_id,
    'product_id', p_product_id,
    'quantity_before', v_adjustment.quantity_before,
    'quantity_delta', v_adjustment.quantity_delta,
    'quantity_after', v_adjustment.quantity_after,
    'reason', v_adjustment.reason,
    'note', v_adjustment.note,
    'created_at', v_adjustment.created_at
  );
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.adjust_product_inventory(bigint, integer, text, text, text)
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.adjust_product_inventory(bigint, integer, text, text, text)
  TO service_role;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_product_inventory(
  p_product_id bigint,
  p_stock integer,
  p_reason text,
  p_note text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_actor text DEFAULT 'admin'
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_product public.products%ROWTYPE;
  v_delta integer;
  v_adjustment public.inventory_adjustments%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_product_id IS NULL OR p_product_id <= 0
     OR p_stock IS NULL OR p_stock < 0
     OR p_reason IS NULL
     OR p_reason NOT IN ('損毀', '員工自用', '實體盤點差異', '其他') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '商品編號、庫存數量或調整原因無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_note IS NOT NULL AND (
    length(p_note) > 500 OR p_note ~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '庫存調整備註格式無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_product
  FROM public.products
  WHERE id = p_product_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '找不到指定商品'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  v_delta := p_stock - COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0);
  IF v_delta = 0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'stock', p_stock,
      'quantity_before', p_stock,
      'quantity_delta', 0,
      'quantity_after', p_stock,
      'adjustment_id', NULL,
      'reason', p_reason,
      'note', NULLIF(btrim(p_note), '')
    );
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.products
  SET stock = p_stock
  WHERE id = p_product_id;

  INSERT INTO public.inventory_adjustments (
    product_id,
    quantity_before,
    quantity_delta,
    quantity_after,
    reason,
    note,
    actor
  )
  VALUES (
    p_product_id,
    COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0),
    v_delta,
    p_stock,
    p_reason,
    NULLIF(btrim(p_note), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_actor), ''), 'admin')
  )
  RETURNING * INTO v_adjustment;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'stock', p_stock,
    'quantity_before', v_adjustment.quantity_before,
    'quantity_delta', v_adjustment.quantity_delta,
    'quantity_after', v_adjustment.quantity_after,
    'adjustment_id', v_adjustment.adjustment_id,
    'reason', v_adjustment.reason,
    'note', v_adjustment.note,
    'created_at', v_adjustment.created_at
  );
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.set_product_inventory(bigint, integer, text, text, text)
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.set_product_inventory(bigint, integer, text, text, text)
  TO service_role;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_product_inventory_alerts(
  p_safety_stock integer DEFAULT 3,
  p_target_stock integer DEFAULT 10,
  p_slow_days integer DEFAULT 30
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  product_id text,
  product_name text,
  stock integer,
  safety_stock integer,
  suggested_restock_quantity integer,
  last_order_date timestamptz,
  days_since_last_order integer,
  is_restock_needed boolean,
  is_slow_moving boolean
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_safety_stock IS NULL OR p_safety_stock < 0 OR p_safety_stock > 100000
     OR p_target_stock IS NULL OR p_target_stock < 1 OR p_target_stock > 100000
     OR p_target_stock < p_safety_stock
     OR p_slow_days IS NULL OR p_slow_days < 1 OR p_slow_days > 3650 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '庫存警示查詢參數無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH last_sales AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id, max(o.order_date) AS last_order_date
    FROM public.order_items AS oi
    JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
  ),
  inventory AS (
    SELECT
      p.id::text AS product_id,
      COALESCE(p.product_name, p.name, '未命名商品')::text AS product_name,
      COALESCE(p.stock, 0)::integer AS stock,
      p.created_at,
      last_sales.last_order_date
    FROM public.products AS p
    LEFT JOIN last_sales ON last_sales.product_id = p.id
    WHERE COALESCE(p.status, '') <> '已下架'
  )
  SELECT
    inventory.product_id,
    inventory.product_name,
    inventory.stock,
    p_safety_stock,
    GREATEST(p_target_stock - inventory.stock, 0),
    inventory.last_order_date,
    CASE
      WHEN inventory.last_order_date IS NULL THEN
        GREATEST((CURRENT_DATE - inventory.created_at::date)::integer, 0)
      ELSE GREATEST((CURRENT_DATE - inventory.last_order_date::date)::integer, 0)
    END,
    inventory.stock <= p_safety_stock,
    CASE
      WHEN inventory.last_order_date IS NULL THEN
        inventory.created_at < now() - make_interval(days => p_slow_days)
      ELSE inventory.last_order_date < now() - make_interval(days => p_slow_days)
    END
  FROM inventory
  WHERE inventory.stock <= p_safety_stock
     OR CASE
       WHEN inventory.last_order_date IS NULL THEN
         inventory.created_at < now() - make_interval(days => p_slow_days)
       ELSE inventory.last_order_date < now() - make_interval(days => p_slow_days)
     END
  ORDER BY
    (inventory.stock <= p_safety_stock) DESC,
    CASE
      WHEN inventory.last_order_date IS NULL THEN inventory.created_at
      ELSE inventory.last_order_date
    END ASC,
    inventory.product_name;
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.get_product_inventory_alerts(integer, integer, integer)
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_product_inventory_alerts(integer, integer, integer)
  TO service_role;

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.list_admin_customers(text, integer, integer);

CREATE FUNCTION public.list_admin_customers(
  p_search text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_limit integer DEFAULT 50,
  p_offset integer DEFAULT 0
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  customer_phone text,
  customer_name text,
  credit_status text,
  default_shipping_method text,
  notes text,
  created_at timestamptz,
  total_orders bigint,
  total_spent numeric,
  tags text[]
)
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
  WITH customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
      c.id,
      c.customer_phone,
      c.customer_name,
      c.credit_status,
      c.default_shipping_method,
      c.notes,
      c.created_at,
      COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)::bigint AS total_orders,
      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0)::numeric AS total_spent
    FROM public.customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_phone = c.customer_phone
    WHERE p_search IS NULL
       OR c.customer_phone ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
       OR COALESCE(c.customer_name, '') ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
    GROUP BY c.id
  ),
  customer_product_counts AS (
    SELECT
      customer.customer_phone,
      p.product_name,
      p.name,
      COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS purchase_count
    FROM public.customers AS customer
    JOIN public.orders AS o ON o.customer_phone = customer.customer_phone
    JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN public.products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE p_search IS NULL
       OR customer.customer_phone ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
       OR COALESCE(customer.customer_name, '') ILIKE '%' || p_search || '%'
    GROUP BY customer.customer_phone, p.product_name, p.name
  ),
  preferences AS (
    SELECT
      ranked.customer_phone,
      array_agg(
        '#喜歡' || left(COALESCE(ranked.product_name, ranked.name, '商品'), 20)
        ORDER BY ranked.purchase_count DESC, COALESCE(ranked.product_name, ranked.name)
      ) AS tags
    FROM (
      SELECT
        counts.*,
        row_number() OVER (
          PARTITION BY counts.customer_phone
          ORDER BY counts.purchase_count DESC, COALESCE(counts.product_name, counts.name)
        ) AS preference_rank
      FROM customer_product_counts AS counts
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE ranked.preference_rank <= 2
    GROUP BY ranked.customer_phone
  )
  SELECT
    totals.id,
    totals.customer_phone,
    totals.customer_name,
    totals.credit_status,
    totals.default_shipping_method,
    totals.notes,
    totals.created_at,
    totals.total_orders,
    totals.total_spent,
    array_remove(
      ARRAY[
        CASE WHEN totals.total_orders >= 5 THEN '#熟客VIP' END,
        CASE WHEN totals.total_spent >= 5000 THEN '#高消費客群' END
      ]::text[] || COALESCE(preferences.tags, ARRAY[]::text[]),
      NULL
    ) AS tags
  FROM customer_totals AS totals
  LEFT JOIN preferences ON preferences.customer_phone = totals.customer_phone
  ORDER BY totals.created_at DESC, totals.id
  LIMIT p_limit
  OFFSET p_offset;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.list_admin_customers(text, integer, integer)
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.list_admin_customers(text, integer, integer)
  TO service_role;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bulk_ship_orders(p_shipments jsonb)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_item jsonb;
  v_order_id text;
  v_order_ids text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
  v_seen_order_numbers text[] := ARRAY[]::text[];
  v_result jsonb;
  v_results jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_order_number text;
  v_tracking_number text;
  v_shipping_method text;
BEGIN
  IF p_shipments IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_shipments) <> 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '物流匯入必須是 JSON 陣列'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(p_shipments) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '物流匯入必須包含 1 至 100 筆資料'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_shipments) LOOP
    v_order_number := upper(btrim(v_item->>'order_number'));
    v_tracking_number := btrim(v_item->>'tracking_number');
    v_shipping_method := btrim(v_item->>'shipping_method');
    IF v_order_number IS NULL OR v_order_number = ''
       OR length(v_order_number) > 100
       OR v_tracking_number IS NULL OR v_tracking_number = ''
       OR length(v_tracking_number) > 100
       OR v_shipping_method IS NULL
       OR v_shipping_method NOT IN ('面交', '自取', '順豐', '京東') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '物流匯入包含無效訂單編號、運單號或運送方式'
        USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    IF v_order_number = ANY(v_seen_order_numbers) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '物流匯入包含重複訂單編號 %', v_order_number
        USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;
    v_seen_order_numbers := array_append(v_seen_order_numbers, v_order_number);

    SELECT order_row.order_id::text
      INTO v_order_id
    FROM public.orders AS order_row
    WHERE upper(btrim(order_row.order_number)) = v_order_number
    FOR UPDATE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '找不到訂單編號 %', v_order_number
        USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
    END IF;
    v_order_ids := array_append(v_order_ids, v_order_id);

    v_result := public.ship_order(
      v_order_id,
      v_shipping_method,
      v_tracking_number,
      NULL
    );
    IF COALESCE((v_result->>'success')::boolean, false) IS NOT TRUE THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '訂單 % 出貨未成功', v_order_number
        USING ERRCODE = '55000';
    END IF;
    v_results := v_results || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'order_number', v_order_number,
      'shipment', v_result->'shipment'
    ));
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'shipments', v_results,
    'order_ids', to_jsonb(v_order_ids)
  );
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.bulk_ship_orders(jsonb)
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.bulk_ship_orders(jsonb) TO service_role;

NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

COMMIT;

BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.whatsapp_order_intents (
  intent_id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  intent_token uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  source_message_id text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  confirmation_message_id text UNIQUE,
  customer_phone text NOT NULL,
  items jsonb NOT NULL,
  total_amount numeric(14, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (total_amount >= 0),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + interval '15 minutes'),
  order_id uuid REFERENCES public.orders(order_id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  order_number text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  confirmed_at timestamptz,
  CONSTRAINT whatsapp_order_intents_phone_check
    CHECK (customer_phone ~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$'),
  CONSTRAINT whatsapp_order_intents_items_check
    CHECK (
      CASE
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(items) = 'array'
          THEN jsonb_array_length(items) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        ELSE false
      END
    ),
  CONSTRAINT whatsapp_order_intents_status_check
    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'expired'))
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS whatsapp_order_intents_phone_pending_idx
  ON public.whatsapp_order_intents (customer_phone, created_at DESC)
  WHERE status = 'pending';

ALTER TABLE public.whatsapp_order_intents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.whatsapp_order_intents FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON TABLE public.whatsapp_order_intents TO service_role;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_whatsapp_order_catalog()
RETURNS SETOF jsonb
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'id', product.id::text,
    'product_code', to_jsonb(product)->>'product_code',
    'product_name', COALESCE(
      NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'product_name', ''),
      NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'name', ''),
      '未命名商品'
    ),
    'price', COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'price', '')::numeric, 0),
    'stock', COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'stock', '')::integer, 0),
    'status', COALESCE(to_jsonb(product)->>'status', 'active'),
    'is_active', COALESCE(to_jsonb(product)->>'is_active', 'true')::boolean,
    'tier_prices', COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'tier_prices', '')::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb),
    'preorder_deadline', NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'preorder_deadline', '')
  )
  FROM public.products AS product
  WHERE NULLIF(btrim(to_jsonb(product)->>'product_code'), '') IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY product.id;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_whatsapp_order_intent(
  p_customer_phone text,
  p_source_message_id text,
  p_items jsonb
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_existing public.whatsapp_order_intents%ROWTYPE;
  v_intent public.whatsapp_order_intents%ROWTYPE;
  v_input jsonb;
  v_product record;
  v_tier jsonb;
  v_items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_product_id text;
  v_product_code text;
  v_quantity integer;
  v_unit_price numeric(14, 2);
  v_total numeric(14, 2) := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_customer_phone IS NULL
     OR p_customer_phone !~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$'
     OR p_source_message_id IS NULL
     OR length(btrim(p_source_message_id)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 255
     OR p_items IS NULL
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'WhatsApp 訂單意圖資料無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF jsonb_array_length(p_items) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'WhatsApp 訂單意圖商品數量無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_existing
  FROM public.whatsapp_order_intents
  WHERE source_message_id = p_source_message_id;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_existing.customer_phone <> p_customer_phone THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', false,
        'data', NULL,
        'message', '訊息 ID 已被其他客戶使用。',
        'code', 'MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT'
      );
    END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', true,
      'data', jsonb_build_object(
        'duplicate', true,
        'status', v_existing.status,
        'intent_token', v_existing.intent_token,
        'items', v_existing.items,
        'total_amount', v_existing.total_amount,
        'expires_at', v_existing.expires_at
      ),
      'message', '此 WhatsApp 訊息已處理。'
    );
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS entry(value)
    WHERE jsonb_typeof(entry.value) <> 'object'
       OR COALESCE(entry.value->>'product_id', '') = ''
       OR COALESCE(entry.value->>'product_code', '') = ''
       OR COALESCE(entry.value->>'quantity', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
       OR CASE
         WHEN COALESCE(entry.value->>'quantity', '') ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
           THEN (entry.value->>'quantity')::numeric > 1000
         ELSE false
       END
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'WhatsApp 訂單商品或數量無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS entry(value)
    GROUP BY lower(entry.value->>'product_id')
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        OR SUM((entry.value->>'quantity')::numeric) > 1000
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'WhatsApp 訂單包含重複商品或超量商品'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  FOR v_input IN
    SELECT value
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
    ORDER BY value->>'product_id'
  LOOP
    v_product_id := v_input->>'product_id';
    v_product_code := v_input->>'product_code';
    v_quantity := (v_input->>'quantity')::integer;

    SELECT
      product.id::text AS id,
      to_jsonb(product)->>'product_code' AS product_code,
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'product_name', ''),
        NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'name', ''),
        '未命名商品'
      ) AS product_name,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'price', '')::numeric, 0)::numeric(14, 2) AS price,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'stock', '')::integer, 0) AS stock,
      COALESCE(to_jsonb(product)->>'status', 'active') AS product_status,
      COALESCE(to_jsonb(product)->>'is_active', 'true')::boolean AS is_active,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'tier_prices', '')::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb) AS tier_prices,
      NULLIF(to_jsonb(product)->>'preorder_deadline', '')::timestamptz AS preorder_deadline
    INTO v_product
    FROM public.products AS product
    WHERE product.id::text = v_product_id
    FOR SHARE;

    IF NOT FOUND
       OR v_product.product_code IS DISTINCT FROM v_product_code
       OR v_product.product_status IN ('inactive', 'archived', '停用', '下架', '已下架')
       OR NOT v_product.is_active
       OR v_product.preorder_deadline IS NOT NULL
          AND v_product.preorder_deadline <= now() THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', false,
        'data', NULL,
        'message', '商品已下架、截單或資料已變更，請重新提交。',
        'code', 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE'
      );
    END IF;

    IF v_product.stock < v_quantity THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', false,
        'data', jsonb_build_object(
          'product_code', v_product.product_code,
          'available', v_product.stock,
          'requested', v_quantity
        ),
        'message', '商品庫存不足，請調整數量後再試。',
        'code', 'STOCK_UNAVAILABLE'
      );
    END IF;
    IF v_product.price < 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION '商品售價無效'
        USING ERRCODE = '22023';
    END IF;

    v_unit_price := v_product.price;
    FOR v_tier IN
      SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_product.tier_prices)
    LOOP
      IF (v_tier->>'min_qty')::integer <= v_quantity THEN
        v_unit_price := (v_tier->>'price')::numeric(14, 2);
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    v_total := v_total + (v_unit_price * v_quantity);
    v_items := v_items || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'product_id', v_product.id,
      'product_code', v_product.product_code,
      'product_name', v_product.product_name,
      'quantity', v_quantity,
      'unit_price', v_unit_price,
      'subtotal', v_unit_price * v_quantity
    ));
  END LOOP;

  INSERT INTO public.whatsapp_order_intents (
    source_message_id,
    customer_phone,
    items,
    total_amount
  )
  VALUES (
    p_source_message_id,
    p_customer_phone,
    v_items,
    v_total
  )
  ON CONFLICT (source_message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING * INTO v_intent;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    SELECT *
    INTO v_existing
    FROM public.whatsapp_order_intents
    WHERE source_message_id = p_source_message_id;

    IF NOT FOUND OR v_existing.customer_phone <> p_customer_phone THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', false,
        'data', NULL,
        'message', '訊息 ID 已被其他客戶使用。',
        'code', 'MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT'
      );
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', true,
      'data', jsonb_build_object(
        'duplicate', true,
        'status', v_existing.status,
        'intent_token', v_existing.intent_token,
        'items', v_existing.items,
        'total_amount', v_existing.total_amount,
        'expires_at', v_existing.expires_at
      ),
      'message', '此 WhatsApp 訊息已處理。'
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'data', jsonb_build_object(
      'duplicate', false,
      'status', v_intent.status,
      'intent_token', v_intent.intent_token,
      'items', v_intent.items,
      'total_amount', v_intent.total_amount,
      'expires_at', v_intent.expires_at
    ),
    'message', '訂單預覽已建立，等待客戶確認。'
  );
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.confirm_whatsapp_order_intent(
  p_customer_phone text,
  p_intent_token uuid,
  p_confirmation_message_id text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_intent public.whatsapp_order_intents%ROWTYPE;
  v_existing public.whatsapp_order_intents%ROWTYPE;
  v_order jsonb;
  v_order_id uuid;
  v_order_number text;
BEGIN
  IF p_customer_phone IS NULL
     OR p_customer_phone !~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$'
     OR p_intent_token IS NULL
     OR p_confirmation_message_id IS NULL
     OR length(btrim(p_confirmation_message_id)) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 255 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'WhatsApp 訂單確認資料無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_existing
  FROM public.whatsapp_order_intents
  WHERE confirmation_message_id = p_confirmation_message_id;

  IF FOUND THEN
    IF v_existing.customer_phone <> p_customer_phone THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', false,
        'data', NULL,
        'message', '確認訊息 ID 已被其他客戶使用。',
        'code', 'MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT'
      );
    END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', true,
      'data', jsonb_build_object(
        'duplicate', true,
        'status', v_existing.status,
        'order_number', v_existing.order_number
      ),
      'message', '此確認訊息已處理。'
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_intent
  FROM public.whatsapp_order_intents
  WHERE customer_phone = p_customer_phone
    AND intent_token = p_intent_token
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'data', NULL,
      'message', '找不到此電話號碼對應的待確認訂單。',
      'code', 'INTENT_NOT_FOUND'
    );
  END IF;

  IF v_intent.status = 'confirmed' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', true,
      'data', jsonb_build_object(
        'duplicate', true,
        'status', v_intent.status,
        'order_number', v_intent.order_number
      ),
      'message', '此訂單已確認。'
    );
  END IF;

  IF v_intent.status = 'expired' OR v_intent.expires_at <= now() THEN
    UPDATE public.whatsapp_order_intents
    SET status = 'expired'
    WHERE intent_id = v_intent.intent_id
      AND status = 'pending';
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'data', NULL,
      'message', '訂單預覽已過期，請重新提交商品。',
      'code', 'INTENT_EXPIRED'
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT public.create_customer_order(
    p_customer_phone,
    (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'product_id', item.value->>'product_id',
        'quantity', (item.value->>'quantity')::integer
      ))
      FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_intent.items) AS item(value)
    ),
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL
  )
  INTO v_order;

  v_order_id := NULLIF(v_order->>'order_id', '')::uuid;
  IF v_order_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '結帳 RPC 未回傳有效訂單識別碼'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  v_order_number := v_order->>'order_number';
  IF v_order_number IS NULL
     OR v_order_number !~* '^LP-[0-9]{8}-[A-F0-9]{8}$'
     OR v_order_number ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f-]{27}$' THEN
    v_order_number := 'LP-' ||
      to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Hong_Kong', 'YYYYMMDD') ||
      '-' || upper(substr(md5(gen_random_uuid()::text), 1, 8));
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.orders
  SET order_number = v_order_number
  WHERE order_id = v_order_id
    AND (
      order_number IS NULL
      OR btrim(order_number) = ''
      OR order_number !~* '^LP-[0-9]{8}-[A-F0-9]{8}$'
    )
  RETURNING order_number INTO v_order_number;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    SELECT order_number
    INTO v_order_number
    FROM public.orders
    WHERE order_id = v_order_id;
  END IF;

  IF v_order_number IS NULL
     OR v_order_number !~* '^LP-[0-9]{8}-[A-F0-9]{8}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '無法產生有效正式訂單編號'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.whatsapp_order_intents
  SET status = 'confirmed',
      confirmation_message_id = p_confirmation_message_id,
      order_id = v_order_id,
      order_number = v_order_number,
      confirmed_at = now()
  WHERE intent_id = v_intent.intent_id
    AND status = 'pending';

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '訂單意圖狀態已變更，無法完成確認'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'data', jsonb_build_object(
      'duplicate', false,
      'status', 'confirmed',
      'order_number', v_order_number,
      'total_amount', v_order->'total_amount'
    ),
    'message', '訂單已建立，付款狀態為未付款。'
  );
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.list_whatsapp_order_catalog() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.create_whatsapp_order_intent(text, text, jsonb) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.confirm_whatsapp_order_intent(text, uuid, text) FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.list_whatsapp_order_catalog() TO service_role;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.create_whatsapp_order_intent(text, text, jsonb) TO service_role;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.confirm_whatsapp_order_intent(text, uuid, text) TO service_role;

NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

COMMIT;

```

### File: `supabase\migrations\20261023000200_whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts.sql`

```
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts (
  message_id text PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_phone text NOT NULL,
  order_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.orders(order_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  order_number text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'processing'
    CHECK (status IN ('processing', 'pending_review', 'failed')),
  object_path text,
  notification_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
    CHECK (notification_status IN ('pending', 'not_configured', 'sent', 'failed')),
  notification_error text,
  processing_error text,
  claimed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

ALTER TABLE public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts_order_id_idx
  ON public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts (order_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_whatsapp_payment_proof(
  p_message_id text,
  p_customer_phone text,
  p_order_number text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_phone text;
  v_local_phone text;
  v_phones text[];
  v_order_id public.orders.order_id%TYPE;
  v_order_number text;
  v_proof_status text;
  v_match_count integer;
  v_receipt public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts%ROWTYPE;
  v_inserted boolean := false;
BEGIN
  v_phone := regexp_replace(COALESCE(p_customer_phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g');
  v_order_number := upper(btrim(COALESCE(p_order_number, '')));
  IF p_message_id IS NULL
     OR p_message_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,256}$'
     OR v_phone !~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$'
     OR v_order_number !~ '^LP-[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{0,96}$' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'data', NULL,
      'message', '付款憑證資料格式無效。',
      'code', 'INVALID_INPUT'
    );
  END IF;

  v_local_phone := CASE
    WHEN length(v_phone) = 11 AND left(v_phone, 3) = '852' THEN substr(v_phone, 4)
    ELSE v_phone
  END;
  v_phones := ARRAY[v_phone, v_local_phone, '852' || v_local_phone];

  SELECT count(*)
    INTO v_match_count
  FROM public.orders AS o
  WHERE upper(o.order_number) = upper(btrim(p_order_number))
    AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(o.customer_phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = ANY(v_phones);

  IF v_match_count = 0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'data', NULL,
      'message', '找不到符合此電話及訂單編號的訂單。',
      'code', 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND'
    );
  END IF;
  IF v_match_count <> 1 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'data', NULL,
      'message', '訂單資料無法唯一識別，請聯絡管理員。',
      'code', 'AMBIGUOUS_ORDER'
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_number, o.payment_proof_status
    INTO v_order_id, v_order_number, v_proof_status
  FROM public.orders AS o
  WHERE upper(o.order_number) = upper(btrim(p_order_number))
    AND regexp_replace(COALESCE(o.customer_phone, ''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = ANY(v_phones);

  IF v_proof_status = 'verified' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'data', NULL,
      'message', '此訂單付款憑證已核實，不能重新提交。',
      'code', 'PROOF_ALREADY_VERIFIED'
    );
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts (
    message_id, customer_phone, order_id, order_number
  )
  VALUES (p_message_id, v_phone, v_order_id, upper(btrim(p_order_number)))
  ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING true INTO v_inserted;

  IF NOT COALESCE(v_inserted, false) THEN
    SELECT *
      INTO v_receipt
    FROM public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts
    WHERE message_id = p_message_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_receipt.customer_phone <> v_phone
       OR upper(v_receipt.order_number) <> upper(btrim(p_order_number)) THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', false,
        'data', NULL,
        'message', 'WhatsApp 訊息 ID 已被其他資料使用。',
        'code', 'MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT'
      );
    END IF;
    IF v_receipt.status = 'pending_review'
       OR (v_receipt.status = 'processing' AND v_receipt.claimed_at > now() - interval '5 minutes') THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'data', jsonb_build_object(
          'order_id', v_receipt.order_id,
          'order_number', v_receipt.order_number,
          'duplicate', true
        ),
        'message', '此 WhatsApp 訊息已處理。'
      );
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts
    SET status = 'processing',
        processing_error = NULL,
        claimed_at = now(),
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE message_id = p_message_id
    RETURNING * INTO v_receipt;
    v_order_id := v_receipt.order_id;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'data', jsonb_build_object(
      'order_id', v_order_id,
      'order_number', upper(btrim(p_order_number)),
      'duplicate', false
    ),
    'message', '付款憑證訂單已驗證。'
  );
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_whatsapp_payment_proof(
  p_message_id text,
  p_object_path text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_receipt public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts%ROWTYPE;
  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_old_path text;
BEGIN
  IF p_message_id IS NULL OR p_object_path IS NULL OR length(p_object_path) > 512 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'data', NULL, 'message', '付款憑證路徑無效。');
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_receipt
  FROM public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts
  WHERE message_id = p_message_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_receipt.status <> 'processing' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'data', NULL, 'message', '付款憑證處理狀態無效。');
  END IF;
  IF split_part(p_object_path, '/', 1) <> v_receipt.order_id::text THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'data', NULL, 'message', '付款憑證未能連結至指定訂單。');
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_order
  FROM public.orders
  WHERE order_id = v_receipt.order_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_order.payment_proof_status = 'verified' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'data', NULL, 'message', '訂單不存在或憑證已核實。');
  END IF;

  v_old_path := v_order.payment_proof_url;
  UPDATE public.orders
  SET payment_proof_url = p_object_path,
      payment_proof_status = 'pending'
  WHERE order_id = v_order.order_id;

  UPDATE public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts
  SET status = 'pending_review',
      object_path = p_object_path,
      processing_error = NULL,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE message_id = p_message_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'data', jsonb_build_object(
      'order_number', v_order.order_number,
      'old_proof_path', v_old_path,
      'payment_proof_status', 'pending'
    ),
    'message', '付款憑證已儲存並等待管理員審核。'
  );
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fail_whatsapp_payment_proof(
  p_message_id text,
  p_error text
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts
  SET status = 'failed',
      processing_error = left(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_error), ''), '付款憑證處理失敗'), 500),
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE message_id = p_message_id
    AND status = 'processing';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'data', NULL, 'message', '付款憑證目前不可標記失敗。');
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'data', NULL, 'message', '付款憑證處理失敗已記錄。');
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_whatsapp_payment_proof_notification(
  p_message_id text,
  p_status text,
  p_error text DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_status IS NULL OR p_status NOT IN ('not_configured', 'sent', 'failed') THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'data', NULL, 'message', '內部通知狀態無效。');
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.whatsapp_payment_proof_receipts
  SET notification_status = p_status,
      notification_error = CASE
        WHEN p_status = 'failed' THEN left(COALESCE(p_error, '內部通知失敗'), 500)
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE message_id = p_message_id
    AND status = 'pending_review';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'data', NULL, 'message', '付款憑證審核記錄不存在。');
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'data', jsonb_build_object('status', p_status), 'message', '內部通知狀態已更新。');
END;
$function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_paid_before_shipment()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = public
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.shipping_status = '已出貨'
     AND NEW.payment_status IS DISTINCT FROM '已付清' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '訂單必須已付清才可出貨'
      USING ERRCODE = '55000';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS orders_require_paid_before_shipment ON public.orders;
CREATE TRIGGER orders_require_paid_before_shipment
BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF shipping_status, payment_status
ON public.orders
FOR EACH ROW
EXECUTE FUNCTION public.enforce_paid_before_shipment();

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.enforce_paid_before_shipment() FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

COMMIT;

BEGIN;

DO $migration$
DECLARE
  product_id_type text;

      quantity_after integer NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_after >= 0),
      reason text NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN (
        ''損毀'', ''員工自用'', ''實體盤點差異'', ''其他''

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.adjust_product_inventory(
  p_product_id text,
  p_quantity_delta integer,
  p_reason text,
  p_note text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_actor text DEFAULT 'admin'
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_product public.products%ROWTYPE;
  v_after integer;
  v_adjustment public.inventory_adjustments%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_product_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_product_id) = ''
     OR p_quantity_delta IS NULL
     OR p_quantity_delta = 0
     OR abs(p_quantity_delta::bigint) > 100000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '商品編號或庫存調整數量無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_reason IS NULL OR p_reason NOT IN ('損毀', '員工自用', '實體盤點差異', '其他') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '庫存調整原因無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_note IS NOT NULL AND (
    length(p_note) > 500 OR p_note ~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '庫存調整備註格式無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_product
  FROM public.products
  WHERE id::text = p_product_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '找不到指定商品'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0) + p_quantity_delta < 0
     OR COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0) + p_quantity_delta > 2147483647 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '調整後庫存不可小於零或超出可儲存範圍'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  v_after := COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0) + p_quantity_delta;

  UPDATE public.products
  SET stock = v_after
  WHERE id::text = p_product_id;

  INSERT INTO public.inventory_adjustments (
    product_id,
    quantity_before,
    quantity_delta,
    quantity_after,
    reason,
    note,
    actor
  )
  VALUES (
    v_product.id,
    COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0),
    p_quantity_delta,
    v_after,
    p_reason,
    NULLIF(btrim(p_note), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_actor), ''), 'admin')
  )
  RETURNING * INTO v_adjustment;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'adjustment_id', v_adjustment.adjustment_id,
    'product_id', v_product.id,
    'quantity_before', v_adjustment.quantity_before,
    'quantity_delta', v_adjustment.quantity_delta,
    'quantity_after', v_adjustment.quantity_after,
    'reason', v_adjustment.reason,
    'note', v_adjustment.note,
    'created_at', v_adjustment.created_at
  );
END;
$function$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.adjust_product_inventory(text, integer, text, text, text)
  FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.adjust_product_inventory(text, integer, text, text, text)
  TO service_role;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_product_inventory(
  p_product_id text,
  p_stock integer,
  p_reason text,
  p_note text DEFAULT NULL,
  p_actor text DEFAULT 'admin'
)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = pg_catalog, public
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_product public.products%ROWTYPE;
  v_delta integer;
  v_adjustment public.inventory_adjustments%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF p_product_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_product_id) = ''
     OR p_stock IS NULL OR p_stock < 0
     OR p_reason IS NULL
     OR p_reason NOT IN ('損毀', '員工自用', '實體盤點差異', '其他') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '商品編號、庫存數量或調整原因無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_note IS NOT NULL AND (
    length(p_note) > 500 OR p_note ~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '庫存調整備註格式無效'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
    INTO v_product
  FROM public.products
  WHERE id::text = p_product_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '找不到指定商品'
      USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  v_delta := p_stock - COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0);
  IF v_delta = 0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'stock', p_stock,
      'quantity_before', p_stock,
      'quantity_delta', 0,
      'quantity_after', p_stock,
      'adjustment_id', NULL,
      'reason', p_reason,
      'note', NULLIF(btrim(p_note), '')
    );
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.products
  SET stock = p_stock
  WHERE id::text = p_product_id;

  INSERT INTO public.inventory_adjustments (
    product_id,
    quantity_before,
    quantity_delta,
    quantity_after,
    reason,
    note,
    actor
  )
  VALUES (
    v_product.id,
    COALESCE(v_product.stock, 0),
    v_delta,
    p_stock,
    p_reason,
    NULLIF(btrim(p_note), ''),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_actor), ''), 'admin')
  )
  RETURNING * INTO v_adjustment;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'stock', p_stock,
    'quantity_before', v_adjustment.quantity_before,
    'quantity_delta', v_adjustment.quantity_delta,
    'quantity_after', v_adjustment.quantity_after,
    'adjustment_id', v_adjustment.adjustment_id,
    'reason', v_adjustment.reason,
    'note', v_adjustment.note,
    'created_at', v_adjustment.created_at
  );
END;
$function$;

BEGIN;

DO $migration$
DECLARE
  order_id_type text;
  product_id_type text;
  missing_columns text;
  existing_order_id_type text;
  existing_product_id_type text;
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('public.orders') IS NULL
     OR to_regclass('public.products') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.orders and public.products must exist before creating order_items';
  END IF;

  SELECT format_type(attribute.atttypid, attribute.atttypmod)
    INTO order_id_type
  FROM pg_attribute AS attribute
  WHERE attribute.attrelid = 'public.orders'::regclass
    AND attribute.attname = 'order_id'
    AND attribute.attnum > 0
    AND NOT attribute.attisdropped;

  SELECT format_type(attribute.atttypid, attribute.atttypmod)
    INTO product_id_type
  FROM pg_attribute AS attribute
  WHERE attribute.attrelid = 'public.products'::regclass
    AND attribute.attname = 'id'
    AND attribute.attnum > 0
    AND NOT attribute.attisdropped;

  IF order_id_type IS NULL OR product_id_type IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.orders.order_id and public.products.id are required before creating order_items';
  END IF;

  IF to_regclass('public.order_items') IS NULL THEN
    EXECUTE format(
      'CREATE TABLE public.order_items (
        item_id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
        order_id %s NOT NULL,
        product_id %s NOT NULL,
        quantity integer NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
        unit_price numeric(14, 2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
        item_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''待進貨''
          CHECK (item_status IN (''待進貨'', ''已到貨倉'', ''已出貨'')),
        is_travel_buy boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
        received_quantity integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        CONSTRAINT order_items_received_quantity_check
          CHECK (received_quantity >= 0 AND received_quantity <= quantity)
      )',
      order_id_type,
      product_id_type
    );
  ELSE
    SELECT string_agg(required.column_name, ', ' ORDER BY required.column_name)
      INTO missing_columns
    FROM unnest(ARRAY[
      'item_id',
      'order_id',
      'product_id',
      'quantity',
      'unit_price',
      'item_status',
      'is_travel_buy',
      'received_quantity'
    ]) AS required(column_name)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM information_schema.columns AS existing
      WHERE existing.table_schema = 'public'
        AND existing.table_name = 'order_items'
        AND existing.column_name = required.column_name
    );

    IF missing_columns IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.order_items already exists but is missing columns: %; inspect existing rows before applying a repair', missing_columns;
    END IF;

    SELECT format_type(attribute.atttypid, attribute.atttypmod)
      INTO existing_order_id_type
    FROM pg_attribute AS attribute
    WHERE attribute.attrelid = 'public.order_items'::regclass
      AND attribute.attname = 'order_id'
      AND attribute.attnum > 0
      AND NOT attribute.attisdropped;

    SELECT format_type(attribute.atttypid, attribute.atttypmod)
      INTO existing_product_id_type
    FROM pg_attribute AS attribute
    WHERE attribute.attrelid = 'public.order_items'::regclass
      AND attribute.attname = 'product_id'
      AND attribute.attnum > 0
      AND NOT attribute.attisdropped;

    IF existing_order_id_type IS DISTINCT FROM order_id_type
       OR existing_product_id_type IS DISTINCT FROM product_id_type THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'public.order_items key types do not match public.orders.order_id and public.products.id';
    END IF;
  END IF;
END
$migration$;

DO $migration$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM pg_constraint
    WHERE conrelid = 'public.order_items'::regclass
      AND conname = 'order_items_order_id_fkey'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.order_items
      ADD CONSTRAINT order_items_order_id_fkey
      FOREIGN KEY (order_id)
      REFERENCES public.orders(order_id)

BEGIN;

-- 修復 wishlist 支援 Google 登入 email
ALTER TABLE public.customer_wishlists
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customer_email text;

-- 簡單 email 格式 check，允許 NULL
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint 
    WHERE conrelid = 'public.customer_wishlists'::regclass 
    AND conname = 'customer_wishlists_email_check'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.customer_wishlists
      ADD CONSTRAINT customer_wishlists_email_check
      CHECK (customer_email IS NULL OR customer_email ~* '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$');
  END IF;
END
$$;

-- 至少 phone 或 email 其中一個要有
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint 
    WHERE conrelid = 'public.customer_wishlists'::regclass 
    AND conname = 'customer_wishlists_identity_check'
  ) THEN
    ALTER TABLE public.customer_wishlists
      ADD CONSTRAINT customer_wishlists_identity_check
      CHECK (
        (customer_phone IS NOT NULL AND customer_phone ~ '^[0-9]{8,15}$')
        OR (customer_email IS NOT NULL AND btrim(customer_email) <> '')
      );
  END IF;
END
$$;

-- phone 之前是 NOT NULL，改成可空以支援純 email 登入
ALTER TABLE public.customer_wishlists
  ALTER COLUMN customer_phone DROP NOT NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customer_wishlists_customer_email_created_idx
  ON public.customer_wishlists (customer_email, created_at DESC, id DESC);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS customer_wishlists_email_product_unique
  ON public.customer_wishlists (customer_email, product_id)
  WHERE customer_email IS NOT NULL;

NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
COMMIT;

  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

function createTestApp(options = {}) {

      { token: ANALYTICS_TOKEN, scopes: ['analytics'] }

  });
  const app = express();

  app.get('/api/shipping/report', (req, res) => {
    const authorized = sessions.isAuthorized(req, SHIPPING_TOKEN, 'shipping');
    return authorized
      ? res.json({ success: true, data: { authorized }, message: 'ok' })
      : res.status(401).json({ success: false, data: null, message: 'Unauthorized.' });
  });
  app.post('/api/shipping/update', (req, res) => {
    const authorized = sessions.isAuthorized(req, SHIPPING_TOKEN, 'shipping');
    return authorized
      ? res.json({ success: true, data: { authorized }, message: 'ok' })
      : res.status(403).json({ success: false, data: null, message: 'Unauthorized or invalid origin.' });
  });
  return app;
}

test('admin login issues an HttpOnly scoped cookie and session authorizes same-origin writes', async () => {
  const app = createTestApp({ secureCookie: true });
  await withServer(app, async baseUrl => {
    const origin = baseUrl;
    const loginResponse = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/admin-auth/login`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Origin: origin,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ token: SHIPPING_TOKEN })
    });
    const loginBody = await loginResponse.json();
    const setCookie = loginResponse.headers.get('set-cookie');
    assert.equal(loginResponse.status, 200);
    assert.equal(loginBody.success, true);
    assert.deepEqual(loginBody.data.scopes, ['shipping', 'products']);
    assert.match(setCookie, /HttpOnly/i);
    assert.match(setCookie, /SameSite=Strict/i);
    assert.match(setCookie, /Secure/i);
    assert.match(setCookie, /Path=\/api/i);
    assert.doesNotMatch(setCookie, new RegExp(SHIPPING_TOKEN));

    const cookie = setCookie.split(';', 1)[0];
    const sessionResponse = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/admin-auth/session`, {
      headers: { Cookie: cookie }
    });
    const sessionBody = await sessionResponse.json();
    assert.equal(sessionBody.data.authenticated, true);

    const readResponse = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/shipping/report`, {
      headers: { Cookie: cookie }
    });
    assert.equal(readResponse.status, 200);

    const writeResponse = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/shipping/update`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Origin: origin,
        Cookie: cookie
      }
    });
    assert.equal(writeResponse.status, 200);

    const crossOriginWrite = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/shipping/update`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Origin: 'http://attacker.example',
        Cookie: cookie
      }
    });
    assert.equal(crossOriginWrite.status, 403);
    assert.equal((await crossOriginWrite.json()).success, false);
  });
});

    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/admin-auth/login`, {
      method: 'POST',

});

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const createAnalyticsRouter = require('../routes/analytics');

const ADMIN_TOKEN = 'fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210';

async function withServer(router, run) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use('/api/analytics', router);
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();

  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

async function request(baseUrl, path, token = ADMIN_TOKEN) {
  const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  return {
    status: response.status,
    body: await response.json(),
    cacheStatus: response.headers.get('x-analytics-cache')
  };
}

function createRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  return createAnalyticsRouter(supabase, {
    adminToken: ADMIN_TOKEN,
    readEnabled: true,
    profitDetailsEnabled: true,
    ...options
  });
}

function createTableClient(tables, options = {}) {
  return {
    from(tableName) {
      if (typeof options.onFrom === 'function') {
        options.onFrom(tableName);
      }
      const state = {
        rows: tables[tableName] || [],
        filters: [],
        start: 0,
        end: Infinity,
        columns: null
      };
      const query = {
        select(columns, selectOptions) {
          if (typeof options.onSelect === 'function') {
            options.onSelect(tableName, columns);
          }
          state.columns = columns.split(',').map(column => column.trim());
          state.countRequested = Boolean(selectOptions && selectOptions.count === 'exact');
          return query;
        },
        gte(column, value) {
          state.filters.push(row => new Date(row[column]).getTime() >= new Date(value).getTime());
          return query;
        },
        lt(column, value) {
          state.filters.push(row => new Date(row[column]).getTime() < new Date(value).getTime());
          return query;
        },
        eq(column, value) {
          state.filters.push(row => row[column] === value);
          return query;
        },
        in(column, values) {
          if (typeof options.onIn === 'function') {
            options.onIn(tableName, column, values);
          }
          const selected = new Set(values.map(String));
          state.filters.push(row => selected.has(String(row[column])));
          return query;
        },
        order() {
          return query;
        },
        limit(limit) {
          state.end = Math.min(state.end, limit - 1);
          return query;
        },
        range(start, end) {
          state.start = start;
          state.end = end;
          return query;
        },
        then(resolve, reject) {
          const availableColumns = options.schemas && options.schemas[tableName];
          const missingTable = options.missingTables &&
            options.missingTables.includes(tableName);
          const missingColumn = availableColumns && state.columns
            ? state.columns.find(column => !availableColumns.includes(column))
            : null;
          const injectedError = options.errors && options.errors[tableName];
          const matchingRows = state.rows.filter(row => state.filters.every(filter => filter(row)));
          const result = {
            data: injectedError || missingTable || missingColumn
              ? null
              : matchingRows.slice(state.start, state.end + 1),
            error: injectedError || (missingTable
              ? {
                code: 'PGRST205',
                message: `Could not find the table 'public.${tableName}' in the schema cache`
              }
              : missingColumn
              ? {
                code: '42703',
                message: `column ${tableName}.${missingColumn} does not exist`,
                details: `Missing column: ${tableName}.${missingColumn}`
              }
              : null),
            count: state.countRequested ? matchingRows.length : null
          };
          return Promise.resolve(result).then(resolve, reject);
        }
      };
      return query;
    }
  };
}
