test('analytics summary requires an analytics session and aggregates bounded dashboard data', async () => {
  const today = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit'
  }).format(new Date());
  const orderDate = `${today}T03:00:00+08:00`;
  const selectedOrderItemColumns = [];
  const supabase = createTableClient({
    orders: [
      { order_id: 'summary-1', order_date: orderDate, total_amount: 125 },
      { order_id: 'summary-2', order_date: orderDate, total_amount: 75 }
    ],
    order_items: [
      { order_id: 'summary-1', product_id: 'product-a', quantity: 2, unit_price: 50 },
      { order_id: 'summary-2', product_id: 'product-a', quantity: 1, unit_price: 50 },
      { order_id: 'summary-2', product_id: 'product-b', quantity: 1, unit_price: 25 }
    ],
    products: [
      { id: 'product-a', name: '星球手帳' },
      { id: 'product-b', name: '月球貼紙' }
    ]
  }, {
    schemas: {
      order_items: ['order_id', 'product_id', 'quantity']
    },
    onSelect(tableName, columns) {
      if (tableName === 'order_items') {
        selectedOrderItemColumns.push(columns);
      }
    }
  });
  await withServer(createRouter(supabase), async baseUrl => {
    const legacyMount = await request(baseUrl, '/api/analytics/summary');
    assert.equal(legacyMount.status, 401);
    assert.equal(legacyMount.body.success, false);
  });

  let sessionAuthorized = false;
  const router = createRouter(supabase, {
    requireSession: true,
    isSessionAuthorized: (_req, scope) => sessionAuthorized && scope === 'analytics'
  });
  const app = express();
  app.use('/api/admin/analytics', router);
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  try {
    const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}/api/admin/analytics/summary`;
    const unauthorized = await fetch(url);
    assert.equal(unauthorized.status, 401);
    const bearer = await fetch(url, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}` }
    });
    assert.equal(bearer.status, 401);

    sessionAuthorized = true;
    const response = await fetch(url);
    const result = await response.json();
    assert.equal(response.status, 200);
    assert.equal(result.success, true);
    assert.equal(result.data.total_revenue, 200);
    assert.equal(result.data.total_orders, 2);
    assert.deepEqual(result.data.top_products, []);
    assert.equal(result.data.order_trend.length, 7);
    assert.equal(result.data.order_trend.at(-1).order_count, 2);
    assert.deepEqual(selectedOrderItemColumns, []);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
});

test('analytics summary batches large order ID filters to avoid oversized Supabase requests', async () => {

  }, {

  });

});

test('analytics report responses are cached by endpoint and query parameters', async () => {
  let rpcCalls = 0;
  const router = createRouter({
    rpc: async (_functionName, parameters) => {
      rpcCalls += 1;
      return {
        data: {
          start_date: parameters.p_start_date,
          end_date: parameters.p_end_date,
          total_revenue: rpcCalls,
          total_orders: rpcCalls,
          paid_orders: 0,
          unpaid_orders: rpcCalls,
          paid_order_percentage: 0,
          unpaid_order_percentage: 100,
          shipped_orders: 0,
          unshipped_orders: rpcCalls,
          shipped_order_percentage: 0,
          unshipped_order_percentage: 100
        },
        error: null
      };
    }
  });

  await withServer(router, async baseUrl => {
    const path = '/api/analytics/overview?start_date=2026-09-01&end_date=2026-09-26';
    const first = await request(baseUrl, path);
    const cached = await request(baseUrl, path);
    const differentRange = await request(
      baseUrl,
      '/api/analytics/overview?start_date=2026-09-02&end_date=2026-09-26'
    );

    assert.equal(first.status, 200);
    assert.equal(first.body.data.total_revenue, 1);
    assert.equal(first.body.success, true);
    assert.equal(cached.body.data.total_revenue, 1);
    assert.equal(first.cacheStatus, 'MISS');
    assert.equal(cached.cacheStatus, 'HIT');
    assert.equal(differentRange.body.data.total_revenue, 2);
    assert.equal(rpcCalls, 2);
  });
});

  app.use('/api/customer', router);
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();

  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

async function request(baseUrl, body) {
  const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/customer/orders/lookup`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  return {
    status: response.status,
    retryAfter: response.headers.get('retry-after'),
    body: await response.json()
  };
}

function createRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  return createCustomerRouter(supabase, {
    rateLimitSecret: RATE_SECRET,
    readEnabled: true,
    ...options
  });
}

function createLookupSupabase(orders, state = { calls: 0, rpcCalls: 0 }) {
  return {
    async rpc(name, args) {
      state.rpcCalls += 1;
      assert.equal(name, 'lookup_customer_orders');
      const order = orders.find(row => String(row.order_id) === String(args.p_order_id));
      return {
        data: {
          rate_limited: false,
          orders: order ? [{ order_id: order.order_id, items: [] }] : []
        },
        error: null
      };
    },
    from(table) {
      const filters = [];
      const query = {
        select() {
          return this;
        },
        in(field, values) {
          filters.push(row => values.includes(row[field]));
          return this;
        },
        eq(field, value) {
          filters.push(row => String(row[field]) === String(value));
          return this;
        },
        async maybeSingle() {
          state.calls += 1;
          const rows = table === 'orders' ? orders : [];
          return {
            data: rows.find(row => filters.every(filter => filter(row))) || null,
            error: null
          };
        },
        then(resolve, reject) {
          state.calls += 1;
          const rows = table === 'orders' ? orders : [];
          return Promise.resolve({
            data: rows.filter(row => filters.every(filter => filter(row))),
            error: null
          }).then(resolve, reject);
        }
      };
      return query;
    }
  };
}

  function createMemberSupabase() {
    const orders = [
      {
        order_id: ORDER_UUID,
        customer_phone: PHONE,
        order_date: '2026-10-03T01:00:00.000Z',
        total_amount: 49.5,
        status: 'pending',
        payment_status: '未付款',
        shipping_status: '待到貨'
      },
      {
        order_id: 'e1da0bac-9021-4e87-920b-2f5bf5381f33',
        customer_phone: PHONE,
        order_date: '2026-10-02T01:00:00.000Z',
        total_amount: 25,
        status: 'completed',
        payment_status: '已付清',
        shipping_status: '已出貨'
      },
      {
        order_id: 'e1da0bac-9021-4e87-920b-2f5bf5381f34',
        customer_phone: '85200000000',
        order_date: '2026-10-01T01:00:00.000Z',
        total_amount: 999,
        status: 'pending',
        payment_status: '未付款',
        shipping_status: '待到貨'
      }
    ];
    const items = [
      { order_id: ORDER_UUID, product_id: 7, quantity: 3, unit_price: 16.5 },
      { order_id: 'e1da0bac-9021-4e87-920b-2f5bf5381f33', product_id: 8, quantity: 1, unit_price: 25 }
    ];
    const products = [
      { id: 7, name: '星球貼紙' },
      { id: 8, product_name: '月球筆記本' }
    ];

    class Query {
      constructor(table) {
        this.table = table;
        this.filters = [];
        this.rangeStart = 0;
        this.rangeEnd = Infinity;
      }

      select(_fields, options) {
        this.countRequested = options && options.count === 'exact';
        return this;
      }

      eq(field, value) {
        this.filters.push(row => String(row[field]) === String(value));
        return this;
      }

      or(expression) {
        const values = [...expression.matchAll(/customer_phone\.eq\.([+0-9]+)/g)].map(match => match[1]);
        this.filters.push(row => values.includes(row.customer_phone));
        return this;
      }

      in(field, values) {
        const set = new Set(values.map(String));
        this.filters.push(row => set.has(String(row[field])));
        return this;
      }

      order() {
        return this;
      }

      range(start, end) {
        this.rangeStart = start;
        this.rangeEnd = end;
        return this;
      }

      limit(maximum) {
        this.maximum = maximum;
        return this;
      }

      async maybeSingle() {
        const result = await this.execute();
        return { data: result.data[0] || null, error: null };
      }

      async execute() {
        const source = this.table === 'orders'
          ? orders
          : this.table === 'order_items'
            ? items
            : products;
        const matching = source.filter(row => this.filters.every(filter => filter(row)));
        const selected = matching.slice(this.rangeStart, this.rangeEnd + 1);
        return {
          data: this.maximum === undefined ? selected : selected.slice(0, this.maximum),
          count: this.countRequested ? matching.length : null,
          error: null
        };
      }

      then(resolve, reject) {
        return this.execute().then(resolve, reject);
      }
    }

    return { from: table => new Query(table) };
  }

  function createMemberRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
    return createCustomerRouter(supabase, {
      rateLimitSecret: RATE_SECRET,
      sessionSecret: SESSION_SECRET,
      readEnabled: true,
      ...options
    });
  }

      const secondPage = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/customer/orders?limit=1&offset=1`, {

      const tamperedCookie = `${cookieName}=${encodeURIComponent(

    },
    async rpc(name, args) {
      store.queryCount += 1;

      if (name === 'create_customer_order') {
        if (store.failNextOrderInsert) {
          store.failNextOrderInsert = false;
          return { data: null, error: { code: 'PGRST202', message: 'Function is not available.' } };
        }
        if (store.failNextOrderItemsInsert) {
          store.failNextOrderItemsInsert = false;
          return { data: null, error: { code: 'XX000', message: 'Simulated atomic transaction failure.' } };
        }

        const requestedItems = args.p_items.map(item => {
          const product = store.products.find(candidate => String(candidate.id) === String(item.product_id));
          const unit_price = product
            ? (Array.isArray(product.tier_prices) ? product.tier_prices : [])
              .filter(tier => tier.min_qty <= item.quantity)
              .reduce((price, tier) => tier.price, Number(product.price))
            : null;
          return { product, quantity: item.quantity, unit_price };
        });
        const missingProduct = requestedItems.find(item => !item.product);
        if (missingProduct) {
          return { data: null, error: { code: 'P0001', message: 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE' } };
        }
        const closedPreorder = requestedItems.find(item =>
          item.product.preorder_deadline &&
          Date.parse(item.product.preorder_deadline) <= Date.now()
        );
        if (closedPreorder) {
          return { data: null, error: { code: 'P0001', message: 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE' } };
        }
        const shortStock = requestedItems.find(item => item.product.stock < item.quantity);
        if (shortStock) {
          return {
            data: null,
            error: {
              code: 'P0001',
              message: 'STOCK_UNAVAILABLE',
              details: JSON.stringify({
                product_id: shortStock.product.id,
                requested: shortStock.quantity,
                available: shortStock.product.stock
              })
            }
          };
        }

        const orderId = crypto.randomUUID();
        const orderNumber = `LP-E2E-${orderId.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}`;
        const order = {
          order_id: orderId,
          order_number: orderNumber,
          customer_phone: args.p_customer_phone,
          customer_name: args.p_customer_name || null,
          order_date: new Date().toISOString(),
          shipping_method: args.p_shipping_method || null,
          shipping_address: args.p_shipping_address || null,
          total_amount: requestedItems.reduce(
            (total, item) => total + item.unit_price * item.quantity,
            0
          ),
          payment_status: '未付款',
          shipping_status: '待到貨'
        };
        const createdItems = requestedItems.map(({ product, quantity, unit_price }) => ({
          item_id: crypto.randomUUID(),
          order_id: orderId,
          product_id: product.id,
          product_name: product.name,
          quantity,
          unit_price,
          received_quantity: 0,
          item_status: '待進貨',
          is_travel_buy: false
        }));
        store.orders.push(order);
        store.orderItems.push(...createdItems);
        for (const { product, quantity } of requestedItems) {
          product.stock -= quantity;
        }
        return {
          data: {
            order_id: orderId,
            order_number: orderNumber,
            order_date: order.order_date,
            customer_name: order.customer_name,
            shipping_method: order.shipping_method,
            shipping_address: order.shipping_address,
            payment_status: order.payment_status,
            shipping_status: order.shipping_status,
            total_amount: order.total_amount,
            items: createdItems
          },
          error: null
        };
      }

      if (name === 'record_product_receipt') {
        const product = store.products.find(item => item.id === args.p_product_id);
        if (!product) {
          return { data: null, error: { code: 'P0002' } };
        }

        product.stock += args.p_quantity;
        if (['預購中', '旅購中'].includes(product.status)) {
          product.status = '已到貨';
        }

        let remaining = args.p_quantity;
        let allocated = 0;
        const allocations = [];
        const matchingItems = store.orderItems
          .filter(item => item.product_id === product.id && item.item_status === '待進貨')
          .sort((left, right) => {
            const leftOrder = store.orders.find(order => order.order_id === left.order_id);
            const rightOrder = store.orders.find(order => order.order_id === right.order_id);
            return new Date(leftOrder.order_date) - new Date(rightOrder.order_date) ||
              left.item_id - right.item_id;
          });

        for (const item of matchingItems) {
          if (remaining === 0) break;
          const amount = Math.min(remaining, item.quantity - item.received_quantity);
          item.received_quantity += amount;
          if (item.received_quantity >= item.quantity) {
            item.item_status = '已到貨倉';
          }
          remaining -= amount;
          allocated += amount;
          allocations.push({ item_id: item.item_id, received_quantity: item.received_quantity });
        }

        for (const order of store.orders) {
          const items = store.orderItems.filter(item => item.order_id === order.order_id);
          if (items.length > 0) {
            const ready = items.every(item => (
              item.item_status === '已出貨' ||
              item.item_status === '已到貨倉' ||
              item.received_quantity >= item.quantity
            ));
            const anyReceived = items.some(item => item.received_quantity > 0);
            order.shipping_status = ready ? '可出貨' : anyReceived ? '部分到貨' : '待到貨';
          }
        }

        return {
          data: {
            success: true,
            product_id: product.id,
            stock: product.stock,
            allocated_quantity: allocated,
            unallocated_quantity: remaining,
            allocations
          },
          error: null
        };
      }

      if (name === 'reconcile_inbound_orders') {
        const result = store.orders
          .filter(order => args.p_order_id === null || order.order_id === args.p_order_id)
          .map(order => ({
            order_id: order.order_id,
            shipping_status: order.shipping_status,
            items: store.orderItems
              .filter(item => item.order_id === order.order_id)
              .map(item => ({
                item_id: item.item_id,
                item_status: item.item_status,
                received_quantity: item.received_quantity,
                reconciliation_status: item.received_quantity >= item.quantity ? '已齊貨' : '缺貨',
                shortage_quantity: Math.max(0, item.quantity - item.received_quantity)
              }))
          }));
        return { data: result, error: null };
      }

      if (name === 'get_shipping_pick_list') {
        const readyItems = store.orderItems.filter(item => {
          const order = store.orders.find(candidate => candidate.order_id === item.order_id);
          return order && order.shipping_status === '可出貨' && item.item_status === '已到貨倉';
        });

        if (args.p_group_by === 'product') {
          const result = new Map();
          for (const item of readyItems) {
            const product = store.products.find(candidate => candidate.id === item.product_id);
            let row = result.get(item.product_id);
            if (!row) {
              row = {
                product_id: item.product_id,
                product_name: product.name,
                total_quantity: 0,
                orders: []
              };
              result.set(item.product_id, row);
            }
            row.total_quantity += item.quantity;
            row.orders.push({ order_id: item.order_id, item_id: item.item_id, quantity: item.quantity });
          }
          return { data: [...result.values()], error: null };
        }

        const grouped = new Map();
        for (const item of readyItems) {
          const order = store.orders.find(candidate => candidate.order_id === item.order_id);
          let row = grouped.get(order.order_id);
          if (!row) {
            row = { order_id: order.order_id, items: [] };
            grouped.set(order.order_id, row);
          }
          const product = store.products.find(candidate => candidate.id === item.product_id);
          row.items.push({
            item_id: item.item_id,
            product_id: item.product_id,
            product_name: product.name,
            quantity: item.quantity,
            item_status: item.item_status
          });
        }
        return { data: [...grouped.values()], error: null };
      }

      if (name === 'ship_order') {
        const order = store.orders.find(candidate => String(candidate.order_id) === String(args.p_order_id));
        if (!order) return { data: null, error: { code: 'P0002' } };
        if (order.payment_status !== '已付清') {
          return {
            data: null,
            error: { code: '55000', message: '訂單必須已付清才可出貨。' }
          };
        }
        if (order.shipping_status !== '可出貨') {
          return { data: null, error: { code: '55000', message: '訂單未齊貨。' } };
        }

        order.shipping_status = '已出貨';
        order.shipping_method = args.p_shipping_method;
        order.tracking_number = args.p_tracking_number;
        for (const item of store.orderItems.filter(candidate => candidate.order_id === order.order_id)) {
          item.item_status = '已出貨';
        }
        for (const item of store.orderItems.filter(candidate => candidate.order_id === order.order_id)) {
          const product = store.products.find(candidate => candidate.id === item.product_id);
          product.stock -= item.quantity;
        }
        store.notifications.set(String(order.order_id), {
          status: 'pending',
          customer_phone: args.p_customer_phone || order.customer_phone,
          shipping_method: order.shipping_method,
          tracking_number: order.tracking_number
        });
        return { data: { success: true, shipment: { order_id: order.order_id } }, error: null };
      }

      if (name === 'claim_shipping_notification') {
        const notification = store.notifications.get(String(args.p_order_id));
        if (!notification) return { data: null, error: { code: 'P0002' } };
        if (notification.status !== 'pending' && notification.status !== 'failed') {
          return { data: { claimed: false, status: notification.status }, error: null };
        }
        notification.status = 'sending';
        return { data: { claimed: true, ...notification }, error: null };
      }

      if (name === 'finish_shipping_notification') {
        const notification = store.notifications.get(String(args.p_order_id));
        if (!notification) return { data: null, error: { code: 'P0002' } };
        notification.status = args.p_success ? 'sent' : 'failed';
        return { data: { status: notification.status }, error: null };
      }

      if (name === 'lookup_customer_orders') {
        const orders = store.orders
          .filter(order => (
            args.p_customer_phone === null ||
            order.customer_phone === args.p_customer_phone
          ) && (
            args.p_order_id === null ||
            order.order_id === args.p_order_id
          ))
          .sort((left, right) => new Date(right.order_date) - new Date(left.order_date))
          .slice(0, 20)
          .map(order => ({
            order_id: order.order_id,
            order_date: order.order_date,
            total_amount: order.total_amount,
            payment_status: order.payment_status,
            shipping_status: order.shipping_status,
            shipping_method: order.shipping_method || null,
            tracking_number: order.tracking_number || null,
            whatsapp_notification_status: store.notifications.has(String(order.order_id))
              ? store.notifications.get(String(order.order_id)).status
              : 'not_created',
            items: store.orderItems
              .filter(item => item.order_id === order.order_id)
              .map(item => ({
                item_id: item.item_id,
                product_id: item.product_id,
                product_name: store.products.find(product => product.id === item.product_id).name,
                quantity: item.quantity,
                received_quantity: item.received_quantity,
                item_status: item.item_status,
                reconciliation_status: item.item_status === '已出貨'
                  ? '已齊貨'
                  : item.received_quantity >= item.quantity
                    ? '已齊貨'
                    : item.received_quantity > 0
                      ? '部分到貨'
                      : '待到貨'
              }))
          }));
        return { data: { rate_limited: false, orders }, error: null };
      }

      if (name === 'get_revenue_overview') {
        const totalRevenue = store.orders.reduce((sum, order) => sum + order.total_amount, 0);
        const totalOrders = store.orders.length;
        const paidOrders = store.orders.filter(order => order.payment_status !== '未付款').length;
        const shippedOrders = store.orders.filter(order => order.shipping_status === '已出貨').length;
        return {
          data: {
            total_revenue: totalRevenue,
            total_orders: totalOrders,
            paid_orders: paidOrders,
            unpaid_orders: totalOrders - paidOrders,
            paid_order_percentage: totalOrders ? paidOrders * 100 / totalOrders : 0,
            unpaid_order_percentage: totalOrders ? (totalOrders - paidOrders) * 100 / totalOrders : 0,
            shipped_orders: shippedOrders,
            unshipped_orders: totalOrders - shippedOrders,
            shipped_order_percentage: totalOrders ? shippedOrders * 100 / totalOrders : 0,
            unshipped_order_percentage: totalOrders ? (totalOrders - shippedOrders) * 100 / totalOrders : 0
          },
          error: null
        };
      }

      if (name === 'get_top_selling_products') {
        const aggregate = new Map();
        for (const item of store.orderItems) {
          const product = store.products.find(candidate => candidate.id === item.product_id);
          const existing = aggregate.get(product.id) || {
            product_id: product.id,
            product_name: product.name,
            quantity_sold: 0,
            sales_amount: 0
          };
          existing.quantity_sold += item.quantity;
          existing.sales_amount += item.quantity * item.unit_price;
          aggregate.set(product.id, existing);
        }
        const result = [...aggregate.values()]
          .sort((left, right) => right.quantity_sold - left.quantity_sold)
          .slice(0, args.p_limit)
          .map((item, index) => ({ rank: index + 1, ...item }));
        return { data: result, error: null };
      }

      if (name === 'get_financial_reconciliation') {
        return {
          data: {
            total_count: store.orders.length,
            rows: store.orders.slice(args.p_offset, args.p_offset + args.p_limit).map(order => ({
              order_id: order.order_id,
              order_date: order.order_date,
              total_amount: order.total_amount,
              payment_status: order.payment_status,
              shipping_status: order.shipping_status,
              shipping_method: order.shipping_method || null,
              tracking_number: order.tracking_number || null,
              items: store.orderItems.filter(item => item.order_id === order.order_id)
            }))
          },
          error: null
        };
      }

      if (name === 'lookup_whatsapp_order') {
        const order = store.orders.find(candidate => (
          candidate.order_id === args.p_order_id &&
          candidate.customer_phone === args.p_customer_phone
        ));
        return {
          data: order ? { found: true, order_id: order.order_id } : { found: false },
          error: null
        };
      }

      if (name === 'record_whatsapp_payment_report') {
        const order = store.orders.find(candidate => (
          candidate.order_id === args.p_order_id &&
          candidate.customer_phone === args.p_customer_phone
        ));
        if (!order) return { data: { found: false, duplicate: false }, error: null };
        if (store.paymentReports.has(args.p_provider_message_id)) {
          return { data: { found: true, duplicate: true }, error: null };
        }
        store.paymentReports.set(args.p_provider_message_id, {
          order_id: args.p_order_id,
          payment_reference: args.p_payment_reference,
          status: '待核實'
        });
        return { data: { found: true, duplicate: false, status: '待核實' }, error: null };
      }

      throw new Error(`Unexpected Supabase RPC: ${name}`);
    }
  };

  return store;
}

class QueryBuilder {
  constructor(store, table) {
    this.store = store;
    this.table = table;
    this.operation = 'select';
    this.filters = [];
    this.sorts = [];
    this.payload = null;
    this.selectedColumns = '*';
    this.singleResult = false;
    this.rangeStart = 0;
    this.rangeEnd = Infinity;
    this.countRequested = false;
  }

  select(columns = '*', options) {
    this.selectedColumns = columns;
    this.countRequested = Boolean(options && options.count === 'exact');
    return this;
  }

  in(column, values) {
    this.filters.push(row => values.includes(row[column]));
    return this;
  }

  eq(column, value) {
    this.filters.push(row => row[column] === value);
    return this;
  }

  gte(column, value) {
    this.filters.push(row => String(row[column]) >= String(value));
    return this;
  }

  lte(column, value) {
    this.filters.push(row => String(row[column]) <= String(value));
    return this;
  }

  or() {
    return this;
  }

  order(column, options = {}) {
    this.sorts.push({ column, ascending: options.ascending !== false });
    return this;
  }

  range(start, end) {
    this.rangeStart = start;
    this.rangeEnd = end;
    return this;
  }

  update(values) {
    this.operation = 'update';
    this.payload = values;
    return this;
  }

  insert(values) {
    this.operation = 'insert';
    this.payload = values;
    return this;
  }

  delete() {
    this.operation = 'delete';
    return this;
  }

  single() {
    this.singleResult = true;
    return this.execute().then(result => ({
      data: Array.isArray(result.data) ? result.data[0] || null : result.data,
      error: result.error
    }));
  }

  maybeSingle() {
    return this.execute().then(result => ({
      data: Array.isArray(result.data) ? result.data[0] || null : result.data,
      error: result.error
    }));
  }

  async execute() {
    const { store, table } = this;
    if (table === 'products') {
      if (this.operation === 'update') {
        const updated = store.products.filter(row => this.filters.every(filter => filter(row)));
        for (const row of updated) {
          if (this.payload.remind_claimed_at) {
            store.reminderClaims += 1;
          }
          Object.assign(row, this.payload);
        }
        return { data: updated.map(row => ({ ...row })), error: null };
      }
      let selected = store.products.filter(row => this.filters.every(filter => filter(row)));
      for (const sort of this.sorts) {
        selected = selected.slice().sort((left, right) => {
          const leftValue = left[sort.column];
          const rightValue = right[sort.column];
          const comparison = typeof leftValue === 'number' && typeof rightValue === 'number'
            ? leftValue - rightValue
            : String(leftValue || '').localeCompare(String(rightValue || ''));
          return sort.ascending ? comparison : -comparison;
        });
      }
      const count = selected.length;
      selected = selected.slice(this.rangeStart, this.rangeEnd + 1);
      return {
        data: selected.map(row => ({ ...row })),
        count: this.countRequested ? count : null,
        error: null
      };
    }

    if (table === 'orders') {
      if (this.operation === 'insert') {
        if (store.failNextOrderInsert) {
          store.failNextOrderInsert = false;
          return {
            data: null,
            error: { code: '42703', message: 'Missing order column.' }
          };
        }
        const inserted = this.payload.map(record => ({
          order_id: store.nextOrderId++,
          ...record
        }));
        store.orders.push(...inserted);
        return { data: inserted.map(row => ({ ...row })), error: null };
      }
      if (this.operation === 'delete') {
        const deleted = store.orders.filter(row => this.filters.every(filter => filter(row)));
        store.orders = store.orders.filter(row => !deleted.includes(row));
        const deletedIds = new Set(deleted.map(row => row.order_id));
        store.orderItems = store.orderItems.filter(row => !deletedIds.has(row.order_id));
        return { data: deleted, error: null };
      }
      return {
        data: store.orders.filter(row => this.filters.every(filter => filter(row))).map(row => ({ ...row })),
        error: null
      };
    }

    if (table === 'order_items') {
      if (this.operation === 'insert') {
        if (store.failNextOrderItemsInsert) {
          store.failNextOrderItemsInsert = false;
          return { data: null, error: { code: 'XX000', message: 'Simulated detail insert failure.' } };
        }
        const inserted = this.payload.map(record => ({
          item_id: store.nextItemId++,
          received_quantity: 0,
          ...record
        }));
        store.orderItems.push(...inserted);
        return { data: inserted.map(row => ({ ...row })), error: null };
      }
      return {
        data: store.orderItems.filter(row => this.filters.every(filter => filter(row))).map(row => ({ ...row })),
        error: null
      };
    }

    throw new Error(`Unexpected Supabase table: ${table}`);
  }

  then(resolve, reject) {
    return this.execute().then(resolve, reject);
  }
}

function createApplication(store) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json({
    limit: '50kb',
    verify(req, res, buffer) {
      if (req.originalUrl.startsWith('/api/webhook/whatsapp')) {
        req.rawBody = Buffer.from(buffer);
      }
    }
  }));

  app.use('/api/products', createProductsRouter(store.supabase));
  app.use('/api/orders', createOrdersRouter(store.supabase));
  app.use('/api/reminders', createReminderRouter(store.supabase, {
    cronToken: TOKENS.reminder,
    recipients: ['85212345678'],
    sendWhatsApp: async message => store.whatsappMessages.push(message)
  }));
  app.use('/api/inbound', createInboundRouter(store.supabase, {
    adminToken: TOKENS.inbound,
    writeEnabled: true
  }));
  app.use('/api/shipping', createShippingRouter(store.supabase, {
    adminToken: TOKENS.shipping,
    writeEnabled: true,
    sendWhatsApp: async message => store.whatsappMessages.push(message)
  }));
  app.use('/api/customer', createCustomerRouter(store.supabase, {
    rateLimitSecret: TOKENS.lookup,
    readEnabled: true
  }));
  app.use('/api/analytics', createAnalyticsRouter(store.supabase, {
    adminToken: TOKENS.analytics,
    readEnabled: true
  }));
  app.use('/api/webhook', createWebhookRouter(store.supabase, {
    verifyToken: TOKENS.webhookVerify,
    appSecret: TOKENS.webhookAppSecret,
    writeEnabled: true,
    sendWhatsApp: async message => store.whatsappMessages.push(message)
  }));
  return app;
}

async function withServer(app, run) {
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();

  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

async function jsonRequest(baseUrl, path, { method = 'GET', token, body } = {}) {
  const headers = {};
  if (token) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  if (body !== undefined) headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';

  const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, {
    method,
    headers,
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() };
}

function createSignature(rawBody) {
  return `sha256=${crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', TOKENS.webhookAppSecret)
    .update(rawBody)
    .digest('hex')}`;
}

test('E2E business flow: products, checkout rollback, reminders, inbound, shipping, customer lookup, analytics', async () => {
  const store = createStore();
  const app = createApplication(store);

  await withServer(app, async baseUrl => {
    const products = await jsonRequest(baseUrl, '/api/products?category=%E5%85%AC%E4%BB%94');
    assert.equal(products.status, 200);
    assert.equal(products.body.success, true);
    assert.equal(products.body.data.products[0].id, 51);

    const checkoutBody = {
      customer_phone: '+85212345678',
      customer_name: '小行星客人',
      shipping_method: 'sf_locker',
      shipping_address: 'H852K01P',
      totalAmount: 50,
      items: [{ product_id: 51, quantity: 2 }]
    };
    store.failNextOrderItemsInsert = true;
    const rolledBack = await jsonRequest(baseUrl, '/api/orders', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: checkoutBody
    });
    assert.equal(rolledBack.status, 500);
    assert.equal(rolledBack.body.success, false);
    assert.equal(store.orders.length, 0);
    assert.equal(store.orderItems.length, 0);

test('WhatsApp webhook verifies Meta challenge and signature before processing messages', async () => {
  const store = createStore();

  const order = {
    order_id: orderId,

  await withServer(app, async baseUrl => {
    const verification = await fetch(
      `${baseUrl}/api/webhook/whatsapp?hub.mode=subscribe&hub.verify_token=${TOKENS.webhookVerify}&hub.challenge=challenge-abc`
    );
    assert.equal(verification.status, 200);
    assert.equal(await verification.text(), 'challenge-abc');

    const invalidVerification = await fetch(
      `${baseUrl}/api/webhook/whatsapp?hub.mode=subscribe&hub.verify_token=wrong&hub.challenge=challenge-abc`
    );
    assert.equal(invalidVerification.status, 403);

    const payload = {
      object: 'whatsapp_business_account',
      entry: [{
        changes: [{
          value: {
            messages: [{
              id: 'wamid.lookup-1',
              from: '+85212345678',
              type: 'text',
              text: { body: `查詢訂單 ${orderId}` }
            }]
          }
        }]
      }]
    };
    const rawBody = JSON.stringify(payload);
    const unauthorized = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/webhook/whatsapp`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Hub-Signature-256': 'sha256=invalid' },
      body: rawBody
    });
    assert.equal(unauthorized.status, 401);

    const accepted = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/webhook/whatsapp`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'X-Hub-Signature-256': createSignature(rawBody)
      },
      body: rawBody
    });
    const result = await accepted.json();
    assert.equal(accepted.status, 200);
    assert.equal(result.success, true);
    assert.equal(result.data.processed_count, 1);
    assert.equal(store.whatsappMessages.at(-1).to, '85212345678');
    assert.match(store.whatsappMessages.at(-1).text, new RegExp(`訂單 #${orderId}`));
  });
});

'use strict';

require('express-async-errors');

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const { apiNotFound, errorHandler } = require('../middleware/error-handler');

async function withServer(app, run) {
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();

  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

function responseShape(body) {
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(body).sort(), ['data', 'message', 'success']);
  assert.equal(body.success, false);
  assert.equal(body.data, null);
  assert.equal(typeof body.message, 'string');
}

test('central handler returns a structured error for rejected async route handlers', async () => {
  const app = express();
  app.set('env', 'production');
  app.get('/api/failure', async (req, res) => {
    await Promise.resolve();
    throw new Error('private database detail');
  });
  app.use('/api', apiNotFound);
  app.use(errorHandler);

  await withServer(app, async baseUrl => {
    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/failure`);
    const body = await response.json();
    assert.equal(response.status, 500);
    responseShape(body);
    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(body).includes('private database detail'), false);
    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(body).includes('stack'), false);
  });
});

test('central handler formats malformed JSON and unknown API routes consistently', async () => {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.post('/api/echo', (req, res) => res.json({ success: true, data: req.body, message: 'ok' }));
  app.use('/api', apiNotFound);
  app.use(errorHandler);

  await withServer(app, async baseUrl => {
    const malformed = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/echo`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: '{"incomplete":'
    });
    assert.equal(malformed.status, 400);
    responseShape(await malformed.json());

    const missing = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/not-found`);
    assert.equal(missing.status, 404);
    responseShape(await missing.json());
  });
});

```
'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const createInboundRouter = require('../routes/inbound');

const ADMIN_TOKEN = '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef';
const TODAY = '2026-10-22';

async function withServer(supabase, run, options = {}) {
  const app = express();
  app.use('/api/inbound', createInboundRouter(supabase, {
    adminToken: ADMIN_TOKEN,
    writeEnabled: true,
    now: () => new Date('2026-10-22T04:00:00.000Z'),
    isSessionAuthorized: (req, token, scope) => (
      token === ADMIN_TOKEN &&
      scope === 'inbound' &&
      req.get('x-admin-session') === 'valid'
    ),
    ...options
  }));
  app.use((error, req, res, next) => {
    res.status(error.status || 500).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: '請求處理失敗。'
    });
  });
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();
  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

function createSupabase(batches, products, options = {}) {
  return {
    from(table) {
      let filters = [];
      let selectedTable = table;
      const query = {
        select() {
          return query;
        },
        gt(field, value) {
          filters.push(row => row[field] > value);
          return query;
        },
        not(field, operator, value) {
          assert.equal(operator, 'is');
          assert.equal(value, null);
          filters.push(row => row[field] !== null && row[field] !== undefined);
          return query;
        },
        lte(field, value) {
          filters.push(row => row[field] <= value);
          return query;
        },
        order() {
          return query;
        },
        limit() {
          return query;
        },
        in(field, values) {
          filters.push(row => values.includes(row[field]));
          return query;
        },
        async maybeSingle() {
          return { data: null, error: options.error || null };
        },
        then(resolve, reject) {
          if (options.error) {
            return Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: options.error }).then(resolve, reject);
          }
          const rows = selectedTable === 'product_stock_batches' ? batches : products;
          return Promise.resolve({
            data: rows.filter(row => filters.every(filter => filter(row))),
            error: null
          }).then(resolve, reject);
        }
      };
      return query;
    }
  };
}

test('expiring stock alerts include all expired and next-30-day batches with remaining stock', async () => {
  const supabase = createSupabase([
    { batch_id: 1, product_id: 9, quantity_remaining: 3, best_before_date: '2026-10-01' },
    { batch_id: 2, product_id: 9, quantity_remaining: 2, best_before_date: '2026-11-10' },
    { batch_id: 3, product_id: 10, quantity_remaining: 1, best_before_date: '2026-11-22' },
    { batch_id: 4, product_id: 10, quantity_remaining: 0, best_before_date: '2026-10-30' },
    { batch_id: 5, product_id: 10, quantity_remaining: 4, best_before_date: null }
  ], [
    { id: 9, name: '小行星曲奇' },
    { id: 10, product_name: '星球軟糖' }
  ]);
  await withServer(supabase, async baseUrl => {
    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/inbound/expiring`, {
      headers: { 'x-admin-session': 'valid' }
    });
    const result = await response.json();
    assert.equal(response.status, 200);
    assert.equal(result.success, true);
    assert.equal(result.data.today, TODAY);
    assert.equal(result.data.through_date, '2026-11-21');
    assert.deepEqual(result.data.alerts.map(alert => alert.batch_id), [1, 2]);
    assert.equal(result.data.alerts[0].is_expired, true);
    assert.equal(result.data.alerts[0].product_name, '小行星曲奇');
    assert.equal(result.data.alerts[1].is_expired, false);
  });
});

test('expiring stock alerts require inbound authorization and report database errors', async () => {
  const supabase = createSupabase([], [], { error: { message: 'private database detail' } });
  await withServer(supabase, async baseUrl => {
    const denied = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/inbound/expiring`);
    assert.equal(denied.status, 401);

    const failed = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/inbound/expiring`, {
      headers: { 'x-admin-session': 'valid' }
    });
    const result = await failed.json();
    assert.equal(failed.status, 500);
    assert.equal(result.success, false);
    assert.doesNotMatch(result.message, /private database detail/);
  });
});

    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(body).includes('SyntaxError'), false);
    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(body).includes('stack'), false);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
    app.set('env', previousEnvironment);
  }
});

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const createInboundRouter = require('../routes/inbound');

const ADMIN_TOKEN = '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef';

async function withServer(router, run) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use('/api/inbound', router);
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();
  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

async function request(baseUrl, path, options = {}) {
  const headers = {
    ...(options.token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${options.token}` } : {}),
    ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {})
  };
  const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, {
    method: options.method || 'GET',
    headers,
    body: options.body ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : undefined
  });
  return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() };
}

function createRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  return createInboundRouter(supabase, {
    adminToken: ADMIN_TOKEN,
    writeEnabled: true,
    ...options
  });
}

function getHongKongDate(offsetDays = 0) {
  const date = new Date(Date.now() + offsetDays * 86400000);
  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Hong_Kong',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit'
  }).formatToParts(date);
  const values = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(part => [part.type, part.value]));
  return `${values.year}-${values.month}-${values.day}`;
}

function createBatchUpdateSupabase(batches, options = {}) {
  const updates = [];
  return {
    updates,
    from(table) {
      assert.equal(table, 'product_stock_batches');
      let patch = null;
      let batchId = null;
      let columns = null;
      const query = {
        update(values) {
          patch = values;
          return query;
        },
        eq(column, value) {
          assert.equal(column, 'batch_id');
          batchId = String(value);
          return query;
        },
        select(value) {
          columns = value;
          return query;
        },
        async maybeSingle() {
          updates.push({ batch_id: batchId, patch, columns });
          if (options.throwOnUpdate) {
            throw new Error('Simulated batch update exception.');
          }
          if (options.error) {
            return { data: null, error: options.error };
          }
          const batch = batches.find(item => String(item.batch_id) === batchId);
          if (!batch) return { data: null, error: null };
          Object.assign(batch, patch);
          return { data: { ...batch }, error: null };
        }
      };
      return query;
    }
  };
}

function createBatchRecord(batchId, overrides = {}) {
  return {
    batch_id: batchId,
    product_id: 51,
    quantity_received: 5,
    quantity_remaining: 5,
    best_before_date: '2027-04-30',
    received_at: '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z',
    is_legacy_stock: false,
    ...overrides
  };
}

'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const createOrdersRouter = require('../routes/orders');

const ORDER_ID = 'e1da0bac-9021-4e87-920b-2f5bf5381f32';

async function withServer(supabase, run) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use('/api/orders', createOrdersRouter(supabase, {
    serviceRoleAvailable: true,
    isSessionAuthorized: (req, scope) => (
      scope === 'orders' &&
      req.get('x-admin-session') === 'valid'
    )
  }));
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();

  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

function createSupabase() {
  const orders = [{
    order_id: ORDER_ID,
    customer_phone: '85212345678',
    total_amount: 49.5,
    order_date: '2026-10-03T01:00:00.000Z',
    status: 'pending'
  }];
  const items = [{
    item_id: 1,
    order_id: ORDER_ID,
    product_id: 9,
    quantity: 3,
    unit_price: 16.5
  }];
  const products = [{ id: 9, name: '小行星貼紙' }];
  let productSelectFields = null;

  class Query {
    constructor(table) {
      this.table = table;
      this.operation = 'select';
      this.filters = [];
      this.values = null;
    }

    select(fields, options) {
      this.fields = fields;
      if (this.table === 'products') {
        productSelectFields = fields;
      }
      this.countRequested = options && options.count === 'exact';
      return this;
    }

    order() {
      return this;
    }

    range(from, to) {
      this.rangeStart = from;
      this.rangeEnd = to;
      return this;
    }

    limit(limit) {
      this.maxRows = limit;
      return this;
    }

    in(field, values) {
      this.filters.push(row => values.includes(row[field]));
      return this;
    }

    eq(field, value) {
      this.filters.push(row => row[field] === value);
      return this;
    }

    update(values) {
      this.operation = 'update';
      this.values = values;
      return this;
    }

    async maybeSingle() {
      const result = await this.execute();
      return { data: result.data[0] || null, error: result.error };
    }

    async execute() {
      const source = this.table === 'orders'
        ? orders
        : this.table === 'order_items'
          ? items
          : products;
      const matching = source.filter(row => this.filters.every(filter => filter(row)));
      if (this.operation === 'update') {
        matching.forEach(row => Object.assign(row, this.values));
        return {
          data: matching.map(row => ({ ...row })),
          error: null
        };
      }
      const ranged = this.rangeStart === undefined
        ? matching
        : matching.slice(this.rangeStart, this.rangeEnd + 1);
      return {
        data: this.maxRows === undefined ? ranged : ranged.slice(0, this.maxRows),
        count: this.countRequested ? matching.length : null,
        error: null
      };
    }

    then(resolve, reject) {
      return this.execute().then(resolve, reject);
    }
  }

  return {
    orders,
    get productSelectFields() {
      return productSelectFields;
    },
    from(table) {
      return new Query(table);
    }
  };
}

'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const createPaymentProofRouter = require('../routes/payment-proofs');

const ORDER_ID = 'e1da0bac-9021-4e87-920b-2f5bf5381f32';
const ORDER_NUMBER = 'LP-20261022-A1B2C3D4';
const PHONE = '85212345678';
const PNG = Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10, 1, 2, 3]);

async function withServer(supabase, run, options = {}) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use('/api/orders', createPaymentProofRouter(supabase, {
    serviceRoleAvailable: true,
    isSessionAuthorized: (req, scope) => (
      scope === 'orders' && req.get('x-admin-session') === 'valid'
    ),
    enableAdmin: false,
    ...options
  }));
  app.use('/api/admin/orders', createPaymentProofRouter(supabase, {
    serviceRoleAvailable: true,
    isSessionAuthorized: (req, scope) => (
      scope === 'orders' && req.get('x-admin-session') === 'valid'
    ),
    enableUpload: false,
    ...options
  }));
  app.use((error, req, res, next) => {
    res.status(error.status || 500).json({
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: error.status === 413
        ? '付款憑證檔案超出大小限制。'
        : '請求處理失敗。'
    });
  });
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();
  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

function createSupabase(options = {}) {
  const orders = [{
    order_id: ORDER_ID,
    order_number: ORDER_NUMBER,
    customer_phone: PHONE,
    payment_status: '未付款',
    payment_proof_url: null,
    payment_proof_status: 'pending'
  }];
  const storageCalls = [];

  class Query {
    constructor(table) {
      this.table = table;
      this.filters = [];
      this.operation = 'select';
      this.values = null;
      this.columns = '';
    }

    select(columns) {
      this.columns = columns;
      return this;
    }

    in(field, values) {
      this.filters.push(row => values.includes(row[field]));
      return this;
    }

    eq(field, value) {
      this.filters.push(row => String(row[field]) === String(value));
      return this;
    }

    update(values) {
      this.operation = 'update';
      this.values = values;
      return this;
    }

    async maybeSingle() {
      if (options.databaseError) {
        return { data: null, error: options.databaseError };
      }
      const rows = this.table === 'orders' ? orders : [];
      const match = rows.find(row => this.filters.every(filter => filter(row)));
      if (!match) {
        return { data: null, error: null };
      }
      if (this.operation === 'update') {
        Object.assign(match, this.values);
      }
      const selected = this.columns
        ? Object.fromEntries(this.columns.split(',').map(column => [
          column.trim(),
          match[column.trim()]
        ]))
        : { ...match };
      return { data: selected, error: null };
    }
  }

  return {
    orders,
    storageCalls,
    from(table) {
      assert.equal(table, 'orders');
      return new Query(table);
    },
    storage: {
      from(bucket) {
        assert.equal(bucket, 'payment-proofs');
        return {
          async upload(path, file, fileOptions) {
            storageCalls.push({ method: 'upload', path, fileOptions });
            assert.ok(Buffer.isBuffer(file));
            if (options.storageError) {
              return { data: null, error: options.storageError };
            }
            return { data: { path }, error: null };
          },
          async remove(paths) {
            storageCalls.push({ method: 'remove', paths });
            return { data: paths, error: null };
          }
        };
      }
    }
  };
}

async function upload(baseUrl, body = PNG, overrides = {}) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${baseUrl}/api/orders/${encodeURIComponent(overrides.orderNumber || ORDER_NUMBER)}/payment-proof`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': overrides.contentType || 'image/png',
        'X-Customer-Phone': overrides.phone || PHONE
      },
      body
    }
  );
  return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() };
}

test('payment proof upload requires both matching order number and phone and stores a private object reference', async () => {
  const supabase = createSupabase();
  await withServer(supabase, async baseUrl => {
    const denied = await upload(baseUrl, PNG, { phone: '85287654321' });
    assert.equal(denied.status, 404);
    assert.equal(denied.body.success, false);
    assert.equal(supabase.storageCalls.length, 0);

    const response = await upload(baseUrl);
    assert.equal(response.status, 201);
    assert.equal(response.body.success, true);
    assert.equal(response.body.data.payment_proof_status, 'pending');
    assert.equal(response.body.data.payment_proof_url, undefined);
    assert.match(supabase.orders[0].payment_proof_url, new RegExp(`^${ORDER_ID}/[0-9a-f-]+\\.png$`));
    assert.equal(supabase.orders[0].payment_proof_status, 'pending');
    assert.equal(supabase.storageCalls[0].method, 'upload');
    assert.equal(supabase.storageCalls[0].fileOptions.contentType, 'image/png');
  });
});

test('payment proof upload validates image bytes, MIME, size and protects verified proofs', async () => {
  const supabase = createSupabase();
  await withServer(supabase, async baseUrl => {
    const invalidImage = await upload(baseUrl, Buffer.from('not an image'));
    assert.equal(invalidImage.status, 400);

    const mismatchedMime = await upload(baseUrl, PNG, { contentType: 'image/jpeg' });
    assert.equal(mismatchedMime.status, 400);

    assert.equal(oversized.status, 413);

    supabase.orders[0].payment_proof_status = 'verified';
    const verified = await upload(baseUrl);
    assert.equal(verified.status, 409);
    assert.equal(supabase.storageCalls.length, 0);

    const uuidLookup = await upload(baseUrl, PNG, { orderNumber: ORDER_ID });
    assert.equal(uuidLookup.status, 400);
  });
});

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const createProductsRouter = require('../routes/products');

const ADMIN_TOKEN = 'product-stock-admin-token-for-tests-000000';

async function withServer(router, run) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use('/api/products', router);
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();

  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

async function request(baseUrl, path, options = {}) {
  const headers = {
    ...(options.token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${options.token}` } : {}),
    ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {})
  };
  const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, {
    method: options.method || 'GET',
    headers,
    body: options.body ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : undefined
  });
  return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() };
}

function createRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  return createProductsRouter(supabase, {
    adminToken: ADMIN_TOKEN,
    stockWriteEnabled: true,
    ...options
  });
}

function createProductsQuery(rows) {
  const filters = [];
  const sorts = [];
  let offset = 0;
  let limit = 24;
  let countRequested = false;
  const query = {
    select(_fields, options) {
      countRequested = Boolean(options && options.count === 'exact');
      return query;
    },
    eq(column, value) {
      filters.push(row => row[column] === value);
      return query;
    },
    in(column, values) {
      filters.push(row => values.map(String).includes(String(row[column])));
      return query;
    },
    or(expression) {
      const match = expression.match(/^name\.ilike\.\*(.*)\*,description\.ilike\.\*(.*)\*$/);
      assert.ok(match);
      const needle = match[1].toLocaleLowerCase();
      filters.push(row => String(row.name || '').toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle) ||
        String(row.description || '').toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle));
      return query;
    },
    order(column, options) {
      sorts.push({ column, ascending: options.ascending });
      return query;
    },
    range(start, end) {
      offset = start;
      limit = end - start + 1;
      return query;
    },
    then(resolve, reject) {
      let filtered = rows.filter(row => filters.every(filter => filter(row)));
      for (const sort of sorts.slice().reverse()) {
        filtered = filtered.slice().sort((left, right) => {
          const leftValue = left[sort.column];
          const rightValue = right[sort.column];
          const comparison = typeof leftValue === 'number' && typeof rightValue === 'number'
            ? leftValue - rightValue
            : String(leftValue || '').localeCompare(String(rightValue || ''));
          return sort.ascending ? comparison : -comparison;
        });
      }
      const count = filtered.length;
      return Promise.resolve({
        data: filtered.slice(offset, offset + limit),
        count: countRequested ? count : null,
        error: null
      }).then(resolve, reject);
    }
  };
  return query;
}

test('product image upload requires admin access and validates bytes before Storage upload', async () => {
  const uploads = [];
  const supabase = {
    storage: {
      from(bucket) {
        assert.equal(bucket, 'product-images');
        return {
          async upload(path, bytes, options) {
            uploads.push({ path, bytes, options });
            return { error: null };
          },
          getPublicUrl(path) {
            return { data: { publicUrl: `https://storage.example/product-images/${path}` } };
          }
        };
      }
    }
  };
  const router = createRouter(supabase);
  await withServer(router, async baseUrl => {
    const png = Buffer.from([
      0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a,
      0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00
    ]);
    const unauthorized = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/products/images`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'image/png' },
      body: png
    });
    assert.equal(unauthorized.status, 401);

    const invalid = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/products/images`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}`,
        'Content-Type': 'image/png'
      },
      body: Buffer.from('not a png')
    });
    assert.equal(invalid.status, 400);
    assert.equal(uploads.length, 0);

    const uploaded = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/products/images`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}`,
        'Content-Type': 'image/png'
      },
      body: png
    });
    const result = await uploaded.json();
    assert.equal(uploaded.status, 201);
    assert.equal(result.success, true);
    assert.match(result.data.image_url, /^https:\/\/storage\.example\/product-images\//);
    assert.equal(uploads.length, 1);
    assert.match(uploads[0].path, /^[0-9a-f-]+\.png$/);
    assert.equal(uploads[0].options.contentType, 'image/png');
  });
});

test('products endpoint returns only a date-only public summary for multiple batches when requested', async () => {
  const productRows = [
    { id: 51, name: '有日期商品', stock: 3 },
    { id: 52, name: '無日期商品', stock: 2 },
    { id: 53, name: '沒有批次商品', stock: 0 }
  ];
  const batchRows = [
    {
      product_id: 51,
      best_before_date: '2027-08-15',
      is_legacy_stock: false,
      quantity_received: 4,
      quantity_remaining: 2,
      batch_id: 9001
    },
    {
      product_id: 51,
      best_before_date: '2027-02-01',
      is_legacy_stock: false,
      quantity_received: 6,
      quantity_remaining: 3,
      batch_id: 9002
    },
    {
      product_id: 51,
      best_before_date: null,
      is_legacy_stock: false,
      quantity_received: 1,
      quantity_remaining: 1,
      batch_id: 9003
    },
    {
      product_id: 51,
      best_before_date: null,
      is_legacy_stock: true,
      quantity_received: 2,
      quantity_remaining: 2,
      batch_id: 9004
    },
    {
      product_id: 52,
      best_before_date: null,
      is_legacy_stock: false,
      quantity_received: 2,
      quantity_remaining: 2,
      batch_id: 9005
    }
  ];
  const selectedTables = [];
  const supabase = {
    from(table) {
      selectedTables.push(table);
      if (table === 'products') return createProductsQuery(productRows);
      assert.equal(table, 'product_stock_batches');
      let selectedIds = [];
      const query = {
        select(columns) {
          assert.equal(columns, 'product_id, best_before_date, is_legacy_stock');
          return query;
        },
        in(column, ids) {
          assert.equal(column, 'product_id');
          selectedIds = ids.map(String);
          return query;
        },
        then(resolve, reject) {
          return Promise.resolve({
            data: batchRows.filter(row => selectedIds.includes(String(row.product_id))),
            error: null
          }).then(resolve, reject);
        }
      };
      return query;
    }
  };

  const router = createRouter(supabase);
  await withServer(router, async baseUrl => {
    const response = await request(
      baseUrl,
      '/api/products?include_best_before_dates=true'
    );
    assert.equal(response.status, 200);
    assert.equal(response.body.success, true);
    const [dated, undated, noBatches] = response.body.data.products;
    assert.deepEqual(dated.best_before_summary, {
      best_before_dates: ['2027-02-01', '2027-08-15'],
      has_undated_batch: true,
      has_legacy_unknown_date: true
    });
    assert.deepEqual(undated.best_before_summary, {
      best_before_dates: [],
      has_undated_batch: true,
      has_legacy_unknown_date: false
    });
    assert.deepEqual(noBatches.best_before_summary, {
      best_before_dates: [],
      has_undated_batch: false,
      has_legacy_unknown_date: false
    });
    assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(dated.best_before_summary, 'quantity_remaining'), false);
    assert.equal(Object.hasOwn(dated.best_before_summary, 'batch_id'), false);
    assert.deepEqual(selectedTables, ['products', 'product_stock_batches']);
  });
});

test('inventory adjustments validate reasons and persist a transactional audit RPC', async () => {
  const calls = [];
  const router = createRouter({
    rpc: async (name, args) => {
      calls.push({ name, args });

        data: {
          adjustment_id: 42,
          product_id: 12,
          quantity_before: 4,
          quantity_delta: -1,
          quantity_after: 3,
          reason: '損毀',
          note: '包裝破損',
          created_at: '2026-10-22T10:00:00.000Z'
        },
        error: null
      };
    }
  });

  await withServer(router, async baseUrl => {
    const unauthorized = await request(baseUrl, '/api/products/4268/adjustments', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: { quantity_delta: -1, reason: '損毀' }
    });

    const saved = await request(baseUrl, '/api/products/4268/adjustments', {
      method: 'POST',
      token: ADMIN_TOKEN,
      body: { quantity_delta: -1, reason: '損毀', note: '包裝破損' }

    assert.equal(saved.status, 200);
    assert.equal(saved.body.success, true);
    assert.equal(saved.body.data.quantity_after, 3);
    const uuid = await request(
      baseUrl,
      '/api/products/4c260c94-2cb3-4de4-a71e-5b0f5cf53d87/adjustments',
      {
        method: 'POST',
        token: ADMIN_TOKEN,
        body: { quantity_delta: -1, reason: '損毀' }
      }
    );
    assert.equal(uuid.status, 200);
    assert.deepEqual(calls, [{
      name: 'adjust_product_inventory',
      args: {
        p_product_id: '4268',
        p_quantity_delta: -1,
        p_reason: '損毀',
        p_note: '包裝破損',
        p_actor: 'admin'
      }
    }, {
      name: 'adjust_product_inventory',
      args: {
        p_product_id: '4c260c94-2cb3-4de4-a71e-5b0f5cf53d87',
        p_quantity_delta: -1,
        p_reason: '損毀',
        p_note: null,
        p_actor: 'admin'
      }
    }]);
  });
});

test('product create and edit endpoints require admin access and persist validated fields', async () => {
  const operations = [];
  const savedProduct = {
    id: '7',
    name: '星球筆記本',
    price: 89.5,
    stock: 0,
    status: '預購中'
  };
  const supabase = {
    from(table) {
      assert.equal(table, 'products');
      return {
        insert(values) {
          operations.push({ operation: 'insert', values });
          return {
            select() {
              return {
                single: async () => ({ data: savedProduct, error: null })
              };
            }
          };
        },
        update(values) {
          operations.push({ operation: 'update', values });
          return {
            eq(column, value) {
              operations[operations.length - 1].filter = { column, value };
              return {
                select() {
                  return {
                    maybeSingle: async () => ({ data: savedProduct, error: null })
                  };
                }
              };
            }
          };
        }
      };
    }
  };
  const router = createRouter(supabase);

  await withServer(router, async baseUrl => {
    const unauthorized = await request(baseUrl, '/api/products', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: { name: '未授權商品', price: 20 }
    });
    assert.equal(unauthorized.status, 401);
    assert.equal(unauthorized.body.success, false);

    const created = await request(baseUrl, '/api/products', {
      method: 'POST',
      token: ADMIN_TOKEN,
      body: {
        name: '星球筆記本',
        price: 89.5,
        tier_prices: [{ min_qty: 6, price: 82 }, { min_qty: 3, price: 85 }],
        preorder_deadline: '2026-11-01T12:00:00.000Z'
      }
    });
    assert.equal(created.status, 201);
    assert.equal(created.body.success, true);
    assert.equal(created.body.data.stock, 0);
    assert.deepEqual(operations[0].values.tier_prices, [
      { min_qty: 3, price: 85 },
      { min_qty: 6, price: 82 }
    ]);
    assert.equal(operations[0].values.preorder_deadline, '2026-11-01T12:00:00.000Z');

    const updated = await request(baseUrl, `/api/products/${savedProduct.id}`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      token: ADMIN_TOKEN,
      body: {
        name: '星球筆記本（新版）',
        price: 99,
        tier_prices: [{ min_qty: 3, price: 88 }],
        preorder_deadline: null
      }
    });
    assert.equal(updated.status, 200);
    assert.equal(updated.body.success, true);
    assert.equal(updated.body.data.name, savedProduct.name);
  });

  assert.deepEqual(operations, [
    {
      operation: 'insert',
      values: {
        name: '星球筆記本',
        price: 89.5,
        tier_prices: [
          { min_qty: 3, price: 85 },
          { min_qty: 6, price: 82 }
        ],
        preorder_deadline: '2026-11-01T12:00:00.000Z',
        stock: 0,
        status: '預購中'
      }
    },
    {
      operation: 'update',
      values: {
        name: '星球筆記本（新版）',
        price: 99,
        tier_prices: [{ min_qty: 3, price: 88 }],
        preorder_deadline: null
      },
      filter: { column: 'id', value: savedProduct.id }
    }
  ]);
});

test('product edit preserves UUID IDs when updating batch expiry data', async () => {

  const router = createRouter({
    from(table) {
      if (table === 'products') {
        return {
          update() {
            return {
              eq(column, value) {
                assert.equal(column, 'id');
                assert.equal(value, productId);
                return {
                  select() {
                    return {
                      maybeSingle: async () => ({
                        data: { id: productId, name: 'UUID 商品', price: 10, stock: 4 },
                        error: null
                      })
                    };
                  }
                };
              }
            };
          }
        };
      }
      assert.equal(table, 'product_stock_batches');
      return {
        delete() {
          return {
            eq(column, value) {
              assert.equal(column, 'product_id');
              assert.equal(value, productId);
              return { error: null };
            }
          };
        },
        insert(values) {
          insertedBatch = values;
          return { error: null };
        }
      };
    }
  });

  await withServer(router, async baseUrl => {
    const response = await request(baseUrl, `/api/products/${productId}`, {
      method: 'PATCH',
      token: ADMIN_TOKEN,
      body: {
        name: 'UUID 商品',
        price: 10,
        best_before_date: '2027-08-15'
      }
    });
    assert.equal(response.status, 200);
    assert.equal(response.body.success, true);
  });

  assert.deepEqual(insertedBatch, {
    product_id: productId,
    best_before_date: '2027-08-15',
    is_legacy_stock: false,
    quantity_received: 4,
    quantity_remaining: 4
  });
});

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const test = require('node:test');
const vm = require('node:vm');

const publicDirectory = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'public');

test('storefront web app manifest declares installable LittlePlanet app metadata and an existing icon', () => {
  const manifest = JSON.parse(
    fs.readFileSync(path.join(publicDirectory, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8')
  );
  assert.equal(manifest.name, 'LittlePlanet 宇宙網店');
  assert.equal(manifest.short_name, 'LittlePlanet');
  assert.equal(manifest.display, 'standalone');
  assert.equal(manifest.theme_color, '#f8fafc');
  for (const size of ['192x192', '512x512']) {
    const icon = manifest.icons.find(item => item.sizes === size);
    assert.ok(icon, `manifest should include a ${size} icon`);
    assert.ok(fs.existsSync(path.join(publicDirectory, icon.src.replace(/^\//, ''))));
  }
  assert.ok(manifest.icons.some(icon =>
    icon.sizes === 'any' &&
    fs.existsSync(path.join(publicDirectory, icon.src.replace(/^\//, '')))
  ));
});

test('service worker parses and explicitly avoids caching API responses', () => {
  const source = fs.readFileSync(path.join(publicDirectory, 'sw.js'), 'utf8');
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => new vm.Script(source, { filename: 'public/sw.js' }));
  assert.match(source, /url\.pathname\.startsWith\('\/api\/'\)/);
  assert.match(source, /request\.mode === 'navigate'/);
  assert.match(source, /response\.ok && !url\.search/);
  assert.match(source, /caches\.match\('\/'\)/);
});
