'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const createReminderRouter = require('../routes/reminders');

const CRON_TOKEN = 'r'.repeat(40);
const NOW = new Date('2026-10-23T08:00:00.000Z');

async function withReminderServer(supabase, sendWhatsApp, run) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use('/api/reminders', createReminderRouter(supabase, {
    cronToken: CRON_TOKEN,
    recipients: ['85290899546'],
    sendWhatsApp
  }));

  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();

  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

function createSupabase(products, options = {}) {
  return {
    from(table) {
      assert.equal(table, 'products');
      let operation = 'select';
      let payload = null;
      let selectedColumns = '*';
      const filters = [];
      let claimFilter = null;

      const query = {
        select(columns = '*') {
          selectedColumns = columns;
          return query;
        },
        eq(field, value) {
          filters.push(product => product[field] === value);
          return query;
        },
        gte(field, value) {
          filters.push(product => Date.parse(product[field]) >= Date.parse(value));
          return query;
        },
        lte(field, value) {
          filters.push(product => Date.parse(product[field]) <= Date.parse(value));
          return query;
        },
        order() {
          return query;
        },
        update(values) {
          operation = 'update';
          payload = values;
          return query;
        },
        or(expression) {
          const separator = ',remind_claimed_at.lt.';
          const separatorIndex = expression.indexOf(separator);
          assert.notEqual(separatorIndex, -1);
          const staleClaimBefore = expression.slice(separatorIndex + separator.length);
          claimFilter = product => (
            product.remind_claimed_at == null ||
            Date.parse(product.remind_claimed_at) < Date.parse(staleClaimBefore)
          );
          return query;
        },
        then(resolve, reject) {
          if (options.queryError) {
            return Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: options.queryError })
              .then(resolve, reject);
          }

          const matchingProducts = products.filter(product => (
            filters.every(filter => filter(product)) &&
            (!claimFilter || claimFilter(product))
          ));

          if (operation === 'update') {
            for (const product of matchingProducts) {
              Object.assign(product, payload);
            }
          }

          const data = matchingProducts.map(product => {
            if (selectedColumns === '*') {
              return { ...product };
            }
            return Object.fromEntries(
              selectedColumns
                .split(',')
                .map(column => [column, product[column]])
            );
          });
          return Promise.resolve({ data, error: null }).then(resolve, reject);
        }
      };

      return query;
    }
  };
}

async function postReminderRun(baseUrl) {
  const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/reminders/run`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${CRON_TOKEN}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ hours: 24 })
  });
  return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() };
}

function createProduct(cutoffOffsetMs, overrides = {}) {
  return {
    id: 1,
    name: '小行星曲奇',
    cutoff_datetime: new Date(NOW.getTime() + cutoffOffsetMs).toISOString(),
    remind_status: '未提示',
    remind_claimed_at: null,
    is_active: true,
    status: '預購中',
    ...overrides
  };
}

test('提醒在截單前剛好 24 小時時成功發送並更新狀態', async t => {
  t.mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['Date'], now: NOW });
  const products = [createProduct(24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)];
  const sentMessages = [];
  const supabase = createSupabase(products);

  await withReminderServer(supabase, async message => {
    sentMessages.push(message);
  }, async baseUrl => {
    const result = await postReminderRun(baseUrl);

    assert.equal(result.status, 200);
    assert.equal(result.body.success, true);
    assert.equal(result.body.data.length, 1);
    assert.equal(result.body.data[0].success, true);
    assert.equal(sentMessages.length, 1);
    assert.equal(sentMessages[0].to, '85290899546');
    assert.match(sentMessages[0].text, /小行星曲奇/);
    assert.equal(products[0].remind_status, '已發送提醒');
    assert.equal(products[0].remind_claimed_at, null);
  });
});

test('截單時間超出 24 小時窗口時不會發送提醒', async t => {
  t.mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['Date'], now: NOW });
  const products = [createProduct(24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 + 1)];
  let sendCount = 0;

  await withReminderServer(createSupabase(products), async () => {
    sendCount += 1;
  }, async baseUrl => {
    const result = await postReminderRun(baseUrl);

    assert.equal(result.status, 200);
    assert.equal(result.body.success, true);
    assert.deepEqual(result.body.data, []);
    assert.equal(sendCount, 0);
    assert.equal(products[0].remind_status, '未提示');
  });
});

test('成功發送後重跑不會重複發送同一商品提醒', async t => {
  t.mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['Date'], now: NOW });
  const products = [createProduct(24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)];
  let sendCount = 0;

  await withReminderServer(createSupabase(products), async () => {
    sendCount += 1;
  }, async baseUrl => {
    const firstRun = await postReminderRun(baseUrl);
    const secondRun = await postReminderRun(baseUrl);

    assert.equal(firstRun.status, 200);
    assert.equal(firstRun.body.data[0].success, true);
    assert.equal(secondRun.status, 200);
    assert.equal(secondRun.body.success, true);
    assert.deepEqual(secondRun.body.data, []);
    assert.equal(sendCount, 1);
    assert.equal(products[0].remind_status, '已發送提醒');
  });
});

test('Supabase 查詢失敗時回傳標準 JSON 錯誤格式', async t => {
  t.mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['Date'], now: NOW });
  const supabase = createSupabase([], {
    queryError: { code: 'XX000', message: 'private database detail' }
  });

  await withReminderServer(supabase, async () => {
    assert.fail('資料庫查詢失敗時不應發送提醒。');
  }, async baseUrl => {
    const result = await postReminderRun(baseUrl);

    assert.equal(result.status, 500);
    assert.deepEqual(result.body, {
      success: false,
      data: null,
      message: '執行截單提醒時發生錯誤。'
    });
    assert.doesNotMatch(result.body.message, /private database detail/);
  });
});

  class Query {

    eq(field, value) {

      return this;

    insert(value) {

      return this;
    }

    delete() {

    async single() {

      return { data: result.data[0] || null, error: result.error };

    async maybeSingle() {

      }
      const rows = tables[this.table];
      if (this.operation === 'insert') {
        const inserted = {
          review_id: REVIEW_ID,
          created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          ...this.insertValues
        };
        rows.push(inserted);
        return { data: [inserted], count: null, error: null };
      }
      const matched = rows.filter(row => this.filters.every(filter => filter(row)));
      if (this.operation === 'update') {
        matched.forEach(row => Object.assign(row, this.updateValues));
        return { data: matched, count: null, error: null };
      }
      if (this.operation === 'delete') {
        tables[this.table] = rows.filter(row => !matched.includes(row));
      }
      const start = this.rangeStart || 0;
      const sliced = matched.slice(start, this.rangeEnd === undefined
        ? this.limitValue
        : this.rangeEnd + 1);
      return {
        data: this.operation === 'delete' ? matched : sliced,
        count: this.countRequested ? matched.length : null,
        error: null
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    tables,
    rpc: async (name, args) => {
      if (name === 'has_customer_purchased_product') {
        return { data: options.purchased !== false, error: options.purchaseError || null };
      }
      if (options.rpcError) return { data: null, error: options.rpcError };
      if (name === 'get_product_review_summaries') {
        return {
          data: [{
            product_id: args.p_product_ids[0],
            average_rating: 4.5,
            review_count: 2
          }],
          error: null
        };
      }
      assert.equal(name, 'get_product_reviews');
      assert.equal(args.p_product_id, PRODUCT_ID);
      return {
        data: {
          average_rating: 5,
          review_count: 1,
          reviews: [{
            review_id: REVIEW_ID,
            product_id: PRODUCT_ID,
            rating: 5,
            comment: '很喜歡！',
            created_at: '2026-10-04T01:00:00Z'
          }]
        },
        error: null
      };
    },
    from(table) {
      return new Query(table);
    }
  };
}

function customerCookie() {
  return `littleplanet_customer_session=${encodeURIComponent(
    createCustomerSession(PHONE, SESSION_SECRET)
  )}`;
}

test('API protection rate limits requests and returns retry metadata', async () => {
  const middleware = createApiProtection({ windowMs: 60000, maxRequests: 2 });
  await withServer(middleware, async baseUrl => {
    const first = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/ping`);
    const second = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/ping`);
    const limited = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/ping`);
    const body = await limited.json();

    assert.equal(first.status, 200);
    assert.equal(first.headers.get('ratelimit-limit'), '2');
    assert.equal(second.status, 200);
    assert.equal(limited.status, 429);
    assert.equal(limited.headers.get('retry-after') !== null, true);
    assert.equal(body.success, false);
    assert.equal(body.data, null);
  });
});

  });

      headers: { Origin: baseUrl }

      }

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const XLSX = require('xlsx');
const createShippingRouter = require('../routes/shipping');
const createOrdersRouter = require('../routes/orders');

const ADMIN_TOKEN = '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef';

async function withServer(router, run, mountPath = '/api/shipping') {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use(mountPath, router);
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();

  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

async function request(baseUrl, path, options = {}) {
  const headers = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}`,
    ...(options.body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
    ...(options.headers || {})
  };
  const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, {
    method: options.method || 'GET',
    headers,
    body: options.body ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : undefined
  });
  return { status: response.status, body: await response.json() };
}

function createRouter(supabase, options = {}) {
  return createShippingRouter(supabase, {
    adminToken: ADMIN_TOKEN,
    writeEnabled: true,
    ...options
  });
}

function createTableClient(tables) {
  return {
    from(tableName) {
      const state = {
        rows: tables[tableName] || [],
        filters: []
      };
      const query = {
        select() {
          return query;
        },
        eq(column, value) {
          state.filters.push(row => row[column] === value);
          return query;
        },
        in(column, values) {
          const selected = new Set(values.map(String));
          state.filters.push(row => selected.has(String(row[column])));
          return query;
        },
        order() {
          return query;
        },
        limit() {
          return query;
        },
        then(resolve, reject) {
          return Promise.resolve({
            data: state.rows.filter(row => state.filters.every(filter => filter(row))),
            error: null
          }).then(resolve, reject);
        }
      };
      return query;
    }
  };
}

    rpc: async (name, args) => {

      if (name === 'ship_order') {
        return { data: { success: true }, error: null };
      }
      if (name === 'claim_shipping_notification') {
        attempt += 1;
        return {
          data: {
            claimed: true,
            status: 'sending',
            customer_phone: '85212345678',
            shipping_method: '京東',
            tracking_number: 'JD007'
          },
          error: null
        };
      }
      return { data: { status: args.p_success ? 'sent' : 'failed' }, error: null };
    }
  };
  const router = createRouter(supabase, {
    sendWhatsApp: async () => {
      if (attempt === 1) {
        throw new Error('WhatsApp unavailable');
      }
    }

);

  .map(match => match[1])

  .join('\n');

test('admin SOP generator is limited to product managers and supplies pricing, cutoff, upload and preview controls', () => {

  assert.match(adminHtml, /id="sop-image" type="file" accept="image\/jpeg,image\/png,image\/webp"/);
  assert.match(adminHtml, /id="sop-preview"/);
  assert.match(inlineScript, /Math\.ceil\(cost \* 1\.2\)/);
  assert.match(inlineScript, /deadline\.setDate\(deadline\.getDate\(\) \+ 7\)/);
  assert.match(inlineScript, /deadline\.setHours\(23, 59, 0, 0\)/);
  assert.match(inlineScript, /activeAdminView === 'sop' && !adminScopes\.includes\('products'\)/);
  assert.match(inlineScript, /method: 'POST',[\s\S]*body: JSON\.stringify\(\{[\s\S]*cost_price: costPrice/);
  assert.match(inlineScript, /\/api\/products\/images/);
  assert.match(inlineScript, /LittlePlanet 宇宙直送/);
  assert.match(inlineScript, /items=\$\{encodeURIComponent\(productId\)\}:1/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(inlineScript, /sop-supplier-source[\s\S]{0,100}body:/);
  assert.doesNotThrow(() => new vm.Script(inlineScript, { filename: 'public/admin.html' }));
});

'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const crypto = require('node:crypto');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const createWebhookRouter = require('../routes/webhook');

const APP_SECRET = 'whatsapp-order-webhook-test-secret-0123456789';
const PHONE = '85291234567';
const INTENT_TOKEN = 'f6d946f1-6712-4ea2-9a75-a1ca24a60001';

function createStore() {
  const store = {
    products: [
      {
        id: 101,
        product_code: 'A',
        product_name: '星球餅乾',
        price: 20,
        stock: 8,
        status: '預購中',
        is_active: true,
        tier_prices: [],
        preorder_deadline: null
      },
      {
        id: 102,
        product_code: 'B款',
        product_name: '月亮公仔',
        price: 30,
        stock: 6,
        status: '預購中',
        is_active: true,
        tier_prices: [],
        preorder_deadline: null
      }
    ],
    intents: new Map(),
    confirmationMessages: new Map(),
    orders: [],
    rpcCalls: [],
    replies: []
  };

  store.supabase = {
    async rpc(name, args = {}) {
      store.rpcCalls.push({ name, args });

      if (name === 'list_whatsapp_order_catalog') {
        return { data: store.products.map(product => ({ ...product })), error: null };
      }

      if (name === 'create_whatsapp_order_intent') {
        const previous = store.intents.get(args.p_source_message_id);
        if (previous) {
          if (previous.customer_phone !== args.p_customer_phone) {
            return {
              data: {
                success: false,
                data: null,
                message: '訊息 ID 已被其他客戶使用。',
                code: 'MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT'
              },
              error: null
            };
          }
          return {
            data: {
              success: true,
              data: { ...previous, duplicate: true },
              message: '此 WhatsApp 訊息已處理。'
            },
            error: null
          };
        }

        const items = [];
        let total = 0;
        for (const requested of args.p_items) {
          const product = store.products.find(item => String(item.id) === requested.product_id);
          if (!product || product.product_code !== requested.product_code) {
            return {
              data: {
                success: false,
                data: null,
                message: '商品已下架、截單或資料已變更，請重新提交。',
                code: 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE'
              },
              error: null
            };
          }
          if (product.stock < requested.quantity) {
            return {
              data: {
                success: false,
                data: null,
                message: '商品庫存不足，請調整數量後再試。',
                code: 'STOCK_UNAVAILABLE'
              },
              error: null
            };
          }
          const subtotal = product.price * requested.quantity;
          total += subtotal;
          items.push({
            product_id: requested.product_id,
            product_code: product.product_code,
            product_name: product.product_name,
            quantity: requested.quantity,
            unit_price: product.price,
            subtotal
          });
        }

        const intent = {
          duplicate: false,
          status: 'pending',
          intent_token: INTENT_TOKEN,
          items,
          total_amount: total,
          expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
          customer_phone: args.p_customer_phone
        };
        store.intents.set(args.p_source_message_id, intent);
        return {
          data: {
            success: true,
            data: { ...intent },
            message: '訂單預覽已建立，等待客戶確認。'
          },
          error: null
        };
      }

      if (name === 'confirm_whatsapp_order_intent') {
        const prior = store.confirmationMessages.get(args.p_confirmation_message_id);
        if (prior) {
          return {
            data: {
              success: true,
              data: { ...prior, duplicate: true },
              message: '此確認訊息已處理。'
            },
            error: null
          };
        }

        const intent = [...store.intents.values()].find(item => (
          item.intent_token === args.p_intent_token &&
          item.customer_phone === args.p_customer_phone
        ));
        if (!intent || intent.status !== 'pending') {
          return {
            data: {
              success: false,
              data: null,
              message: '找不到此電話號碼對應的待確認訂單。',
              code: 'INTENT_NOT_FOUND'
            },
            error: null
          };
        }

        const order = {
          order_number: 'LP-20261023-ABCDEF12',
          payment_status: '未付款',
          total_amount: intent.total_amount
        };
        for (const item of intent.items) {
          const product = store.products.find(candidate => (
            String(candidate.id) === item.product_id
          ));
          product.stock -= item.quantity;
        }
        store.orders.push(order);
        intent.status = 'confirmed';
        intent.order_number = order.order_number;
        const confirmed = {
          duplicate: false,
          status: 'confirmed',
          order_number: order.order_number,
          total_amount: order.total_amount
        };
        store.confirmationMessages.set(args.p_confirmation_message_id, confirmed);
        return {
          data: {
            success: true,
            data: confirmed,
            message: '訂單已建立，付款狀態為未付款。'
          },
          error: null
        };
      }

      throw new Error(`Unexpected RPC: ${name}`);
    }
  };
  return store;
}

async function withWebhookServer(store, run) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json({
    verify(req, res, buffer) {
      req.rawBody = Buffer.from(buffer);
    }
  }));
  app.use('/api/webhook', createWebhookRouter(store.supabase, {
    appSecret: APP_SECRET,
    verifyToken: 'v'.repeat(40),
    writeEnabled: true,
    sendWhatsApp: async message => store.replies.push(message)
  }));
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();
  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

function createPayload(messageId, text, phone = PHONE) {
  return {
    object: 'whatsapp_business_account',

            type: 'text',

          }]
        }
      }]
    }]
  };
}

function sign(body) {

}

    },

  });

}

'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const crypto = require('node:crypto');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const createWebhookRouter = require('../routes/webhook');

const APP_SECRET = 'whatsapp-payment-proof-test-secret-0123456789';
const ORDER_ID = 'e1da0bac-9021-4e87-920b-2f5bf5381f32';
const ORDER_NUMBER = 'LP-20261023-0003';
const PHONE = '85291234567';
const PNG = Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10, 1, 2, 3]);

function createStore(options = {}) {
  const store = {
    orders: [{
      order_id: ORDER_ID,
      order_number: ORDER_NUMBER,
      customer_phone: PHONE,
      payment_status: '未付款',
      payment_proof_status: 'pending',
      payment_proof_url: null
    }],
    receipts: new Map(),
    storageCalls: [],
    rpcCalls: [],
    replies: [],
    images: []
  };

  store.supabase = {
    async rpc(name, args) {
      store.rpcCalls.push({ name, args });
      if (name === 'claim_whatsapp_payment_proof') {
        if (
          args.p_customer_phone !== PHONE ||
          args.p_order_number !== ORDER_NUMBER
        ) {
          return {
            data: {
              success: false,
              data: null,
              message: '找不到符合此電話及訂單編號的訂單。',
              code: 'ORDER_NOT_FOUND'
            },
            error: null
          };
        }
        const previous = store.receipts.get(args.p_message_id);
        if (previous) {
          return {
            data: {
              success: true,
              data: {
                order_id: ORDER_ID,
                order_number: ORDER_NUMBER,
                duplicate: true
              },
              message: '此 WhatsApp 訊息已處理。'
            },
            error: null
          };
        }
        store.receipts.set(args.p_message_id, {
          order_id: ORDER_ID,
          order_number: ORDER_NUMBER,
          status: 'processing'
        });
        return {
          data: {
            success: true,
            data: {
              order_id: ORDER_ID,
              order_number: ORDER_NUMBER,
              duplicate: false
            },
            message: '付款憑證訂單已驗證。'
          },
          error: null
        };
      }
      if (name === 'complete_whatsapp_payment_proof') {
        const receipt = store.receipts.get(args.p_message_id);
        if (options.completeError) {
          return { data: null, error: options.completeError };
        }
        receipt.status = 'pending_review';
        store.orders[0].payment_proof_url = args.p_object_path;
        store.orders[0].payment_proof_status = 'pending';
        return {
          data: {
            success: true,
            data: {
              order_number: ORDER_NUMBER,
              old_proof_path: null,
              payment_proof_status: 'pending'
            },
            message: '付款憑證已儲存並等待管理員審核。'
          },
          error: null
        };
      }
      if (name === 'fail_whatsapp_payment_proof') {
        const receipt = store.receipts.get(args.p_message_id);
        if (receipt) receipt.status = 'failed';
        return {
          data: { success: true, data: null, message: '處理失敗已記錄。' },
          error: null
        };
      }
      if (name === 'set_whatsapp_payment_proof_notification') {
        const receipt = store.receipts.get(args.p_message_id);
        if (!receipt || receipt.status !== 'pending_review') {
          return {
            data: { success: false, data: null, message: '記錄不存在。' },
            error: null
          };
        }
        receipt.notification_status = args.p_status;
        receipt.notification_error = args.p_error;
        return {
          data: { success: true, data: { status: args.p_status }, message: '已更新。' },
          error: null
        };
      }
      throw new Error(`Unexpected RPC: ${name}`);
    },
    storage: {
      from(bucket) {
        assert.equal(bucket, 'payment-proofs');
        return {
          async upload(path, media, fileOptions) {
            store.storageCalls.push({ method: 'upload', path, media, fileOptions });
            if (options.storageError) {
              return { data: null, error: options.storageError };
            }
            return { data: { path }, error: null };
          },
          async remove(paths) {
            store.storageCalls.push({ method: 'remove', paths });
            return { data: paths, error: null };
          }
        };
      }
    }
  };
  return store;
}

async function withServer(store, run, options = {}) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json({
    verify(req, res, buffer) {
      req.rawBody = Buffer.from(buffer);
    }
  }));
  app.use('/api/webhook', createWebhookRouter(store.supabase, {
    appSecret: APP_SECRET,
    writeEnabled: true,
    receiptRecipients: ['85290000001'],
    sendWhatsApp: async message => store.replies.push(message),
    downloadWhatsAppMedia: async () => ({
      media: options.media || PNG,
      mimeType: options.mimeType || 'image/png'
    }),
    sendWhatsAppImage: async message => {
      store.images.push(message);
      if (options.forwardError) throw new Error('simulated internal notification failure');
      return 'wamid.receipt';
    }
  }));
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();
  try {
    await run(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const test = require('node:test');
const {
  MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY,
  parseWhatsAppOrderMessage
} = require('../utils/whatsapp-order-parser');

const PRODUCTS = [
  { product_code: 'B款', name: 'B 款商品' },
  { product_code: 'A', name: 'A 商品' },
  { product_code: 'C', name: 'C 商品' },
  { product_code: 'D', name: 'D 商品' }
];

test('parses a product code with Chinese variant text and compact quantity', () => {
  const result = parseWhatsAppOrderMessage('B款 x3', PRODUCTS);

  assert.deepEqual(result, {
    success: true,
    data: { items: [{ product_code: 'B款', quantity: 3 }] },
    message: '落單內容已驗證，尚未建立訂單。'
  });
});

test('normalizes case, whitespace, full-width characters and multiple items', () => {
  const result = parseWhatsAppOrderMessage('Ｂ款　Ｘ　３， ａ x 1，Ｃ × 1；D＊３', PRODUCTS);

  assert.equal(result.success, true);
  assert.deepEqual(result.data.items, [
    { product_code: 'B款', quantity: 3 },
    { product_code: 'A', quantity: 1 },
    { product_code: 'C', quantity: 1 },
    { product_code: 'D', quantity: 3 }
  ]);
});

test('rejects an unknown product code without producing order items', () => {
  const result = parseWhatsAppOrderMessage('Z x 1', PRODUCTS);

  assert.equal(result.success, false);
  assert.equal(result.data, null);
  assert.equal(result.error.code, 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND');
  assert.match(result.message, /找不到商品代號「Z」/);
});

test('rejects malformed entries and non-positive quantities', async t => {
  await t.test('malformed syntax', () => {
    const result = parseWhatsAppOrderMessage('B款 三件', PRODUCTS);
    assert.equal(result.success, false);
    assert.equal(result.error.code, 'INVALID_ITEM_FORMAT');
  });

  await t.test('zero quantity', () => {
    const result = parseWhatsAppOrderMessage('A x 0', PRODUCTS);
    assert.equal(result.success, false);
    assert.equal(result.error.code, 'INVALID_QUANTITY');
  });

  await t.test('quantity above the checkout limit', () => {
    const result = parseWhatsAppOrderMessage(`A x ${MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY + 1}`, PRODUCTS);
    assert.equal(result.success, false);
    assert.equal(result.error.code, 'QUANTITY_EXCEEDED');
  });
});

test('rejects repeated or ambiguous product codes', async t => {
  await t.test('duplicate item in a message', () => {
    const result = parseWhatsAppOrderMessage('A x 1, a x 2', PRODUCTS);
    assert.equal(result.success, false);
    assert.equal(result.error.code, 'DUPLICATE_ITEM');
  });

  await t.test('duplicate product code in the catalog', () => {
    const result = parseWhatsAppOrderMessage('A x 1', [

'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const http = require('node:http');
const test = require('node:test');
const express = require('express');
const createCustomerRouter = require('../routes/customer');
const { createCustomerSession } = require('../middleware/customer-session');

const SECRET = 'wishlist-customer-session-secret-0123456789';
const PRODUCT_ID = '7';

async function withServer(supabase, run, options = {}) {
  const app = express();
  app.use(express.json());
  app.use('/api/customer', createCustomerRouter(supabase, {
    sessionSecret: SECRET,
    readEnabled: true,
    ...options
  }));
  const server = http.createServer(app);
  await new Promise(resolve => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', resolve));
  const baseUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}`;
  try {
    await run(baseUrl);
  } finally {
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve());
    });
  }
}

function memberCookie(phone = PHONE) {
  return `littleplanet_customer_session=${encodeURIComponent(
    createCustomerSession(phone, SECRET)
  )}`;
}

function createSupabase(options = {}) {
  const tables = {
    customer_wishlists: [{
      id: WISHLIST_ID,
      customer_phone: PHONE,
      product_id: 7,
      created_at: '2026-10-03T00:00:00.000Z'
    }],
    products: [

        id: 7,
        name: '小行星貼紙',
        price: 28.5,
        stock: 5,
        image_url: 'https://example.com/item.png',
        secret_column: 'must-not-leak'
      },
      { id: 8, name: '月球筆記本', price: 45, stock: 2 }
    ]
  };

  class Query {
    constructor(table) {
      this.table = table;
      this.filters = [];
      this.operation = 'select';
    }

    select(fields, selectionOptions) {
      this.fields = fields;
      this.countRequested = selectionOptions && selectionOptions.count === 'exact';
      return this;
    }

    eq(field, value) {
      this.filters.push(row => String(row[field]) === String(value));
      return this;
    }

    in(field, values) {
      const accepted = new Set(values.map(String));
      this.filters.push(row => accepted.has(String(row[field])));
      return this;
    }

    order() { return this; }

    range(start, end) {
      this.start = start;
      this.end = end;
      return this;
    }

    insert(value) {
      this.operation = 'insert';
      this.value = value;
      return this;
    }

    delete() {
      this.operation = 'delete';
      return this;
    }

    async single() {
      const result = await this.execute();
      return { data: result.data && result.data[0] || null, error: result.error };
    }

    async maybeSingle() {
      const result = await this.execute();
      return { data: result.data && result.data[0] || null, error: result.error };
    }

    then(resolve, reject) {
      return this.execute().then(resolve, reject);
    }

    async execute() {
      if (options.error && options.error.table === this.table &&
          options.error.operation === this.operation) {
        return { data: null, count: null, error: options.error.value };
      }
      const rows = tables[this.table];
      if (this.operation === 'insert') {
        if (rows.some(row =>
          row.customer_phone === this.value.customer_phone &&
          String(row.product_id) === String(this.value.product_id)
        )) {
          return { data: null, count: null, error: { code: '23505' } };
        }
        const row = {
          id: '99a420aa-07ac-4c83-8ee9-b76f3613fb0d',
          created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          ...this.value
        };
        rows.push(row);
        return { data: [row], count: null, error: null };
      }
      const matching = rows.filter(row => this.filters.every(filter => filter(row)));
      if (this.operation === 'delete') {
        tables[this.table] = rows.filter(row => !matching.includes(row));
      }
      const offset = this.start || 0;
      const result = this.operation === 'delete'
        ? matching
        : matching.slice(offset, this.end === undefined ? undefined : this.end + 1);
      return {
        data: result,
        count: this.countRequested ? matching.length : null,
        error: null
      };
    }
  }

  return { tables, from: table => new Query(table) };
}

'use strict';

function hasRealConfiguration(value) {
  return typeof value === 'string' &&
    value.trim() !== '' &&
    !/^(?:your-|replace-with-|vXX)/i.test(value.trim());
}

function createWhatsAppSender(options = {}) {
  const apiVersion = options.apiVersion;
  const phoneNumberId = options.phoneNumberId;
  const accessToken = options.accessToken;
  const fetchImpl = options.fetchImpl || globalThis.fetch;
  const configuredValues = [apiVersion, phoneNumberId, accessToken];
  const configuredCount = configuredValues.filter(hasRealConfiguration).length;

  if (configuredCount === 0) {
    return null;
  }
  if (configuredCount !== configuredValues.length) {
    throw new Error('WhatsApp Cloud API 設定不完整，請檢查版本、電話號碼 ID 及 API Token。');
  }
  if (!/^v\d+\.\d+$/.test(apiVersion) || !/^\d+$/.test(phoneNumberId)) {
    throw new Error('WhatsApp Cloud API 版本或電話號碼 ID 格式無效。');
  }
  if (typeof fetchImpl !== 'function') {
    throw new Error('目前 Node.js 環境未提供可用的 fetch。');
  }

  return async function sendWhatsApp({ to, text }) {
    if (typeof to !== 'string' || !/^[0-9]{8,15}$/.test(to)) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 收件電話格式無效。');
    }
    if (typeof text !== 'string' || text.trim() === '' || text.length > 4096) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 訊息內容無效。');
    }

    const response = await fetchImpl(
      `https://graph.facebook.com/${apiVersion}/${phoneNumberId}/messages`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
          recipient_type: 'individual',
          to,
          type: 'text',
          text: { preview_url: false, body: text }
        })
      }
    );

    if (!response || response.ok !== true) {
      const status = response && Number.isInteger(response.status)
        ? response.status
        : 'unknown';
      throw new Error(`WhatsApp Cloud API 發送失敗（HTTP ${status}）。`);
    }

    let result;
    try {
      result = await response.json();
    } catch (error) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp Cloud API 回應格式無效。', { cause: error });
    }
    if (!result || !Array.isArray(result.messages) || typeof result.messages[0]?.id !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp Cloud API 未確認訊息已接收。');
    }
    return result.messages[0].id;
  };
}

function parseJsonResponse(response, failureMessage) {
  return response.json().catch(error => {
    throw new Error(failureMessage, { cause: error });
  });
}

function isAllowedMediaUrl(value) {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === 'https:' &&
      !url.port &&
      !url.username &&
      !url.password &&
      [
        'graph.facebook.com',
        'lookaside.fbsbx.com',
        'lookaside.facebook.com'
      ].includes(url.hostname);
  } catch (error) {
    return false;
  }
}

function createMediaMethods({ apiVersion, phoneNumberId, accessToken, fetchImpl }) {
  async function downloadMedia(mediaId) {
    if (typeof mediaId !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}$/.test(mediaId)) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 媒體 ID 格式無效。');
    }

    const metadataResponse = await fetchImpl(
      `https://graph.facebook.com/${apiVersion}/${encodeURIComponent(mediaId)}`,
      {
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },

      }
    );
    if (!metadataResponse || metadataResponse.ok !== true) {
      const status = metadataResponse && Number.isInteger(metadataResponse.status)
        ? metadataResponse.status
        : 'unknown';
      throw new Error(`WhatsApp 媒體資料讀取失敗（HTTP ${status}）。`);
    }

    const metadata = await parseJsonResponse(metadataResponse, 'WhatsApp 媒體資料格式無效。');
    if (!metadata || typeof metadata.url !== 'string' || !isAllowedMediaUrl(metadata.url)) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 媒體下載網址無效。');
    }
    if (
      typeof metadata.mime_type !== 'string' ||
      !['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(metadata.mime_type.toLowerCase())
    ) {
      throw new Error('只接受 JPG、PNG 或 WEBP 付款憑證。');
    }
    if (Number(metadata.file_size) > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      throw new Error('付款憑證圖片不可超過 5 MB。');
    }

    const mediaResponse = await fetchImpl(metadata.url, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
      redirect: 'error'
    });
    if (!mediaResponse || mediaResponse.ok !== true) {
      const status = mediaResponse && Number.isInteger(mediaResponse.status)
        ? mediaResponse.status
        : 'unknown';
      throw new Error(`WhatsApp 付款憑證下載失敗（HTTP ${status}）。`);
    }
    const contentType = (mediaResponse.headers.get('content-type') || '')
      .split(';', 1)[0]
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
    const contentLength = Number(mediaResponse.headers.get('content-length'));
    if (
      !['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(contentType) ||
      Number.isFinite(contentLength) && contentLength > 5 * 1024 * 1024
    ) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 下載的付款憑證格式或大小無效。');
    }

    let media;
    if (mediaResponse.body && typeof mediaResponse.body.getReader === 'function') {
      const reader = mediaResponse.body.getReader();
      const chunks = [];
      let totalBytes = 0;
      try {
        while (true) {
          const { done, value } = await reader.read();
          if (done) break;
          totalBytes += value.byteLength;
          if (totalBytes > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
            await reader.cancel();
            throw new Error('付款憑證圖片不可超過 5 MB。');
          }
          chunks.push(Buffer.from(value));
        }
      } finally {
        reader.releaseLock();
      }
      media = Buffer.concat(chunks, totalBytes);
    } else {
      media = Buffer.from(await mediaResponse.arrayBuffer());
      if (media.length > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        throw new Error('付款憑證圖片不可超過 5 MB。');
      }
    }

    if (media.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 下載的付款憑證圖片為空。');
    }
    return { media, mimeType: contentType };
  }

  async function sendImage({ to, media, mimeType, caption }) {
    if (
      typeof to !== 'string' ||
      !/^[0-9]{8,15}$/.test(to) ||
      !Buffer.isBuffer(media) ||
      media.length === 0 ||
      media.length > 5 * 1024 * 1024 ||
      !['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(mimeType)
    ) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 圖片收件人或媒體資料無效。');
    }
    if (typeof Blob !== 'function' || typeof FormData !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('目前 Node.js 環境未提供 WhatsApp 圖片上傳所需功能。');
    }

    const form = new FormData();
    form.append('messaging_product', 'whatsapp');
    form.append('type', mimeType);
    form.append('file', new Blob([media], { type: mimeType }), 'payment-proof');
    const uploadResponse = await fetchImpl(
      `https://graph.facebook.com/${apiVersion}/${phoneNumberId}/media`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
        body: form
      }
    );
    if (!uploadResponse || uploadResponse.ok !== true) {
      const status = uploadResponse && Number.isInteger(uploadResponse.status)
        ? uploadResponse.status
        : 'unknown';
      throw new Error(`WhatsApp 圖片上傳失敗（HTTP ${status}）。`);
    }
    const uploaded = await parseJsonResponse(uploadResponse, 'WhatsApp 圖片上傳回應格式無效。');
    if (!uploaded || typeof uploaded.id !== 'string' || uploaded.id.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('WhatsApp 未確認圖片已上傳。');
    }

    const imageMessage = {
      messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
      recipient_type: 'individual',
      to,
      type: 'image',
      image: { id: uploaded.id }
    };
    if (typeof caption === 'string' && caption.trim()) {
      imageMessage.image.caption = caption.slice(0, 1024);
    }
    const sendResponse = await fetchImpl(
      `https://graph.facebook.com/${apiVersion}/${phoneNumberId}/messages`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(imageMessage)
      }
    );
    if (!sendResponse || sendResponse.ok !== true) {
      const status = sendResponse && Number.isInteger(sendResponse.status)
        ? sendResponse.status
        : 'unknown';
      throw new Error(`WhatsApp 收據轉發失敗（HTTP ${status}）。`);
    }
    const result = await parseJsonResponse(sendResponse, 'WhatsApp 收據轉發回應格式無效。');
    if (!result || !Array.isArray(result.messages) || typeof result.messages[0]?.id !== 'string') {

  }

module.exports = function createWhatsAppSenderWithMedia(options = {}) {
  const sender = createConfiguredSender(options);
  if (!sender) {
    return null;
  }
  const mediaMethods = createMediaMethods({
    apiVersion: options.apiVersion,
    phoneNumberId: options.phoneNumberId,
    accessToken: options.accessToken,

### File: `utils\whatsapp-order-parser.js`

```
'use strict';

const MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY = 1000;
const ITEM_SEPARATOR_PATTERN = /[,、;\n\r]+/;
const ITEM_PATTERN = /^(.+?)\s*(?:x|×|\*)\s*(\d+)$/i;

function normalizeCode(value) {
  return value.normalize('NFKC').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('en');
}

function failure(message, code) {
  return {
    success: false,
    data: null,
    message,
    error: { code }
  };
}

function parseWhatsAppOrderMessage(message, products) {
  try {
    if (typeof message !== 'string' || message.trim() === '') {
      return failure('請提供落單內容。', 'EMPTY_MESSAGE');
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(products)) {
      return failure('商品清單格式無效，未能驗證商品代號。', 'INVALID_CATALOG');
    }

    const productByCode = new Map();
    for (const product of products) {
      if (!product || typeof product.product_code !== 'string') {
        return failure('商品清單包含無效的商品代號。', 'INVALID_CATALOG');
      }

      const normalizedCode = normalizeCode(product.product_code);
      if (!normalizedCode) {
        return failure('商品清單包含空白的商品代號。', 'INVALID_CATALOG');
      }
      if (productByCode.has(normalizedCode)) {
        return failure(
          `商品代號「${product.product_code}」重複，無法唯一識別商品。`,
          'AMBIGUOUS_PRODUCT_CODE'
        );
      }

      productByCode.set(normalizedCode, product);
    }

    const normalizedMessage = message
      .normalize('NFKC')
      .replace(/[，]/g, ',')
      .replace(/[；]/g, ';')
      .trim();
    const segments = normalizedMessage
      .split(ITEM_SEPARATOR_PATTERN)
      .map(segment => segment.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

    if (segments.length === 0) {
      return failure('未找到有效的商品項目。', 'EMPTY_ITEMS');
    }

    const seenCodes = new Set();
    const items = [];

    for (const segment of segments) {
      const match = segment.match(ITEM_PATTERN);
      if (!match) {
        return failure(
          `格式無法辨識：「${segment}」。請使用「商品代號 x 數量」格式。`,
          'INVALID_ITEM_FORMAT'
        );
      }

      const suppliedCode = match[1].trim();
      const normalizedCode = normalizeCode(suppliedCode);
      if (!normalizedCode) {
        return failure('商品代號不可為空白。', 'EMPTY_PRODUCT_CODE');
      }

      const quantity = Number(match[2]);
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
        return failure(`商品「${suppliedCode}」的數量必須是正整數。`, 'INVALID_QUANTITY');
      }
      if (quantity > MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY) {
        return failure(
          `商品「${suppliedCode}」的數量不可多於 ${MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY}。`,
          'QUANTITY_EXCEEDED'
        );
      }

      if (seenCodes.has(normalizedCode)) {
        return failure(`商品「${suppliedCode}」重複出現，請合併數量後再提交。`, 'DUPLICATE_ITEM');
      }
      seenCodes.add(normalizedCode);

      const product = productByCode.get(normalizedCode);
      if (!product) {
        return failure(`找不到商品代號「${suppliedCode}」，請確認商品代號。`, 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND');
      }
      if (
        product.is_active === false ||
        ['inactive', 'archived', '已下架', '停用'].includes(product.status)
      ) {
        return failure(`商品「${product.product_code}」目前未有供應。`, 'PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE');
      }

      items.push({
        product_code: product.product_code,
        quantity
      });
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      data: { items },
      message: '落單內容已驗證，尚未建立訂單。'
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('解析 WhatsApp 落單訊息時發生未預期錯誤：', error);
    return failure('解析落單訊息時發生未預期錯誤。', 'PARSER_ERROR');
  }
}

module.exports = {
  MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY,
  parseWhatsAppOrderMessage
};
